Japanese.Text:
こいつは　エサじゃなくて
あいつらの寝床なんだ

English.Text: This stuff here ain't feed for the animals. It's their beddin'.

Japanese.Text:
ちゃんと乾かしてないと機嫌悪くてな
おいらの頭　かじってくるんだ

English.Text: When it ain't been dried enough, they get all bent outta shape─start peckin' at my head like it's a damn hay barrel!

Japanese.Text:
エサは常に補充しておかないとね
まるまる太らせると　高く売れるからさ

English.Text: It's important to make sure they've got plenty to eat. Need to be nice and plump so they fetch a high price!

Japanese.Text:
生まれた時からいっしょだった
相棒のチョコボが　死んじまったんだ

English.Text: Was with my bird since he was hatched. And now he's gone.

Japanese.Text: いい加減　前に進まないといけないのに

English.Text: I know I gotta "get it together" and move on...

Japanese.Text: なかなか　踏ん切りがつかないのさ

English.Text: ...But knowin' it and doin' it are...

Japanese.Text: ほう　こんなところにお客人かな？

English.Text: Well, I'll be. Not every day we get visitors.

Japanese.Text:
たまーに　ミッドガルやジュノンから
面白いガラクタが流れ着くんだ

English.Text: Every now and then some interesting junk floats in from Midgar or Junon.

Japanese.Text:
昔はここでも
魚が捕れたもんだけどねえ

English.Text: We used to go fishing here, you know. Oh, the memories...

Japanese.Text:
この港はもともと
ジュノン共和国が使っていたそうよ

English.Text: Apparently this port used to be bustling back in the republic days.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルが大変な状況らしいな

English.Text: I hear Midgar's a mess right now.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉爆破に続いて
巨大ハリケーン発生だって？

English.Text: Two reactors get bombed, and then they get hit by some freak cyclone?

Japanese.Text:
アバランチとウータイが組んで
破壊工作してるんだろ

English.Text: I dunno how Avalanche and Wutai did it, but they did it.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルが封鎖されると
俺の仕事もヤバいな

English.Text: I'm gonna have trouble making ends meet with Midgar on lockdown.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチってのは　何様だ
ぶっとばしてやりてえ

English.Text: Who do those Avalanche assholes think they are? Buncha jerks.

Japanese.Text:
カームの魔晄エネルギーは
どうなっちゃうんだろう

English.Text: It won't affect the mako pipeline, will it?

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルに用事があるのに
しばらく無理か～

English.Text: So much for all those errands I had to run in Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチに
カームも襲われたりしないよね

English.Text: Avalanche won't bomb us too, will they?

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとの戦争が始まったら
どうなっちゃうの

English.Text: What'll happen to us if another war really does break out?

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの七番プレートが
落ちたって　本当？

English.Text: You're telling me the Sector 7 plate, like, fell?

Japanese.Text:
『カームへようこそ！』なんて
期待すんじゃねえぞ

English.Text: If you're expectin' a friendly howdy-do, look elsewhere!

Japanese.Text:
現在は　ミッドガル事件への
対応が最優先！

English.Text: We have our hands full dealing with the refugees.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガル方面は封鎖中だ
不用意に街を出るな

English.Text: Midgar's under lockdown, so no point headin' up that way.

Japanese.Text:
現在のモンスター注意報は
危険警報状態だ

English.Text: The Kalm monster advisory level is currently at critical!

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガル方面から流出した
魔晄の影響で　グラスランドの
モンスターも暴れだしている

English.Text: The mako outflow from Midgar has stirred up the monster population, making them especially dangerous.

Japanese.Text: 街を出るのは禁止だ！

English.Text: Leaving town is strictly forbidden!

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと
今日デートするなんて不謹慎じゃない

English.Text: Um, is this really the time to be going out on a date?

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの事件　聞いたでしょ？

English.Text: You heard what happened in Midgar, right?

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉連続爆破にプレート落下
おまけに竜巻だろ？

English.Text: Some reactors were bombed, a plate fell, and then a tornado rolled through town.

Japanese.Text:
ってことは　つまり
世界が終わる運命ってことさ

English.Text: Taken all together, it's enough to suggest the whole world's coming to an end.

Japanese.Text:
ふ～ん　運命の日に
私を選んだってことね
いいじゃない　つきあってあげる

English.Text: So, what? The apocalypse comes and you decide you want to spend your final moments with me? Huh. That's weirdly romantic.

Japanese.Text:
おいおい　どうするオレ
まずいぞオレ

English.Text: This is a disaster... What am I supposed to do now?

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの起こした事件で
仕事がストップ

English.Text: All work's been put on hold because of that shit with Avalanche.

Japanese.Text:
あれもこれも　買ったばかり
飲み屋のツケも溜まってる

English.Text: And right after I went on that shopping spree too. Not to mention my tab...

Japanese.Text:
アバランチは立て替えてくれるのか
それとも　神羅に請求すりゃいいのか？

English.Text: Maybe I should try to get Avalanche to pay for it all. Or...I guess I could file a claim with Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
はあ～　空気がうめえ
アバランチ様のおかげで束の間の休日だ

English.Text: That sweet, fresh air... Hats off to Avalanche for the mandatory vacation.

Japanese.Text: せいいっぱい　楽しまねえとな

English.Text: Savor these brief respites.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルへのガタゴトロードは
ケツが痛くてたまらねえ

English.Text: When you can get off those pothole-riddled roads and give your sore behind a rest.

Japanese.Text: このイスは　揺れねえだけで最高だ

English.Text: Shinra really oughta do something about that.

Japanese.Text:
ほら　サボんないで
さっさと終わらせるよ！

English.Text: Hey, quit slacking! We haven't got all day.

Japanese.Text:
風車村を見に行きたい　ボク知ってるよ
共和国時代の廃墟なんだよね

English.Text: I wanna see the windmills! My teacher said that they're "remnants" from when the republic was still around.

Japanese.Text: 歴史の勉強にもなるしさ

English.Text: It'll be like a history field trip.

Japanese.Text: ガマンしなさい

English.Text: I'm sorry, buddy.

Japanese.Text: 遺跡めぐりのツアーが中止なんだ

English.Text: But all the windmill tours have been canceled.

Japanese.Text:
聞け弟よ　すげえカワイイ子がいたんだ
ピンクのスカートで　髪にはリボン！

English.Text: I just spied the cutest chick. Light pink dress, ribbon in her hair... I think I'm in love, man! Can't let this one get away.

Japanese.Text:
本当かい兄さん
僕も　腹筋ピッチピチの新顔発見！

English.Text: Seriously, bro? Well, I spotted a girl with the best physique I've ever seen!

Japanese.Text:
よ～し　新顔をチェックするぞ
モテない男同盟のために！

English.Text: Wow, I can't believe I missed her! As a founding member of the Singles Club, I should've been paying more attention!

Japanese.Text: その同盟　僕らふたりだけだけどね

English.Text: You do know we're the only ones in that club, right?

Japanese.Text:
でもさ　カワイイ子を発見したあとは
どうすりゃいいの？

English.Text: So, uh... What exactly are we supposed to do after we spot a cute chick?

Japanese.Text: 案ずるな　弟よ

English.Text: Fear not, brother!

Japanese.Text:
エレファダンクのように
ドカーンと当たってくだけろだ！

English.Text: All you gotta do is channel your inner elphadunk, then charge!

Japanese.Text:
じゃあ僕は　カームファングのように
まっしぐら作戦だ！

English.Text: Okay! I picture myself as more of a wolf, but I can do that!

Japanese.Text:
よ～し　モテない男同盟
解散の時は近い！

English.Text: That's the spirit! Say g'bye to single life and say hello to girls galore!

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルから避難してきたけど
大変だったよ

English.Text: God, it was a bitch and a half gettin' out here from Midgar.

Japanese.Text: 道も悪いし　モンスターもヤバくてさ

English.Text: The roads were a mess─not to mention all the monsters.

Japanese.Text:
あなたが急に
カームに避難しようなんて言うから

English.Text: Well, it was your bright idea to pack up and flee to Kalm!

Japanese.Text: どーすんのよ　これから

English.Text: So what're we supposed to do now!?

Japanese.Text: まあ　ゆっくりしていってくれよ

English.Text: Well, go ahead and make yourselves at home.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルに比べたら
仕事も娯楽も　なにもないけどな

English.Text: Though I imagine it'll take you some time to get used to life here in the sticks.

Japanese.Text:
工場長が新商品作るって言って
ここんとこ　ず～っと残業ですよ

English.Text: Been no end to the overtime ever since the boss decided to take on a buncha new orders.

Japanese.Text:
うちも　そんな感じですなあ
『カームこけし』で街おこしするって

English.Text: Yeah, it's the same with me. Making wooden dolls day in, day out.

Japanese.Text:
こっちは休みだよ
ミッドガル封鎖のおかげでな

English.Text: Meanwhile, we've all been forced to take leave 'cause of Midgar gettin' locked down.

Japanese.Text: 給料も出ない

English.Text: Unpaid leave.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄タンクのメーター
減ってるよな？

English.Text: The meter on the mako tank's clearly gone down.

Japanese.Text:
プレジデントの乗ったヘリが落ちて
ヤバイらしいぞ

English.Text: So the president died in a helicopter crash?

Japanese.Text:
アバランチ　やりすぎだよ
魔晄がなきゃ生活できないのに

English.Text: Avalanche's downright crazy. How the hell d'they expect us to live without mako!?

Japanese.Text:
ここにも竜巻がきたら
家が吹っ飛ぶよな？

English.Text: If a twister like that hit us, I could kiss my house goodbye.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの一味が
ミッドガルから逃亡中らしい

English.Text: I heard those Avalanche guys left Midgar and are on the run now.

Japanese.Text:
友達が心配だけど
全然電話つながらない　どうしよう

English.Text: I can't get a hold of my friend! What should I do? What if they're...

Japanese.Text:
神羅は　新社長が就任か
かっこいいのかな？

English.Text: So junior is the new president? I can't even remember what he looks like.

Japanese.Text:
うちの洗濯機　動かなくなっちゃったの
魔晄エネルギーが減ってるせいかな

English.Text: My washing machine's given up the ghost. You don't think it's got something to do with the drop in mako, do you?

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルから避難してきた人
けっこう　いるね

English.Text: It's honestly frightening how many people have evacuated from Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチ恨むわ～
神羅抜きじゃ暮らせないのに

English.Text: Oh, please. Does Avalanche really think we can get by without Shinra?

Japanese.Text:
新社長就任のウワサって知ってる？
プレジデント　病気で重体なんだって

English.Text: You know why Rufus had to step up, don't you? Everyone's saying it's 'cause his dad caught something─the man's on his deathbed.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルニュース放送局で言ってた

English.Text: The Midgar news broadcasts back it up.

Japanese.Text:
ま～た
おカタいラジオなんか聞いちゃって

English.Text: You're still listening to that crap? Wake up already!

Japanese.Text:
プレジデントは
アバランチに暗殺されたんだよ

English.Text: The president isn't sick; he was assassinated by Avalanche!

Japanese.Text: アンタの　その情報の出どころ

English.Text: According to your "sources" maybe.

Japanese.Text:
ウォール・マーケットラジオとかいう
あやしいやつでしょうが

English.Text: I wouldn't trust anything Wall Market Radio says.

Japanese.Text:
あの子　災害に
巻き込まれてないだろうね

English.Text: Just thinking about what might've happened to my family makes me sick.

Japanese.Text:
連絡してもかけ直せばかりで通じないし
本当に無事なんだろうか

English.Text: I've tried to contact them so many times now, but...nothing. I can only pray that they're safe.

Japanese.Text:
我らが魔晄炉視察団は　定期的に
ミッドガルの魔晄炉視察を実施してきた

English.Text: Our inspection team conducts routine surveys of Midgar's reactors─or we used to.

Japanese.Text:
だが　今期は魔晄炉爆破の影響で中止
はあ……行きたかったな　魔晄炉視察

English.Text: Goes without saying the bombings put a hard stop to all that. I live for the on-site work. Job's just not the same without it.

Japanese.Text:
オレさ　ついに
ネコ飼っちゃったんだよね

English.Text: It took me long enough, but I finally went and got myself a cat!

Japanese.Text: もう可愛くてさ　写真撮りまくり！

English.Text: He's so cute. My camera roll's filling up!

Japanese.Text:
わかるわかる　うちのワンコも可愛くて
もう毎日写真撮ってるよ

English.Text: I feel that. I'm the same way with my dog. I just gotta snap a pic of everything he does.

Japanese.Text:
そうだよね　同じ姿勢なのに
ついつい撮っちゃう

English.Text: I know, right? I swear I have, like, a million photos of Cactie.

Japanese.Text:
みんなも見る？
サボちゃんの写真　可愛いよ～

English.Text: Wanna see 'em? I'm telling you, she's adorable.

Japanese.Text:
ほんと　どこでサボテンダー拾ったの
この近くには　いないよね？

English.Text: How did you even get your hands on a cactuar? They're not local, right?

Japanese.Text:
遅い……遅すぎる　いや
俺が早すぎたのか？

English.Text: She's late. Too late... Or am I here too early?

Japanese.Text: １日前から待つのは　早すぎたか！

English.Text: Was getting here a day ahead of time overkill?

Japanese.Text:
今日こそ告白するからって
気合い入れすぎたか？　でも
週刊恋愛占いモテオとモテコには

English.Text: Maybe I got a little carried away with this whole proposal business... But the weekly horoscope was crystal clear!

Japanese.Text:
出会いを気長に待つべしって
書いてあったし

English.Text: "Preparation is key." How else am I supposed to interpret that?

Japanese.Text:
次は　見晴らし塔に登りたい
ミッドガルが見たい！

English.Text: I wanna go up the clock tower next! You can see Midgar from there.

Japanese.Text:
弐番と参番のプレートが無事なのか
確認しなくちゃ

English.Text: I gotta check to make sure Sectors 2 and 3 are alright!

Japanese.Text: あなたは本当にミッドガルが好きねえ

English.Text: Always looking out for your city, aren't you?

Japanese.Text:
将来はソルジャーになって
ミッドガルを守るんだもんね

English.Text: One day, I'll be telling everyone how you made it into SOLDIER.

Japanese.Text:
やったわ！
収穫祭の踊り子に選ばれたの

English.Text: Guess what!? I'm gonna get to dance in the harvest festival!

Japanese.Text:
すごいじゃないか
じゃあ　もう衣装は届いたの？

English.Text: Congratulations! Have you gotten your costume yet?

Japanese.Text: 見せてほしいな

English.Text: I'd love to see it.

Japanese.Text:
いいな～　早くわたしも
踊り子に選ばれたいな

English.Text: That's so cool! I hope I can be a dancer too when I grow up!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
カードゲーム　知ってる？

English.Text: Hey, Dad, have you heard of Queen's Blood?

Japanese.Text:
みんなやってるから
やりたいんだ　買ってよ

English.Text: All the kids at school are playin' it! You gotta buy it for me.

Japanese.Text:
よ～し　買ってあげよう
僕もやりたかったんだ

English.Text: Sure thing, son. Was thinking of givin' it a try myself.

Japanese.Text:
へへ　魔晄タンクちゃん
今日も可愛いなあ

English.Text: Hoho... Looking adorable as ever, my darling little mako tank.

Japanese.Text:
ここ　汚れてるな
いまキレイにしてあげるからね

English.Text: Oh no! You've got a bit of a stain. Don't worry, I'll take care of that for you.

Japanese.Text:
あのセンパイ　またタンクなでてるよ
いやいや　可愛いのはパイプだろ

English.Text: That weirdo's whispering sweet nothings to the mako tank again. Can't he see the pipes've got it going on?

Japanese.Text: この　磨かれたツヤがいいんだよな

English.Text: The way they glisten in the sunlight...

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉のある場所の土地は
やせてしまう

English.Text: Reactors are terrible for nearby farmlands.

Japanese.Text:
カームの魔晄は
ミッドガルから来てるんだ

English.Text: Which is why I'm glad we get our mako from Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
エネルギーだけ供給してもらうのが
いちばんいい

English.Text: Let them deal with the fallout while we reap the benefits.

Japanese.Text: さあ　元気よく行くよ！

English.Text: And don't forget to smile!

Japanese.Text: カウント　まちがえないでね

English.Text: Make sure you stay on the beat!

Japanese.Text: ようこそ　カーム・インをご利用ですか？

English.Text: Hello! Welcome to the Inn at Kalm.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ　どうぞごゆっくり

English.Text: Please, make yourself at home.

Japanese.Text: いってらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Safe travels!

Japanese.Text:
カーム・インのご利用
ありがとうございました

English.Text: We hope you found your stay with us refreshing.

Japanese.Text:
お客様が心地よく過ごせるように
念入りに掃除しておかないと

English.Text: I need to keep this place looking spick-and-span. Don't wanna let Broden down.

Japanese.Text:
掃除だけはうまいって
ブロードさんにも　ほめられたんだから

English.Text: Especially after he insisted I focus exclusively on cleaning!

Japanese.Text:
現在　ミッドガルは
かつてない危機にさらされています

English.Text: Of course, this is only the most recent in a series of crises.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉爆破事件
七番プレート崩壊につづき

English.Text: Multiple reactor bombings, followed by the fall of the Sector 7 plate...

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガル・ハイウェイに
突如発生した竜巻が

English.Text: culminating in this unprecedented destruction...

Japanese.Text:
零番街から　弐番街にいたる区画に
甚大な被害をもたらしました

English.Text: caused by a massive tornado, which swept through Sectors 0, 1, and 2.

Japanese.Text:
ドミノ市長と市当局は
神羅カンパニーの助言を得て

English.Text: After a briefing with Shinra investigators, Mayor Domino released a statement...

Japanese.Text:
この竜巻は　反神羅勢力
『アバランチ』による

English.Text: declaring the tornado to be, quote, "weather warfare..."

Japanese.Text:
未知の兵器を使った攻撃である
という見解を発表しました

English.Text: perpetrated by the infamous insurgent group known as Avalanche.

Japanese.Text:
現在停戦中の
ウータイの関与も視野に入れて
引き続き　調査するとのことです

English.Text: The administration also suspects the involvement of Wutai─and has begun investigations into the matter.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉爆破とか　プレート落下とか
ミッドガルはどうなっちまうんだろうな

English.Text: Between the reactor bombings and a whole plate falling, hard to see how Midgar'll ever be the same.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイと神羅の戦争が始まったら
カームは前線基地だ

English.Text: If Wutai really does declare war, Kalm'll be in the crosshairs.

Japanese.Text: 巻き込まれるかもな

English.Text: Where would we go?

Japanese.Text:
カームのワインは繊細です
些細なことで　すぐに味が落ちてしまう

English.Text: Kalm's wine grapes are very delicate. The slightest change in conditions and bam─your crop is ruined.

Japanese.Text:
このご時世では
苦みが増すでしょうな

English.Text: Feels like every new vintage has been more bitter than the last.

Japanese.Text:
渋みにまで至るやもしれん
いやはや　心配です

English.Text: Might even get to the point where I can't choke it down. That'd be a crying shame.

Japanese.Text:
ついに手に入れたのよ
欲しかったレアカード！

English.Text: I finally got my hands on that super rare card I've been after!

Japanese.Text: ほほう　やりましたねえ

English.Text: Wow! Congratulations!

Japanese.Text:
これでまた
理想のデッキに近づいたのでは？

English.Text: Now you're one step closer to creating your ideal deck.

Japanese.Text: どこで手に入れたんだ？

English.Text: So, where'd you get it?

Japanese.Text:
もちろんグラスランドのカードハウスよ
裏ルートで　特別に仕入れてもらったの

English.Text: At that specialty shop out in the grasslands, of course. The owner used his "special connections" to get it for me.

Japanese.Text:
コスモキャニオンの
カクテル言葉を知っているかい？

English.Text: Know what the Cosmo Canyon cocktail symbolizes?

Japanese.Text:
『運命の星はそこにある』
君が僕のスターってことさ

English.Text: The guiding star of destiny─that's what you mean to me. My glorious goddess.

Japanese.Text:
え～　ホント～？
わたしが　お星様ってこと？

English.Text: Really? So does that mean I'm your "one and only"?

Japanese.Text: このわたしを　口説いてるの～？

English.Text: Or are you just giving me the same line you give all the girls?

Japanese.Text:
僕がコスモキャニオンを頼むのは
特別な出会いを感じたときだけさ

English.Text: Heh... I only order a Cosmo Canyon when I know I've met someone truly special.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　遅刻遅刻！
ニュース聞いてたら遅れちゃったよ

English.Text: Crap, I'm gonna be so late! That's what I get for keeping up with the news.

Japanese.Text:
神羅は社長交代だって
景気よくなるといいねえ

English.Text: Shinra's getting a new president, huh? Hope he does something for the economy.

Japanese.Text: カームに避難してきたのか？

English.Text: Came here to escape the chaos?

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとこのまま戦争突入なんて
勘弁してくれよ

English.Text: Please tell me this won't rekindle the war with Wutai. That's the last thing we need.

Japanese.Text: アバランチ　早く捕まるといいよな

English.Text: I hope they catch those Avalanche guys soon.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルが封鎖されてるって
ほんと？

English.Text: Did they really lock down the whole city?

Japanese.Text: 今日は多めに買い物　買い物っと

English.Text: Might be time to start hoarding supplies.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチ？
ネズミ被害のほうが困るのよ

English.Text: Avalanche? I'm worried about the poor rats caught in the cross fire.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガル　いま大変なの？

English.Text: Hey, do you know what's going on in Midgar?

Japanese.Text:
聞いてよ　もう
洗濯機が動いてなかったのよ

English.Text: My washing machine crapped out on me again. Can you believe it?

Japanese.Text: 竜巻の影響かしら　天気が不安定よね

English.Text: I wonder if this crazy weather had anything to do with that tornado.

Japanese.Text: そろそろ買い替え時かねえ

English.Text: Guess it's time I bought a new one.

Japanese.Text:
そりゃ　ミッドガルからの
魔晄が減ってるからよ

English.Text: It's not your machine; it's the mako pipeline!

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの連中が
魔晄炉を爆破したから

English.Text: The town's been runnin' on fumes since those terrorist attacks.

Japanese.Text:
えっ　うちの洗濯物が汚れたままなのは
そのアバランチってやつらのせいなの？

English.Text: So it's Avalanche's fault I have to keep wearing dirty underwear? Those absolute monsters!

Japanese.Text:
どっちにせよ
旦那に新しいのを買わせるチャンスよ

English.Text: Either way... It's a good excuse to get your husband to buy you a new one!

Japanese.Text:
いまでは　なんでもかんでも
魔晄エネルギーで動く

English.Text: Technology sure has come a long way since our younger days.

Japanese.Text: 便利な世の中になったものだ

English.Text: Hard to think we got by without mako.

Japanese.Text:
神羅が魔晄を送ってくれるからですねえ
感謝しないと

English.Text: Honestly, I don't know where we'd be without Shinra. Life is so much better now.

Japanese.Text:
田舎だと思ってたけど　いいなあカーム
もうここに住んじまおうかな

English.Text: You know, I thought Kalm was some hick town in the middle of nowhere. Surprised it's actually kinda liveable.

Japanese.Text:
でさ　ここにも
蜜蜂の館とか　ある？

English.Text: So...you guys got anything here like the Honeybee Inn?

Japanese.Text: ねえよ　酒場で我慢しとけって

English.Text: Why don't you just stick to regular bars for now?

Japanese.Text:
踊り子に貢ぎまくって
借金取りに追われてるの知ってるんだぞ

English.Text: The Honeybee Inn is the whole reason you're out here, man. You wanna rack up more debt?

Japanese.Text:
スキルブックってのは
俺には無理だよな

English.Text: Those folios are too much for me. Can't understand them at all.

Japanese.Text:
ああ～……
『サボテン大王』は売り切れか

English.Text: Ahhh... Cactuar King's completely sold out? Lame.

Japanese.Text:
ここは　魔導書店マグナタの
１号店なんだよ

English.Text: This is where it all began─the first Maghnata Books.

Japanese.Text:
店長さんの衣装は
星命学の学者風らしいわ

English.Text: Judging from that outfit, the manager's really into planetology.

Japanese.Text:
ここは　全国展開されています
魔導書店『マグナタ』の１号店です

English.Text: Here we have the very first Maghnata Books, which has since grown into a worldwide chain.

Japanese.Text:
コスモキャニオン発祥の
星命学を起源とする

English.Text: It is their mission to spread knowledge of planetology...

Japanese.Text:
難解なスキルブックの知見を
民衆に広めようと努力を続けている
歴史ある本屋さんです

English.Text: through the distribution of their trademark folios, in the hopes of creating a brighter future for people everywhere.

Japanese.Text:
初代の店長さんは引退され　現在は
お弟子さんが経営を引き継いでいます

English.Text: The original manager of this historic location has since retired, leaving it in the care of one of his pupils.

Japanese.Text:
こちらは
武器屋『セルヴァカーサ』です

English.Text: And here we have the weapon shop, Selvacarsa.

Japanese.Text:
グラスランドのモンスターに
負けないように　カームの熟練の職人が
鍛錬した武器がそろっています

English.Text: Our blacksmiths work endlessly to supply the people of Kalm with arms to defend themselves and their homes.

Japanese.Text:
お土産にひとつ
護身用に　もうひとつ

English.Text: Why not browse their wares─maybe take home a souvenir?

Japanese.Text: お買い上げになってはいかがでしょうか

English.Text: The craftsmanship is second to none!

Japanese.Text:
こちらは　グラスランドの眺望を
一望できる　見晴らし塔です

English.Text: Kalm's iconic clock tower provides a commanding view of the surrounding grasslands.

Japanese.Text:
塔の上で告白したカップルは
結ばれるという伝承もあり

English.Text: Local legend claims that a proposal made at the top is sure to be accepted...

Japanese.Text:
恋人たちに人気の
デートスポットとなっています

English.Text: so─naturally─it's become one of the most popular date spots.

Japanese.Text:
永遠の幸せを願いながら
広大な世界の風を　感じてみてください

English.Text: After all, what could be more romantic than standing atop the world and professing your undying love?

Japanese.Text:
このあたりは
カームのご家庭の食卓を彩る市場です

English.Text: And here's the market that furnishes our dinner tables with the freshest produce.

Japanese.Text:
朝は　採れたての野菜が並ぶ
朝市が開催されています

English.Text: It opens early in the morning with the very first shipment of local vegetables.

Japanese.Text:
お昼は　素朴な味のランチを楽しむ
お客様でにぎわい

English.Text: Visit in the afternoon to be treated to some of the best lunches in Kalm...

Japanese.Text:
夕方には　家族の晩ごはんを
作る人たちが　多く訪れます

English.Text: then swing by in the evening to spend time with the locals picking up ingredients for supper.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルやジュノンとはひと味違う
栄養満点の　新鮮な食材で作られる

English.Text: Finally, finish off your day with a hearty Kalm meal that'll leave you raring for a new day of sightseeing.

Japanese.Text:
故郷の料理を味わってみては
いかがでしょうか

English.Text: You won't find anything like it in Midgar or Junon!

Japanese.Text:
この魔晄タンクは　カームの
日々の生活を支えています

English.Text: This mako tank allows us to live in comfort, with every modern convenience.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄エネルギーは　地面の下や
地上を通る大きなパイプを通じて
ミッドガルから供給されています

English.Text: Our supply of mako comes to us all the way from the great city of Midgar, through a giant pipe that travels both above- and belowground.

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代の給水塔を
モチーフにした形状となっており

English.Text: The tank itself is modeled after Kalm's old republic-era water tower...

Japanese.Text:
カームを象徴する
モニュメントのひとつです

English.Text: and is one of our town's most famous landmarks.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボみたいに可愛い恋人が
できたんだって？

English.Text: Landed yourself a cutie, huh? Congrats.

Japanese.Text: 俺にも紹介してくれよ

English.Text: You gotta introduce me.

Japanese.Text: チョコボみたいじゃなくて

English.Text: I wouldn't call 'im a "cutie."

Japanese.Text:
カームファングみたいな
かっこいい彼氏だよ

English.Text: He's more dashing. Like a wolf.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　彼氏？
なんだ　そうだったのか
おめでとう

English.Text: Oh. Hey, that's great, man. I'm glad you found the one for you. Seriously, congratulations.

Japanese.Text:
最近　カームコケシ作り始めたから
いい感じに稼げてるんだ

English.Text: Damn... Who knew there was so much gil to be made in this wooden doll business?

Japanese.Text:
おお　コケシ！
うちのかみさんも買ってたな
可愛いってよ

English.Text: Get out─you make those? My wife picked one up recently. Said it's the cutest!

Japanese.Text:
あれが可愛いのか……
夢で　あれに追いかけられて怖いんだ

English.Text: "Cute," huh? I'd say they look like the stuff of nightmares, but to each their own.

Japanese.Text:
また面接落ちたよ
２７回目　もう嫌になるよ

English.Text: That's the twenty-seventh time I've bombed the interview... I'm never gonna get the job at this rate!

Japanese.Text: いったい　なにが悪いんだよ

English.Text: I just wish I knew what I was doing wrong.

Japanese.Text:
こっちで林業継げば　安定してるし
あんなにかわいい嫁もいるのに

English.Text: Why are you so hung up on getting a job in Midgar? Just take over your family's business.

Japanese.Text:
どうして　ミッドガルの仕事に
こだわるのよ

English.Text: Besides, you've already built up a life here.

Japanese.Text:
オレは蜜蜂になりたいんだ
キレイな　蜜蜂になりたいんだよ！

English.Text: No! I've dreamt of being a honeyboy my entire life, and I'm not gonna give up now!

Japanese.Text:
ぼく　大きくなったら
神羅のソルジャーになるんだ

English.Text: When I grow up, I'm gonna be a SOLDIER and fight bad guys!

Japanese.Text:
そのために　いまから
モウクンレンしてるんだ！

English.Text: So I gotta start training hard now or I'll never make it!

Japanese.Text:
お兄ちゃん　子供っぽくて
わたし　恥ずかしい

English.Text: Ugh, I hate when he talks like that. It's so embarrassing.

Japanese.Text:
きれいな空気　どこまでも広い空
プレートがないだけで　この解放感！

English.Text: Breathe in that fresh air! Take in the never-ending sky! Goodbye Midgar, hello freedom.

Japanese.Text:
ここなら彼氏とケンカ別れしたこと
忘れられそうね

English.Text: This is just what I needed to put that creep behind me.

Japanese.Text: そうそう　アイツ

English.Text: Ugh, that absolute pig...

Japanese.Text:
まさか私も振るなんてありえないわ
ホント

English.Text: I can't believe he dumped both of us! The nerve!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　あんたもアイツと付き合ってたの
そんな話　聞いたことないんですけど！

English.Text: Wait, you were dating him too? How am I only finding out about this now!? What the hell!?

Japanese.Text: しまった　これ秘密だったわ

English.Text: Oh crap. I wasn't supposed to tell you that part.

Japanese.Text:
このまえ　道に迷って
物見やぐらまで行ったら

English.Text: Took a wrong turn the other day and wound up at the lookout on the cliff.

Japanese.Text:
盗賊団みたいなのに追いかけられて
大変だったよ

English.Text: It was crawling with bandits. Do not recommend.

Japanese.Text: 相変わらず方向音痴ね

English.Text: You gotta pay more attention to where you're going.

Japanese.Text:
このまえも農場に行こうとして
船着き場に行っちゃって
モンスターに追いかけられてたじゃない

English.Text: I'll never forget the time you set off for the farms and somehow wound up at the swamp, surrounded by monsters.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　空の鳥を眺めながら歩いてると
変なとこいっちゃうんだよなあ

English.Text: Yeah, you think I would've learned by now that staring up at the sky as I walk is a recipe for disaster.

Japanese.Text:
『我はカイルゲイト伯爵！
　見よ　この凛々しくそそり立つ壁を』

English.Text: "I am Baron Kylegate! Behold the towering wall that I have built!"

Japanese.Text: 『ああ　カームの未来は幸いなり！』

English.Text: "The future of Kalm is bright indeed!"

Japanese.Text: いや　こうじゃないな

English.Text: No, no! That won't do at all.

Japanese.Text:
カーム歌劇団のために
もっと　いい話を書かないとな

English.Text: We'll never draw crowds to the theater with hackneyed drivel like this.

Japanese.Text:
おはよう　みんな集まったら
今日はなにする？

English.Text: Morning! Whaddaya wanna do today once everyone gets here?

Japanese.Text:
昨日『追いかけラット』やったから
今日は『くすぐりオーガ』やるって
決めたじゃん

English.Text: We're gonna play Hide-and-Tickle today 'cause we played Rat Race yesterday. Right?

Japanese.Text:
そうそう！
集まったらオーガ決めないとね

English.Text: We are, don't worry! We'll decide who's "it" when the others come.

Japanese.Text:
週末にミッドガルでイベントだったのに
封鎖なんて

English.Text: I was really looking forward to going into Midgar this weekend...

Japanese.Text:
マテリアイスの大食い大会
今度こそ　全制覇狙ってたの

English.Text: That materia pop eating contest was my chance to try the flavors I haven't yet.

Japanese.Text:
来週なら限定タイタンアイスが出るから
それまで待つと思えばいいんじゃない？

English.Text: What about next week? They're bringing back that limited edition Titan pop. You liked that one, didn't you?

Japanese.Text:
あれ　大きすぎてお腹いっぱいになるの
マテリアイス全制覇できなくなるのよね

English.Text: Thing is, I gotta finish it, but that one's so big that by the time I have, I'll be way too full to try any of the other types.

Japanese.Text:
そういえばさ　モーグリ書店が出してる
『サボテン大王』の新作読んだ？

English.Text: Oh my god, tell me you've read the latest issue of Cactuar King. It's legit amazing!

Japanese.Text: うそ　『サボ大』の新作出てたの？

English.Text: What!? No one told me that was out already!

Japanese.Text:
えっえっ　じゃあ
サボーン七世はどうなったの？

English.Text: Oh, man... I've gotta know what happens to Cacter the Seventh!

Japanese.Text:
貸したげるからあんたも読んで
あっ　みんなにネタバレ厳禁だからね！

English.Text: No worries, I'll lend you my copy. Oh, but don't spoil anything for other people, 'kay?

Japanese.Text: 息子がミッドガルで働いてる

English.Text: My boy and I had a big falling-out.

Japanese.Text:
ケンカ別れしちまったが
プロの歌手になって成功したって聞いた

English.Text: He moved to Midgar because of it. Word is he's a well-known singer now...

Japanese.Text:
やっと『月刊ミステリック』
買えたんだ～！

English.Text: I finally got my hands on the new issue of Mysteryc!

Japanese.Text: ほら　見てよ

English.Text: Pretty cool, isn't it?

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代の戦車や風車が
きれいに載ってる！

English.Text: It's got pics of republic tanks, and windmills, and─everything!

Japanese.Text: 遺跡の写真集なんて見て楽しいか？

English.Text: You like lookin' at rusted hunks of crap?

Japanese.Text:
『週刊チョコボーイ』じゃ
チョコボグラビアなんてのもあるんだぞ

English.Text: Chocoboy Weekly is way better. Check out these sweet birds!

Japanese.Text: いいんです～

English.Text: Yeah, no thanks.

Japanese.Text:
可愛いものより　古いもの
歴史が感じられるものがいいのよ

English.Text: I'll take historic, educational artifacts over cheap cutesy crap every time.

Japanese.Text:
はあ　いつかコスモキャニオンに
旅行にいきたいわ～

English.Text: One of these days I gotta make it out to Cosmo Canyon...

Japanese.Text:
居眠りするヒマもない
労働の日々だ

English.Text: Barely had time to squeeze in a nap, we were so busy.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　きみが毎月稼ぐ金を
１日で稼いでいたぞ

English.Text: Though it paid well enough. One day's earnings were about what an average man makes in a month.

Japanese.Text:
うひょ　うらやましいだろ
名刺いるか　うん？

English.Text: Well? Jealous? I'll bet you want my business card now, don't you?

Japanese.Text: 景気はどうですかな

English.Text: So, what's new with you?

Japanese.Text:
私のほうは　息子に譲った
コスタに出してるホテルが順調でして

English.Text: As for me, the hotel I left my son in Costa del Sol seems to be doing well.

Japanese.Text: おお　いいですな

English.Text: Well, that's excellent news!

Japanese.Text:
私はチョコボレースに投資しようかと
計画中です

English.Text: Personally, I'm thinking of investing in a chocobo racing team.

Japanese.Text:
ほう　チョコボ遊びなら
ファームまるごと買っちゃうほうが
安いかもしれませんな

English.Text: If it's chocobos you're interested in, you'd be better off buying a ranch of your own. That's where the real money's at.

Japanese.Text:
地元のチェリーと
チョコレートを使ったお菓子よ

English.Text: Our candy uses locally produced cherries and chocolate!

Japanese.Text: どうぞ　試食していって！

English.Text: Free samples available!

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルアレンジもあるわよ

English.Text: We've got Midgar-style too!

Japanese.Text:
甘～い甘～いシロップだけど
ノンカロリー！

English.Text: They're as sweet as can be, all with zero calories!

Japanese.Text:
チョコボが作った
不思議なコーヒーはいかがですか？

English.Text: You won't find coffee like this anywhere else, I guarantee!

Japanese.Text:
不思議なチョコボコーヒーで
ステキなひとときを

English.Text: Try a relaxing cup of coffee─made by chocobos!

Japanese.Text:
チョコボコーヒーのウワサ
知ってる？

English.Text: You heard the rumors about this "chocoffee" stuff?

Japanese.Text: えっ　なになに？

English.Text: No! Do tell.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボに
サラハの実を噛ませて作るんだって

English.Text: It's made from saraha nuts chewed by chocobos.

Japanese.Text:
それって　まさか……
やだ　もう飲めないじゃない！

English.Text: That's... That's disgusting! Oh my god, I'm never drinking this crap again!

Japanese.Text:
やっと入れたね～
ホント　今日は混んでる

English.Text: Finally, we're in. It's crowded today.

Japanese.Text: こんな日だけど

English.Text: So, um...

Japanese.Text:
この塔の上で告白をすれば
幸せな結婚ができるって逸話は
変わらないよ

English.Text: They say if you go to the top and tell someone how you feel, you'll live happily ever after.

Japanese.Text:
おっと　わたし違うから
告白はナシね

English.Text: Sorry, but, uh, I don't really believe in that kinda stuff.

Japanese.Text:
カームこけし
カームこけしはいらんかえ～！

English.Text: Need something for the kids? How 'bout a handmade wooden doll?

Japanese.Text:
恋愛成就間違いなしの　グラスランドの
天然木材を使った民芸品だ

English.Text: All natural! Made from local wood! Guaranteed to bring you closer to that special someone too!

Japanese.Text:
開運　縁結び　家内安全
ご利益は本物だよ！

English.Text: Brings you good luck and keeps you safe to boot! There's nothing this doll can't do!

Japanese.Text:
カームこけし
お土産にぜひ買っていって！

English.Text: Sold only in Kalm─the perfect souvenir!

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルは　大変らしいじゃない
反神羅のアバランチが暴れてるんでしょ

English.Text: I heard this "Avalanche" is tearing Midgar to pieces. What has the world come to?

Japanese.Text:
それよりも　アタシの隣のお屋敷
夜な夜な変な声が聞こえるのよ

English.Text: Forget about that! I've been hearing the most disturbing noises from the mansion next door at night.

Japanese.Text: オバケでも出るのかしら

English.Text: I wonder if it's haunted.

Japanese.Text:
あらまあ
そっちのほうが気になるわね

English.Text: Goodness! I'd certainly be much more concerned about that.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボフレーバーの
アイスはいかがですか？

English.Text: Cool off with some chocobo ice cream!

Japanese.Text:
グラスランド農場直送の
濃厚ミルクで作ってまーす！

English.Text: Our ice cream is made with fresh milk straight from the local farms!

Japanese.Text: おまけにラサンの実もまぜるわよ～！

English.Text: Topped with a generous helping of lasan nuts!

Japanese.Text:
ふわふわ　とろっとろクリームの
モーグリまんじゅう！

English.Text: Moogle buns! Get your piping hot moogle buns!

Japanese.Text:
ポンポンまで
クリームたっぷりだよ～！

English.Text: Even the fluffy pom is packed with cream!

Japanese.Text:
いっしょに食べたら幸せになる
モーグリまんじゅうはいかが～？

English.Text: Come share a moogle bun with that special someone! You won't regret it!

Japanese.Text: これ　いくらだ？

English.Text: How much is this one here?

Japanese.Text:
こういうのも
持ってたほうがいいんだろうな

English.Text: Yeah, I better pick me up one of these.

Japanese.Text: おっ　いいわねこの剣！

English.Text: Mm, this one looks sharp.

Japanese.Text:
弾の補充に　整備用の油
物騒だから予備も……と

English.Text: Extra bullets, a couple cans of oil... Gotta be prepared for anything these days.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ運送の荷物
お届けでーす

English.Text: Chocobo Express! Delivery!

Japanese.Text: お待たせしました　っと

English.Text: Got a package with your name on it!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　いいねえ！

English.Text: Yeah, looking good!

Japanese.Text: はい　笑顔ちょうだい！

English.Text: Okay, say cheese!

Japanese.Text: 最高だよ！

English.Text: That's perfect!

Japanese.Text: きれいだ　いいよ～

English.Text: Beautiful. You got it!

Japanese.Text: ふふふっ

English.Text: Ahaha.

Japanese.Text: うふふ

English.Text: Hehe.

Japanese.Text: どうかな？

English.Text: This okay?

Japanese.Text: 疲れる～

English.Text: I need a break!

Japanese.Text: こんなのはどう？

English.Text: Whaddya think?

Japanese.Text: あっははは！

English.Text: Hahaha!

Japanese.Text: いいだろ

English.Text: Am I good or what?

Japanese.Text: はい　ポーズ！

English.Text: How's this pose?

Japanese.Text: いいよ～　ステキ！

English.Text: Yeah, that's the stuff!

Japanese.Text: どうやるの？

English.Text: What do I press?

Japanese.Text: こうかな？

English.Text: Like this?

Japanese.Text: あっ　ピンボケ……

English.Text: Ah! Out of focus...

Japanese.Text:
ほら　あれが見晴らし塔よ
あそこからならミッドガルが見れるわ

English.Text: Look, sweetheart─there's the clock tower. We should be able to see all the way to Midgar from up there.

Japanese.Text:
すごーい！
ミッドガルの絵　早く描きたい

English.Text: It's so tall! I wanna draw a picture of Midgar. Come on!

Japanese.Text: うひょ　名刺が欲しい？

English.Text: What's that? You...want my business card?

Japanese.Text:
わしは神羅の宇宙開発部門で
働いてたんだ

English.Text: I was a supervisor in Shinra's Space and Aeronautics Division.

Japanese.Text: ロケット開発で毎日忙しくてな

English.Text: We worked day and night developing new rockets.

Japanese.Text: 新鮮な食材を仕入れるぞ～

English.Text: There's so much fresh produce to choose from!

Japanese.Text: さて　今日はなにを買おうかな

English.Text: Hmm... What looks good today?

Japanese.Text: ええと　今日のオススメはなに？

English.Text: Hard to choose... Anything you'd recommend?

Japanese.Text:
よし　野菜は買った
あとは　肉とチーズだな

English.Text: Okay, good on produce. Just need to grab some meat and cheese.

Japanese.Text:
市場はいいよな～
野菜のかおりが気持ちいい！

English.Text: I love the smell of fresh vegetables. There's nothing like it.

Japanese.Text:
イフリートオイルが特売だから
買いに行かなきゃね

English.Text: I'd better stock up on Ifrit oil while it's still on sale.

Japanese.Text: 次はあの店で仕入れて　っと

English.Text: Oh, that shop looks promising.

Japanese.Text: 今日のサラダは　なににしようかな

English.Text: I always have a hard time deciding what I want.

Japanese.Text:
う～ん　これも安いあれも安い
買いすぎ注意ね

English.Text: All these sales are so gosh darn tempting, but I gotta watch how much I spend.

Japanese.Text: さて　今日もお店をめぐりますか！

English.Text: What hidden treasures will I find in the shops today?

Japanese.Text: 肉を買うならうちの店だ　安いぞ！

English.Text: You won't find any meat cheaper than mine! See for yourself!

Japanese.Text:
どの部位もオススメ！
ぜんぶ買ってくのもいいぜ

English.Text: All kinds of cuts, all very good! Buy 'em while you can!

Japanese.Text: さあ　らっしゃいらっしゃい！

English.Text: Have a drink or take it to go!

Japanese.Text:
カーム名物
カームビアで乾杯しましょう！

English.Text: Try a pint of Kalm's finest! You'll never go back!

Japanese.Text: 大人気のランドサンドはいかがですか？

English.Text: Come grab a sandwich before they're all sold out!

Japanese.Text: 野菜たっぷり　ランドサンドだよ！

English.Text: Each one is loaded with the freshest veggies around!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　寄ってらっしゃい
見てらっしゃい！

English.Text: Come on down, and browse our wares at your leisure!

Japanese.Text: 安いよ　安いよー！

English.Text: Bargain prices, right here!

Japanese.Text:
見るだけならタダ！
どうぞ　お手に取ってみて～

English.Text: You're welcome to look and touch! Take all the time you need!

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい　どうぞ見ていって！

English.Text: Welcome! Feel free to look around.

Japanese.Text: 今日は　なんにしますか？

English.Text: What're you lookin' for today?

Japanese.Text: はい　みなさん寄っていって！

English.Text: Come on over and see what we've got!

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい　アイテム屋で～す！

English.Text: Hello and welcome to my humble shop!

Japanese.Text: しっかり準備していってね

English.Text: Stock up on whatever you need!

Japanese.Text: さあ　選んで選んで！

English.Text: Go on. Take a look around!

Japanese.Text: またのご利用　お待ちしてま～す！

English.Text: Thanks. Hope to see you again soon!

Japanese.Text: ありがとうございました～！

English.Text: Thank you so much!

Japanese.Text: バイバ～イ　また来てね！

English.Text: You have yourself a wonderful day!

Japanese.Text:
お姉さんが　いつも元気だから
通っちゃうんだよな

English.Text: This place has great customer service. It's my go-to.

Japanese.Text: フフフ　私はただの冷やかしです

English.Text: Heh heh heh... Don't mind me. I'm just window-shopping.

Japanese.Text:
自動販売機より
ここで買うほうが好きなのよ

English.Text: Vending machines don't have that personal touch, you know?

Japanese.Text: ポーションの予備を買っておこうかしら

English.Text: Maybe I should grab some potions.

Japanese.Text: グラスランドの採れたて野菜だよ！

English.Text: All my vegetables are locally sourced!

Japanese.Text: 農場直送の　あま～い果物もあるよ

English.Text: Don't pass up these succulent fruits straight from the orchard!

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの港から仕入れた魚だよ

English.Text: Fresh fish from Junon harbor! Right here!

Japanese.Text: 焼いてもよし　煮てもよし！

English.Text: Good grilled, baked, or fried!

Japanese.Text:
摩訶不思議な
カームピザはいかがっすか？

English.Text: How about a slice of Kalm's mystery pizza?

Japanese.Text:
とろとろチーズに　ピリ辛ソース
クセになるよ！

English.Text: Just one bite and you'll find yourself running back for more!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　見ていって！
お得な品がいっぱいよ～

English.Text: Household goods! We've got everything you need!

Japanese.Text: 役に立つ品がそろってるよ～！

English.Text: All the essentials at bargain prices!

Japanese.Text: 焼きたてのパンはいかがですか～？

English.Text: Fresh bread─straight from the oven!

Japanese.Text: お弁当に　サンドイッチもあります！

English.Text: We've got plenty of sandwiches and lunches too!

Japanese.Text: グラスランドで育ったお肉たちだよ！

English.Text: Locally raised beef and pork right here!

Japanese.Text:
今日は家族で
厚切りステーキはどうだい？

English.Text: Treat your family to some nice, juicy steaks tonight!

Japanese.Text:
散歩をすると
気持ちが落ち着きますよね

English.Text: Nothing like a leisurely stroll to clear your head.

Japanese.Text: この静けさが　カームの日常なんです

English.Text: This tranquility is what makes Kalm, Kalm.

Japanese.Text: ああ　今日も風が気持ちいいな

English.Text: Ahhh... There's a nice breeze today.

Japanese.Text:
外でなにがあっても
カームの壁の中は安全と信じたい

English.Text: No matter what happens outside these walls, I know we'll be safe in Kalm.

Japanese.Text:
ここの景色が
お気に入りなんですよ

English.Text: I can never get enough of this view.

Japanese.Text:
ゆるやかに流れる時間
好きなんです

English.Text: I love how time almost seems to stop here.

Japanese.Text: あら　今日は花のかおりがここまで

English.Text: The scent of flowers on the wind is simply divine.

Japanese.Text: すてきな出会いがありますように

English.Text: Maybe today I'll meet the person of my dreams.

Japanese.Text: カームに引っ越してきて良かった～

English.Text: Moving here was the best decision of my life.

Japanese.Text:
平和な日々が続くようにって
祈るんです

English.Text: I pray these peaceful days last forever.

Japanese.Text: ふ～ん　ふふ～ん

English.Text: Hmmm-hm-hmmm♪

Japanese.Text: 宿屋のブロードさん　調子悪そうね

English.Text: Is it just me, or is Broden not doing so well?

Japanese.Text: 最近　体調が良くないらしいわ

English.Text: I think he's been under the weather recently.

Japanese.Text:
あなた　彼のファンだったわよね
寂しそうな笑顔がステキとかなんとか

English.Text: Didn't you used to have a crush on him? Said his eyes looked "sad when he smiled," or something?

Japanese.Text: あら　主人には内緒にしてよ

English.Text: Oh gosh, don't tell my husband.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルもうでは　いかがでした
いつもの蜜蜂の館には行きましたか？

English.Text: So, how was your trip to Midgar? Did you hit up the Honeybee Inn like you always do?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　すげえステージだった
金髪の踊り子のダンスがキレキレでさ

English.Text: Yeah, you should've been there, man. This blonde dude slayed the stage like I've never seen before.

Japanese.Text:
女装して
コルネオの屋敷に行っちまったけど

English.Text: Then they beat his mug and sent him to Corneo's place.

Japanese.Text: いまごろ　どうなってんだろうな

English.Text: Hope he made it outta there in one piece.

Japanese.Text:
戦争が始まるかもって噂ですけど
どうします

English.Text: I dunno, man. Everyone's saying that another war might break out.

Japanese.Text: 蜜蜂の館ツアー　やめにします？

English.Text: D'you think we oughta cancel our Honeybee Inn trip?

Japanese.Text:
こんなときこそ
ハニーたちに元気もらうんだよ

English.Text: No way! It's times like this that you really gotta let loose!

Japanese.Text:
女装の踊り子
まだいてくれるといいんだけどな

English.Text: Plus, I can't pass up a chance at seeing that blonde queen again.

Japanese.Text: さあ　きれいなお花を咲かせてね

English.Text: That's it, spread your beautiful petals.

Japanese.Text: ああ　いいにおい

English.Text: Ah, I love this scent.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　黒マントとはなにか

English.Text: Hmm... But what made them the way they are?

Japanese.Text: そこにあるのは　神羅の闇か

English.Text: I'd bet all my gil that Shinra's got something to do with 'em.

Japanese.Text:
私は　黒マントたちのことを
追っている作家だ

English.Text: Oh, I'm working on an article about those men in robes.

Japanese.Text:
彼らは　重度の魔晄中毒という説が
一般的だが　特別な実験の
犠牲者という説もあるようだ

English.Text: Most agree that they suffer from acute mako poisoning, but others theorize that they're also victims of secret experiments.

Japanese.Text:
もっと秘密があるような気がするんだが
まずは　証拠を集めて検証しようと思う

English.Text: Personally, I think there's something even more sinister behind their existence, but I don't have any proof yet.

Japanese.Text:
神羅を敵にまわすことになれば
厄介だからな

English.Text: And I'd better be careful making claims involving Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
フッカフカのお饅頭に
甘辛いそぼろ煮　うまかったなあ

English.Text: I'll never forget those steamed buns. The minced meat filling was...it was heavenly.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルを離れて残念なのは
あの八番饅頭を
いつでも食べられなくなったことだな

English.Text: That's my one regret about leaving Midgar for good. No more stopping off for Sector 8 buns. I used to eat 'em every day.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　売り子のお姉さん
ボクのお饅頭ちゃん

English.Text: I'll miss that girl too. My little steamed honeybun...

Japanese.Text: いまごろ　どうしてるかな

English.Text: I wonder if she's still selling them.

Japanese.Text:
ここの花壇　ミッドガルが見える丘から
花を摘んできたら
もっと綺麗になるんじゃないかしら

English.Text: It's missing something... Maybe adding a few flowers from that big hill west of here will give it more variety?

Japanese.Text:
赤　青　黄色そろえて飾って
緑のねこじゃらしも

English.Text: Red, blue, yellow... Could use green foxtails too.

Japanese.Text: いいアクセントになるわよね　きっと

English.Text: Yeah, that ought to really liven this up.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ聞いた？　宿屋のブロードさん
行方不明なんだって

English.Text: Have you heard? Broden's missing. He just up and vanished!

Japanese.Text:
体調悪かったみたいだし
どこかに療養でも行ったのかしら

English.Text: It did seem like his health was taking a turn, so maybe he went to see a doctor?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　ブロードさんの笑顔が見られない
私の楽しみがひとつ消えたわ

English.Text: I hope so. But I am going to miss having him around. I pray he gets better soon.

Japanese.Text:
兵士に殴られたよ
この傷はアバランチのせいだ

English.Text: A trooper slugged me. Me! If it weren't for those terrorists...

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉爆破の影響で
カームの魔晄タンクもやばいらしい

English.Text: If it weren't for the Midgar bombings, we'd still be getting a steady stream of mako.

Japanese.Text: 神羅軍の本気　見せてもらったぜ

English.Text: Shinra must mean business, dropping paratroopers...

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとの戦争のウワサも
現実になるかもな

English.Text: Those rumors about another war might not be rumors...

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルがぶっ壊れたのって
マジだったのかよ

English.Text: Is it true? Was Midgar reduced to rubble?

Japanese.Text:
アバランチのせいで
俺たちの生活も苦しくなるな

English.Text: Those bombings are gonna screw with our lives too. Thanks, Avalanche.

Japanese.Text:
カームに魔晄が供給されなくなったら
終わりよ

English.Text: If our mako supply gets cut off, Kalm is finished.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルは
しばらく封鎖みたいね

English.Text: Midgar's gonna be locked down for a while.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチに襲われる前に
神羅に襲われるとは

English.Text: I never would've guessed that Shinra would storm us before Avalanche.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとの戦争って
ほんとに起こるんじゃないかしら

English.Text: It's looking more and more like we've got another war on our hands.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの暴行は星からの警告
巻き起こった竜巻は　星の怒りの証だ

English.Text: Avalanche has warned us of what will come if we persist in our folly. You need only look to that devastating tornado for proof of her rage.

Japanese.Text:
プレート落下って
何人が犠牲になったんでしょう

English.Text: I don't wanna think about how many people died when the plate fell.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄は星の命　星の命が尽きれば
やがて　人の命も尽きる

English.Text: Mako is her lifeblood. Our lifeblood. To exhaust it is to exhaust our very souls, and upset the natural cycle.

Japanese.Text:
ライフストリームを絶やしてはならぬ！
我らの命が　星とともにあらんことを

English.Text: We cannot stand by and allow her lifestream to be bled dry! Our lives are bound to the planet. If she dies, then so too shall we!

Japanese.Text:
カームは現在　厳重警戒中だ
立ち寄り先は必要最小限に留めろ

English.Text: Kalm is currently on high alert! Please limit your activities to essential business.

Japanese.Text: 用が済んだら　さっさと立ち去れ！

English.Text: Once you've finished, return home!

Japanese.Text:
現在　モンスター注意報
重点注意！

English.Text: The monster advisory level is currently at: Caution!

Japanese.Text:
飛空艇の騒音の影響で
モンスターが興奮してる

English.Text: Recent security operations have agitated the local fiends!

Japanese.Text: 無闇に近づいて　命を落とすな

English.Text: Do not approach them under any circumstances!

Japanese.Text: デート中に神羅軍に捕まるなんて最悪！

English.Text: I can't believe we got arrested in the middle of our date!

Japanese.Text: でも　興奮しただろ？

English.Text: It was kinda cool though, wasn't it?

Japanese.Text: そうね　あなたが殴られたのは最高！

English.Text: Yeah─and when that guy decked you, whoa!

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう　アバランチ
僕たちのデートを盛り上げてくれて

English.Text: Heh... Hey Avalanche, thanks a ton! That was just the spark our date needed.

Japanese.Text:
そういえばミッドガルのゲートの近くで
黒マントたちが
荒野をさまよってるのを見たよ

English.Text: Come to think of it, I saw these odd people in black robes wandering the wastelands outside Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
なんか　うめいてるし
気持ち悪いよな

English.Text: Shoulda heard the way they were moaning. Gave me the creeps.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルから逃げ出してるのかしら
ドブネズミみたいな　しぶとい人たちね

English.Text: Prob'ly some slum rats looking to get out of Midgar. Making a run for it with just the clothes on their backs.

Japanese.Text: はは　君たちと同じだね！

English.Text: Like you guys did?

Japanese.Text:
ねえねえ
アバランチのメンバーの特徴は？

English.Text: So, uh, what do these Avalanche people look like?

Japanese.Text:
情報ナシ
まだよくわからねえみたいだ

English.Text: No one knows. They didn't show any pictures on the news.

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　探せないじゃない

English.Text: Then how're we supposed to identify them?

Japanese.Text:
適当にヤバそうなヤツを
差し出せばいいってことさ

English.Text: Eh, just bring 'em anyone who looks suspicious.

Japanese.Text:
そっか　じゃあ
あんたを通報しようか

English.Text: Oh yeah? How 'bout I start by reporting you?

Japanese.Text: いや～　あせったよ

English.Text: Man, I was sweatin' bullets.

Japanese.Text:
カームに向かう途中
黒マントたちをひきそうになってさ

English.Text: Almost ran over a bunch of guys in black robes on my way here.

Japanese.Text: 危なかったねえ

English.Text: Sounds like a close call.

Japanese.Text:
あの連中　魔晄中毒なんだろ？
ミッドガルを追い出されたのかねえ

English.Text: I've seen them too. Buncha mako junkies, aren't they? Wonder if they were chased out of Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
なんか　集団で歩いてたんだよね
このあたりじゃ珍しいよ

English.Text: I know they got all kinds in the city, but wandering packs of that is a new kind of weird to me.

Japanese.Text: 星の民よ　星の叫びを聞け

English.Text: Children of the planet! Hear our mother's cries!

Japanese.Text:
星は嘆いている
星は悲しんでいる
星は怒っている

English.Text: She weeps in grief─cries out in pain and despair even now. Open your hearts and listen.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄が減ってる原因はアバランチだ
絶対　捕まえるんだ！

English.Text: It's Avalanche's fault we're gonna have to ration mako. Bastards!

Japanese.Text:
神羅もずいぶんと
混乱してるようだね

English.Text: Seems like Shinra's scrambling to deal with everything.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチと神羅
どっちが勝っても得しなさそうだ

English.Text: Doesn't matter who comes out on top. We'll lose either way.

Japanese.Text:
このまま魔晄が減ったら
カームは　干上がっちまう

English.Text: Kalm won't last much longer if they keep cutting our mako supply.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチがカームにいるとか
聞いてねえよ！

English.Text: An Avalanche cell in Kalm? That's ridiculous!

Japanese.Text: 本当にプレート　落ちたんだ

English.Text: The plate fell? They can do that?

Japanese.Text:
カームにも
アバランチの協力者がいるのかしら

English.Text: Does this mean there are Avalanche conspirators in Kalm?

Japanese.Text:
魔晄が減ってるのね
いまのうちに節約しなきゃ

English.Text: Better start cutting back. Just isn't enough mako to go around.

Japanese.Text:
神羅って
あんなに怖いこともするのね

English.Text: To be honest, Shinra kind of scares me sometimes.

Japanese.Text:
グラスランドで
黒マントの人たち見たんだけど

English.Text: Does anyone know what those weird robed guys out in the grasslands are up to?

Japanese.Text:
魔晄がこなくなって
急に電源が落ちたんだ

English.Text: We're not gonna be able to keep the lights on at this rate!

Japanese.Text: 早く直してくれよ！

English.Text: Hurry up and fix it!

Japanese.Text:
うちの冷蔵庫も壊れちゃったよ
ガタピシ言ってるんだ　どうしてくれる

English.Text: My fridge is busted! It's been making awful noises all day. Do somethin'!

Japanese.Text:
魔晄パイプが故障だって？
いったい　いつになったら直るんだ

English.Text: We know the pipeline is broken! What we want to know is when will you fix it!?

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと　どうなってるの？
うちに来てる魔晄が少ないんですけど

English.Text: Hey, what's going on!? Why is my house hardly getting any mako!?

Japanese.Text:
洗濯機が動かなくて困ってるのよ
なんとかしてよ

English.Text: I tell you, the whole town'll be stinking to high heaven if we can't do our laundry soon!

Japanese.Text: 早く魔晄を送っておくれよ

English.Text: Get Shinra to send us more mako already!

Japanese.Text:
やっと直ったか
これで普段どおりに生活できる

English.Text: Took them long enough. Now life can finally go back to normal.

Japanese.Text: 修理人には感謝だな

English.Text: That repairman's a lifesaver.

Japanese.Text:
今後は　こんなことが
起こらないように頼むぜ

English.Text: Just make sure it doesn't happen again, alright?

Japanese.Text:
直ったのね　もう
もっと早くしてほしかったわ

English.Text: They really should've gotten on it sooner, but at least it's fixed now.

Japanese.Text: 溜まった洗濯物　片付けなきゃ

English.Text: Now to deal with all the laundry that's piled up.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　これでようやく
魔晄が行き渡るわね

English.Text: Well, I'm glad to see everything's back to how it should be.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の新社長は　プレジデントの息子の
ルーファウス神羅って人なんでしょ？

English.Text: So, let me get this straight. Rufus Shinra, the new president, is the son of the old one?

Japanese.Text:
まだ若いみたいだけど
大企業のカンバン背負って
やっていけるのかなあ

English.Text: Yeah, but he's still so young. Dunno if he can handle all that responsibility.

Japanese.Text:
若くてカッコイイみたいだから
だいじょーぶ！

English.Text: Who cares? He's hot. Like, really hot.

Japanese.Text: 仕事は顔でするものじゃないんだけど

English.Text: "Hotness" is not a qualification...

Japanese.Text:
アバランチがこの街に居ただなんて
なんで気がつかなかったんだ！

English.Text: Avalanche was here─in this town!? How could they have slipped by us!?

Japanese.Text:
今度ヤツらが来たら
俺たちが倒してやるんだ

English.Text: The next time they come through Kalm though, we'll be ready.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉を守るのも
魔晄炉視察団の仕事だ

English.Text: We may be an inspection team, but we can hold our own in a fight!

Japanese.Text:
神羅軍の尋問にも耐え　待ち続けた俺
きっと　いいことあるよな？

English.Text: Something good has to be in store for me after suffering through that interrogation. Patience is always rewarded, right?

Japanese.Text:
見てくださいよ　あそこで
収穫祭のダンスを練習していますよ

English.Text: Oh look, dear. Seems they're practicing the dance for the harvest festival already.

Japanese.Text:
もうすこし若ければ
私もやるのにねえ

English.Text: If I were a few years younger, I'd have to join them.

Japanese.Text: もう　そんな時期か

English.Text: 'Tis the season, huh?

Japanese.Text:
激しいダンスはできなくても　一緒に
ゆったり踊るのはできるんじゃないかな

English.Text: Even if you can't keep up with them, you could still go and wiggle along with the beat.

Japanese.Text: ふふ　踊るなんて何年振りかしら

English.Text: When was the last time I danced?

Japanese.Text:
昔　ウォール・マーケットのお店で
出会って以来ね

English.Text: Probably not since the day you and I met in Wall Market.

Japanese.Text:
ブオーンブオーン！
飛空艇　かっこいいよな

English.Text: Whop, whop, whop, whop, whop, whop, whop, whop! Whoosh! Airships are the coolest!

Japanese.Text: たあっ　パラシュート部隊参上！

English.Text: Paratroopers away! Go, go, go!

Japanese.Text:
オレ　いつかホンモノに乗りたい
将来は神羅軍に入ろう！

English.Text: When we become Shinra troopers for real, we'll travel all over the world in an airship!

Japanese.Text:
うん　悪いヤツらを
こらしめてやろう

English.Text: Yeah! We'll show those bad guys who's boss!

Japanese.Text:
う～ん　やっぱり神羅が来ると
緊張しちゃうね

English.Text: Shinra troopers always set me on edge.

Japanese.Text: 監視されてるみたいで　ヤな気分

English.Text: Feels like they're watching my every move.

Japanese.Text:
うん　兵士のメット見ると
悪いことしてなくても身構えちゃう

English.Text: The sight of those helmeted thugs is enough to make me tense no matter what I'm doing.

Japanese.Text:
でも　あのメットの下が
イイ男だったら　どう？

English.Text: Then again─what if one of those helmets was hiding the man of your dreams?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　それはアリだわ～
身体検査くらいなら許すかも！

English.Text: Well, under different circumstances, I might not mind getting to know one.

Japanese.Text:
久しぶりだね
ランチに誘ってくれるなんてさ

English.Text: I can't even remember the last time you invited me out for lunch like this.

Japanese.Text:
で　今日はいくら貸してほしいの？
このまえは３００ギルだったけど

English.Text: So, how much do you need this time? Would another three hundred gil cover it?

Japanese.Text: ご……５００ギルくらいかなあ

English.Text: Um, five hundred would be ideal...

Japanese.Text:
それだけあれば
ムームーちゃんを手に入れられるんだ

English.Text: But that's all! And then I can get Fuzzy Wuzzy.

Japanese.Text: ほんとに仕方ないなあ

English.Text: What am I going to do with you?

Japanese.Text: ニャーニャー！

English.Text: Meow meow!

Japanese.Text:
ダメダメ　そんなに大声出しちゃ
逃げちゃうよ

English.Text: You can't yell at kitties like that. You're gonna scare 'em away!

Japanese.Text: ほら　エサだぞ～

English.Text: Here─have some food!

Japanese.Text: それ　チョコボにあげるやつ！

English.Text: That's for chocobos, not cats!

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉があるから土地が枯れるのよ

English.Text: Those reactors are turning everything to dust.

Japanese.Text:
カームの自然が守られているのは
魔晄炉がないからね

English.Text: Thank heavens we don't have one here, or there wouldn't be a spot of green left.

Japanese.Text: ああ　またお説教が始まった

English.Text: Don't start with this again, Grandma.

Japanese.Text: わたし　アバランチに入ろうかしら

English.Text: You know what? I'm gonna join Avalanche!

Japanese.Text:
ひとりひとりの行動が　星を守るの
燃えるじゃない？

English.Text: They're the only ones who care about keeping this planet from turning into a dried out husk!

Japanese.Text:
もう　魔晄のおかげで
穏やかな生活ができてるんだから
それでいいじゃないの

English.Text: Grandma, please! You of all people should know how much easier life is with mako energy. Just enjoy it!

Japanese.Text: あいつは違うな　こいつはどうだ？

English.Text: No, not them. Hmm... That one might bite.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　金持ってなさそうだ

English.Text: Hahhh... Doubt they've got two gil to rub together, though.

Japanese.Text:
いいか
あの子の仕事あがりは１９時だ

English.Text: To review─she gets off work at seven on the dot.

Japanese.Text:
そして　あの子の好きな酒は
ランドピルスナーだ

English.Text: And her favorite drink is a grassland-style pilsner. Got that?

Japanese.Text:
わかりました　師匠
酒場に誘います！

English.Text: Got it! I'll invite her out for drinks, then.

Japanese.Text:
がんばれ　声をかけるだけならタダだ
成功したら　１００ギルな

English.Text: Remember, all you gotta do is be yourself. Also that you owe me a hundred gil if you hit it off.

Japanese.Text:
５０回連続失敗ですけど
割引　あります？

English.Text: Right, but I got shot down like fifty times now, so...shouldn't you be giving me a discount?

Japanese.Text: うふ　カワイイって罪よね

English.Text: Being good-looking comes with its own problems.

Japanese.Text: 熱い視線を感じるのよね～

English.Text: Hehe. Someone's got their eyes on me.

Japanese.Text: 臨時ニュースをお伝えします

English.Text: Breaking news at this hour...

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルでの破壊活動で指名手配中の
反神羅組織『アバランチ』が
カームに潜伏しているという情報を受け

English.Text: Avalanche, the anti-Shinra terrorist group responsible for the bombings in Midgar, is believed to have taken shelter in Kalm.

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは
カームに捜索隊を派遣しました

English.Text: Security forces performed a thorough sweep of the town...

Japanese.Text:
アバランチ捜索のため
カームは一時的に封鎖されましたが
現在は　解除されています

English.Text: during which time it was placed under a temporary lockdown, which has since been lifted as of this report.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチは　現在も逃亡中で
治安維持部門による捜査が続いています

English.Text: The suspects remain at large, though Public Security is confident they will be apprehended soon.

Japanese.Text:
また　組織の協力者が
カームに潜伏していたとみられ

English.Text: Local insurgents are believed to have played a role in their escape.

Japanese.Text:
今後は　カームの協力者も含め
さらに詳しく調べていく模様です

English.Text: The company will conduct a separate investigation to identify these collaborators...

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは
住民への情報提供を呼びかけており

English.Text: and is encouraging residents with any information to step forward.

Japanese.Text:
有力な情報には
報奨金が支払われるとのことです

English.Text: Information which leads to an arrest is subject to a reward.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの次は
カームが狙われたか

English.Text: First they target Midgar, and now Kalm...

Japanese.Text:
アバランチめ
次は　ジュノンでやらかしそうだな

English.Text: Even money says Junon is next on the bastards' hit list.

Japanese.Text: 早く捕まってくれよ　頼むからさ

English.Text: Wish Shinra'd get off their asses and arrest 'em.

Japanese.Text:
いつになったら
平和な頃に戻れるんだろうな

English.Text: I'm tired of wonderin' when I'll hear about another attack.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチが潜伏してるとしたら
どこだろう

English.Text: If Avalanche really is here, where d'you think they're hiding?

Japanese.Text:
そりゃ　人が集まる
酒場とかじゃね？

English.Text: If it were me, I'd go to a bar and try to blend in.

Japanese.Text:
ってことは　この店の中に
アバランチが？

English.Text: Hey...you don't think they're here right now, do you?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　どいつもこいつも
あやしく見えてきた

English.Text: Oh great. Now I'm gonna be suspicious of everyone!

Japanese.Text:
ヘリの風圧で
屋根が吹き飛びそうでしたよ

English.Text: Thought my roof was gonna blow off when those helicopters showed up.

Japanese.Text:
なんでアバランチは
カームを狙ったんだよ！

English.Text: Why would Avalanche target Kalm of all places!?

Japanese.Text:
本当に戦争になりそうだな
くそ　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: Well shit. Sounds like war's brewing for real. But what can we do about it?

Japanese.Text:
カームは
１０年前に建て直された街なんだ

English.Text: It's only been ten short years since Kalm was rebuilt.

Japanese.Text: また壊されたら　たまらねえよ

English.Text: If it ends up getting razed again...

Japanese.Text:
家の中まで揺れたぜ
皿が割れちまった

English.Text: My house shook so hard that half my plates got shattered!

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと　うちの洗濯物
どこ飛んでったのよ

English.Text: Hey, where'd my laundry go? I just hung it up!

Japanese.Text:
神羅軍が来るなんて
本当に大変な状況なのね

English.Text: Things must be really bad if Shinra's sending paratroopers into Kalm.

Japanese.Text:
ヘリが飛んできたら
ネズミが大量に出てきたわ

English.Text: Those Shinra helicopters scared a whole horde of rats out of hiding!

Japanese.Text:
はやく　いつもの暮らしに
戻ってほしいわね

English.Text: I hope everything goes back to normal soon.

Japanese.Text: カームは　いままで平和だったのに

English.Text: Kalm used to be so peaceful until now.

Japanese.Text: あはは　あははは！

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Japanese.Text: ひゃはは！

English.Text: Nyahaha!

Japanese.Text:
みんなつかまえた～！
じゃあ　もう１回な

English.Text: I got all of you! Okay, let's go again!

Japanese.Text:
なあなあ　『サボテン大王』の新作
サボーン七世のバトルある？

English.Text: Tell me─does the latest issue have any cool fight scenes with Cacter the Seventh?

Japanese.Text: うん　すごいの！

English.Text: Oh yeah, it's got tons!

Japanese.Text:
大王と王子のトゲくらべが
めちゃくちゃ熱かった！

English.Text: I was on the edge of my seat when the king and the prince needled it out!

Japanese.Text: ゴブリンのキッドＧは出てくる？

English.Text: And does Kid G show up too?

Japanese.Text:
オレ　あいつのでかでかパンチ
好きなんだよね

English.Text: I love his mega-punch. Gets me every time!

Japanese.Text:
もちろん　でもこれ以上はネタバレ
あ～　早くあんたも読んでよ！

English.Text: Of course he shows up! But I don't wanna spoil it for you. You gotta hurry up and read it so we can talk about that ending!

Japanese.Text:
聞いてよもう　神羅のヘリのせいで
洗濯物がぜんぶ飛んでっちゃったのよ

English.Text: I can't believe it! Those Shinra helicopters blew my laundry all over town!

Japanese.Text: ご愁傷さま

English.Text: That's just awful.

Japanese.Text:
これもアバランチが原因ってことよね？
お高いパンツが行方不明なんですけど

English.Text: Another crime to lay at the feet of Avalanche. I lost some really expensive clothes too!

Japanese.Text:
賞金が出てるから
一攫千金のチャンスよ！

English.Text: Turn them in for the reward and that'll more than make up for it.

Japanese.Text:
神羅のパラシュート　すごかった
ぼくも将来できるようになりたい！

English.Text: Did you see those parachutes!? They looked so cool! I wanna do that someday.

Japanese.Text: だから　モウトックンするんだ！

English.Text: So I gotta train really, really hard!

Japanese.Text:
お兄ちゃん　ほんともう
いいかげんにしてほしいなあ

English.Text: I wish my brother would just stop it. Can't he see how silly he looks?

Japanese.Text: これは　あいつのぶん！

English.Text: This is for him!

Japanese.Text: なによ！

English.Text: Hey─quit it!

Japanese.Text: むかつく！

English.Text: You hussy!

Japanese.Text: もうっ！

English.Text: Excuse me!?

Japanese.Text:
あははは　私たち
良いコンビね

English.Text: Hahaha! Actually, we're a pretty good match.

Japanese.Text:
はあはあ……
つきあっちゃおうか

English.Text: Haha... In more ways than one, maybe?

Japanese.Text: 『我は　カイルゲイト伯爵！』

English.Text: "I am Baron Kylegate!"

Japanese.Text:
『おお　神羅め！
　この恨み　晴らしてくれる』

English.Text: "And I will make you rue the day you decided to cross me, Shinra!"

Japanese.Text: 『地べたの下に　這いずるがいい！』

English.Text: "Now squirm like the worms you are!"

Japanese.Text: フフフフ　華麗なる復讐劇だ

English.Text: Everyone loves a good revenge tale.

Japanese.Text:
災い転じて話書く
これこそ　脚本家の天賦の才だな

English.Text: I've outdone myself. Throw what you will at me, world─I'll spin it into pure gold.

Japanese.Text: 行くぞ～！

English.Text: Ready or not, here I come!

Japanese.Text: があああ　オーガだぞ～！

English.Text: Rawr! I'm gonna get you!

Japanese.Text: そっち行くぞ～！

English.Text: Maybe over here?

Japanese.Text: 悪い子はどこだ～？

English.Text: Come out, come out, wherever you are!

Japanese.Text: やった！

English.Text: Gotcha!

Japanese.Text: みっけ～！

English.Text: Found you!

Japanese.Text: わはは　ちょっとちょっと～！

English.Text: Ahaha! Stop! Stop!

Japanese.Text: みてみて　ミッドガルだよ！

English.Text: Look, I drew Midgar! See?

Japanese.Text:
はいはい
もう家に帰りましょうね

English.Text: Very nice, dear. Now come on, let's head home.

Japanese.Text: 神羅の軍隊が来るなんて　びっくり

English.Text: Gosh, those paratroopers startled me.

Japanese.Text:
世の中　なにがあるかわからないから
ここで告白されるのも悪くないかも

English.Text: Maybe I should spill my heart atop the tower. Who knows if I'll ever get another chance?

Japanese.Text: ほんとかい？

English.Text: You mean it!?

Japanese.Text:
おっと　でも相手は
あなたじゃないから早まらないで

English.Text: Whoa there, I, uh... I never said I'd be spilling my heart to you.

Japanese.Text:
ごらん　あの山を越えると
ジュノンだ

English.Text: Just gotta cross those mountains, and then we'll be in Junon.

Japanese.Text:
そこから船に乗ると
コスタ・デル・ソルだよ

English.Text: From there, we'll take the ferry to Costa del Sol.

Japanese.Text:
ステキ！　ここからでも耳を澄ませば
海の音が聞こえてきそう

English.Text: It's gonna be great! I feel like I can already hear the waves crashing on the beach!

Japanese.Text:
うん　でも方角あってるか
わからないんだよね

English.Text: Only problem is, I'm not one hundred percent sure how to cross the mountains.

Japanese.Text:
いいわ　ふたりで
確かめに行きましょう

English.Text: It's alright. We'll figure it out together!

Japanese.Text:
ここから見ると
ミッドガルは無事に見えるけど
いろいろ事件とかが起こってるんだよね

English.Text: From here, Midgar looks the same as ever... Hard to believe it's facing an unprecedented crisis.

Japanese.Text: そ……そうだね

English.Text: Uh... Yeah.

Japanese.Text:
カームにいるからって
無関心じゃダメよね

English.Text: Even if we don't live there, it affects us all.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルのために
できることをしなくちゃ！

English.Text: There has to be something we can do to help!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　だけど
もっと　大事なことがある

English.Text: Right, right. That's all super important, I agree, but...

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルよりも
僕のために　手をつないでくれ！

English.Text: Can't we just, like, hold hands and be romantic!?

Japanese.Text: カームは　静かなのがいちばんだ

English.Text: All quiet─as it should be.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄タンクでも見に行くかな

English.Text: Might go check on the mako tank.

Japanese.Text:
なにもない日常が
続いてくれるといいよな

English.Text: The best days are the ones when nothing happens.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチは
どこに行ったんだろうな

English.Text: Wonder where the Avalanche guys ran off to.

Japanese.Text:
これからは
良い風が吹く気がするんだ

English.Text: Feels like things are finally starting to look up.

Japanese.Text:
農場のほうまで
散歩しに行こうかしら

English.Text: Maybe I should take a walk on down to the ranch.

Japanese.Text:
新鮮な野菜
買いに行くところなの

English.Text: I'd better go and pick up some fresh vegetables.

Japanese.Text: いろいろあったけど　少し落ち着いたわ

English.Text: Really feels like life is getting back to normal.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボに揺られて
旅をしてみたいなあ

English.Text: I'd love to get my own chocobo and travel the world someday.

Japanese.Text:
道をもっと整備してほしいわ
お尻が痛い

English.Text: I really wish someone would fix those roads. They're so rough.

Japanese.Text:
なあ　もうすぐ戦争がはじまるって噂
本当か？

English.Text: Is it true what everyone's saying? Are we really going to war again?

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会って
アバランチと関係あるのか？

English.Text: So does this "SRC" have ties to Avalanche or something?

Japanese.Text:
なんにせよ
カームが巻き込まれたらたまらないよ

English.Text: Whatever happens, I hope Kalm doesn't get caught up in it.

Japanese.Text:
また神羅の軍隊がやってきたら
困るなあ

English.Text: If I never see another Shinra trooper, it'll be too soon.

Japanese.Text: 反神羅連絡会ってのは　なんなんだ？

English.Text: I've never heard of this "Resistance Committee."

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会なんて
すぐに　つぶされるでしょ？

English.Text: This "SRC" can't possibly be a threat to Shinra, can it?

Japanese.Text: 防災訓練が始まるんだって！

English.Text: We gotta do emergency drills now?

Japanese.Text:
戦争が始まったら
カームはどうなるのかしら

English.Text: I wonder─what's gonna happen to Kalm if war really does break out?

Japanese.Text: 戦争？　あの人は行かないわよね

English.Text: War? Wait, he won't be drafted, will he?

Japanese.Text:
非常食を買い溜めておいたほうが
いいかな？

English.Text: Maybe it's time to start stocking up on food.

Japanese.Text:
カームへようこそ
外じゃ　物騒な事件が続いてる

English.Text: Welcome to Kalm! Where you can forget the troubles of the outside world.

Japanese.Text:
なにかあったら
すぐに　自警団に報告するように

English.Text: If you notice anything out of the ordinary, let us know.

Japanese.Text:
現在　モンスター注意報
重点注意！

English.Text: The monster advisory level is currently at: Caution!

Japanese.Text:
モンスターの群れを見かけたら
近づくな

English.Text: If you run across any of 'em, keep your distance!

Japanese.Text:
あなたとのデート
毎回毎回なにか起きるわね

English.Text: Something crazy happens every time we go on a date! What's up with that?

Japanese.Text: 運命が　ボクを放っておかないのさ

English.Text: Guess I'm just one of those people "touched by fate."

Japanese.Text:
うふ　次はなにが起きるのかな
楽しみだわ

English.Text: Heh... And that's what I love about you. I can't wait to see what'll happen next!

Japanese.Text:
もし　戦争が始まってしまったら
デートなんかできないかもしれないわね

English.Text: If war really does break out, we probably won't be able to keep going on dates like this.

Japanese.Text:
だったら　ボクたち結婚しよう！
ボクといっしょなら
毎日　刺激でいっぱいだよ？

English.Text: If you're worried about that, I think we should tie the knot. I promise you, babe─you'll never have a boring day with me.

Japanese.Text:
わお　ほんとあなたって
なにが起きるかわからないわ！

English.Text: That's the truth! I never know what kind of trouble you'll attract.

Japanese.Text:
いくぞ　弟よ
エレファダンク流の突進だ！

English.Text: Here I come, dear brother! Time to channel my inner elphadunk and charge!

Japanese.Text: よし　来い！

English.Text: Okay, ready!

Japanese.Text: ああっ！

English.Text: Oof!

Japanese.Text:
どうだ　これが
モテない男同盟の本気だ！

English.Text: Yes! Behold the power of the Singles Club. Nothing can stop us!

Japanese.Text: いいよ　兄さん最高だ！

English.Text: Yeah, you're the best, bro!

Japanese.Text:
もういっちょいくぞ弟よ
熱い想い　受け取ってくれ！

English.Text: Alright, one more time! I'm gonna charge at you with the burning passion of a thousand suns!

Japanese.Text: どーんと来い！

English.Text: Lemme have it!

Japanese.Text: うへえっ！

English.Text: Ow!

Japanese.Text:
見たか　これが
カーム流の告白法だ！

English.Text: Did you see that? That's how we express our feelings in Kalm!

Japanese.Text: いいね　兄さん燃えるよ！

English.Text: Yeah! You're on fire!

Japanese.Text:
モテない男同盟は
モテないままだった……
だが弟よ　まだ終わらないぞ！

English.Text: We of the Singles Club sadly remain as single as ever... But don't give in to despair, my dear brother! We're not throwing in the towel yet!

Japanese.Text: ああ　兄さん！

English.Text: No─never!

Japanese.Text: だああっ！

English.Text: Ungh!

Japanese.Text:
どうだ　この突進で
カームを守るぞ！

English.Text: Ha-hah! If any troublemakers come to Kalm, they won't know what hit 'em!

Japanese.Text: だね　僕たちならカームを守れる！

English.Text: Yeah! We'll keep everybody safe!

Japanese.Text: あれから　黒マントの連中見たかい？

English.Text: Hey, have you seen any of those robed folks lately?

Japanese.Text:
いや　この辺じゃ
見かけなくなったな

English.Text: Nah. Ain't seen one for a while now.

Japanese.Text: どこか遠くに行っちまったのかね

English.Text: D'you think they moved on to some other town?

Japanese.Text:
どこだよ　あの連中に
行くとこなんてないだろ

English.Text: But where would they go? Certainly didn't seem to have any place to be.

Japanese.Text:
さあ　どこかに黒マントの巣穴でも
あるんじゃないかねえ

English.Text: Beats me. Maybe they've got some sort of den out there that no one knows about.

Japanese.Text: 仕事サボって　ちょいと１杯っと

English.Text: The boss won't notice if I sneak out for a quick drink.

Japanese.Text:
はあ　デートの待ち合わせって
緊張する～

English.Text: Pretty sure this was where we were s'posed to meet.

Japanese.Text:
カーム名物の魔晄タンク
よく見ていくといいぞ

English.Text: Be sure to check out the mako tank. Tourists love it.

Japanese.Text:
酒を飲むなら
ラスティアロウがオススメだぜ

English.Text: If you're lookin' for a drink, I recommend the Rusty Arrow.

Japanese.Text: お疲れなら　カーム・インで休めよ

English.Text: The Inn at Kalm should have rooms if you need one.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄タンクの前は
待ち合わせしやすいのよね

English.Text: The mako tank makes for a great meeting place, doesn't it?

Japanese.Text:
見晴らし塔の鐘の音を聞くと
運気があがるのよ

English.Text: Feels like my luck improves whenever I hear the clock tower chime.

Japanese.Text: 今日のモンスター注意報はなんだっけ

English.Text: What's the monster advisory level for today?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス神羅には
がんばってもらいたいわ

English.Text: The new Shinra president has some big shoes to fill.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　いろんなところに旅するのって
楽しそう～！

English.Text: Might be fun to plan a trip around the world someday. See what there is to see.

Japanese.Text:
もし戦争が始まったら
魔晄不足になるよな

English.Text: If war breaks out again, we're gonna have to go back to rationing mako.

Japanese.Text: うわ～　遅刻遅刻～！

English.Text: Oh shit, I'm running late!

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会ってのは
カームにもいるのか？

English.Text: Are these Shinra Resistance Committee people here in Kalm too?

Japanese.Text:
なにがあったって
カームビア飲んだら解決だな

English.Text: There's nothing in this world a pint of Kalm's finest can't fix.

Japanese.Text:
宿屋のブロードさんが
行方不明なんだってよ

English.Text: I can't believe that Broden just up and vanished.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイの放送って
神羅への挑戦状よね？

English.Text: That broadcast was a full-fledged declaration of war.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄タンク
止められたりとかしないよね

English.Text: Our mako supply won't get cut off, right? I can't imagine...

Japanese.Text:
こんなときこそ
ダンスで元気にしなきゃ！

English.Text: Dancing's just the thing to get rid of all this stress.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス神羅なら
戦争も止めてくれるでしょ

English.Text: The new president will put a stop to this war, just you wait and see.

Japanese.Text:
カームワイン飲んで
いろいろ忘れようっと

English.Text: What I need right now is a good, stiff drink.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　聞いた？

English.Text: Hey, did you hear?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス様が
ジュノンで襲撃されたって話

English.Text: Rufus Shinra was attacked during his inauguration in Junon!

Japanese.Text: 社長就任直後に大変よね

English.Text: Whoa, what a way to start your presidency.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチもよくやるわ
真犯人はウータイかもしれないけど

English.Text: Avalanche went for broke huh? Assuming it was them─I've heard rumors the real culprit might've been Wutaian.

Japanese.Text: お顔に傷がついてないといいんだけど

English.Text: As long as they didn't scar his heavenly face!

Japanese.Text: 心配するとこ　そこなの？

English.Text: Right, that's what you're worried about.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイ　反神羅ナントカ
またルーファウス様に苦難が～

English.Text: Hear about that...Wutaian Shinra Resistance Commission or whatever? Why does everyone have it out for Rufus?

Japanese.Text:
戦争になるのかって　みんな言ってるわ
あんたはどう思うわけ？

English.Text: I dunno, but either way, people think there's gonna be a war─or worse...

Japanese.Text:
そんなことより
ルーファウス様の体調が心配よ

English.Text: Who cares about all that!? I'm much more worried about Rufus's physical and mental health.

Japanese.Text: 許さないわよ　反神羅ナントカ！

English.Text: If I ever get my hands on those Resistance...people...

Japanese.Text:
カームに来たら
叩きのめしてやるんだから！

English.Text: I'll punish them for what they did to my Rufus!

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉視察団！

English.Text: Alright, team!

Japanese.Text:
いつでも視察に行けるよう
足腰を鍛えるぞ

English.Text: We have to build those leg muscles so we're ready to go at a moment's notice!

Japanese.Text:
いち　にー　いち　にー……
魔晄炉視察団のすべては
魔晄炉のために！

English.Text: One...! Two...! One...! Two...! Everything that we do...is for the reactors!

Japanese.Text: がんばるぞー！

English.Text: Keep at it, team!

Japanese.Text: うおお　フラれた～～～！

English.Text: She dumped me! She seriously dumped me!

Japanese.Text:
なぜだ～　つきあってもいないのに
プロポーズは早すぎたのか？

English.Text: Where did I go wrong? Should I have tried to ask her out before begging her to marry me?

Japanese.Text:
でも　週刊恋愛占いモテオとモテコに
告白は情熱的に　ためらわず行けって
書いてあったんだ！

English.Text: But the weekly horoscope was clear as day! It said to cast all doubts aside and seize the moment!

Japanese.Text:
また戦争になるかもしれないんですって
どうしましょう

English.Text: Not another war! It feels like the last one only just ended.

Japanese.Text: なに　何度やろうが神羅が勝つ

English.Text: It'll be fine. Shinra always comes out on top.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノン共和国にも
ウータイにも勝ったんじゃからな

English.Text: They beat the Republic of Junon and Wutai, right?

Japanese.Text:
あら　頼もしい
神羅は昔のあなたみたいに勇ましいのね

English.Text: Yes, you're right. I'm sure they're as strong as they ever were─maybe even more.

Japanese.Text: 臨時ニュースをお伝えします

English.Text: And now breaking news.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで行われた
神羅カンパニーの式典で

English.Text: Rufus Shinra, our newly appointed president...

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス新社長が
襲撃される事件がありました

English.Text: was attacked during his inauguration in Junon.

Japanese.Text:
幸い　ルーファウス新社長にケガはなく
業務に支障もないとのことです

English.Text: Thankfully, he was uninjured and was able to assume his new position without delay.

Japanese.Text:
治安維持部門の発表によりますと
犯行当時　ウータイ人とみられる
不審な女性が式典会場の近くで
目撃されたという証言があり

English.Text: Public Security has confirmed that multiple eyewitnesses observed a young woman, believed to be of Wutaian origin, behaving erratically shortly before the incident.

Japanese.Text: 事件との関連を調査中とのことです

English.Text: Authorities are investigating her involvement...

Japanese.Text:
また　アバランチの関与につきましても
今後明らかにしていくとしています

English.Text: as well as her potential connections to Avalanche and other insurgent groups.

Japanese.Text:
先日発生した　反神羅連絡会
およびウータイ暫定政府による
電波ジャックの続報です

English.Text: The illegal broadcast from the Shinra Resistance Committee and the interim Wutaian government has left many fearful of future attacks.

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは　住民の間で
不安の声が高まっているのを受け

English.Text: The Shinra Electric Power Company regrets the distress inflicted upon the people...

Japanese.Text:
近日中に　ルーファウス新社長による
声明文を発表するとしています

English.Text: and has promised to make a public statement in the near future to address their concerns.

Japanese.Text:
また　治安維持部門は
錯綜する情報に惑わされず

English.Text: Public Security anticipates a rise in misinformation in the coming days...

Japanese.Text:
いつもどおりの生活を心掛けるよう
呼びかけています

English.Text: and is encouraging everyone to go about their lives as normal.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで騒動を起こしたの
アバランチだと思う？

English.Text: So, d'you think Avalanche was behind what happened in Junon?

Japanese.Text: そりゃあ　そうじゃねえのか

English.Text: Well, yeah. Obviously.

Japanese.Text: いや　ウータイの可能性もあるだろ

English.Text: You never know. It could've been Wutai.

Japanese.Text:
それなら俺は
両方に賭けるね

English.Text: My bet's on the two of 'em workin' together.

Japanese.Text: ウータイに　反神羅連絡会だってよ

English.Text: Wutai's bad enough, but now we got the "SRC."

Japanese.Text:
よくわかんねえけど
やっぱり戦争になるんだよ

English.Text: Feels like this whole world's goin' to hell in a handbasket.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチとかの活動は
このための布石だったってことかな

English.Text: You think all those terrorist attacks were a prelude to their big reveal?

Japanese.Text:
本当　どうしてみんな
平和に暮らしてられないんだ

English.Text: Man, I don't get it. Why can't people just be happy with what they've got?

Japanese.Text:
神羅の世の中に
どっか悪い事とかあったか？

English.Text: What's so horrible about the way Shinra's been running things?

Japanese.Text: う～ん　オレが貧乏？

English.Text: Only complaint I got is I'm broke!

Japanese.Text: オレも

English.Text: Same!

Japanese.Text: そういうことなら　俺もだ！

English.Text: Hah! Now that I can relate to.

Japanese.Text:
本日　神羅カンパニー広報部の
会見が開かれました

English.Text: At an official Shinra press conference held earlier today...

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで行われる
神羅カンパニーの式典は
予定通り　明日開催されます

English.Text: a spokesperson confirmed that the inauguration in Junon will be held tomorrow as scheduled.

Japanese.Text:
軍事拠点である
要塞都市ジュノンでの式典が
どんな内容や規模になるのか

English.Text: What exciting festivities does our new company president have in store for the city?

Japanese.Text:
全世界の注目が
ジュノンに集まっています

English.Text: Make sure to tune in tomorrow to find out.

Japanese.Text:
続いて　ミッドガルへの破壊活動で
指名手配されている反神羅組織
アバランチ捜索関連の続報です

English.Text: We have received new information regarding Avalanche, the anti-Shinra group responsible for multiple terrorist attacks in Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
治安維持部門からの発表によると
アバランチは　現在も逃亡中であり

English.Text: According to a recent statement from Public Security, key members remain at large...

Japanese.Text:
カームに潜伏していた協力者も
逮捕には至っておりません

English.Text: and those who concealed them in Kalm have yet to be apprehended.

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは
カームの協力者も含めて　引き続き
アバランチの捜索を続けていくとの事で

English.Text: Shinra is asking citizens to come forward if they have information concerning Avalanche's current whereabouts...

Japanese.Text: 市民への情報提供を呼びかけています

English.Text: or the identities of their associates.

Japanese.Text:
本日　神羅カンパニーの新たなリーダー
ルーファウス新社長の
就任パレードが行われます

English.Text: Today, the Shinra Electric Power Company is celebrating the inauguration of Rufus Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
開催地となる要塞都市ジュノンには
多くの人々が
新社長の雄姿を見るべく訪れています

English.Text: Many people have flocked to Junon for the chance to see his first official appearance as commander in chief.

Japanese.Text:
式典では今後の神羅カンパニーについて
ルーファウス新社長の
就任演説が　行われます

English.Text: The president will also give his first public address, in which he is expected to outline his vision for the future.

Japanese.Text:
現在　様々な問題を抱える
神羅カンパニーに
新しい風を吹かすことができるのか
期待されています

English.Text: While this remains a difficult period for Shinra, there is hope that the transition will mark a turning point for the company.

Japanese.Text: さ～て　久しぶりの仕事だ

English.Text: Well, it's been long enough. Back to work!

Japanese.Text: 今日の晩ごはん　なんだろうなあ

English.Text: Hmm... What to make for supper...

Japanese.Text:
鳥の鳴き声が聞こえると
