落ち着くよな

English.Text: There's just something so soothing about birdsong.

Japanese.Text:
今日は俺の料理担当だし
市場行くか

English.Text: I'd better hit up the market to get all the ingredients I need for tonight.

Japanese.Text:
やっぱり
なにもないのがいちばんだな

English.Text: Yeah, I'd take peace and quiet any day.

Japanese.Text: カームの鐘の音に元気をもらえるの

English.Text: I'll never get tired of hearing the clock chime.

Japanese.Text: いい天気だし　洗濯日和ね

English.Text: Perfect weather for putting out my laundry!

Japanese.Text: ネズミを飼いならしてみたわ

English.Text: I took in some of those rats as pets!

Japanese.Text: あら　ごきげんよう

English.Text: Oh, hello there.

Japanese.Text: やっと平和なカームが戻ってきたわね

English.Text: I'm so glad things are finally back to normal.

Japanese.Text: 反神羅連絡会って　どう思う？

English.Text: What do you make of the "SRC"?

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会ってのは
悪いヤツらなのか？

English.Text: So are these SRC people bad, or...?

Japanese.Text:
戦争になったら
引っ越しを考えるべきか

English.Text: I oughta start thinking about moving, in case it really does come to war.

Japanese.Text:
物騒なことが起きるまえに
食料買いこんでおくか

English.Text: It might be smart to stock up on food before we get hit with any shortages.

Japanese.Text:
なにが起きようと
まずは仕事だ　仕事！

English.Text: No matter what happens, work always comes first!

Japanese.Text: 本当に　戦争になっちゃうの？

English.Text: You don't really think it'll come to war, do you?

Japanese.Text:
この不安も　洗濯物といっしょに
飛んでいけばいいのに

English.Text: If only all my fears would fly away like my laundry did.

Japanese.Text:
収穫祭の頃には
平和になってればいいんだけど

English.Text: I really hope things calm down in time for the harvest festival.

Japanese.Text:
あのウータイの放送以来
みんな不安なのよ

English.Text: Who wouldn't be freaking out after that insane declaration?

Japanese.Text: 神羅が負けたりしないわよね

English.Text: Shinra wouldn't lose to them, right?

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　次の休みに
デート行っちゃおうよ

English.Text: Hey, let's go on a date on our next day off.

Japanese.Text:
パーッと
ゴールドソーサーとか行く？

English.Text: Okay! How about the Gold Saucer?

Japanese.Text:
いいわね
カップルイベントもやってるらしいし

English.Text: I hear they do all kinds of fun couples events!

Japanese.Text: 楽しめそう！

English.Text: I'd love to go!

Japanese.Text: 『壁を築き　我が街を永遠とするのだ』

English.Text: "I will construct a wall to protect this town for all eternity."

Japanese.Text:
『称えよ　我が名を　我が偉業を
　我が名はカイルゲイトなり！』

English.Text: "Now come and shower me with praise for my magnificent accomplishments! For I am none other than Mütten Kylegate!"

Japanese.Text:
フッ　自分の才能が恐ろしい
まさにこの脚本は魔法だ

English.Text: I knew I was talented, but people will hail this as my masterpiece.

Japanese.Text:
きっと　どんなお客も
感動させられるに違いない

English.Text: I can already hear the crowd's thunderous applause.

Japanese.Text: 『壁を築き　我が街を永遠とするのだ』

English.Text: "I will construct a wall to protect this town for all eternity."

Japanese.Text:
『称えよ　我が名を　我が偉業を
　我が名はカイルゲイトなり！』

English.Text: "Now come and shower me with praise for my magnificent accomplishments! For I am none other than Mütten Kylegate!"

Japanese.Text:
おお　みんな
新作公演を見に来てくれないか！

English.Text: Oh, why hello there! Have you come to see our latest production?

Japanese.Text: しばらくは無料公演だ

English.Text: It's free for a limited time!

Japanese.Text: だが　無料でも客席は埋まらない

English.Text: Except even that doesn't seem to be enough incentive!

Japanese.Text:
なぜだ　戦争が起こりそうで
みんな不安だろう

English.Text: It doesn't make sense! The people should be flocking to the theater!

Japanese.Text:
いまこそ　魔法の脚本が
夢を見させる時なのに！

English.Text: Don't they need something to distract themselves from all the horrible news these days!?

Japanese.Text:
『サボテン大王』の新作
すごかったよ！

English.Text: That latest issue was the best yet!

Japanese.Text:
だよねだよね
どこがよかった？

English.Text: Wasn't it, though? Which part was your favorite?

Japanese.Text: キッドＧだよ！

English.Text: Kid G, for sure!

Japanese.Text:
でかでかパンチが
サボーン七世に直撃するところなんて
思わず叫んじゃったよ！

English.Text: Man, I literally jumped up and cheered when he hit Cacter the Seventh with his mega-punch!

Japanese.Text:
コレル砂漠に眠る秘宝は
どうなるんだろう

English.Text: I wanna know what's up with that treasure in Corel Desert.

Japanese.Text: ああ　つづきが気になる～！

English.Text: Aww, I can't wait to see what happens next!

Japanese.Text:
息子のポスターと
ミュージックディスクを見つけたんだ

English.Text: I finally tracked down a music disc of my son's.

Japanese.Text:
息子は　アキラという
売れっ子歌手なんだよ

English.Text: His name's Akira, in case I hadn't mentioned.

Japanese.Text:
ウォール・マーケットで
派手に活動してるんだ

English.Text: He's developed quite a following in Wall Market.

Japanese.Text:
カームにも　いつかツアーで
帰ってきてくれるだろう

English.Text: Maybe one day a tour will bring him back to Kalm.

Japanese.Text:
凱旋公演のその日まで
私がここで宣伝するんだよ

English.Text: Until then, I'll be bragging to everyone about how my boy's a star.

Japanese.Text:
カームが生んだ大スター
売れっ子歌手アキラの凱旋公演だ！

English.Text: The Rising Star of Kalm! Don't miss Akira's homecoming concert!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　みんな聞いていってくれ
魂を揺さぶるアキラのコンサートだよ！

English.Text: Adored in Wall Market and the world over, his silky smooth voice is sure to stir your soul!

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの人気歌手が来てるんだって

English.Text: Apparently, a famous singer's come from Midgar.

Japanese.Text: この歌声　心にしみるなあ

English.Text: What a voice... He's tugging at all my heartstrings.

Japanese.Text: あの衣装　目がチカチカする

English.Text: Gotta say, that outfit's got some dazzle.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルを制して
地方進出しにきたらしいね

English.Text: I heard he's gonna go on a tour to expand his fan base.

Japanese.Text: 収穫祭にも出演してくれないかな

English.Text: You think we could get him to perform at the harvest festival?

Japanese.Text: キャー　アキラー！

English.Text: Ahhh! Akira!

Japanese.Text: こっち向いて～！

English.Text: Over here, over here!

Japanese.Text: ああ　もう興奮で倒れる！

English.Text: Oh gosh, oh gosh! I think I'm gonna faint!

Japanese.Text: 憂さ晴らしにもってこいよね

English.Text: This is just what I needed.

Japanese.Text: ラブラブ　アキラー！

English.Text: I love you, Akira!

Japanese.Text:
あたし　もっとお高いパンツを
買っちゃったわ

English.Text: So, I went and bought myself even more expensive clothes.

Japanese.Text: あら　やるわね

English.Text: No shame in that!

Japanese.Text:
いつかは履けなくなるんだし
いまを楽しまなくちゃ

English.Text: May as well live for the moment. You know, enjoy things while they last.

Japanese.Text: なるほど　あたしも買おうかな？

English.Text: Good point. Maybe I should splurge too.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　風が気持ちいいねえ

English.Text: Ah, the perfect breeze!

Japanese.Text:
世界でなにが起きても
僕たちには　関係ないな

English.Text: Doesn't matter what's going on out there─it won't affect us.

Japanese.Text:
次のバカンスは
コスタにでも行こうか

English.Text: Maybe we'll take our next trip to Costa del Sol.

Japanese.Text: 休みは　家族水いらずで過ごすんだ

English.Text: There's nothing like a vacation to bring the family together.

Japanese.Text:
見晴らし塔の鐘の音は
カームの誇りだよ

English.Text: It wouldn't be Kalm without the chime of the clock tower.

Japanese.Text: 嫌なことがあると　あの塔に登るんだ

English.Text: Climbing the clock tower always helps clear my head.

Japanese.Text:
健康のために
ウォーキングしてるの

English.Text: I'm trying to walk more to get in shape.

Japanese.Text: モーグリまんじゅう買って帰ろっと

English.Text: A moogle bun sounds so good right about now.

Japanese.Text: 次はどの豆でコーヒー飲もうかしら

English.Text: Now, what kind of coffee should I try next?

Japanese.Text:
鐘の音を　塔の上で聞くのが
趣味なんです

English.Text: You gotta be at the top when it chimes. Trust me.

Japanese.Text:
ここから見える景色も
変わっちまうのかな

English.Text: I hope this perfect view doesn't get destroyed.

Japanese.Text:
戦争だなんて
ウータイは困ったやつらだよ

English.Text: I can't believe those Wutaians want to go to war again.

Japanese.Text:
せっかく　静かなカームに
越してきたっていうのに

English.Text: The whole reason I moved out here is 'cause I thought it'd be peaceful...

Japanese.Text:
戦争か　カームも
無傷ではいられないだろうな

English.Text: If it comes to all-out war, not even Kalm will make it out unscathed.

Japanese.Text:
とりあえず
いまできることをやらなきゃ

English.Text: Gotta focus on what we can do in the here and now.

Japanese.Text: 戦争　本当に起きるのかな

English.Text: Makes me sick to even think about another war breaking out.

Japanese.Text:
どうせ神羅が勝つんだから
心配するだけ損よね

English.Text: Shinra's obviously gonna win, so there's no point in worrying about it.

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会なんて
すぐにおしまいさ

English.Text: The SRC won't last two seconds. Just wait and see.

Japanese.Text:
これから先　なにがあっても
カームは無事よね？

English.Text: Kalm will be alright. I mean, we'd be nowhere near the front lines.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　コスタのバカンスまでは
戦争は禁止！

English.Text: No! No wars allowed until I'm back from my Costa del Sol vacay!

Japanese.Text: みんな　盛りあがってるか～！

English.Text: Hey, Kalm! How y'all doin' today?

Japanese.Text:
ＳＨＩＮＲＡ　ＲＥＣＯＲＤＳ所属
シンガー・アキラ　帰って参りました

English.Text:
Yeah, it's me, your boy Akira!
Still with Shinra Records too.

Japanese.Text:
ふるさとカームを離れて苦節７年……
売れないときもあったけど

English.Text: It's been a long seven years since I hit the road, and the world hasn't always been kind...

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの空を見あげて
見えない星を探し続けたんだ

English.Text:
but I never lost sight of my guiding light─
even when the plate was blocking my view.

Japanese.Text:
いつか　スターになるって夢を叶えて
ふるさとに帰るんだってな

English.Text:
I always knew that, one day,
I'd make it big and come back a star.

Japanese.Text:
はは……そのまえにミッドガルから
逃げてきちゃったんだけど

English.Text: Haven't quite yet, but I'm working on it.

Japanese.Text:
でもオレにだって　この歌声で
みんなを励ますことはできるよな？

English.Text:
Even though I left Midgar behind, my journey
won't end here, no sir. It's only just begun.

Japanese.Text:
そんなオレの歌　聞いてください
『旅の途中　夢の途中』

English.Text: I dedicate this next song to all you guys and gals still finding your way: "Gotta Walk On."

Japanese.Text: ありがとう！

English.Text: Thank you!

Japanese.Text: 次の曲は　ちょっとだけほろ苦いんだ

English.Text: I wrote this next song for a special lady.

Japanese.Text:
売れないオレを
支えてくれた彼女がいたんだ

English.Text:
Felt like a gillionaire with her─
even when I was broke.

Japanese.Text: もう　別れちゃったんだけどな

English.Text: We're not together anymore...

Japanese.Text:
いまでもどこかで
オレの歌を聞いていてくれると信じてる

English.Text:
but I hope this song reaches her,
wherever she may be.

Japanese.Text: 『黄金の花火』聞いてください

English.Text: This one's for you: "Golden Sparks."

Japanese.Text: ありがとう！

English.Text: Thank you!

Japanese.Text:
最後にオレのデビュー曲
聞いてください

English.Text: This last song is the one that kicked off my career.

Japanese.Text:
フラれつづけて　ロックンロールな歌さ
『ミッドガル・ブルース』

English.Text:
The tale of a small-town kid that the
big city got the best of: "Midgar Blues."

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう！
いつまでも終わらない夢を見たいよな

English.Text:
Thank you; you're too kind! Seriously, this
is nothing short of a dream come true.

Japanese.Text:
それではもういちど
オレの歌　聞いてください

English.Text:
And to all my fellow dreamers,
I hope yours come true too.

Japanese.Text: 『旅の途中　夢の途中』

English.Text: One more time, here's "Gotta Walk On."

Japanese.Text:
ＳＨＩＮＲＡ　ＲＥＣＯＲＤＳ所属
シンガー・アキラ　歌います

English.Text:
Hey there!
I'm Akira, Shinra Records' soon-to-be star.

Japanese.Text: 『旅の途中　夢の途中』

English.Text: Here's a favorite of mine: "Gotta Walk On."

Japanese.Text:
コスタが楽しみすぎて
踊りたくなっちゃうよ～

English.Text: I'm so excited I can barely control my feet!

Japanese.Text: おう　いっしょに飲まないか？

English.Text: Yo yo! Wanna grab a drink?

Japanese.Text: ハンモックで寝るのは初めてなんだ

English.Text: It's kinda neat, sleeping in a hammock.

Japanese.Text:
ふふ　旅先の出会いとか
期待しちゃうよなあ

English.Text: Hehe... I wonder if I'll find love in paradise.

Japanese.Text:
コスタで贅沢するぶん
移動費は節約さ

English.Text: Save on the travel costs so you can splurge later!

Japanese.Text: ボクは西の大陸へ　出稼ぎに行くんだ

English.Text: I'm gonna head out west and strike it rich!

Japanese.Text:
船旅ってのは
ユラユラするのがいいんだよ

English.Text: Nothing feels better than rocking along to the motion of the ocean.

Japanese.Text:
クルージングって初めてだから
ワクワクする

English.Text: This whole traveling by ship thing's kinda cool!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは
常夏の楽園なんだよ

English.Text: Costa del Sol, where summer never ends...

Japanese.Text:
神羅から返してもらったりは
できないんですか？

English.Text: Has he ever thought about trying to get it back?

Japanese.Text:
貧乏旅行の最中なんです
人生経験になるかなって

English.Text: I'm backpacking across the world on a budget. For the life experience.

Japanese.Text:
取り返したいから　船長は出世も望まず
この船に乗り続けているんだ

English.Text: 'Course he has. He's just biding his time until the right moment comes along to reclaim what's his.

Japanese.Text:
コスタへの船旅は
がんばった自分へのごほうびよ

English.Text: I know I had to splurge a little to make this trip happen, but I don't care. I deserve it.

Japanese.Text: うわ～　ゆれ～るゆれ～る

English.Text: Whoa! I liked it better when it wasn't...swaying...

Japanese.Text:
はやくコスタの
ふかふかのベッドで寝たいなあ

English.Text: I can't wait to dive into a big, fluffy hotel bed.

Japanese.Text:
コスタで食べ歩きするから
船旅中はガマン！

English.Text: I'm fasting for now so I can eat my way through Costa del Sol!

Japanese.Text: はあ　コスタには仕事で行くんです

English.Text: Hng... Wish I wasn't taking this trip for work.

Japanese.Text: 海に沈む夕日でも見に行こうかな

English.Text: I bet a sunset at sea's amazing.

Japanese.Text: コスタのビーチで遊びまくるつもり！

English.Text: Once I hit the beach, it's party time!

Japanese.Text:
うーん
もっとオシャレしてくればよかった

English.Text: Ugh. I should've gone with something more elegant.

Japanese.Text:
コスタでお金持ちをつかまえて
帰りは絶対　一等客室に乗るんだから！

English.Text: I'm gonna find me a rich idiot and make him buy me a first-class ticket for my trip home─alone, of course.

Japanese.Text:
神羅丸は船員も親切だって
とても評判のいい船よ

English.Text: I knew I'd be in good hands. All the reviews said the service was stellar.

Japanese.Text:
さっき黒いマントを着た
妙な連中を見かけたよ

English.Text: What was with those guys in black robes? They doing a flash mob?

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンのパレードを見て
コスタ・デル・ソルでバカンス
っていうツアーなんだよ

English.Text: I'm glad I caught the parade in Junon, but I'm really lookin' forward to Costa del Sol.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッド大会を
見に行ってみるか

English.Text: Maybe I'll go check out the Queen's Blood tournament.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスも社長に就任して早々
襲撃されるとは　災難だねえ

English.Text: Rufus can't catch a break. First he loses his father, and then he nearly loses his own life.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たち
船員さんに連れてかれちゃったよ？

English.Text: I saw one of the crew usher those men in black robes away... Wonder where they went.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス新社長の演説
感動しちゃった

English.Text: The president's speech was so inspiring─I started tearing up!

Japanese.Text:
神羅の新社長が　就任式典中に
襲撃されたってホント？

English.Text: Did you hear about the parade in Junon? Someone tried to assassinate the new president!

Japanese.Text:
私もクイーンズ・ブラッドの大会に
出てみようかな

English.Text: This Queen's Blood thing sounds kind of fun. Maybe I'll give it a go!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドの大会
盛りあがったな！

English.Text: Man, that final match was electrifying!

Japanese.Text:
最後に乱入してきた
謎の挑戦者は誰なんだ？

English.Text: Who the heck was that mystery player who showed up all dramatic at the end there!?

Japanese.Text:
レジーのカードさばき
ありゃすげえ！

English.Text: I heard Regina was something else, but damn!

Japanese.Text: いや～　楽しかった楽しかった！

English.Text: Wow, that match had me on the edge of my seat!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
見てるだけでも面白いな

English.Text: Queen's Blood's just as much fun to watch as it is to play!

Japanese.Text:
あたしもクイーンズ・ブラッド
はじめようかな

English.Text: Maybe I'll give Queen's Blood a try. It's free to play, isn't it?

Japanese.Text:
謎の挑戦者って
おもしろい人……だったね

English.Text: That "mysterious challenger" certainly made the finals interesting, don't you think?

Japanese.Text:
チトフ船長って　渋くて
とってもすてきなオジサマね

English.Text: That Captain Titov's low-key kinda hot─especially for a guy his age.

Japanese.Text:
思ってたよりハイレベルな大会で
びっくり！

English.Text: I didn't think the competition was gonna be so intense!

Japanese.Text: 船内の警備も　水兵の仕事の１つです

English.Text: The crew doesn't just keep the ship moving─we keep it safe too.

Japanese.Text:
航行中も異常がないか
点検をしているんだ

English.Text: We have to do inspections to make sure everything's in order.

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸　いい船でしょう
やっと配属してもらえたんです！

English.Text: The Shinra-8 is one hell of a ship! I'm over the moon that I finally landed an assignment on it!

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸では船員一同
みなさまの船旅が素敵なものと
なりますよう　努めております

English.Text: On behalf of the entire crew, I wish you a pleasant voyage. If there is anything we can do for you, let us know.

Japanese.Text:
上の階にはラウンジがございます
ぜひ　足を運んでみてください

English.Text: Have you been to the lounge on the upper deck yet? It's open to all of our guests.

Japanese.Text:
目的地のコスタ・デル・ソルは
神羅が作った常夏のリゾートです

English.Text: Costa del Sol is Shinra's premier resort─a paradise where summer never ends!

Japanese.Text: クルージングの旅はいかがでしょうか

English.Text: How are you enjoying the voyage so far?

Japanese.Text:
フルーツ　いかがっすか～？
バナナ　オレンジ　リンゴにマンゴー

English.Text: Get your fresh fruit here! Oranges, bananas, apples, mangoes, and more!

Japanese.Text: 美味しいフルーツは　いかがっすか？

English.Text: Ripe and tasty fruit for sale!

Japanese.Text:
コスタの太陽をたっぷり浴びてますから
甘くて　みずみずしいですよ！

English.Text: Sweet, juicy fruit, right here! Get a taste of the tropical sun!

Japanese.Text:
水兵さんたちは
世界中を旅してまわってるの？

English.Text: You sailors must be living the life, traveling all over the world.

Japanese.Text:
仕事であれば　どこへでも
という感じです

English.Text: Well, not all over─just wherever the job takes us.

Japanese.Text: それは楽しそうだ

English.Text: Still sounds like fun to me.

Japanese.Text:
知らない街へ行くときは
ワクワクしますが

English.Text: Yeah, visiting new places is nice...

Japanese.Text:
モンスターがたくさんいる地域ですと
ちょびっと怖いんですよ

English.Text: except when those new places happen to be filled with fiends─could do without that.

Japanese.Text: チョコレート　も～らい

English.Text: That chocolate's mine!

Japanese.Text: わたし　クッキー！

English.Text: I want a cookie!

Japanese.Text: キャラメルは　だれにも渡さない

English.Text: Nobody's getting my caramel!

Japanese.Text:
よ～し
クイーンズ・ブラッドで勝負な！

English.Text: Alright─Queen's Blood! Winner takes 'em all!

Japanese.Text: へっ　おまえにはぜってー負けねえ

English.Text: Heh. Hope you're ready to watch me eat!

Japanese.Text:
神羅の新社長が
就任式で襲撃されるなんて！
大スクープ　とくダネよ

English.Text: We got the scoop on the new president skirting death at his own inauguration! This is gonna make our careers!

Japanese.Text:
襲撃したのは
ウータイのシノビらしいって噂は
本当ですかね？

English.Text: That rumor about Wutai's ninjas being involved... You think it holds any water?

Japanese.Text:
ふふ　事件の真相を確かめるために
なんとかウータイに潜り込めないかしら

English.Text: Maybe I ought to go undercover in Wutai to root out the truth! It'd be the ultimate exposé!

Japanese.Text: ええっ　無茶言わないでくださいよ

English.Text: Whoa, easy! Let's slow down there a little bit!

Japanese.Text:
ペンはシノビよりも強し
突撃あるのみ！

English.Text: Oh no─the pen is mightier than the ninja, and I'm gonna prove it!

Japanese.Text: おみやげに　ダチャオ豆も手に入るしね

English.Text: And while I'm at it, I can pick up some Da-chao beans as tasty souvenirs.

Japanese.Text:
はわ～　第八神羅丸さま
カッコよすぎて語彙力死ぬでありんす！

English.Text: Oh em gee. I can't believe we're actually on board the Shinra-8! I'm literally speechless!

Japanese.Text:
エンジンの重低音を聴いてると
耳元で囁いてほしくなる

English.Text: Oh baby, what I wouldn't give to hear the purr of that engine up close!

Japanese.Text:
ひょえ～　マッチョな鉄骨
抱かれたい船　ナンバーワン！

English.Text: And can we talk about that frame? I like my ships well built, and this baby is thicc!

Japanese.Text:
機関室のエンジンも覗きたいんだけど
いけるかな？

English.Text: I wonder if we could sneak into the engine room without getting busted...

Japanese.Text:
セキュリティ固いから
無理っぽいでありんす～

English.Text: It's worth a try, but security's looking pretty tight...

Japanese.Text: ここで　熱い鼓動を感じるのがいいっす

English.Text: But at least we can feel the ship's pulse from here!

Japanese.Text: はわ～！

English.Text: Oh wow!

Japanese.Text:
パパはいま　猛烈に感動している
こうして家族旅行に行けるなんて！

English.Text: You know why Daddy's so happy, sweetheart? Because he's on vacation with his two favorite ladies!

Japanese.Text: 大袈裟ねえ

English.Text: Oh, stop.

Japanese.Text: コスタで新しい服を買ってもいい？

English.Text: I wanna buy some new clothes for the beach!

Japanese.Text: 私は美味しいディナーが食べたいわ

English.Text: And I'd love to have a candlelit dinner!

Japanese.Text:
よ～し　奮発しちゃうぞ！
太陽の楽園へのドリームツアーなんだ

English.Text: Whatever you want, it's yours! Daddy's gonna make all your dreams come true!

Japanese.Text:
ふたりのためなら
パパはごはん抜きでも問題ナシ！

English.Text: I'd go hungry if it meant I could make the two of you happy!

Japanese.Text:
出向先の神羅リゾートで
どんな仕事するんですか？

English.Text: So what's on the docket for you once we arrive in Costa del Sol?

Japanese.Text: 主に　社員旅行の準備だな

English.Text: Just doing prep for the big corporate trip.

Japanese.Text:
のんびりと　ゆるゆると
おいしい仕事だよ

English.Text: It's laid-back and low stress─kind of the perfect job for me.

Japanese.Text:
リゾート地での業務なんて
想像つかないな

English.Text: And what sort of "work" does this "job" of yours entail?

Japanese.Text:
朝からサーフィンだろ
昼間は釣りだな　夜は……ムフフだよ

English.Text: Well, there's surfing in the morning, then fishing at noon. And then the evening's reserved for more "adult" pastimes.

Japanese.Text:
俺　ミッドガルで
バリバリやりたかったっす

English.Text: Damn... Sounds like you're living the dream for both of us.

Japanese.Text: コスタでは　どんな遊びを？

English.Text: So, what's on the agenda?

Japanese.Text:
私はサーフィンですね
波がイイんですよ　あそこは

English.Text: Surfing for me. The waves in Costa del Sol are second to none.

Japanese.Text: ボクはダイビングです

English.Text: I'm gonna go diving.

Japanese.Text:
コスタでは　珍しい魚と
たくさん触れあえるんですよ

English.Text: I'm all about rare fish, and they've got loads of 'em out there.

Japanese.Text: あなたは？

English.Text: And you?

Japanese.Text:
浮き輪ですね
私　珍種の浮き輪コレクターなんです

English.Text: Me? Swim rings, baby. There's so many kinds, and I love to collect rare ones!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　モルボル浮き輪
見せびらかした～い！

English.Text: I've got this malboro-shaped gem that I am totally dying to show off!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　特注の
リヴァイアサンもありますよ！

English.Text: Oh! I've got a bespoke Leviathan ring too!

Japanese.Text:
この船に乗り始めて
もう何年かな　覚えてねえや

English.Text: I've been sailing with this old girl for decades... Honestly can't remember how long it's been.

Japanese.Text:
あなたのようなベテランが
長年　神羅の海運を支えてきたのですね

English.Text: Shinra is indebted to you for supporting our maritime endeavors for so many years.

Japanese.Text: 我々もみんな感謝していますよ

English.Text: Thank you, on behalf of us all.

Japanese.Text:
コツコツ働いてきただけだよ
ねぎらいの言葉なんざ　いらねえ

English.Text: 'Preciate the sentiment, but there's no need to thank me. I'm just doin' my job.

Japanese.Text: そんな　ご謙遜を

English.Text: You shouldn't downplay your contributions.

Japanese.Text:
兄ちゃんも船のエンジンの歯車に
ありがとうなんて言った事はねえだろ？

English.Text: Well, what about the engine, or the gears? You gonna thank them for their contributions too?

Japanese.Text: それと同じさ

English.Text: Didn't think so.

Japanese.Text:
七番プレート崩落でケガしたときは
お先まっくら

English.Text: When the plate fell and I got hurt, I was pretty depressed.

Japanese.Text:
勘弁してくれって感じだったけど
おかげで休みが取れてよかったよ

English.Text: But then I got this vacation, so I guess it turned out pretty good in the end!

Japanese.Text:
うんうん
キミはいつも働きすぎなんだから

English.Text: I couldn't agree more! You've been working too hard for too long.

Japanese.Text:
コスタで　のんびり
リフレッシュしようね

English.Text: It's past time you got some R & R!

Japanese.Text:
いいか　船の点検ってのはな
五感をフルに使ってやるもんなんだよ

English.Text: Listen up: servicing this ship requires more than just a good set of tools. You've gotta have good instincts too!

Japanese.Text: 機械にばかり頼ってちゃあいけねえ

English.Text: Your sense of sight, your sense of touch...

Japanese.Text:
五感ってことは　先輩は
船を舐めたりとかもするんスか？

English.Text: What about taste, sir? You aren't gonna make us lick the ship, are you?

Japanese.Text:
あたぼうよ　ベロベロ～ってな
舌つきだして油を感じろ　油だ！

English.Text: You bet your ass I am! Now stick that tongue out, boy, and taste the motor oil in the air. Taste it!

Japanese.Text:
この船はもともと　チトフ船長の
おじいさんの船だったって本当ですか？

English.Text: I heard this ship used to belong to Captain Titov's grandfather. That true?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　ジュノン戦争のあと
神羅に持っていかれた挙句に
改造されてこのザマだ

English.Text: Sure is. After the war, Shinra took everything─including his vessel. Gave it a real makeover.

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸のホスピタリティは
噂どおり　悪くないね

English.Text: I heard excellent things about their hospitality, and I'm pleased to say the rumors were true.

Japanese.Text:
コスタでは
別荘でのんびりするつもりさ

English.Text: Once we dock, I'm making a beeline for my villa.

Japanese.Text:
船に乗るのが楽しみで
昨日は眠れなかったんだ

English.Text: I was so excited for this trip I barely slept a wink last night!

Japanese.Text:
水兵のみんなに
チップでも振るまってみようかな

English.Text: Those sailors are working so hard, someone really oughta tip them.

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルへの到着が
待ちきれないよ！

English.Text: I can't wait till we arrive in Costa del Sol!

Japanese.Text: わたくし　クルージングが大好きなの

English.Text: I never tire of sailing the open sea.

Japanese.Text: ディナーはルームサービスで済ますわ

English.Text: I can't wait to order room service!

Japanese.Text:
ラウンジのバーに
１杯　飲みにいこうかな

English.Text: Perhaps I'll pop over to the lounge for a quick tipple.

Japanese.Text:
船旅を選ぶのは
贅沢な海のひとときを楽しむためよ

English.Text: It's not about when you get there, but how─and what's more grand than arriving by ship.

Japanese.Text: 甲板で風でも浴びてこようかしら

English.Text: I bet the breeze on the deck feels exquisite.

Japanese.Text: こちらは一等客室でございます

English.Text: These are the first-class cabins.

Japanese.Text: 申し訳ございません

English.Text: I'm terribly sorry.

Japanese.Text:
一等のお客様のお部屋ですので
ご遠慮ください

English.Text: These cabins are reserved for our first-class passengers.

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸の快適なクルージングを
心ゆくまでお楽しみください

English.Text: On behalf of the Shinra-8 staff, we wish you a pleasant and peaceful voyage.

Japanese.Text:
ご乗船いただき
まことにありがとうございます

English.Text: On behalf of our entire crew, I thank you for sailing with us.

Japanese.Text:
こちらは一等客室でございます
入室は　ご遠慮ください

English.Text: My apologies, but these are the first-class cabins. Other passengers are not allowed beyond this point.

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸の快適なクルージングを
心ゆくまでお楽しみください

English.Text: Thank you again for choosing to cruise with the Shinra-8. We hope you enjoy your voyage.

Japanese.Text: この先は　関係者以外立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: Sorry, sir. Only ship's crew allowed in here.

Japanese.Text:
なにがあるか　気になりますよね
教えられません！

English.Text: Bet you're wondering what's behind this door. Unfortunately, I can't say!

Japanese.Text: 本社から連絡があった

English.Text: Just got a call from HQ.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンの騒動の後始末で
大変な状況らしい

English.Text: Cleaning up that mess in Junon is gonna take more work than they thought.

Japanese.Text:
バカンスはまた今度にして　会社に
顔を出したほうがいいかもしれない

English.Text: As much as I'd love to stay with you, I think they're gonna need me back at the office.

Japanese.Text:
ええ　家に帰るの？
コスタで遊んでからにしようよ～

English.Text: Wait─you're going home already? But our vacation hasn't even started!

Japanese.Text:
そうですよ
せっかくのお休みなのに

English.Text: He's right, dear─and we both know you deserve some time off.

Japanese.Text:
いまは部長さんや課長さんより
私たちへの気配りが大事だよ　お父さん

English.Text: You spend all your time with "director this" and "manager that." What about spending time with us, Dad!?

Japanese.Text:
一等客室は
ベッドの寝心地も素晴らしいね
感動しちゃったよ

English.Text: I knew I was in for a luxurious trip when I booked a first-class cabin, but that bed is incredible!

Japanese.Text:
お気に召していただき
光栄でございます

English.Text: I'm so pleased to hear that you found it to your liking, sir.

Japanese.Text:
ふかふか　ふがふが
グ～スカピ～といったところだ

English.Text: I certainly did! No sooner did I flop down than I was honk-shooing like a baby.

Japanese.Text: さすがお客様　旅慣れてらっしゃる

English.Text: Sounds like the perfect fit for a seasoned traveler like you.

Japanese.Text:
あはは　おみやげにして
持って帰りたいくらいだよ

English.Text: Haha! So perfect I'd take it with me if it weren't bolted down.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッド大会
盛りあがりそうだ

English.Text: This Queen's Blood tournament is gonna be a blast!

Japanese.Text: 大会に参加するなら応援するぜ

English.Text: If you play, I'll be sure to cheer you on!

Japanese.Text:
レジーっていう
凄腕バウターが出るらしいな

English.Text: I heard this famous cardslinger named "Regina" is playing.

Japanese.Text:
カードバウトをツマミに
お酒飲もうっと

English.Text: Can't wait to grab a pint and check out the tourney from the sidelines!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッド大会の受付は
ここよ

English.Text: Sign-ups for the Queen's Blood tournament are over here!

Japanese.Text:
どんなバウトが見れるのかな
ワクワクする！

English.Text: Today's tournament is gonna be intense─I can feel it!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドのルールは
意外とシンプルなの

English.Text: You'd be surprised how easy Queen's Blood is to pick up and play.

Japanese.Text:
熱い対戦の前に
オンザロックで喉をうるおすわ

English.Text: I'm gonna need a drink or two to calm my nerves before the matches start.

Japanese.Text:
おお　あんたのこと
応援するぜ！

English.Text: Hey, good luck out there. I'll be rooting for you!

Japanese.Text: カードバウトの調子はどうだ？

English.Text: You holding your own against the others?

Japanese.Text:
レジーっていう凄腕バウター
噂どおり　つえーな

English.Text: That Regina makes some big-brain plays. She's a Queen-ius!

Japanese.Text:
熱いバウトを見てると
酒が進むぜ！

English.Text: Just watching stresses me out... I need another drink!

Japanese.Text: あら　あなたも大会に参加しているの？

English.Text: Ooh, tough guy, huh? I'd hate to have to face off against you.

Japanese.Text:
どっかで　面白そうなバウトは
やってない？

English.Text: If I'm gonna watch, I wanna make sure I pick a good match.

Japanese.Text:
今日の私は　応援専門
戦況を分析するのよ

English.Text: I won't be playing today. I'm just gonna watch from the sidelines and analyze the competition.

Japanese.Text:
１杯飲みながら観戦するのも
いいものね

English.Text: I think I prefer to sip my drink while I spectate.

Japanese.Text: おお　いい勝負だったぞ！

English.Text: Hey, you did amazing out there!

Japanese.Text:
ゴホッゴホッ
応援しすぎて喉が痛いぜ

English.Text: Think I'm losing my voice from all this cheering!

Japanese.Text:
謎の挑戦者
関節が妙な方向に曲がってなかったか

English.Text: What was up with that challenger? I've heard of people getting their sea legs, but no legs should bend like that.

Japanese.Text:
うへえ　もうベロベロだ
フラつく……

English.Text: Oof... Think I might've had one too many drinks.

Japanese.Text: うまくカードバウトできた？

English.Text: Manage to hold your own out there?

Japanese.Text: クイーンズ・ブラッド　堪能しちゃった

English.Text: That was the hottest tournament I've ever seen!

Japanese.Text: 頭ガンガンする……知恵熱かな？

English.Text: My head is pounding... Maybe I'm putting too much thought into this game.

Japanese.Text: 大会の成功を祝して　カンパ～イ！

English.Text: Cheers to you on your stunning performance!

Japanese.Text: パーティーナイト　フォ～！

English.Text: Party, party, party, yeah!

Japanese.Text: なあなあ　誰が優勝すると思う？

English.Text: So─who do you think's gonna win the tournament?

Japanese.Text:
さてと
どのバウターを応援するかな

English.Text: Let's see... Which competitor am I gonna root for today?

Japanese.Text: 船上のお祭って感じがするね

English.Text: Wow, I've never been to a party on a cruise before!

Japanese.Text:
ぼく　クイーンズ・ブラッド
好きなんですよ

English.Text: I'm actually really into Queen's Blood right now.

Japanese.Text:
さあさあ　お気楽に
楽しんでいきましょう！

English.Text: Can't wait to kick back, relax, and enjoy some cards!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドのアドバイスなら
まかせて

English.Text: If you need any Queen's Blood tips, feel free to ask.

Japanese.Text:
大会に参加するなら
健闘を　お祈りするわ

English.Text: Are you gonna join today's tournament? I'll be rooting for you if you do.

Japanese.Text:
ここにいるだけで　カードバウトが
強くなったような気になります

English.Text: I'm not the greatest player, but my plan is to hang around others and improve through osmosis!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドは
世界中に愛好家がいるの

English.Text: Queen's Blood is, like, literally a worldwide phenomenon!

Japanese.Text: ここは　大人の社交場って感じ

English.Text: Finally, a place to mingle with my people!

Japanese.Text: よっしゃ　燃えてきた～！

English.Text: Now I'm really gettin' fired up!

Japanese.Text:
カードバウトで
パーティー　フォ～！

English.Text: Card battles, baby! All night long!

Japanese.Text: 優勝はやっぱり　レジーで決まりかな

English.Text: There's no world in which Regina doesn't win.

Japanese.Text:
アイツが勝つか
それとも　コイツかな？

English.Text: Hm... It's a close match. Either one of 'em could take it!

Japanese.Text:
くう～　熱い対戦の雰囲気
たまらんぜ！

English.Text: Phew! Competition's so hot, I'm starting to feel a little feverish!

Japanese.Text:
ボクが出場してなくて
ラッキーでしたね

English.Text: Let's just say you're lucky you won't have to face me.

Japanese.Text:
カードバウトの駆け引きは
楽しめていますか？

English.Text: Nothin' compares to the thrill of a good game!

Japanese.Text:
強いカードをどのタイミングで出すかを
よーく考えて

English.Text: Even the strongest cards only shine when you play them at the right moment!

Japanese.Text: それがクイーンズ・ブラッドの極意よ！

English.Text: That's the key to becoming a champion!

Japanese.Text:
勝利の美酒に酔うのは誰か
見届けさせてもらうわ

English.Text: I look forward to seeing who among them will savor the sweet taste of victory.

Japanese.Text:
バウトって叫ぶと
強くなった気になりません？

English.Text: I may not be that good, but I'm great at yelling "Draw!"

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドの戦術は
強い者同士の戦いの中で
磨かれてきたのよ

English.Text: The best strategies are the ones honed through countless battles─and against the toughest of opponents.

Japanese.Text: いいわね　優雅な大会だわ

English.Text: Ah, such a wonderful and elegant affair!

Japanese.Text: もっと熱い　灼熱のバウトを見せてよ！

English.Text: Come on, come on! Let's see some real card action!

Japanese.Text: 祝勝パーティー　フォ～！

English.Text: You're a winner, baby! A champ-i-on!

Japanese.Text:
いやあ　レジー戦
すごい盛りあがりだったね

English.Text: Regina really knows how to put on a show. That match was fire!

Japanese.Text:
うおお　オレの応援してた子
負けちゃったよ

English.Text: Dang... I knew I shouldn't have gone all in on that player. What a heartbreaker!

Japanese.Text:
決勝戦からの興奮で
酔いも吹っ飛んだよ！

English.Text: I was getting a bit woozy, but that last match woke me right up!

Japanese.Text:
ハハハ　ボク抜きの大会じゃ
こんなものですかね

English.Text: Hah! That tournament felt so amateurish without me.

Japanese.Text:
勝ち負けより　楽しい時間を
過ごせたかどうかが大切なんですよ

English.Text: It's not about who won or lost. The real victor is the one who had the most fun playing!

Japanese.Text:
勝負が終わったら　すぐ結果の分析
それが強くなるコツ

English.Text: Reflect on your matches as soon as they're over─while it's all still fresh. That's how you get good.

Japanese.Text:
うふふ
いいライバルは見つかったかしら

English.Text: Find a worthy opponent out there yet?

Japanese.Text:
バウトって叫びました？
熱い戦いでしたね

English.Text: That was riveting! And you didn't even shout "Draw!" like I always do!

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドマニアの人たちも
今大会のクオリティには
大満足じゃないかしら

English.Text: I'll bet that every QB fan in the world will be wishing they could've been here to witness this tournament in person!

Japanese.Text:
はあ～……
熱戦の余韻にひたっているの

English.Text: Whew! My heart's still pounding after that last match!

Japanese.Text:
熱くなりすぎて
今夜は寝つけないかも

English.Text: That match was so hype, I won't be able to sleep tonight!

Japanese.Text:
快適な船旅のためには
遊び心を忘れちゃいけません

English.Text: The key to enjoying your voyage is making the most of your downtime.

Japanese.Text: さあ　キミの腕前を見せてくれ！

English.Text: Alright, stud, show us what ya got!

Japanese.Text:
船長は　こういう
サプライズイベントが好きなんだ

English.Text: The captain's always planning some kind of special event.

Japanese.Text:
ナンバーワンを目指して
がんばってください

English.Text: Shoot for the top─you can do it!

Japanese.Text:
思いきりの良さが
勝負の分かれ目だぞ

English.Text: If you wanna win, you've gotta be able to think on your feet.

Japanese.Text:
さあ　熱いカードバウトで
盛りあげてくださいよ！

English.Text: You've got an audience out there, so make sure to give 'em a good show!

Japanese.Text:
なかなか　いい戦いを
見せてもらいましたよ

English.Text: Glad I caught that match. What a showstopper!

Japanese.Text: どうだ　大会は楽しめたかい？

English.Text: Sure looked like you were havin' fun out there!

Japanese.Text:
みなさん　盛りあがってくれたようで
なによりです

English.Text: I think it's safe to say today's tournament was a huge success!

Japanese.Text:
船旅を盛りあげてくれる１杯を
いただこうか

English.Text: I was thinking we might raise a toast to our trip.

Japanese.Text: おまかせください

English.Text: Very good, sir.

Japanese.Text:
フルーティで
トロピカルなものがいいわ

English.Text: I'd like something fruity and tropical.

Japanese.Text:
では　コスタ産のロゼワインなど
いかがでしょう

English.Text: We have a spectacular Costa del Sol rosé.

Japanese.Text: うむ　いちばん高級なやつで頼む

English.Text: Perfect. We'll take your classiest bottle.

Japanese.Text: あら　あたしにピッタリ！

English.Text: For your "classiest" lady?

Japanese.Text:
カードバウトの極意を教えてやろうか？
実は　絶対負けない方法があるんだ

English.Text: There's a surefire way to become a Queen's Blood master─to guarantee that you never, ever lose.

Japanese.Text: えっ　ホント？

English.Text: Like, for real?

Japanese.Text:
それはな　勝てない相手には
決して挑まないことだ

English.Text: It's simple. Don't challenge opponents you know you can't beat.

Japanese.Text:
へえ……って　それじゃオレ
誰とも戦えない！

English.Text: Huh... Wait─then I wouldn't be able to play anyone!

Japanese.Text:
あと　もうひとつ
負けそうになったらリタイアだ

English.Text: Also, remember to always quit when you're about to lose!

Japanese.Text:
無様に負けるよりは
戦略的撤退を選ぶのが　一流だよ

English.Text: Before you suffer a shameful defeat, make a strategic withdrawal!

Japanese.Text: あはは　ミツバチの格好してる！

English.Text: Hahaha, you look like a big bee!

Japanese.Text:
うふふ　あんまり笑うと
プスっと刺しちゃうぞ～！

English.Text: You'd better watch out, little boy! Or you just might get stung!

Japanese.Text: いける　そのまま押し切れ！

English.Text: C'mon, you got this in the bag!

Japanese.Text: いい流れがきてるな！

English.Text: Damn, you're really on a roll!

Japanese.Text: よっしゃ　その調子！

English.Text: Now that's a play!

Japanese.Text: へえ　なかなかやるじゃん

English.Text: They're really kickin' ass!

Japanese.Text: うわっ　容赦ねえ

English.Text: Oh! Brutal!

Japanese.Text: おお～！

English.Text: Wha-ha-hoa!

Japanese.Text: へえ　やるじゃないの

English.Text: Wow! Color me impressed!

Japanese.Text: うわ　すごい　そう来るか！

English.Text: Whoa! I never woulda thought of that!

Japanese.Text: そこだ　いまがチャンス！

English.Text: Yeah, that's it! Now's your chance!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　かっこいい！

English.Text: You are killing it, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: いいよ　押してけ～！

English.Text: Go, go─you've got 'em on the ropes!

Japanese.Text: アンタなら絶対勝てるよ　クラウド

English.Text: This tournament is yours, my man!

Japanese.Text:
レジーに勝てたら
最強の座はアンタのものだ

English.Text: Show her who the greatest Queen's Blood player really is!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　決勝戦ぶちかませ！

English.Text: C'mon, Cloud! I wanna see you kick some ass!

Japanese.Text:
世界一になって
クイーンズ・ブラッドの歴史に
クラウドの名前を残そうぜ！

English.Text: One more match, Cloud! You got this! Claim your place in Queen's Blood history!

Japanese.Text: レジーに勝って　祝杯をあげような

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! Drinks're on me if you win it all!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさ～ん　ハイタッチして～！

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! Gimme a high five!

Japanese.Text: キャ～　こっち見てクラウド～！

English.Text: Cloud, Cloud! Over here!

Japanese.Text: 勝ったら　いっしょにお祝いしようね！

English.Text: Let's share a bottle if you win this one, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　あとで
インタビューさせてください

English.Text: Find me when you've won, Cloud! I wanna know everything about you!

Japanese.Text:
優勝まで　あと１勝だよ
がんばって！

English.Text: Only one more match to go! You can do this!

Japanese.Text: ああ　もう最高！

English.Text: That's the stuff. Get 'em!

Japanese.Text:
レジーも乱入者も
まとめてひねりつぶすなんて

English.Text: Taking down not only Regina but that newcomer as well?

Japanese.Text: アンタすごかったよ　クラウドさん！

English.Text: Damn─you're a QB shark!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドとまともに勝負できる
バウターは　もうこの世界には
存在しないのかもな

English.Text: Man, you killed it! Doubt there's anyone on the planet who's got a snowball's chance in hell against you.

Japanese.Text:
挑戦者全員　完膚なきまでに
叩きのめすなんて

English.Text: The way you obliterated your opponents, I almost feel bad for the competition!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　おそるべし

English.Text: How the hell did you do that!?

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんの戦いっぷりは
クイーンズ・ブラッド史上に残る
ベストバウトでしたよ

English.Text: Your matches're gonna go down in history as some of the best Queen's Blood playing ever!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　おめでとう！
まさに完全勝利だったな

English.Text: Congratulations! You went on one hell of a run.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんみたいに
強い人がいるなんて　知りませんでした

English.Text: Wow, Cloud. I've never seen anyone that good at Queen's Blood before.

Japanese.Text: 完全優勝おめでとう　クラウドさん

English.Text: You sure showed them! Nice one, man.

Japanese.Text:
あとで　記念撮影を
お願いしてもいいかしら

English.Text: Can we take a selfie? I mean, if you're not too busy!

Japanese.Text: あの　とってもカッコよかったです！

English.Text: That was the best QB action ever!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
パーフェクトでしたね！

English.Text: Those games of yours were flawless!

Japanese.Text: キャ～！

English.Text: Woo hoo!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　優勝おめでとう！

English.Text: Hey Cloud! Way to go!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　最後まで
楽しませてもらったよ

English.Text: Pure brilliance, Cloud! Just incredible!

Japanese.Text:
エキシビションまで
すごい戦いの連続でした

English.Text: Man, that was amazing! Kept me on the edge of my seat!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさんの勝利を信じてましたよ

English.Text: I just knew you were gonna take it all the way!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドのカードバウト
忘れないぞ！

English.Text: Now that was a tournament I'll never forget!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
最後まで　がんばったね！

English.Text: You never gave up, not even for a second!

Japanese.Text: 優勝おめでとう　クラウドさん

English.Text: Right on, Cloud! You did it!

Japanese.Text:
あなたのバウトは
とってもよかったわ

English.Text: Your matches were sensational!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
これからも　がんばってください

English.Text: That was great─I can't wait to see where you go from here!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんのカードバウトは
最高です！

English.Text: I could watch you play QB forever!

Japanese.Text: なるほど　そうきたか

English.Text: Oooh, that's a good play.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　エキシビションは
惜しかったな

English.Text: It was a close one. You nearly had that guy!

Japanese.Text:
謎の挑戦者は強すぎだよ
なんだよあれ

English.Text: Where did that last dude come from? And how the hell did he get so good!?

Japanese.Text:
最後まで楽しませてくれて
ありがとう！

English.Text: For what it's worth, I had a lotta fun watching you!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんなら
次は完全勝利できますよ！

English.Text: You'll sweep the competition next time, I just know it!

Japanese.Text:
いきなり変なヤツが乱入してきて
ビックリだな

English.Text: What a twist! Who even was that guy?

Japanese.Text:
無名の選手があんなに強いなんて
信じられない

English.Text: Certainly didn't expect a last-minute entrant to make that big a splash.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
最後のバウトは気にしないで

English.Text: Don't sweat that last match, Cloud. You did great.

Japanese.Text:
あの挑戦者は
きっと人間じゃないのよ

English.Text: I'm calling it─that last player was not human!

Japanese.Text:
エキシビションマッチ
おもしろかった～

English.Text: That was such a crazy match. I'm glad I was there to see it!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんの優勝は
変わらないからね

English.Text: Just remember, you still won the tournament.

Japanese.Text: 集中集中　がんばって！

English.Text: You got this, man. Just keep your head in the game!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　エキシビションの勝利
おめでとう！

English.Text: Way to kick ass in that exhibition match, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: 謎の挑戦者ってのは　何者だったんだ？

English.Text: Seriously, though─ Who was that guy?

Japanese.Text: クラウド　最後のバウトは燃えたぜ！

English.Text: Holy shit, that last match had everything!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　次の大会では優勝
期待してますよ！

English.Text: Lemme know when you're playing next, okay? I wanna be there when you win it all!

Japanese.Text:
変な乱入者を倒してくれて
良かったよ

English.Text: Nice job stickin' it to that mystery card shark.

Japanese.Text:
妙な挑戦者を倒してくれて
スカッとしたわ

English.Text: Watching you take down that weirdo was glorious!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
エキシビション良かったよ！

English.Text: Excellent work, Cloud. Bravo!

Japanese.Text:
あの挑戦者
しっぽ　生えてたよね？

English.Text: That player who showed up last minute─he had a tail...

Japanese.Text:
エキシビションマッチ
盛りあがったね～！

English.Text: Woo! That got my blood pumping!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
エキシビションの勝利おめでとう！

English.Text: Huge congrats on winning that exhibition match, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: 実力　見せてやれ！

English.Text: C'mon, show 'em what you're made of!

Japanese.Text: 相手はあのレジーだ　よくやったよ

English.Text: Don't take it too hard. I mean, you were up against Regina!

Japanese.Text: 負けることもあるさ　しょうがない

English.Text: Ya win some, ya lose some. That's life.

Japanese.Text:
いやあ　レジーにうまく
やられちまったな

English.Text: Yikes. Regina really goes for the jugular, doesn't she...

Japanese.Text:
決勝戦も　いいバウトでした
次こそはリベンジしましょう！

English.Text: Hope you're not beating yourself up. You put up a good fight, man!

Japanese.Text:
元気出せよ　クラウド
準優勝だって立派なもんだろ

English.Text: Hey, don't let it get to you, alright? Second place is nothing to sneeze at!

Japanese.Text: やっぱり　優勝はレジーか

English.Text: Should've figured Regina was gonna win it all.

Japanese.Text: 準優勝おめでとう　クラウドさん

English.Text: Congrats on coming in second place, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
あなたもじゅうぶん強かった
ただ　相手が悪かったのよ

English.Text: You put up a good fight, but...everyone here knew you were gonna lose that one.

Japanese.Text:
あきらめない気持ちを
クラウドさんから学びました

English.Text: You taught me the importance of sticking things out till the bitter end.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
決勝戦は惜しかったですね

English.Text: Aw, man... You were so close to beating 'em too!

Japanese.Text: 油断するなよ

English.Text: Don't get cocky now.

Japanese.Text:
カード大会　まあ
そこそこの盛りあがりだったな

English.Text: Was a fun tournament, all in all. Definitely seen better, though.

Japanese.Text: 決勝戦は　主役不在って感じだ

English.Text: Didn't feel like much of a contest towards the end there, did it?

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　もうちょっと
がんばってほしかったよ

English.Text: You coulda won it all, man. If you'd've just stuck it out...

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんには
期待していたのですが

English.Text: Thought you'd play a better game than that...

Japanese.Text: 負けて失うモノなんてないのにな

English.Text: Why'd you quit? You had nothing to lose.

Japanese.Text:
決勝の舞台にあがれないんじゃ
かっこ悪くない？

English.Text: You couldn't make it to the final round. Lame.

Japanese.Text:
はい　カードバウト
お疲れさま～

English.Text: Well, at least you tried. E for effort?

Japanese.Text:
最後まで戦わず
リタイアしちゃうのって残念

English.Text: You weren't losing that badly, y'know... Could've at least tried.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんには
最後までバウトしてほしかったな～

English.Text: Aw! You really couldn't keep at it? I wanted to see you win!

Japanese.Text:
ええ～　クラウド
あきらめちゃったの？

English.Text: Why didn't you see the tournament through? You could've won, y'know.

Japanese.Text: じっくり相手を観察していけ

English.Text: Can't let 'em get the upper hand, aight?

Japanese.Text:
う～ん……
盛りあがらないカード大会だったな

English.Text: What a snooze-fest of a QB tournament. Where was the excitement─the drama?

Japanese.Text:
あきらめの早いヤツは
いつまでも強くなれないぞ

English.Text: I hope that's not how you face every challenge life throws your way.

Japanese.Text:
あ～　解散解散
さっさと寝ちまおう

English.Text: Talk about a bust... Back to my room, I guess?

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッド
難しすぎましたか

English.Text: You're not very good at this game, are you?

Japanese.Text: まあ　気が乗らない時もあるよな

English.Text: When you're not feelin' it...then you're not feelin' it.

Japanese.Text:
戦わない者は決して負けないけど
つまらないよね

English.Text: Guess you can't say you "lost" when you threw in the towel so early, but...

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんには
期待してたんですけど

English.Text: I had high hopes for you going into this tournament...

Japanese.Text:
もう　どうでもいいやっていう日も
ありますからね

English.Text: I suppose we all have those days when we can't be bothered to try...

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんがいなくても
とってもおもしろい大会でしたよ

English.Text: That tournament had me on the edge of my seat the whole time─even without you in it.

Japanese.Text:
あたし　クラウドの勝利に
賭けていたんだけど

English.Text: Aww, and I was so sure you'd go the distance...

Japanese.Text: へえ～！

English.Text: Damn!

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　この大会に
レジーも出るんだって！

English.Text: Did you know? Regina's gonna be playing in this tournament!

Japanese.Text: ええっ　本当に？

English.Text: Wait, for serious?

Japanese.Text:
レジーって　天才バウターの
レジー・ケーニギンのことだよね

English.Text: Regina Konigin, the card game maven? That Regina?

Japanese.Text: レジー・ケーニギン……

English.Text: I've heard of her.

Japanese.Text:
幼い頃から　大人相手に
数々の大会を勝ち抜いてきた
世界一のカードバウター

English.Text: People say she's a prodigy─that she was beating pros on the circuit while she was still in diapers.

Japanese.Text:
いちども負けたことがないって
噂じゃない！

English.Text: Apparently she's never even lost a match.

Japanese.Text:
ふふ　このカード大会
おもしろくなってきたね

English.Text: This just got a whole lot more interesting.

Japanese.Text: レジーのバウト　すごいね

English.Text: Regina's plays are out of this world!

Japanese.Text: もう　優勝は決まりでしょ

English.Text: She's got this tournament on lock.

Japanese.Text: いやいや　まだわからないよ

English.Text: I wouldn't say that just yet.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドは
強い者が必ず勝つとは限らないから

English.Text: I've seen all kinds of crazy twists and upsets in Queen's Blood before.

Japanese.Text:
決勝戦もすごかったけど
それよりも　エキシビションよ

English.Text: The championship match was pretty intense, but that surprise one put it to shame!

Japanese.Text: いいよ～　オーケーオーケー！

English.Text: Nice going! That'll make 'em sweat!

Japanese.Text: なにあれ！

English.Text: What was that!?

Japanese.Text:
まさか　謎のバウターが
乱入してくるとはね

English.Text: Who would've thought a mystery player would show up at the last second?

Japanese.Text: 見た目は　なんか変だったけど

English.Text: Something was off about him, though...

Japanese.Text:
あんなに強い人が
無名のままでいたなんて

English.Text: I'm shocked someone that skilled isn't more widely known.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドは
実に奥が深いわ

English.Text: The Queen's Blood talent pool is incredibly deep.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッド大会で
優勝するのは誰か　賭けをしてみないか

English.Text: So, who do you think is gonna come out on top in the Queen's Blood tournament? Any guesses?

Japanese.Text:
でも　この大会
レジーが出場しているらしいぞ

English.Text: I mean, what's there to guess? It's obviously gonna be Regina.

Japanese.Text:
レジーって
あのレジー・ケーニギン？

English.Text: You mean Regina Konigin's playing?

Japanese.Text:
負けたことがないって
天才バウターだろ

English.Text: I heard she's never lost a match!

Japanese.Text:
そうそう
つまり賭けは成立しないよ

English.Text: Exactly. Which is why it's hardly worth speculating.

Japanese.Text:
盤面の上では　みなが平等に
立場を忘れて夢中になれる

English.Text: Queen's Blood is the ultimate equalizer. Wealth and status mean nothing to the cards.

Japanese.Text:
これこそ　世界中で愛される
クイーンズ・ブラッドの
本当の美しさだと思わないか？

English.Text: That's the reason why so many people around the world are drawn to it. It's the only level playing field we've got.

Japanese.Text: みんな　自分の強さを見せたいだけよ

English.Text: I'd say it's more that people want to test their limits.

Japanese.Text: それも真理だ

English.Text: True, true...

Japanese.Text: そうそう　そこ！

English.Text: You read my mind!

Japanese.Text: しかし　今回はそれも難しかろう

English.Text: But I'm not sure this tournament is the best place for that.

Japanese.Text:
なんせ大会には
あのレジーが出場しているそうだ

English.Text: It's hard to gauge your true potential when you're immediately demolished by Regina.

Japanese.Text:
あらら　それじゃあ挑戦者は全員
彼女にボコボコにされちゃうわね

English.Text: Oh, is she in this one? Well then yeah, they might as well pack it up and go home before they get humiliated.

Japanese.Text:
戦いを終えた後の健闘を称えあう
カードバウターたちの美しさよ

English.Text: There's nothing quite like that glow victorious players have after a hard-fought match!

Japanese.Text:
目を閉じると　涙があふれてきそうだ
実に感無量な大会であった

English.Text: Each and every time, it never fails to bring me to tears. Oh, their sheer radiance...

Japanese.Text: 相変わらず　ロマンチストね

English.Text: I think you might be a little too into this.

Japanese.Text: むむ　オリジナリティあふれる一手

English.Text: Huh. Never seen anyone try that before.

Japanese.Text: フレーフレー　がんばれ～！

English.Text: Woo! Yeah! I believe in you!

Japanese.Text: 集中　ここからここから

English.Text: Time to knuckle down and bring it home!

Japanese.Text: うわ～！
ここが正念場だぞ

English.Text: It's do-or-die now!

Japanese.Text: 気合いだ　気合いを入れろ！

English.Text: You gotta focus! Focus!

Japanese.Text: きっとまだ手はあるはずだよ

English.Text: Don't you got an ace up your sleeve!?

Japanese.Text: あきらめるのは　まだ早いぞ

English.Text: Stop goin' easy on 'em!

Japanese.Text: もうちょい踏ん張れ　まだいけるぞ！

English.Text: Don't panic! You can still turn this around!

Japanese.Text: ああ～……

English.Text: Aw...

Japanese.Text: あきらめるのは　まだ早いって

English.Text: Don't you dare throw in the towel!

Japanese.Text: ああもう　なにしてんの

English.Text: Ugh, what are you doing?

Japanese.Text: あれれ　調子悪いのかな？

English.Text: Uh, are you just checked out, or...?

Japanese.Text: おお　そこから逆転狙うのね！

English.Text: Hey, it's okay! You haven't lost yet!

Japanese.Text: プレッシャーを力に変えて！

English.Text: You're gonna let them do that to you!?

Japanese.Text: ああ～……

English.Text: Aw, seriously?

Japanese.Text: ティファちゃん　がんばれ！

English.Text: You can do this, Tifa. I know you can!

Japanese.Text: ティファ　応援してるぜ

English.Text: Gimme a "T," gimme an "I"...!

Japanese.Text: ティファ　がんばって！

English.Text: Sock it to 'em, girl!

Japanese.Text: ティファさん　いけるよ！

English.Text: Mop the floor with 'em!

Japanese.Text: エアリスさん　すてき～！

English.Text: I love you, Aeriiith!

Japanese.Text: エアリスちゃん　やっちゃって！

English.Text: C'mon! Show 'em what you're made of!

Japanese.Text: エアリス　負けないで！

English.Text: Sending you winning vibes, Aerith!

Japanese.Text: エアリスさん　ガンバガンバ！

English.Text: Aerith! Bring your A game!

Japanese.Text: バレット　期待してるぜ

English.Text: I wanna see you win big, Barret!

Japanese.Text:
おうおうおう
バレット　いったれ！

English.Text: Yeah, that's what I'm talkin' about! Show 'em who's boss!

Japanese.Text: バレット　あんたなら勝てる

English.Text: If anyone can win this, it's Barret!

Japanese.Text:
バレットさん
いっちょブチかまして！

English.Text: Blow this bozo outta the water, Barret!

Japanese.Text:
アニヤンさん
こっち向いて～！

English.Text: Andrea, over here! Andrea!

Japanese.Text:
アニヤン……
う～ん　ミステリアス

English.Text: That Andrea, so sexy... So alluring.

Japanese.Text: アニヤン　愛してる～！

English.Text: Andrea! I'd die for you!

Japanese.Text: アニヤンさん　最高～！

English.Text: No one can outshine Andrea!

Japanese.Text:
マダム・マム……
妖艶な技の使い手だ

English.Text: The way the madam plays is... It's bewitching.

Japanese.Text: マダム・マム　えぐいぜ～

English.Text: When Madam M gets her claws in...she doesn't let go.

Japanese.Text:
マダム・マムが揉み手してる
気をつけて！

English.Text: That look in Madam M's eye! This is gonna be a bloodbath!

Japanese.Text:
マダム・マムに睨まれたら
もう　おしまいよ

English.Text: She'll sweep 'em aside with a flick of her wrist.

Japanese.Text:
ワイズ……
なかなかのポンコツだな

English.Text: This robot's, uh...kind of a piece of shit, huh?

Japanese.Text:
ワイズ～！
どうした　しっかりしろ

English.Text: The hell, Wize!? Update your damn CPU or firmware or somethin'!

Japanese.Text: ワイズ　あきらめないで！

English.Text: Wize! Don't let the haters get you down!

Japanese.Text:
ワイズ　めげないで
たぶん勝ち目は残ってるよ！

English.Text: You've still got a chance, Wize! Don't throw in the towel just yet!

Japanese.Text: フレッサーの笑顔　ステキ～！

English.Text: Hng, Felix is so hot when he smiles like that.

Japanese.Text:
フレッサー
ミスってもカワイイ！

English.Text: It's so adorable when he goofs up.

Japanese.Text:
フレッサーさん
バウトのあと遊んでね～

English.Text: Hey, Felix! Find me after your match, okay?

Japanese.Text:
フレッサーさん
適当に　ファイト～！

English.Text: Don't try too hard! As long as you're having fun!

Japanese.Text: チャドリー　がんばれよ！

English.Text: You can do this, Chadley!

Japanese.Text:
あははは　チャドリーくんのバウトは
すばらしいね

English.Text: Damn, boy really knows how to play, huh?

Japanese.Text:
オレはチャドリーのバウト
好きだなあ

English.Text: That Chadley's got skills like I've never seen!

Japanese.Text: チャドリーくん　負けないでね

English.Text: Yeah! Give 'em hell, Chadley!

Japanese.Text: チャドリーくん　さえてる～！

English.Text: C'mon, boy wonder! Do it to it!

Japanese.Text:
チャドリーって完璧
すこしの隙も感じられないわね

English.Text: Talk about big brain strategies... That Chadley kid's unstoppable!

Japanese.Text:
レジー・ケーニギン……
最高のバウターだ

English.Text: The Regina Konigin? Now this is gonna be a match...

Japanese.Text: レジーに勝てるヤツなんているのか？

English.Text: No way anyone's beating Regina!

Japanese.Text:
天才レジーのバウトは
見てるだけで興奮する！

English.Text: Nothing gets my heart pounding like a Regina Konigin match!

Japanese.Text:
レジー　世界最強の実力を
見せつけてやれ！

English.Text: Alright, Regina! Show this loser why you're the greatest!

Japanese.Text: いっぱつお見舞いしてやれよ　レジー！

English.Text: Make 'em bleed, Regina! C'mon!

Japanese.Text: 天才レジー　すごすぎる！

English.Text: Regina's amazing. A QB prodigy!

Japanese.Text:
レジー！
最強の称号は伊達じゃないわね

English.Text: Hey, Regina isn't called the world's greatest Queen's Blood player for nothin', you know!

Japanese.Text: レジーに勝とうなんて夢のまた夢

English.Text: You, beat Regina? Keep dreaming.

Japanese.Text: 天才レジーに挑むなんて　無謀よ

English.Text: You don't stand a chance against a genius like Regina.

Japanese.Text:
レジーなら　どうせすぐ
終わらせるでしょ？

English.Text: Regina's playing? Oh this'll be quick.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　がんばれ！

English.Text: You got this one, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　期待してるぞ

English.Text: I'm counting on you to win it all, man!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　応援するぜ

English.Text: Don't let anyone stop you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさんなら　絶対勝てる！

English.Text: You show 'em who's boss, alright!?

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　がんばって～！

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! You rock!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　がんばって！

English.Text: I'm rooting for you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　いけるよ！

English.Text: I believe in you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　勝ってください！

English.Text: Cloud! Win it for us!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　ファイト！

English.Text: You've got this! Don't give up!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　やっちゃって！

English.Text: Show us how it's done, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　いいぞ！

English.Text: Hell yeah, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　勢いにのってけ！

English.Text: You gotta ride this momentum to victory!

Japanese.Text: クラウドのバウト　良かったぜ

English.Text: Damn, you wiped the floor with 'em!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　次も勝利な！

English.Text: This tournament is yours to lose, bro!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　ナイスバウト！

English.Text: Cloud, my man! Nicely done!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　次も勝ってね

English.Text: Yeah! Keep it going, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　おめでとう！

English.Text: Way to go, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　楽勝でしたね

English.Text: Cloud didn't even break a sweat!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　次もがんばって！

English.Text: Keep that winning streak alive, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
コスタでは　プライベートビーチで
のんびりするつもりさ

English.Text: I need that private beach after all these...people.

Japanese.Text: 船も大きいと　意外に揺れないんだな

English.Text: A relief to know a boat this big doesn't rock that much.

Japanese.Text:
潮風を浴びている瞬間が
クルージングツアーの
いちばんの醍醐味ですよ

English.Text: The best part of any cruise is when you gaze at the horizon and bask in the sea breeze!

Japanese.Text: 海鳥が追いかけてきてるな

English.Text: Look─a flock of seagulls!

Japanese.Text:
船で日光浴も
オツなもんだねえ

English.Text: Sunbathing on a cruise... Now this is the life.

Japanese.Text:
ふわ～あ……
コスタまで　ひと眠りするか

English.Text: Hahhh... Just one more nap and I'll be in paradise.

Japanese.Text:
夕日が沈む水平線を見てると
ワクワクしますよね

English.Text: Damn... Now that's a sunset. Awe-inspiring stuff.

Japanese.Text: バカンスって最高だよね

English.Text: I really oughta do this more often!

Japanese.Text: 今夜は船の上でパーティーだぜ！

English.Text: Hey, man! Party on the deck tonight!

Japanese.Text:
夜になったら空を眺めてごらんなさい
澄んだ星空が見えますから

English.Text: You should come out here at night─it'll blow your mind how many stars you can see without any light pollution.

Japanese.Text: 風が気持ちいいわね

English.Text: Doesn't the wind feel great?

Japanese.Text:
救命ボートの位置は確認しておくべきよ
なにかあってからじゃ遅いわ

English.Text: Might be a good idea to note where the lifeboats are. Better safe than sorry, you know?

Japanese.Text: コスタでは　ゆっくり休むつもり

English.Text: This beach vacay can't come soon enough!

Japanese.Text:
汗かいたから
シャワーでも浴びようかな

English.Text: I feel all sweaty. Gonna need to take a shower.

Japanese.Text:
海の夕日を見ながら
カクテルを堪能するのが夢だったの

English.Text: Fruity cocktail in hand, and glittering ocean as far as the eye can see...

Japanese.Text: コスタにいる彼氏に会いに行くの！

English.Text: I can't wait to meet up with my boyfriend!

Japanese.Text:
コスタに着いたら
まずは　なにをしよう？

English.Text: What should I do first? Hit up the beach, or...?

Japanese.Text:
バカンスのために
新しい水着を買ったの

English.Text: I'm so excited to try out that new swimsuit I bought!

Japanese.Text: あの水兵さん　ちょっとイイかも

English.Text: Is it just me, or is that sailor kinda cute?

Japanese.Text: はやく海で泳ぎた～い！

English.Text: Just get me to the beach already!

Japanese.Text: この船は　オレたちの希望なんだ

English.Text: We take a lotta pride in this ship, I'll have you know.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンとコスタの間を走る
この定期航路は　東西の大陸を結ぶ
重要な路線なんだよ

English.Text: This ferry's one of the few options for travel between the continents, so we gotta keep her in good shape─or a lotta people'll be in trouble.

Japanese.Text:
チトフ船長とは　お互い
祖父の代からの付き合いでね

English.Text: The captain and I go way back. Knew him when we were kids.

Japanese.Text: 俺個人も　たくさんの恩義がある

English.Text: Honestly, I don't know where I'd be without him.

Japanese.Text:
同じ船に乗っている者は
家族であるという気持ちが大切なんだ

English.Text: Always best to think of your fellow passengers as family when you're out at sea.

Japanese.Text: 海に逃げ場はないからな

English.Text: Mainly because you're stuck with 'em.

Japanese.Text:
ずっと同じ航路を往復しているが
海の様子は　毎日変わるんだ

English.Text: We've sailed this route more times than I can count, but the ocean always keeps us on our toes.

Japanese.Text: 気は抜けないよ

English.Text: Gotta stay sharp.

Japanese.Text: ねえねえ　知ってる？

English.Text: Get a load of this...

Japanese.Text:
コスタって　ビーチだけじゃなくて
いろんなゲームで遊べるらしいよ

English.Text: We can do more than just chill on the beach. There's a whole boardwalk with games.

Japanese.Text: たとえば　どんなのがあるの？

English.Text: Oh yeah? What kinda games?

Japanese.Text:
射的とか動物競技とか
やってみたいと思わない？

English.Text: There's a shooting gallery, an animal race of some sort... The list goes on!

Japanese.Text:
へえ～　おもしろそう
やるやる！

English.Text: Sounds cool! I bet we can make a whole day of it!

Japanese.Text:
スケジュール表を作ったの
コスタに着くまでに確認しておいてね

English.Text: I made us a schedule for our stay. You promise to review it by the time we arrive?

Japanese.Text:
バカンスなのにキッチリしすぎだって
仕事じゃないんだから

English.Text: Baby, we're on vacation. What do we need a schedule for?

Japanese.Text: ボーナス全部はたいたバカンスなのよ？

English.Text: I'm spending my entire bonus on this trip.

Japanese.Text: １秒だって無駄にはできない

English.Text: I'm not wasting a second.

Japanese.Text:
時間を無駄遣いするのが
バカンスだと思うんだけど

English.Text: Isn't that the point of a vacation? To sit around and do nothing?

Japanese.Text: これで　東の大陸ともお別れか

English.Text: Strange, isn't it? Never thought we'd leave.

Japanese.Text: 名残惜しいですか？

English.Text: Neither did I, honestly.

Japanese.Text:
まあな　でも仕方がない
家が潰れてしまったんだから

English.Text: It's a bit clichéd, but...life's given us lemons, and there's nothing left to do but make lemonade.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルが
あんなことにならなければ……

English.Text: I know, I just hate to leave Midgar like this.

Japanese.Text:
言うな
新しい土地での生活も楽しみだよ

English.Text: Think of it this way: Costa del Sol could be the start of something great.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンのパレード
すごかったらしいよ

English.Text: Heard the president's parade was a spectacle...

Japanese.Text: 参加したかったのか？

English.Text: Jealous, are we?

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸の水兵全員で
パフォーマンスするのも
けっこう　面白そうじゃない？

English.Text: Aren't you? C'mon─would've been fun to get the crew together. Strut our stuff!

Japanese.Text: 海を守るのが　オレたちの仕事だ

English.Text: Oh, come off it. We're sailors!

Japanese.Text:
パフォーマンスは
専門のヤツらにまかせておけばいい

English.Text: We should be sailing, not prancing in the street.

Japanese.Text:
おカタいね
そういうとこがいいんだけど

English.Text: Such a stick in the mud... You're lucky you're cute.

Japanese.Text:
あ～もしもし　聞いてる？
いま船に乗ったよ

English.Text: Hey, can you hear me now? ...Yep, I made it!

Japanese.Text:
コスタの天気はどう
今日も明日も明後日も晴れてる？

English.Text: What's the weather lookin' like over there? Sunny? Clear skies?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　オレって晴れ男だから
ラッキーだな

English.Text: Hehe... Like I said, I've been walking on sunshine!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　コスタは常夏いつも晴れだって？
ああまあ　そりゃそうだ

English.Text: I know─"always sunny in Costa del Sol." You still remember what clouds look like?

Japanese.Text: まあとにかく　海で遊べるな

English.Text: I'm gonna get so tan...!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　買い物がしたい？
オッケー　オッケー

English.Text: Huh? ...Yeah, yeah. We'll hit the shops!

Japanese.Text: あ～もしもし　聞いてる？

English.Text: Hey, can you hear me now?

Japanese.Text:
船の上でさ　クイーンズ・ブラッドの
大会が開かれていたんだよ

English.Text: Just watched this massive QB tournament. Wish you coulda seen it.

Japanese.Text: しかもね　あのレジーが出場してたんだ

English.Text: Regina was here! She killed it!

Japanese.Text: ええ　誰って？

English.Text: C'mon, you know Regina.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドのチャンピオン
レジー・ケーニギンだよ

English.Text: Champ among champs? Regina Konigin?

Japanese.Text: そうそう　うらやましいでしょ

English.Text: See? Told you you knew her!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは
とてもいいところよ

English.Text: It's hard not to like Costa del Sol.

Japanese.Text:
私にとっては
夫との思い出の地なの

English.Text: My husband, he just loved it there.

Japanese.Text: 夫は　もういないわ

English.Text: Late husband.

Japanese.Text:
七番プレートの崩落に
巻きこまれちゃってね……

English.Text: He died when the Sector 7 plate fell...

Japanese.Text:
放っておいてちょうだい
ひとりになりたいの

English.Text: I'm sorry, but I'd like to be alone right now.

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの大砲　かっこよかったね

English.Text: That cannon was just breathtaking!

Japanese.Text: ダーリンのほうがカッコイイよ～！

English.Text: Not nearly as breathtaking as you!

Japanese.Text:
こいつ～　大砲と俺を比べるなんて
意味がわからないぞ？

English.Text: Clichéd much? Besides, nothing can compare to that baby! It's in a league of its own!

Japanese.Text: や～ん　怒られちゃった！

English.Text: Well, excuse me for trying to be romantic.

Japanese.Text:
は～い……
深海を泳ぐボトムスウェルのポーズ

English.Text: Next we'll be moving into Terror of the Deep, plunging down into the sea.

Japanese.Text:
バサ～……
潮風に漂うニードルキッスのポーズ

English.Text: Now, shift into spearhawk form and glide along the sea breeze.

Japanese.Text:
シャ～……
砂浜でうねるビーチプラグのポーズ

English.Text: And release! Now become the shoalopod, twisting along the beach.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ～！

English.Text: Hey there, folks!

Japanese.Text:
おみやげに　第八神羅丸
オリジナルの記念品はどうだい？

English.Text: Need a gift for the little ones? Why not make it a Shinra-8 souvenir!

Japanese.Text:
モーグリのパーカーなんてどう
ここでしか買えない水兵バージョン！

English.Text: Like this nautical-themed moogle pullover! Look at 'im! He's a little sailor!

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸クルーズの記念に
おひとつ　どう？

English.Text: Or keep it for yourself! Be the envy of your friends and family!

Japanese.Text: 好きなだけ見ていってくれ

English.Text: Step right up and take a look.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンでおみやげ
買い忘れちゃったんだよ

English.Text: I forgot to get a souvenir in Junon!

Japanese.Text: 日よけの帽子はないかな

English.Text: Maybe I should pick up a hat.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドのカードって
売ってません？

English.Text: Do you sell any Queen's Blood cards?

Japanese.Text:
おみやげ買っちゃうと
荷物が増えるし　迷うわ～

English.Text: I could get souvenirs, but then I'd have to lug them around. Decisions...

Japanese.Text: モーグリのパーカー　かわいい！

English.Text: This moogle hoodie is the cutest!

Japanese.Text: うっぷ……酔い止め薬をください

English.Text: I...I need something for seasickness...

Japanese.Text: 緊急事態ってなんだよ

English.Text: What do they mean "emergency"!?

Japanese.Text: えっ　なにか事件でも起きたのか

English.Text: What's going on? Did something happen!?

Japanese.Text:
まさか
船　沈んだりしないよな？

English.Text: The ship isn't gonna sink or anything, is it?

Japanese.Text:
なあ　この状況
大丈夫だよな？

English.Text: We're gonna be okay, right? Please tell me we're gonna be okay.

Japanese.Text: おいおい　どうなってんだよ

English.Text: What the hell is going on here!?

Japanese.Text:
なによ　この放送
うるさいなあ

English.Text: Okay, we get it! Turn the announcement off already.

Japanese.Text: コスタへの到着は遅れないよね？

English.Text: I hope this doesn't delay our arrival.

Japanese.Text: なに　どうなってるの？

English.Text: This better not be a joke!

Japanese.Text: えっ　もしかしてヤバい状況？

English.Text: Um...are we in danger here?

Japanese.Text: 緊急事態だって　怖いわね

English.Text: "Emergency"? I don't like the sound of that.

Japanese.Text: 軍関係者は　甲板へ向かってください！

English.Text: All military personnel, report to the deck!

Japanese.Text: 甲板で船長と合流してください！

English.Text: The captain's waiting for you on the deck!

Japanese.Text: くそ　どうなってんだ！

English.Text: Oh god, this is a nightmare!

Japanese.Text: 早く逃げろ！

English.Text: Run, run, run!

Japanese.Text: 海からモンスターが来る！

English.Text: They're coming from everywhere!

Japanese.Text: 助けて～！

English.Text: Help me!

Japanese.Text: うわあああ！

English.Text: Aaah!

Japanese.Text: きゃああ　早く逃げて！

English.Text: Aaah! Run, run!

Japanese.Text: やだやだやだ！

English.Text: This isn't happening!

Japanese.Text: ちょっと　どいて！

English.Text: Get outta the way!

Japanese.Text: どうしよう　船が襲われてる！

English.Text: What's going on!? Are we gonna be okay!?

Japanese.Text: いやあああ！

English.Text: Aaah!

Japanese.Text:
みなさん
早く　こっちへ！

English.Text: Hurry! Over here!

Japanese.Text:
落ち着いて
船室に避難してください！

English.Text: Calmly proceed to your cabins!

Japanese.Text: 船室は安全です　こちらへ！

English.Text: This way, everyone! The cabins are safe!

Japanese.Text:
落ち着いて
船室に避難してください！

English.Text: Please remain calm and make your way to the cabins!

Japanese.Text: 武器の準備はいいか！

English.Text: Weapons at the ready!

Japanese.Text: モンスターを侵入させるな！

English.Text: Leave no fiend alive!

Japanese.Text: 船を守るぞ　いいな！

English.Text: Let's save our ship! Move out!

Japanese.Text: はい！

English.Text: Aye!

Japanese.Text: 助けてくれ……

English.Text: Get me outta here!

Japanese.Text: いてえ　いてえよ……

English.Text: It hurts...so much...

Japanese.Text:
動けねえ……
誰か　助けてくれ！

English.Text: I can't move. Please...someone...!

Japanese.Text: ここは安全なのか？

English.Text: Is it safe here?

Japanese.Text: ちくしょう　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: Goddammit... Are we gonna die out here?

Japanese.Text: お願い　助けて……

English.Text: Help me...please...

Japanese.Text: なに　なんなのこれ！

English.Text: This is the worst trip ever!

Japanese.Text: 怖いよ　怖いよ……

English.Text: Oh my god...I'm too young to die!

Japanese.Text: うう……ううう……

English.Text: Hng...

Japanese.Text:
きゃあああ！
やだ　やだ……！

English.Text: Somebody do something!

Japanese.Text: ここは俺が守る！

English.Text: I got it covered here!

Japanese.Text:
おい　こっちだ！
早く避難しろ

English.Text: Hey! Over here! This way's safe!

Japanese.Text: 乗客を守るのが最優先だ　いいな

English.Text: Ensure the safety of the passengers at all costs!

Japanese.Text: 逃げ遅れた人は集まって！

English.Text: There might be stragglers!

Japanese.Text: くそ　訓練どおりやるしかねえ！

English.Text: Keep it together! Just remember your training!

Japanese.Text:
ここより先は
制御室　並びに機関室です

English.Text: There's nothing back here save for the control room and the engines.

Japanese.Text:
第八神羅丸の乗員以外は
立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: Only Shinra-8 staff are allowed beyond this point. You understand.

Japanese.Text:
くそ　やられた
機関室を守ってくれ……

English.Text: Goddammit... Don't let 'em into the engine room...

Japanese.Text:
黒マントたちが
モンスターといっしょに……

English.Text: Those men...they fused with those...things...

Japanese.Text:
モンスターは……
機関室に向かいました

English.Text: The fiends were...headed for the engine...room...

Japanese.Text:
あれは　人間じゃ
人間なんかじゃない……

English.Text: Those...things. They're not human...

Japanese.Text: 神羅丸を守ってくれ……頼む

English.Text: The ship... It's in your hands now...

Japanese.Text:
船長は……
チトフ船長は無事なのか？

English.Text: Captain Titov... Is he...still alive?

Japanese.Text:
黒マントたちが動き出して
モンスターが来て……

English.Text: The men in robes... And then the fiends came...

Japanese.Text:
エンジンを壊されたら
我々は遭難だ……

English.Text: Don't let them near the engine... Hurry...

Japanese.Text:
エンジンだけは
なんとしても守らなきゃ

English.Text: We need to protect the engine, no matter what!

Japanese.Text: カード大会　楽しかった……

English.Text: Least my last day...was a fun one...

Japanese.Text: うう……かはっ……

English.Text: Urg... Hrk...!

Japanese.Text:
ぐっ……
まだ　やれるさ……

English.Text: Ngh... No... Not yet...

Japanese.Text:
オレは大丈夫だ
ほかのヤツらを助けてくれ

English.Text: Don't worry about me. Go help the others!

Japanese.Text:
よ～し
パレード　気合い入れてくぞ！

English.Text: Okay. Time to win that commendation.

Japanese.Text: ルーファウス様　初めて生で見たな

English.Text: I can't believe we get to see the new president in person.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンの名にかけて
式典は必ず成功させる！

English.Text: We cannot let Midgar win. Not on our own home turf!

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの神羅魂を見せる時だ

English.Text: We'll show everyone what Junon is made of.

Japanese.Text:
ハイデッカー統括がいると思うと
胃が痛いよ

English.Text: Word of advice: do not piss off Director Heidegger.

Japanese.Text: 新社長にイイところを見せないと

English.Text: Just gotta make a good impression on the new president.

Japanese.Text: リハーサルまで　あとすこしか

English.Text: Not long now until the rehearsal.

Japanese.Text: はあ　緊張して眠れなかった……

English.Text: I'm so nervous that I couldn't sleep a wink last night...

Japanese.Text: ハイウインドは　いつ見ても美しいな

English.Text: I tell ya, I never get tired of looking at that beaut.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガル隊との懇親会も
準備しないと

English.Text: Do we have to go to that social for the Midgar units?

Japanese.Text: ルーファウス様　美しかった……

English.Text: Rufus Shinra is a total hunk.

Japanese.Text: 社長は　私たちが必ずお守りする

English.Text: It's our sworn duty to keep the president safe.

Japanese.Text: この先は　立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: Entry is strictly prohibited.

Japanese.Text: この先　見るべきものはないぞ

English.Text: Nothing to see here. Move along.

Japanese.Text:
よしいいぞ　昨日よりもそろっているな
もはや　なにも言うことはない

English.Text: That's the ticket. Much better than yesterday. I don't think I've got anything more to add!

Japanese.Text:
よくぞ　ここまで鍛えあげた
最高の出来だ　私は誇らしいぞ！

English.Text: You've all worked your asses off for this and believe me, it shows. I couldn't be more proud!

Japanese.Text: うん　どうされました？

English.Text: Hm? Do you need something?

Japanese.Text:
街なら下ですよ
リフトで降りてください

English.Text: Elevator's just over there if you wanna get back to town.

Japanese.Text:
まったくなっとらん
貴様ら　いままでなにをやってきた！

English.Text: This is pathetic! I've never seen such a sorry performance!

Japanese.Text:
やる気のないヤツは荷物をまとめて帰れ
せいぜいママに慰めてもらうんだな

English.Text: Shape up or ship out, people! If you can't hack it, pack your bags and run home to your mommas!

Japanese.Text:
なんだ　いま取り込み中だ
パレードを観るならリフトで下へ向かえ

English.Text: Can't you see I'm in the middle of something here? If you wanna check out the parade, take the elevator down.

Japanese.Text:
しっかりタグを確認してください
誤配は減俸ですからね

English.Text: Check each tag carefully. Any mistakes will come out of your salary.

Japanese.Text:
今月こそ誤配ゼロを目指しましょう
みなさん　よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: Let's make sure we have a flawless record this month. You can do it if you put your minds to it!

Japanese.Text:
どうしました？　街なら下ですよ
リフトをお使いください

English.Text: Yes, what is it? Oh, are you trying to get to the town below? Just take the elevator.

Japanese.Text:
オーライ　オーライ！
慎重に

English.Text: You're good! Easy does it now!

Japanese.Text:
ストーップ！
また荷物が傾いてるぞ

English.Text: Stop! Stop! Your cargo's tippin' again.

Japanese.Text:
運搬作業中です　近づかないでください
パレードなら下の階層ですよ

English.Text: Please keep your distance. We're trying to work. If you're here for the parade, it's down below.

Japanese.Text:
嫁がルーファウス社長に
熱を上げててさ

English.Text: My wife is completely obsessed with the new president.

Japanese.Text:
人気急上昇中だもんね
グッズも売り切れ続出なんでしょ？

English.Text: He's definitely growing in popularity. All of his merch is constantly sold out!

Japanese.Text:
朝　店をのぞいたら
開店前から並んでたよ

English.Text: There was a huge line outside the shop this morning!

Japanese.Text: ああそれ　絶対うちのも並んでるわ

English.Text: You know, it wouldn't surprise me if my wife was right there with 'em.

Japanese.Text:
社員向けに販売してくれたらいいのにね
仕方ないから　私も並んだわよ

English.Text: They should have a selection set aside for employees. Why do we have to line up with everyone else?

Japanese.Text:
Ａ区画　Ｂ区画
ともに問題ありませんでした

English.Text: No disturbances to report in either sector!

Japanese.Text: よし　渡航者の審査状況は？

English.Text: Good. What about the passengers?

Japanese.Text:
ＩＤチェックと
持ち物検査を実施した結果
不審な人物は発見できませんでした

English.Text: We checked their IDs and screened all their luggage, sir. There was nothing out of the ordinary.

Japanese.Text:
よし　いいか
本日は神羅にとって記念すべき１日だ

English.Text: Excellent. Now remember: the whole world will be watching the events here today.

Japanese.Text:
失敗は決して許されん
ミッドガルの事件を忘れるな

English.Text: We cannot afford any mistakes. Don't forget what happened in Midgar!

Japanese.Text: ハッ！

English.Text: Sir!

Japanese.Text: 引き続き　気を引き締めて任務に当たれ

English.Text: You must remain vigilant at all times!

Japanese.Text: ハッ！

English.Text: Sir!

Japanese.Text:
ハイウインドのエンジンを見たかい？
あの４基の航空機用空冷星形エンジン

English.Text: Have you seen the engines on the Highwind? That baby's got four of 'em, each with their own cooling unit!

Japanese.Text: シビれるよね～

English.Text: She's a modern marvel.

Japanese.Text:
あの巨体を優雅に上昇させるには
それほどのパワーが必要なんだ

English.Text: Think of the raw power it must take to get a ship that ridiculously huge off the ground.

Japanese.Text: ふん　ゲルニカだって負けてないわよ

English.Text: Ha! It's got nothing on a Relnikha.

Japanese.Text:
離昇出力は低いものの
推進力はなかなかのものよ

English.Text: What they lack in lift, they make up for in sheer propulsive power.

Japanese.Text: なによりフォルムがキュートでしょ

English.Text: Not to mention their sleek frames.

Japanese.Text:
着陸時は可変ウイングが畳まれて
さらに可愛くなるんだから！

English.Text: And I love the way their wings fold up during takeoff. So compact and cute!

Japanese.Text: 確かに　ゲルニカは可愛いね

English.Text: Yeah, fair. I'll give you that.

Japanese.Text:
ハイウインドは
可愛いというより美しいよね

English.Text: But if Relnikhas are cute, then the Highwind is drop-dead gorgeous.

Japanese.Text:
流線形のボディ
ガラス張りのブリッジ

English.Text: Aerodynamic body, full glass bridge...

Japanese.Text:
巨大なプロペラたちに
女神のノーズアート

English.Text: Titanic propellers... Not to mention the nose art...

Japanese.Text: そのすべてが美しい！

English.Text: Every inch of her is stunning!

Japanese.Text:
こちらは　アンダージュノン経由
海底魔晄炉行きのエレベーターです

English.Text: This elevator connects to the offshore reactor via Under Junon.

Japanese.Text: 許可証がないと　ご利用になれません

English.Text: Unauthorized usage is prohibited.

Japanese.Text: 下へ行くには　許可証が必要です

English.Text: Proper clearance is required beyond this point.

Japanese.Text:
ここがジュノンか
迷子になりそうだな

English.Text: How do people live in this city? Place is a damn maze.

Japanese.Text:
式典は　アルジュノンだっけ
エルだっけ？

English.Text: Is the parade in Larboard or Starboard Junon?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄キャノン　でっか～！

English.Text: Look at the size of that cannon!

Japanese.Text: パレードの場所取りしねえと

English.Text: Hope I can still nab a good spot...

Japanese.Text:
どっかの地下に
秘密の酒場があるらしいんだよ

English.Text: Apparently there's a secret underground bar somewhere.

Japanese.Text: 新しい社長　若いのに立派だよな

English.Text: The new prez is surprisingly dignified for his age.

Japanese.Text:
このあたりに
アバランチがまぎれてたりしてな

English.Text: Avalanche could be here right now; you never know.

Japanese.Text:
せっかくミッドガルから来たんだし
楽しまないと

English.Text: Gotta make the most of my time here after traveling all this way.

Japanese.Text: めでたい日だし　たまには奮発すっか

English.Text: What better time to splurge than on a special occasion?

Japanese.Text:
えっ　それは心配しすぎでしょ
要塞都市だよ？
アバランチも簡単には手が出せないって

English.Text: You worry too much. Junon is practically a fortress. There's no way Avalanche could pull anything like that here.

Japanese.Text: パレード　楽しみだね！

English.Text: I can't wait for the parade!

Japanese.Text: ふん　どうだか

English.Text: I don't know...

Japanese.Text:
アバランチを甘くみると
痛い目にあうわよ

English.Text: Underestimate them and you'll regret it later.

Japanese.Text: あんた　アバランチのなんなのよ

English.Text: Honestly, you say that like you're one of them.

Japanese.Text:
ボクの父ちゃんパレードに出るんだ
すごいだろ！

English.Text: My dad's gonna be in the parade! Isn't he the coolest!?

Japanese.Text:
オレのパパもだよ
バイクで出るんだ～！

English.Text: My dad too! He's gonna be on a motorcycle.

Japanese.Text:
いいな～　うちのパパは
たぶん家でゴロゴロしてる

English.Text: Aw, that is cool... My daddy's probably gonna sit around at home, like always.

Japanese.Text: 頭上をご覧ください

English.Text: If you look overhead...

Japanese.Text:
あちらは要塞都市ジュノンが誇る
魔晄キャノン砲です

English.Text: You'll see our famous mako cannon─the pride of Junon.

Japanese.Text:
現在は　ウータイとの協定のため
凍結中ですが

English.Text: It's no longer in use due to our cease-fire with Wutai...

Japanese.Text:
メンテナンスは続けられており
有事の際は　その威力をいかんなく
発揮してくれることでしょう

English.Text: but we still conduct regular maintenance on it to make sure it's in tip-top shape should we ever have need of it again.

Japanese.Text:
こちらはアルジュノンの老舗
『セシリアズ』です

English.Text: Cecilia's is one of the oldest shops in Larboard Junon.

Japanese.Text: この格調高い店構えをご覧ください

English.Text: Note its exquisitely refined architecture.

Japanese.Text:
名所としてガイドブックにも載っており
連日　多くのお客様でにぎわっています

English.Text: This shop is listed as a must-see in every guidebook, and is always filled with customers.

Japanese.Text:
『セシリアズ』って店が
あるはずなんだけど……

English.Text: Cecilia's should be around here somewhere, I think.

Japanese.Text:
大切な記念日のプレゼントなどを
お買い求めになる際は
ぜひ　ご利用ください

English.Text: If you're looking for a gift or souvenir to commemorate this occasion, make sure to check it out.

Japanese.Text:
こちらは
ジュノンショッピングセンターです

English.Text: And here we are at Junon Shopping Center.

Japanese.Text:
入っているテナントは
どれも名店ばかり

English.Text: All the stores here have a reputation for quality.

Japanese.Text: 中でもオススメは　魔導書店ですね

English.Text: Personally, I would recommend checking out the bookstore.

Japanese.Text:
マグナタガールズによる接客は
一見の価値ありですよ

English.Text: You won't want to miss your chance to meet the lovely Maghnata Girls.

Japanese.Text:
これが最新のジュノンコーデね
さてさてお手並み拝見といきましょうか

English.Text: So, this is the latest in Junon fashion, is it? Well, alright then... Let's see what you've got for me.

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　華やかな色使いの中に
さりげなく軍服のモチーフが
隠されてるわ

English.Text: They have a thing for bright colors. But what's this? Elements of military designs subtly worked in...

Japanese.Text:
式典と軍事パレードの融合が
テーマってとこかしら
やるじゃない　勉強になるわ

English.Text: Catering to the people's tastes in the lead-up to the inauguration... Not bad. Not bad at all.

Japanese.Text: は～い　スタンプ～！

English.Text: Okay, say "Stamp!"

Japanese.Text: スタンプ～！

English.Text: Stamp!

Japanese.Text:
あ～ごめん　失敗しちゃった
もう１枚いい？

English.Text: Oops, sorry. I messed it up. Lemme take another one.

Japanese.Text: ええ　また～？

English.Text: What? Again?
