Japanese.Text: 社長就任セールで半額か　悩むな～

English.Text: Half off for the inauguration? As if this wasn't hard enough!

Japanese.Text:
君の可愛さを最大限
引き出したいんだ

English.Text: I wanna make sure I capture your complete beauty.

Japanese.Text: もう　仕方ないな～

English.Text: Oh, fine. If you insist!

Japanese.Text:
カメラの用意はできた？
もうすぐパレードが始まるわよ

English.Text: And you're sure the cameras are prepped? The parade's gonna start any minute now.

Japanese.Text:
大丈夫　もうカンペキ！
いつでも撮れるわよ

English.Text: Yep, all set. Ready to snap pics at a moment's notice.

Japanese.Text:
じゃあ　場所取りをしているグループに
連絡するね

English.Text: Okay! I'll let the others know that we're good to go.

Japanese.Text:
我らルーファウスファンクラブの使命は
世界中のみんなに
ルーファウス様の良さを知ってもらう事

English.Text: Remember our mission: to cultivate love and adoration for Rufus Shinra all over the world!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　今日は撮って撮って
撮りまくるわよ！

English.Text: So let's get in there and take as many photos as we can!

Japanese.Text:
なあ　この大砲って
ただの飾りなんだろ？

English.Text: That giant gun's just for show, right? It doesn't actually shoot?

Japanese.Text: 大砲じゃなくて『魔晄キャノン砲』ね

English.Text: That's not a gun. It's a mako cannon!

Japanese.Text: あと　飾りじゃなくて“凍結中”ね

English.Text: And it's absolutely functional─just not in use.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとの協定で使用禁止になったの
それだけ恐ろしい兵器だったってこと

English.Text: As part of our treaty with Wutai, we agreed never to use it again. That's how big a threat it is.

Japanese.Text:
生でルーファウス様を見るまで
帰らないから！

English.Text: I'm not leaving till I see Rufus in the flesh!

Japanese.Text:
まあ　禁止されてなくても１発撃つのに
膨大な魔晄とお金がかかるって話だから
そう簡単には　撃てないけどね

English.Text: But even if we were allowed to fire it, a single shot consumes a fortune in mako and gil. It's not the kind of weapon you use on a whim.

Japanese.Text:
へえ　そんなにすげえんだったら
ミッドガルのアバランチどもに
撃ちこめばよかったのに

English.Text: Damn...and here I was thinkin' it was window dressing! Company shoulda used it on Avalanche, am I right?

Japanese.Text:
だから使っちゃダメなんだって
話聞いてた？

English.Text: Ugh! Were you even listening to a word I said?

Japanese.Text:
それに　そんなことしたら
ミッドガルごと消えちゃうわよ

English.Text: If they had tried that, Midgar woulda been blown to bits!

Japanese.Text:
毎年軍事パレードを見ているが
今年はひと味ちがうな　弟よ

English.Text: Out of all the military parades we've been to, I've got a feelin' this one is gonna be special.

Japanese.Text: いや　ふた味はちがうぜ兄貴

English.Text: Ha! "Special"? That doesn't even begin to describe it!

Japanese.Text:
俺はリハーサルからチェックしているが
まず　兵士たちのやる気がちがう

English.Text: I peeked in on some of the rehearsals, and the troopers were fired up. Was like nothing I've seen before.

Japanese.Text:
その気持ちが
パフォーマンスに現れてるよ

English.Text: That enthusiasm makes all the difference.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄キャノンの射程って
どれぐらいなんだろう

English.Text: What kinda range do you think a cannon that size has got?

Japanese.Text: 部隊の出場数も過去最多だ

English.Text: Got more units participating this time too.

Japanese.Text:
音楽も　有名な作曲家を招いて
新たに作り直したって話だぞ

English.Text: They even got a famous composer to write a brand-new arrangement of the military march.

Japanese.Text:
くう～！
新しい社長に感謝だな　兄貴

English.Text: That's crazy! And it's all thanks to our new president.

Japanese.Text: そうだな　弟よ

English.Text: I already love the guy.

Japanese.Text:
本日　ルーファウス社長が
大勢の神羅兵によって出迎えられながら
ジュノン空港に降り立ちました

English.Text: Hundreds of troopers were assembled at Junon's aerodrome earlier today to welcome President Rufus Shinra to the city.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長は　エルジュノンで
行われるパレードに参加されたあと

English.Text: In a few hours, he will take part in his inauguration parade through Starboard Junon.

Japanese.Text:
今後の神羅カンパニーについて
演説を行うとのことです

English.Text: After which, he is expected to give a speech on the future of the company.

Japanese.Text:
新たな時代の幕開けをまえに
街は早くも祝賀ムードに包まれています

English.Text: A new day is dawning for Shinra, and our city is eager to greet it with open arms.

Japanese.Text: ついに世代交代か

English.Text: A new era... Hmph.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスグッズ
いっきに増えたわね

English.Text: Rufus merchandise is everywhere these days.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスって
プレジデントの息子だよな？

English.Text: Wait, so, Rufus is the son of the former president?

Japanese.Text: 俺もあんな風に出迎えられたいぜ

English.Text: Wish someone would hold a parade for me.

Japanese.Text: 要塞都市へようこそ　社長さん

English.Text: Welcome to Junon, Mr. President.

Japanese.Text: 統括たちは変わらないのかな？

English.Text: Think there'll be new directors too, or...?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　ルーファウス様が
同じ街にいるのね

English.Text: Omigosh, I can't believe I'm in the same city as Rufus!

Japanese.Text:
社長就任式典も
生で放送してくれるわよね？

English.Text: They will be showing the inauguration live, right? They have to!

Japanese.Text: ルーファウスさま　かっこいい

English.Text: Rufus is such a stud.

Japanese.Text:
やっぱ　スピーチの練習って
してるのかな

English.Text: I'll bet he's rehearsing his speech right now...

Japanese.Text: 熱烈大歓迎って感じね

English.Text: Everybody just loves Rufus!

Japanese.Text: 一般人は立ち入り禁止だ

English.Text: This area is restricted.

Japanese.Text: お店が多くて　迷っちゃうね

English.Text: There're so many shops that it's hard to choose!

Japanese.Text:
ごめんなさい
この先は立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: I don't think so. This place is off-limits.

Japanese.Text:
旅行者だらけ
世界中から集まってんのかな

English.Text: Look at all the tourists! It's like the whole world is coming out for this.

Japanese.Text: 新社長の写真パネルがあるってホント？

English.Text: Do they seriously have one of those photo stands?

Japanese.Text: パレード　がんばれよ！

English.Text: Good luck in the parade today!

Japanese.Text: うん　どこの部隊だ？

English.Text: Hey, which unit you guys with?

Japanese.Text: 兵士が集まってんな

English.Text: What're all these troopers up to?

Japanese.Text: なんだ　パレードの練習か？

English.Text: Are you all practicing for the parade?

Japanese.Text: おっ　気合い入ってんな

English.Text: Heh... Gearing up for something?

Japanese.Text: パレード見てるから　がんばってね

English.Text: Hey─break a leg out there!

Japanese.Text: 見て見て　兵隊さんがいる

English.Text: Hey, look! It's one of the drill teams!

Japanese.Text: 集まって　なにしてるんだろ？

English.Text: What're those troopers up to?

Japanese.Text: パレードに出る部隊かな？

English.Text: Are they gonna be in the parade?

Japanese.Text: あら　訓練中？

English.Text: Oh─they practicing?

Japanese.Text: パレード　楽しみにしてるぞ！

English.Text: I can't wait to see you all in the parade!

Japanese.Text:
息のあったパフォーマンス
期待してるよ！

English.Text: You'd better not disappoint us today! Ya hear me!?

Japanese.Text: 新しい社長のために　がんばれよ

English.Text: You make our new president proud!

Japanese.Text: どんどん集まってきたな

English.Text: Quite the crew he's got...

Japanese.Text: パレードのリハーサルか？

English.Text: This a rehearsal for the parade?

Japanese.Text: パレード　がんばってくださいね！

English.Text: Best of luck to all of you!

Japanese.Text: うわ　兵士がいっぱい！

English.Text: Whoa! So many troopers!

Japanese.Text: 写真撮っとこ

English.Text: I have just gotta snap a pic of this!

Japanese.Text: さっきより増えてない？

English.Text: Whoa, there's more of 'em!

Japanese.Text: あれ　パレードってもうやってるの？

English.Text: Wait─the parade hasn't already started, has it?

Japanese.Text: ミッドガル部隊　がんばれよ！

English.Text: Midgar, Midgar!

Japanese.Text: 第七歩兵連隊　応援してるぞ！

English.Text: Hey Seventh! You got this!

Japanese.Text: こんだけいると　迫力があんな

English.Text: Wow. Now that's impressive!

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの兵士は仕上がってるな

English.Text: The Midgar troopers got this locked up!

Japanese.Text: いやはや　こりゃ壮観だ

English.Text: Now this is a spectacle.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの兵隊さん　がんばって！

English.Text: C'mon! Show 'em how we do it in Midgar!

Japanese.Text: 第七歩兵連隊　ファイト～！

English.Text: I'm rooting for you, Seventh Infantry!

Japanese.Text: すっごい人数だね

English.Text: So many troopers!

Japanese.Text: 私　ミッドガル部隊の応援しよっと

English.Text: I'm Team Seventh all the way! Go Midgar!

Japanese.Text: ミッドガル兵は品があるのよね

English.Text: Troops outta Midgar really are world class.

Japanese.Text: ジュノン支社の本気を見せる時だ！

English.Text: Remember that you represent Junon!

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長のために
準備を万全に！

English.Text: Everything must be perfect for our new president!

Japanese.Text:
神羅社員として
恥ずかしくないようにね

English.Text: C'mon! Let's make the company proud, people!

Japanese.Text: 失敗はできないよ　報連相は密にして！

English.Text: If you're unsure about anything, make sure to ask!

Japanese.Text: すみません　ＪＳＮです

English.Text: Excuse me, I'm with JSN.

Japanese.Text:
すこしだけ
インタビューさせていただいても
よろしいでしょうか

English.Text: We're conducting interviews, if you could spare a moment of your time?

Japanese.Text:
早速ですが　ジュノンで
社長就任式典が行われることについて
どう思われますか？

English.Text: First of all, what do you think about the presidential inauguration being held here in Junon?

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで開催されて嬉しいです
とても名誉なことだと思います

English.Text: I couldn't be happier! It's an honor to be part of such a momentous occasion.

Japanese.Text: ありがとうございます

English.Text: Thank you very much.

Japanese.Text: では　あとひとつだけ

English.Text: Okay, one more question.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長に
なにを期待されますか？

English.Text: Any expectations for our new president?

Japanese.Text: これまでどおりの神羅でしょうか

English.Text: I just hope that he follows in his father's footsteps.

Japanese.Text:
お答えいただき
ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you again for giving us your time.

Japanese.Text:
では　次の方に
お話を伺ってみたいと思います

English.Text: Let's see what some of the other people here today have to say.

Japanese.Text:
式典より軍事パレードが楽しみかな
生で見るの　はじめてなんだよね

English.Text: I'm actually more excited for the parade than the ceremony. It's my first time seeing one in person.

Japanese.Text:
すごく楽しみですよ
社長の就任スピーチをはやく聞きたいわ

English.Text: I think it's great. I can't wait to hear what the president will say for his inauguration speech.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの状況を考えれば
当然の判断かと

English.Text: Well it makes sense, doesn't it? Considering the current state of Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
期待か　う～ん
俺のこと神羅で雇ってくんねえかな？

English.Text: Expectations? Oh, I don't know... Maybe a job? I'd make a great executive!

Japanese.Text:
リーダーとして
世界を引っ張ってほしいわね

English.Text: I want him to step up more as a world leader.

Japanese.Text:
やはり　なによりも
アバランチの逮捕ですね

English.Text: I hope he can finally put an end to the Avalanche problem.

Japanese.Text: こんにちは　ＳＮＮｅｔです

English.Text: Hello there; I'm with SNNet.

Japanese.Text: いま　お時間よろしいですか？

English.Text: Do you have a moment to spare?

Japanese.Text:
インタビューに
ご協力いただけないでしょうか

English.Text: I'd like to interview you, if that's alright.

Japanese.Text: ありがとうございます

English.Text: Thank you so much.

Japanese.Text:
本日は　パレードを
見にこられたんですか？

English.Text: Have you come here today to see the inauguration parade?

Japanese.Text:
もちろん
特に今年は特別ですからね

English.Text: You bet I have. I wouldn't miss this for the world.

Japanese.Text: そうですか

English.Text: I see.

Japanese.Text:
では　ズバリお聞きしますが
社長賞はどの部隊がとると思われますか

English.Text: Next, if you were to guess, which unit do you think will go home with the president's commendation?

Japanese.Text:
バイク隊かな
パフォーマンスが派手だし

English.Text: My gil's on the mobile unit. They'll put on a good show.

Japanese.Text:
お答えいただき
ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you for your time. We appreciate it.

Japanese.Text:
では　次の方に
お話を伺ってみたいと思います

English.Text: Let's see what some of the other people have to say about the festivities.

Japanese.Text:
はい　妻がどうしても
ルーファウス社長を見たいらしくて

English.Text: Yes. My wife was insistent that we come out to support the new president.

Japanese.Text:
パレードっていうか
ルーファウス様を見にきました！

English.Text: Sort of. I'm here to see Rufus more than anything!

Japanese.Text:
ショッピングに来たんですけど
パレードも見るつもりではいます

English.Text: I actually came to do some shopping, but I'm gonna stay for the parade too.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの部隊に
がんばってほしいですね

English.Text: I expect the Midgar units will be giving it their all.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス様の賞なら
私が欲しいです！

English.Text: I don't know, but I envy whoever gets the chance to meet him!

Japanese.Text:
やっぱり　ジュノンの部隊に
とってほしいかな

English.Text: Personally, I hope a local unit wins it.

Japanese.Text: パパ　あの大砲を動かしてよ！

English.Text: Daddy, make it move! I wanna see it move!

Japanese.Text: あれは　パパでも動かせないんだよ

English.Text: I'm afraid even I can't move that.

Japanese.Text:
代わりにプレゼント買ってあげるから
それでカンベンしておくれ

English.Text: But I can buy you any souvenir you want.

Japanese.Text:
やだ　プレゼントより
大砲が動いてるとこが見たい！

English.Text: No! I don't want a souvenir! I wanna see the big cannon move!

Japanese.Text:
先輩　会員制バーには行きました？
高級な酒が社割で飲めて最高でしたよ

English.Text: Hey, have you been to the company bar yet? They've got some quality stuff, and we get an employee discount.

Japanese.Text:
へえ　でもおまえ
飲みに行く時間なんてよくあったな

English.Text: I'll have to check it out. But...is it just me, or are you always drinking?

Japanese.Text:
あっいや　それは
なんとか時間をやりくりして

English.Text: I mean, I wouldn't say always. I just take advantage of it when I can, you know?

Japanese.Text:
おまえ　まさか勤務中に
飲んでねえだろうな

English.Text: But you never "take advantage" on the clock...right?

Japanese.Text: まさか　飲んでないですよ！

English.Text: Oh no, of course not! I'd never do that.

Japanese.Text:
ガイドブックによると
魔導書店がオススメだって
マグナタガールズって店員が有名らしい

English.Text: The guide recommends checking out this bookstore. Apparently they've got a trio of employees called the Maghnata Girls.

Japanese.Text:
却下　カームに本店があるんだから
ここまで来て魔導書店はないでしょ

English.Text: Pass. We have a Maghnata Books in Kalm. And pretty ladies aren't that big of a draw for me.

Japanese.Text: だよね　う～ん

English.Text: Fair enough. Uh...

Japanese.Text:
ほら　はやく決めないと
パレードまで時間がないよ

English.Text: Hurry up and pick something already! The parade's gonna start soon.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ『スリール』ってバーは？

English.Text: Then, what about that bar─Le Sourire?

Japanese.Text:
却下　そこって神羅の社員しか
入れないじゃん

English.Text: Don't you know that only Shinra employees are allowed in there?

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　スタンプラリーとか

English.Text: There's always the stamp rally?

Japanese.Text:
却下　そんなのやるわけないでしょ
子供じゃないんだから　馬鹿じゃないの

English.Text: You've got to be kidding me. What are we, toddlers? I wouldn't be caught dead doing that.

Japanese.Text: あのさ　もう別々に行動しない？

English.Text: You know what? Why don't we just do our own thing instead?

Japanese.Text:
ふう　やっぱ地上はいいねえ
海底魔晄炉とは大違いだ

English.Text: Whew... Finally. Back on dry land. Been way too long, I tell you.

Japanese.Text:
海辺に打ちあがった深海魚の気分だぜ
なにもかもがまぶしくて眩暈がしやがる

English.Text: I feel like a deep-sea fish that's risen to the surface. Everything's so bright; it's makin' me dizzy.

Japanese.Text:
ただよ　おまえらが
地上で何不自由なく暮らせるのは

English.Text: But toiling away on the ocean floor is a duty I'm proud to perform.

Japanese.Text:
俺たちが薄暗い海底で汗水たらして
働いてるおかげってことを　忘れんなよ

English.Text: It's thanks to our hard work that everyone up here can live in the lap of luxury─and don't you forget it.

Japanese.Text: やった～！

English.Text: Hah! Score!

Japanese.Text: スタンプ　ズレちゃったよ～

English.Text: Oh no, I messed it up!

Japanese.Text: あ～あ　かすれちゃった

English.Text: Aw, it's all blurry.

Japanese.Text: よし　スタンプ押せたわ！

English.Text: Tada! A stamp for me!

Japanese.Text: キレイに押せな～い

English.Text: Aw, I can't do it right...

Japanese.Text: もっと　ギュッと押さないと

English.Text: You gotta press it hard, like "Bam!"

Japanese.Text: はやくはやく～！

English.Text: Hurry it up, slowpokes!

Japanese.Text: 次は　あっちだってさ

English.Text: The next one's over there!

Japanese.Text: はやいよ～

English.Text: Slow down!

Japanese.Text: 走れ～　走れスタンプ～

English.Text: Go all out, go all out, little Stamp♪

Japanese.Text: 次のスタンプどこ～？

English.Text: So where's the next stamp at?

Japanese.Text: 待ってよ～

English.Text: Hey, wait!

Japanese.Text:
プレジデントのせがれが社長か
時間が過ぎるのは早いのう

English.Text: So the president's son is gonna take over the company, is he? Thought it'd be years before that happened.

Japanese.Text:
問題はたくさんある
つらい時代になるかもしれんな

English.Text: Poor boy's got his work cut out for him, though, what with the way the world's going these days.

Japanese.Text:
だが　乗り越えてくれるに違いない
もし弱音を吐くようなら尻を叩いてやる

English.Text: But I have faith he won't let us down. And if he does, well, then we'll just have to give him a good talking-to.

Japanese.Text: なんで　ジュノンで式典をやるのよ

English.Text: Why did they have to hold it here?

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルが大変だからじゃない？

English.Text: Because Midgar's a mess.

Japanese.Text:
ほら　アバランチのせいで
いろいろあったでしょ

English.Text: I mean, you saw what Avalanche did to the city, didn't you?

Japanese.Text:
式典のせいで　ジュノンも
アバランチに襲われたらどうすんのよ

English.Text: That's just it though! What if they target Junon because of the ceremony?

Japanese.Text:
これは隊長
パレードの準備は大丈夫ですか？

English.Text: Oh, hey there, Captain. Are you ready for the parade?

Japanese.Text: 社長賞　とれるといいですね

English.Text: I sure hope we can get that commendation.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの状況はいかがですか？

English.Text: So, how are things in Midgar?

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの兵舎にようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to our barracks.

Japanese.Text:
隊長みずから
ライバル部隊の偵察ですか？

English.Text: Scouting out the competition, is that it, Captain?

Japanese.Text: バイク隊のパフォーマンス　楽しみだな

English.Text: Man, I can't wait to see the mobile unit tear it up!

Japanese.Text: 社長賞はジュノンがいただきますよ

English.Text: That commendation is as good as ours.

Japanese.Text: 隊長　気合い入ってますね

English.Text: You must be pretty pumped, huh, sir?

Japanese.Text:
いえ　式典はアルジュノンではなく
エルジュノンで行われます

English.Text: No, the ceremony is being held in Starboard Junon, not Larboard.

Japanese.Text:
エルジュノンは
魔晄キャノン砲をはさんで
向こう側の街になります

English.Text: Starboard Junon is on the other side of the mako cannon. You can't miss it.

Japanese.Text:
こちらでルーファウス社長のグッズは
取り扱っておりません

English.Text: I'm afraid we don't sell any President Shinra merchandise.

Japanese.Text:
いや……社長就任記念コインは
もうどこも売り切れと思いますよ

English.Text: Unfortunately, I believe the limited edition inauguration coin is already sold out.

Japanese.Text:
要塞都市ジュノンは　その名のとおり
東の大陸を防衛するための
軍事施設であります

English.Text: Junon is a military installation that serves as the heart of the eastern continent's defense against western aggression.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンの象徴である魔晄キャノン砲は
西の大陸　果てはウータイまでを
つねに牽制しています

English.Text: It's best known for its mako cannon, which acts as a deterrent to not only Wutai, but to anyone else that might attack our shores.

Japanese.Text:
また　世界で唯一の海底魔晄炉を有し
そこで生み出されたエネルギーが
皆様の生活を支えています

English.Text: Junon is also home to the world's only underwater reactor, which provides us with limitless power and allows us to live in comfort.

Japanese.Text:
ほかにも　ジュノンのエアポートと港は
世界中に人と物を運ぶ中継地点として
重要な役割を担っています

English.Text: In addition, our airport and harbor both see a large volume of commercial and passenger traffic, making Junon one of the world's busiest transport hubs.

Japanese.Text:
以上が　我らが誇る
要塞都市ジュノンの説明となります

English.Text: And that concludes my presentation. I hope you've all learned more about our fair city.

Japanese.Text: ご清聴ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you very much for listening.

Japanese.Text:
神羅軍は
やる気ある若者を求めています

English.Text: Are you young and driven? Then Shinra wants you!

Japanese.Text:
新たな指導者　ルーファウス社長の元で
世界の平和のために働きませんか？

English.Text: Help us guarantee the safety and security of the world under the leadership of our new president!

Japanese.Text:
男女は問いません　申し込みも簡単です
まずは説明会に参加してみてください！

English.Text: All are welcome to enlist─and we're happy to walk you through the process. Join our next seminar to learn more!

Japanese.Text:
恋人に　プロポーズしようと
思ってるんです

English.Text: So, um, I'm thinking of proposing.

Japanese.Text:
早くないか？
このまえ付き合い始めたばかりだろ

English.Text: Don't you think you're rushing it? You two only just started dating.

Japanese.Text:
そうなんですけど　ほら
ミッドガルで事件があったでしょ

English.Text: I know, I know! But after seeing what happened in Midgar...

Japanese.Text:
軍に所属している限り　いつどうなるか
わからないじゃないですか

English.Text: I realized time is precious─especially for a grunt like me.

Japanese.Text: だから　後悔しないうちにと思って

English.Text: And I don't wanna have any regrets.

Japanese.Text: 確かに　そうだな

English.Text: You got a point there.

Japanese.Text:
任務中に兵舎に隠れてサボる
このスリルが　たまんねえんだよな

English.Text: I swear, nothin' gets my blood pumping like hiding in the barracks when I'm on duty.

Japanese.Text:
これはこれは隊長
ミッドガルの部隊には負けませんよ

English.Text: Captain! Good luck in the parade today. You'll need it.

Japanese.Text:
隊長の部隊は
どんなフォーメーションでくるんですか

English.Text: What formations do you have in store for us today, Captain?

Japanese.Text: 社長賞はジュノンがいただきます

English.Text: Junon is winning that commendation.

Japanese.Text:
『メットを磨くことが出世の近道』
いい言葉だろ

English.Text: Keep your boots and helmet polished and you'll go far. Words to live by.

Japanese.Text:
兵舎を出るためにも
出世しないと！

English.Text: Gotta earn that promotion if I'm gonna get outta here.

Japanese.Text:
これから彼女の家で
パレードを見るんです

English.Text: I'm gonna watch the parade with my girlfriend after this.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンとミッドガル
どちらが勝っても恨みっこなしですよ

English.Text: No matter what happens, no hard feelings. May the best unit win.

Japanese.Text: メットにステッカー貼っちゃダメかな

English.Text: Think they'll let me put a sticker on my helmet?

Japanese.Text: 勉強中です　話しかけないでください

English.Text: Please don't talk to me. I'm trying to study.

Japanese.Text:
ソルジャーへの道は厳しいんです
パレードを見ている暇なんてありません

English.Text: I don't have time to watch parades. Not if I ever wanna be a SOLDIER.

Japanese.Text:
もちろん　式典も見ませんよ
勉強のあとは筋トレをするんで

English.Text: I won't be watching the ceremony either. After I'm done studying, I've gotta do my workout!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　さびしくなかったでちゅか～？
大好きなネコ缶を持ってきましたよ～

English.Text: Aww, were you lonely without Daddy? Well, he's here now─and he brought your favorite treats!

Japanese.Text: くう～　懐かないところも可愛いぜ

English.Text: Aww, making Daddy work for your love? That's so adorable!

Japanese.Text: き……緊張しすぎて腹が……

English.Text: The stress... My stomach can't handle it...

Japanese.Text:
パレードのまえに
トイレに行っときなさいよ

English.Text: You'd better hit the head before the parade starts.

Japanese.Text: いや　俺にはわかる……

English.Text: No, I've been through this before...

Japanese.Text:
いま行くと　必ずパレード中に
また行きたくなる

English.Text: If I go now, then I'll end up havin' to go again during the parade, guaranteed.

Japanese.Text:
だから　限界ギリギリまで
我慢するんだ……！

English.Text: I need to hold it until the absolute last second.

Japanese.Text: お願いだから　限界を越えないでよ

English.Text: Okay, but...don't hold it too long.

Japanese.Text:
もういちど
警備体制を確認しておこう

English.Text: Okay, let's go over it one more time.

Japanese.Text:
これで３度目だぞ　落ちつけよ
警備体制は完璧だって

English.Text: We've already gone through it twice. Chill out already. No one's gonna get past security.

Japanese.Text: なにかあってからだと遅いだろ

English.Text: No, we need to be ready for anything.

Japanese.Text:
いまのうちに不安の種は
つぶしておきたいんだ

English.Text: And when I say "anything," I mean anything.

Japanese.Text:
だから　なにも起きないって
心配しすぎなんだよ　おまえは

English.Text: I keep telling you, you worry too much. Nothing's going to happen. Okay?

Japanese.Text:
ほら　深呼吸して
肩の力を抜けよ

English.Text: Here─why don't we take a nice, deep breath and try to relax?

Japanese.Text: これより　緊急会議を行う

English.Text: This meeting is now in session.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長の就任にあわせて
作成した商品が　これまでにない
売れ行きを見せている事は聞いているな

English.Text: As you're all aware, our merchandise sales have skyrocketed ahead of President Rufus's inauguration.

Japanese.Text:
そこで　この流れを
さらに加速させるべく

English.Text: We need to make the most of this opportunity while it's available to us.

Japanese.Text:
いちぶから熱烈な要望があった
ハイデッカー統括のグッズを
開発することになった

English.Text: So, to capitalize on popular demand, we'll create merchandise of Director Heidegger as well.

Japanese.Text:
それは　その……えっと
統括の了承は得られているのですか？

English.Text: Umm, sorry... Not to butt in, but...have you gotten his permission to do that?

Japanese.Text:
そこは問題ない
統括もノリノリだ　安心しろ

English.Text: One step ahead of you. The director said he's all for it. We're good to go.

Japanese.Text: なっ　なんと……

English.Text: That's...unexpected.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長のグッズは
記念コインから日常的に使用する物まで
幅広く商品を展開してきたが

English.Text: For President Rufus, we have a wide range of merchandise─from commemorative coins to more practical everyday goods.

Japanese.Text:
ハイデッカー統括のグッズは
品数をしぼり　高品質
高単価で売りだそうと考えている

English.Text: But for the Director Heidegger limited run, I'd like to focus on premium products with high unit prices.

Japanese.Text:
そこでだ
これぞといった商品案はないか？

English.Text: So, does anyone have any ideas for what we could put out?

Japanese.Text:
ハイデッカー統括の
軍服をモチーフにした
コートなどはいかがでしょう

English.Text: What about a coat designed to look like the director's very own?

Japanese.Text:
ハイデッカー統括の声を使った
目覚まし時計などもよいかと

English.Text: Oh! Maybe an alarm clock that uses Director Heidegger's voice?

Japanese.Text:
いや　ここは思い切って
ハイデッカー統括の
自伝を出版してみてはどうでしょう

English.Text: I think we should convince him to write an autobiography. It'll be a hit for sure!

Japanese.Text: なるほど　どれも甲乙つけがたいな

English.Text: Hmm, yes... Those are all very good suggestions.

Japanese.Text: ところで　おまえら……

English.Text: Having said that...

Japanese.Text:
それらの商品が売りだされた暁には
もちろん　購入するんだろうな？

English.Text: I presume I can count on all of you to buy these products?

Japanese.Text:
お言葉ですが
議長は購入されるのですか？

English.Text: With all due respect, sir, are you planning on buying them?

Japanese.Text: むっ　それは……そうだな

English.Text: Er... Well... I, um...

Japanese.Text: ここではメットを脱ぐのが決まりだぞ

English.Text: We don't do helmets around here, buddy.

Japanese.Text: おまえ　脱がないのか？

English.Text: So, you gonna take that off or what?

Japanese.Text: 解き放つんだ　気持ちいいぞ～！

English.Text: It feels so good to be unburdened!

Japanese.Text: 安心して　みんな仲間だよ

English.Text: Be cool, man. We're all friends here.

Japanese.Text: ここじゃメットを脱がなきゃ

English.Text: Hey, off with the helmets.

Japanese.Text: 脱ぎなよ　暑いでしょ？

English.Text: Aren't you hot? Why don't you take that off?

Japanese.Text: この素晴らしい輝きに！

English.Text: Smooth heads, shinin' bright!

Japanese.Text: この素晴らしい輝きに！

English.Text: Smooth heads, shining bright!

Japanese.Text:
あの　僕の頭はいかがでしょう
イマイチ決まらなくて

English.Text: Hey, how d'you think it looks? My head, I mean. Did...did I do okay?

Japanese.Text:
最初は難しいですからね
どれどれ……

English.Text: Always hard to get it right the first time. Okay, let's see...

Japanese.Text:
あ～　もっと堂々と
心に磨きをかけなきゃ！

English.Text: Ah, you did fine! Take pride in your work─let it shine!

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス神羅は
なぜスキンヘッドにしない？

English.Text: Why do you think the new president isn't going for the bald look?

Japanese.Text:
確かに　スキンヘッドにすれば
髪をセットする時間を
仕事にあてられるわね

English.Text: Dunno, but if he did, he could spend less time preening himself and more time doing his job.

Japanese.Text: よし　嘆願書を出してみるか

English.Text: Yeah! We oughta start a petition!

Japanese.Text: おや　君はパレードに出るのか？

English.Text: Well, well. You marchin' in the parade?

Japanese.Text:
このバーは
神羅社員の憩いの場所さ

English.Text: Welcome to heaven on earth...for Shinra employees.

Japanese.Text:
ここは　静かに飲めるから
好きなんだ

English.Text: This is the one place I can drink in peace.

Japanese.Text:
隊長さん
こんなところにいて大丈夫？

English.Text: You have enough time to be wasting it here, Captain?

Japanese.Text:
この店はね　音楽にあわせて
カクテルを作ってくれるの

English.Text: I just love the way they make all their cocktails in time to the music.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長も
飲みにいらっしゃらないかしら

English.Text: Wouldn't it be great if the president stopped by for a drink?

Japanese.Text: あら　隊長さんも飲みに来たの？

English.Text: So, you here for a hard one too, Captain?

Japanese.Text:
もし　社長賞をとったら
おごってあげるわ

English.Text: I'll give you a drink on the house if you win that commendation.

Japanese.Text:
あの黒服の子
落ち込んでるみたいだな

English.Text: That girl in the suit looks pretty down, but I could cheer her up.

Japanese.Text:
声をかけてみようかな
でも　妙にオーラがあるんだよな

English.Text: Though as much as I wanna buy her a drink, she's got a real...intense vibe about her.

Japanese.Text: 俺の手には負えない気がする

English.Text: Might be too much for me to handle.

Japanese.Text: プロジェクトの発表　おめでとう

English.Text: You did a great job on that presentation.

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう　あなたが
サポートしてくれたおかげよ

English.Text: Thanks. It wouldn't have gone so smoothly without your help.

Japanese.Text:
君のアイデアが秀逸だったんだよ
それじゃあ　祝杯といこう

English.Text: No, it was your genius ideas that carried it. So hey─let's make a toast!

Japanese.Text:
君のこれからの活躍と
新たな社長に　乾杯

English.Text: To your blossoming career─and to our promising new leadership! Cheers!

Japanese.Text:
ええ……
神羅の繁栄に　乾杯

English.Text: Yes, to Shinra's bright future! Cheers!

Japanese.Text: 隊長どの　新しい武器はいかがでしょう

English.Text: Greetings, Captain. In need of some new armaments?

Japanese.Text: 隊長どの　パレード応援してますよ！

English.Text: Good luck out there, Captain. I'll be rootin' for ya!

Japanese.Text: 軍事都市の本領発揮ってところだな

English.Text: Better not mess with the locals if they're packin' this kinda heat.

Japanese.Text: ジュノン製の武器はやっぱいいな

English.Text: There's no beating Junon-made hardware.

Japanese.Text: グリップを革張りにしようと思って

English.Text: I'm thinking of going with a leather grip.

Japanese.Text:
へえ～
社長就任記念モデルなんてあるのね

English.Text: See these? Special models, made just for the inauguration.

Japanese.Text: 兵隊さんが使ってる銃はどれかな？

English.Text: Wonder where they keep the military-grade stuff.

Japanese.Text: 最近の防具はデザインもいいのね

English.Text: These designs are the perfect marriage of form and function!

Japanese.Text: 本日は　なにをお探しでしょう？

English.Text: Can I help you find anything today?

Japanese.Text: ご満足いただけましたか？

English.Text: Feel free to keep browsing.

Japanese.Text: 最高級のマテリアを取りそろえております

English.Text: We carry only the finest in materia here.

Japanese.Text: またのお越しを　お待ちしております

English.Text: We look forward to your next visit.

Japanese.Text: おお　これは見事な細工だ

English.Text: I say! Now that's real craftsmanship!

Japanese.Text:
この腕輪
マテリアをあしらってあるのか

English.Text: That's quite a stone! Did you embed it yourself?

Japanese.Text: 値段を見るのが怖すぎる……

English.Text: I can't bring myself to even look at the price.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンに来たら
ここは外せませんよね

English.Text: Every time I visit Junon, this place is my first stop.

Japanese.Text:
マテリアの香水？
どんなかおりなのかしら

English.Text: Materia...perfume? I wonder what this smells like!

Japanese.Text: 社長就任記念リングはどこ？

English.Text: See any commemorative inauguration rings?

Japanese.Text:
ガイドブックに載ってたから来たけど
やっぱり高いわね

English.Text: The guidebook recommended coming here, but it's way out of my price range.

Japanese.Text:
結婚記念日のプレゼントを
探してるんだけど

English.Text: Hope I can find a good anniversary present...

Japanese.Text: 休憩されていきますか？

English.Text: Will you be staying with us?

Japanese.Text: パレード　期待していますよ

English.Text: Well, good luck at the parade.

Japanese.Text:
これから
パレードを見にいくんですよ

English.Text: I gotta head out now to catch the parade.

Japanese.Text:
明日は会食だし
今日は控えめにしなきゃ

English.Text: Can't eat too much. Need to save room for the party tomorrow.

Japanese.Text:
パレードの準備で徹夜して
これから寝るんです

English.Text: Was up all night getting ready. Time to hit the hay.

Japanese.Text:
出張で高級ホテルに泊まれるなんて
ラッキー！

English.Text: I'm so lucky work was willing to put me up in this swanky hotel!

Japanese.Text:
部屋の窓から
パレードって見えるのかな？

English.Text: Wonder if I'll be able to watch the parade from my window...

Japanese.Text: 式典まで部屋でゆっくりするんだ

English.Text: May as well take it easy until the parade starts.

Japanese.Text:
ふふふ……
うちの店員　可愛いでしょう

English.Text:
Ahaha!
Our girls are lovely, am I right?

Japanese.Text: 隊長　またのお越しをお待ちしてます

English.Text: Thanks, Captain. We hope to see you again soon.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ～！

English.Text: Welcome!

Japanese.Text: ありがとうございました～！

English.Text: Thanks for stopping by!

Japanese.Text: ようこそ　マグナタ書店ジュノン支部へ

English.Text: Welcome to the magical Maghnata Books' Junon location!

Japanese.Text:
わたしたち　マグナタガールズが
今週のオススメブックを紹介しちゃいますよ

English.Text: If you're looking for some recommendations, we'd be more than happy to name a few of this week's favs for you.

Japanese.Text:
わたしのオススメは『ラストフライト』です
この小説以外には考えられません

English.Text: My personal pick would definitely be The Final Flight. I swear, none of the other books even come close to topping it!

Japanese.Text: 航空兵と女性指揮官の　禁断の愛！

English.Text: It's a forbidden romance between a commander and her airman.

Japanese.Text:
最愛の人に突撃を命令するシーンは
涙なしには読めませんよ

English.Text: I promise you'll be sobbing like a baby when you get to the part where she orders her true love to charge into battle.

Japanese.Text: あら隊長さん　こんにちは

English.Text: Oh! Well, hello there, Captain.

Japanese.Text:
マグナタガールズのオススメ本
知りたくない？

English.Text: Are you interested in knowing what my Book of the Week is?

Japanese.Text: 私のオススメは『神羅軍の哲学』かしら

English.Text: I think I'd probably have to go with The Troopers' Creed.

Japanese.Text: 軍人という立場を通して

English.Text: It happens to be a philosophy book.

Japanese.Text:
人はどのように生きるべきかを
深く考えさせてくれる　上質な哲学書よ

English.Text: There's some thought-provoking stuff about how people should live─from the perspective of a trooper.

Japanese.Text:
ああでも　もちろん隊長さんは
すでに読んでるわよね

English.Text: Oh! But I'm sure you've already read it, being a captain and all.

Japanese.Text: わっ　隊長さんだ！

English.Text: Ooh, a captain!

Japanese.Text:
ねえねえ　マグナタガールズが選ぶ
今週のイチオシ本　知りたくない？

English.Text: Since you're here, would you like to learn about the Maghnata Girls' picks for Book of the Week?

Japanese.Text:
ワタシのイチオシはね
もちろん『サボテン大王』の最新巻だよ

English.Text: My top pick would have to be the latest issue of Cactuar King. It's a must-read!

Japanese.Text:
長かった流浪編のクライマックス！
流れついた先で大王が目にした光景は――

English.Text: The king's been wandering for the past few volumes, but suddenly, he looks around and what should he see─

Japanese.Text: おっと　これ以上は自分の目で確かめてね

English.Text: No spoilers. You'll have to read it for yourself.

Japanese.Text: 絶対　ネタバレされるまえに読んだほうがいいよ

English.Text: Better start soon before someone ruins it for you!

Japanese.Text:
女の子たちが紹介してくれた本を
ぜんぶ読んだけど　どれも面白かったよ

English.Text: I've read all the books the girls recommended, and y'know what? Brilliant, each and every one!

Japanese.Text: この店　いいニオイがするんだよな

English.Text: Mm... Gotta love that paperback smell.

Japanese.Text:
僕は真面目に本を買いに来たんだ
本当だよ

English.Text: I just came here to browse the new releases─that's all!

Japanese.Text:
あの子たち　お給料いいのよねえ
うらやましい

English.Text: Those girls must get paid a fortune. I'm so jealous!

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス様のファンクラブが
写真集を売ってるって聞いたんですけど

English.Text: I heard the Rufus fan club was selling a limited edition photo book here.

Japanese.Text:
本のことは　マグナタガールズに
聞くのがいちばんね

English.Text: If you want to know about a specific book, ask the girls for help.

Japanese.Text: ゲホッ……ゲホッ……

English.Text: Ahem, ahem...

Japanese.Text: うう……ああ……

English.Text: Hrk... Uhr...

Japanese.Text: ……ゆっくり見ていくんだな　品質は保証する

English.Text: ...Take your time lookin' around. Quality guaranteed.

Japanese.Text: う……ああ……　いらっしゃい

English.Text: Hng... Hi there. Welcome.

Japanese.Text: ……パレード　がんばれよ

English.Text: ...Knock 'em dead at the parade.

Japanese.Text: う……ああ……　ありがとう

English.Text: Ngh... Appreciate the business.

Japanese.Text: でかめのピアスが欲しいんだよな

English.Text: I bet some big, flashy earrings'd look cool on me!

Japanese.Text:
ここのアクセサリをつけてると
なんか　強くなった気がすんだよ

English.Text: The accessories from this place make me feel like I could take on the world!

Japanese.Text:
ここの店主
元ソルジャーって噂だけど本当かな

English.Text: Word is the owner's a former SOLDIER. I wonder if it's true.

Japanese.Text: ここのアクセサリ　渋くていいよね

English.Text: I love how understated everything is here.

Japanese.Text: なんか雰囲気がある店だね

English.Text: The vibes here are unparalleled.

Japanese.Text:
ここの店主　元ソルジャーなんだって
本当かどうかわかんないけど

English.Text: I heard that the owner used to be a SOLDIER. No idea if it's true or not, though.

Japanese.Text: 事件の犯人って　もう捕まったのか？

English.Text: Think they caught whoever was behind that attack yet?

Japanese.Text: さっさと出航してくんないかな

English.Text: Can we please set sail already?

Japanese.Text: 神羅にまかせておけば安心さ

English.Text: Just trust in Shinra and things'll be fine.

Japanese.Text: はやく船に乗って　ゆっくりしたいよ

English.Text: As soon as I get on board, I'm grabbing a drink.

Japanese.Text:
初めての船旅なのに
波乱の出航になったな

English.Text: Of course things would go crazy before my first voyage.

Japanese.Text: 運航に影響が出なくてよかったわ

English.Text: I swear, if they'd canceled my trip...!

Japanese.Text: もう街のほうも安全なんでしょ？

English.Text: You think things are safer in town now?

Japanese.Text: とにかく社長が無事でよかった

English.Text: I'm just relieved the president is okay.

Japanese.Text: 船は大丈夫だよね？

English.Text: Hope the ship's still sailing.

Japanese.Text:
いまのうちに酔い止め
飲んでおこうかな

English.Text: I'd better take my motion sickness meds before I hop on board.

Japanese.Text:
ＩＤと手荷物をチェックしています
ご協力をお願いします

English.Text: Please have your IDs out and your bags open! Thank you!

Japanese.Text:
順番に確認しています
みなさん　指示に従ってください

English.Text: We'll be working down the line to get everyone processed! Please be patient!

Japanese.Text:
潮風にまじって
魔晄のニオイがするんだよ

English.Text: Sea breeze stinks of mako. Goddamn reactor...

Japanese.Text:
ここは　いつも薄暗いのさ
上に要塞があるからな

English.Text: Another day in a life without sunshine, thanks to the city above.

Japanese.Text:
もう開き直って　魔晄色の海を
名物にしてみようか

English.Text: "Come and visit Under Junon, where the water's mako-green!"

Japanese.Text: コンドル予報を見るのが楽しみなんだ

English.Text: There a new edition of Clear Skies?

Japanese.Text: この村の魚介の燻製はうまいぞ

English.Text: Try the smoked seafood─you won't regret it.

Japanese.Text:
しゃぶしゃぶしてもいいし
マリネにしてもいい

English.Text: I'll tell you when: before Shinra came along!

Japanese.Text:
そんな海への想い
みんなも同じですよね

English.Text: We fight for a world untainted by their greed!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　新鮮なお刺身を食べたいみんな！

English.Text: A world with clean waters and vibrant forests!

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンに集まって
いっしょに神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: Join us in the Crow's Nest and help us put an end to Shinra's tyranny!

Japanese.Text: ふう……

English.Text: Whew...

Japanese.Text:
あたし　サイドジュノンの
青年団から来た
街頭演説担当なんですけど

English.Text: They trusted me─sent me out here to try and recruit new members to the cause...

Japanese.Text: みんな　話を聞いてくれないんです

English.Text: but no one here will even give me the time of day.

Japanese.Text:
あたし　緊張しいで
人前だとうまく話せないんですよね

English.Text: And can you blame them? Who would ever listen to an activist who gets stage fright?

Japanese.Text:
慌てると論点もズレがちっていうか
どうしたらいいんだろう

English.Text: Talk about pathetic. What am I even doing here? I feel so stupid.

Japanese.Text:
なにか　気持ちを
奮い立たせることでもあれば
また演説する勇気が出ると思うんです

English.Text: I was better than this. I had a passion, a fire, but with all the bad shit in the world lately...

Japanese.Text: ああ　なにか起こらないかな

English.Text: I need some good news for a change.

Japanese.Text: よし　がんばろ！

English.Text: Let's do this.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　みなさん
聞いてください！

English.Text: My friends! Are you sick of Shinra!?

Japanese.Text:
海風吹くと　洗濯物
乾きにくいのよね

English.Text: All this laundry and the wind decides to blow in off the sea...

Japanese.Text:
あたし　サイドジュノンの
反神羅青年団のメンバーです

English.Text: Do you long to be free─to have a real sky again!?

Japanese.Text:
あたしたち反神羅といっても
弱小すぎて　反神羅連絡会には
相手にもされてないみたい

English.Text: Then come to the Crow's Nest and join the fight against our oppressors! Though we are small and independent from the SRC...

Japanese.Text:
でも　川で生まれた小魚も
いつか海に出て
大きな魚になるでしょう？

English.Text: what we lack in numbers, we make up for in passion! And that is what will see us victorious against Shinra!

Japanese.Text:
あたしたちにも　なにか
できることがあると思うんだ

English.Text: The time has finally come to stand up and fight back!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　みんな！

English.Text: Join us!

Japanese.Text:
もし　そんな小さな活動でも良かったら
力を貸してください

English.Text: Be the spark that ignites a flame so hot it melts the steel above!

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンに集まって
いっしょに神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: If you feel as strongly as we do, then come and answer the call!

Japanese.Text: えへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh!

Japanese.Text: 海岸にイルカがいるのよ　可愛いわ

English.Text: I love watching that dolphin splash around in the cove. He's so cute.

Japanese.Text:
今日はたくさん　お魚がとれたの
明日もとれるようにお祈りしなくちゃ

English.Text: Not every day we bring in this many fish! Hope tomorrow's haul is just as good.

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: These seas belong to us─to Junon!

Japanese.Text:
大志ある若者よ　サイドジュノン
反神羅青年団に来たれ！

English.Text: If you're sick of polluted waters and steel skies, then come to the Crow's Nest and join the cause!

Japanese.Text: くう～　熱いよなオレたち！

English.Text: Goddamn, I get so fired up about this shit!

Japanese.Text:
でもちょっと曲がってない？
貼り直し！

English.Text: Yeah, that's great and all, but the poster's still crooked!

Japanese.Text: えっ　これでどうだ？

English.Text: For real? This any better?

Japanese.Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
これで何号だっけ

English.Text: How many issues of Clear Skies is this now? I kinda forgot.

Japanese.Text:
忘れちゃったけど
それだけコンドル被害も減って
平和ってことよ

English.Text: But...that's a good thing, right? It means everyone's been giving the condor the space it needs!

Japanese.Text:
干物を使った新メニュー
なにかないかしら

English.Text: Only so many ways you can prepare fish, and I'm running out of ideas...

Japanese.Text:
うんうん　みんなの安全のために
コンドルの観察を続けよう！

English.Text: Very true. The more we respect the condor, the more it will respect us!

Japanese.Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
この写真　ちょっといいね

English.Text: Take a look at the new photo we got for Clear Skies. Pretty cute, don'tcha think?

Japanese.Text: うん　楽しそう

English.Text: Yeah, it's a good one!

Japanese.Text:
コンドルとも
いつか仲良くなれるといいよね

English.Text: Gives me hope that the condor'll learn to trust us one day.

Japanese.Text:
うんうん
コンドルとわかりあえるように
観察を続けよう！

English.Text: Me too. And so long as we keep doing what we're doing, I know we'll win it over!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　上でなにかあるんでしょ？

English.Text: So...what's happening topside?

Japanese.Text:
神羅が派手なイベントをやるらしい
オレたちもどうにか潜り込まなきゃな

English.Text: A Shinra event─one they're pullin' out all the stops for. We gotta get up there to see it.

Japanese.Text:
でも　エレベーターには近づけないよ
コンドルにでも運んでもらうっての？

English.Text: And how do you propose we do that? Hitch a ride on the condor?

Japanese.Text: 上の騒ぎ　新社長就任式典だってな

English.Text: The inauguration parade is gonna be a real spectacle.

Japanese.Text:
そこで神羅の次の方針を
打ち出すんだとさ

English.Text: I hear he's gonna announce some big policy changes too.

Japanese.Text:
そっか　ルーファウスさんならいいかも
かっこいいし　清潔感あるし

English.Text: Rufus, huh...? Yeah, it'll be nice to have someone in charge who isn't a gargoyle.

Japanese.Text:
オレたちの想いを
どうにか届けたいな

English.Text: Be nice to have someone who might listen to us.

Japanese.Text: ここの海の底には　魔晄炉があるんだ

English.Text: We should've never let them build a reactor in our waters...

Japanese.Text:
現状を知ったら変えてくれるかも
手紙に書いて送ろうよ

English.Text: Why don't we try writing him a strongly worded letter!

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスさんへの手紙
返事あったか？

English.Text: Any response to the letters we sent yet?

Japanese.Text: もう９４通　まだ返事ないの

English.Text: Ninety-four written...and not one reply.

Japanese.Text:
なんてったって　神羅の社長だ
きっと忙しいんだろ

English.Text: There's still a chance. Guy's prob'ly up to his eyeballs in work right now.

Japanese.Text: 気長に待とうぜ

English.Text: Just be patient.

Japanese.Text:
プリシラには会ったかい？
目立つ子だからすぐにわかるよ

English.Text: Have you met Priscilla yet? You'll know her when you see her. She's such a special girl.

Japanese.Text:
とってもかわいくて　かしこくてね
イルカもよ～くなついてる

English.Text: Cute as a button and clever to boot. It's no wonder that dolphin has taken a liking to her.

Japanese.Text:
プリシラはイルカに
芸を教えているんだよ

English.Text: Priscilla's even managed to teach her dolphin some tricks.

Japanese.Text: アンダージュノン自慢の娘っ子さ

English.Text: She's our town's pride and joy, I tell you.

Japanese.Text:
プリシラは　かわいいだろ
あたしの若い頃にそっくりなんだ

English.Text: Isn't Priscilla just adorable? She's the spitting image of me in my younger days.

Japanese.Text:
イルカのことを話すと
止まらなくなるんだ

English.Text: If you get her going about dolphins, she'll talk your ear off.

Japanese.Text: そこがまた　かわいいんだよ

English.Text: I adore that passion of hers.

Japanese.Text:
プリシラのイルカショーを見るのが
楽しみで　長生きしてるよ

English.Text: I hope I live long enough to see Priscilla put on her very own dolphin show.

Japanese.Text: 神羅は　やりたい放題やりやがる

English.Text: Shinra acts like they run the whole damn world...

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ運送は制限　自由な漁業の禁止
どこも禁止に制限ばっかだ

English.Text: Clampin' down on chocobo deliveries, prohibiting us from fishing... What next? They gonna outlaw breathin'?

Japanese.Text: 海は魔晄で汚し　空は都市で覆う

English.Text: Those corporate bastards may think they own the seas and the skies...

Japanese.Text:
もともとここは
俺たちの土地なんだぞ　くそ

English.Text: but they're never gonna own us. That's for damn sure!

Japanese.Text:
海がいつもと違うな　波が静かだ
こんな日はなにかあるぜ

English.Text: Ocean's real quiet today. Too quiet... Something's brewin', can tell ya that much...

Japanese.Text:
海に出るなら気をつけろ
俺たち海の男にはわかるのさ

English.Text: When an old salt like me says you oughta keep your feet on dry land, you listen.

Japanese.Text: な？　俺の予感は的中だ

English.Text: See? Told ya there was trouble on the horizon.

Japanese.Text:
でも　あんなでっかいのを
倒しちまうなんて

English.Text: Never imagined you'd haul in a big sucker like that, though.

Japanese.Text: あんたたち　ただものじゃないな

English.Text: Gotta say, you're an impressive bunch.

Japanese.Text:
まさか　指名手配中の
アバランチ……じゃないよな

English.Text: Hey, you're not...y'know, those Avalanche fugitives from Midgar?

Japanese.Text:
まあ　俺も反神羅派だ
見逃してやるさ

English.Text: Wait─don't answer that. I'm a supporter, but...the less I know the better.

Japanese.Text: 昔の海は　もっと静かだったんだ

English.Text: You wouldn't believe how quiet these waters used to be.

Japanese.Text:
神羅のでっかい船が通るようになって
海も荒れちまった

English.Text: But ever since Shinra swept in with their big tankers, seas've been rough.

Japanese.Text:
おまけに　魔晄の垂れ流しでな
海の生態系まで壊れちまった

English.Text: Offshore reactor hasn't helped matters neither. Been leakin' mako from the start, wreakin' havoc on the wildlife.

Japanese.Text: いつか自然に復讐されるんじゃねえかな

English.Text: Mother Nature ain't happy, and one day...

Japanese.Text:
なあ　エレベーターであがってった
３人組

English.Text: Hey, you see that trio that took the elevator up top?

Japanese.Text:
神羅の黒スーツっていえば
タークスとかいうヤバイやつらだよな

English.Text: Had to be Turks. Those suits're unmistakable! Wonder what brought 'em here...

Japanese.Text:
タークスが来てるってことは　上で
アバランチとドンパチ始まるのかもな

English.Text: Whatever it is, I'm sure it'll bring Avalanche too─and then all hell's gonna break loose.

Japanese.Text:
上のイベントは
新社長就任パレードだってよ

English.Text: Guess there's some kinda inauguration parade going on up top.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　タークスが来てたのは
ルーファウス新社長の
警備だったってわけか

English.Text: Aha! Now that would explain why those Turks were here. They must be on bodyguard duty.

Japanese.Text:
でも　なんで
アンダージュノンに寄ったんだ？

English.Text: But then why cut through Under Junon?

Japanese.Text:
さあな　会場の安全確保かなんかだろ
いいなあ　俺も警備つけて歩きてえよ

English.Text: Maybe to scope out the place for unsavory elements? Don't ask me. I'm not important enough to need that kind of protection.

Japanese.Text:
むかしむかし　海の上には共和国の首都
ジュノンがあったのじゃ

English.Text: Many, many years ago, the republic's capital city once floated on these very waters.

Japanese.Text: 海の上に街なんて　うっそだ～

English.Text: That's stupid. Cities don't float!

Japanese.Text:
ふふ　大きな船をいくつもつなげて
大きな大きな街にしたんじゃよ

English.Text: It was a large city with many people, built atop a series of connected ships called a flotilla.

Japanese.Text: おお　かっけ～！

English.Text: That sounds awesome!

Japanese.Text:
うむうむ
波の上でいつも揺れておったな

English.Text: But it was always rocking back and forth, back and forth.

Japanese.Text: うわ　気持ち悪くなりそう

English.Text: I think I'd get seasick.

Japanese.Text:
はっは　住んでるうちに
慣れるもんじゃよ

English.Text: You'd get used to it in time.

Japanese.Text: 海の上の街は　どうなったの？

English.Text: So what happened to the floating city? Where did it go?

Japanese.Text:
ふむ　神羅との戦争に負けて
沈んでしまったな

English.Text: Into the depths. Shinra sank it in the war.

Japanese.Text:
じゃが　いまでも海の底には
お宝を乗せた船がいっぱいじゃ！

English.Text: The flotilla now rests at the bottom of the sea, along with its hidden treasures.

Japanese.Text: うわ～　すげ～！

English.Text: Hidden treasure? For real!?

Japanese.Text: もっと聞きたい！

English.Text: I wanna hear about the treasure!

Japanese.Text:
あの骨は
昔ジュノンでとれた魚の骨さ

English.Text: Believe it or not, those bones over there came from a real fish.

Japanese.Text:
引きあげるのに　船が何隻も沈みかけて
大変だったって話だ

English.Text: I'll never forget the day we reeled it in. Nearly capsized ten times over, but we caught it.

Japanese.Text:
いまじゃあ
あの大きさの魚はもうとれない
それでも俺は　ただ海に出るだけだ

English.Text: Won't find a fish that size these days. Not that it stops me from going out looking on the deep blue─or green, as it were.

Japanese.Text:
魚がいないのなら　いる場所に船を漕ぐ
それが　ジュノンの漁師魂さ

English.Text: In that way we fishermen are stubborn as scissorclaws. Yessir─we'll paddle to the ends of the earth for our catch if we have to.

Japanese.Text:
反対運動の参加者は
ただちに解散しなさい！

English.Text: Disperse immediately! I repeat─disperse!

Japanese.Text: エレベーターは封鎖中だ

English.Text: This is your only warning!

Japanese.Text:
現在　エレベーターの一般使用は禁止だ
いますぐ解散しなさい！

English.Text: The elevator is currently off-limits to civilians! Disperse at once!

Japanese.Text: 神羅は　エレベーターを解放しろ！

English.Text: Our town, our land, our lift!

Japanese.Text: 神羅は　エレベーターを解放しろ！

English.Text: Our town, our land, our lift!

Japanese.Text: 解放しろ！
新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Japanese.Text: 新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Japanese.Text: 新社長就任　反対！

English.Text: Junon has no president!

Japanese.Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Japanese.Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Japanese.Text: ルーファウス　帰れ！

English.Text: Go home, Rufus! Go home!

Japanese.Text: 打倒　神羅！

English.Text: Down. With. Shinra!

Japanese.Text: 打倒　神羅！

English.Text: Down. With. Shinra!

Japanese.Text: 打倒　神羅！

共和国時代は　石炭や石油
それから風力なんかを使って
エネルギーを得ていたんだよ

English.Text: Oil, coal, wind... The Republic of Junon had no shortage of ways to generate power.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄なんて使わなくても生活できるんだ
それなのに　神羅は魔晄に依存させる

English.Text: No need for "mako," no sir. Shinra, though─they couldn't live without it, and they made sure we couldn't either.

Japanese.Text: 自分たちの利益のためさ

English.Text: Gotta make that money, right?

Japanese.Text:
神羅の手を借りなくても
生きていけるんだ

English.Text: People never needed Shinra to survive.

Japanese.Text: みんな　すっかり忘れちまったがね

English.Text: But somewhere along the line, we forgot how...

Japanese.Text:
黒マントのヤツら　どこにいったんだ？
このへんの廃墟に住んでたよな

English.Text: Where'd those robed fellas run off to? Coulda sworn I saw 'em hangin' around the ruins.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　あいつらなら
すこしまえに上に行ったみたいよ

English.Text: If you're looking for them for whatever reason, I saw 'em head up top not too long ago.

Japanese.Text:
自分たちで動いたのかよ　珍しいな
薬でももらいに行ったのかな

English.Text: All together in a group? Didn't expect that. Maybe they went looking for a doctor?

Japanese.Text:
あいつら　くさいし
いなくなって清々するわ

English.Text: Good riddance, I say. They stunk to high heaven.

Japanese.Text:
上には　けっこうな数の
黒マントがいるんだってな

English.Text: Must be a crowd up there now, what with the others.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンは軍事要塞だからね
戦争の犠牲者をかくまってるんじゃない

English.Text: Well, Junon is a military base. Makes sense that refugees would seek shelter here.

Japanese.Text: 船員仲間に聞いたんだけどよ

English.Text: So I was talking with a sailor friend of mine...

Japanese.Text:
このへんに住んでた黒マントたち
連絡船で海を渡ったらしい

English.Text: and he said those robed guys managed to board the Shinra-8 and cross the dang sea.

Japanese.Text:
なに　コスタに遊びにでも行ったの？
神羅の慰安旅行かしら

English.Text: What, they up and decided to take a vacation in Costa del Sol on Shinra's gil?

Japanese.Text:
星の民よ
星の声に耳を傾けるのだ

English.Text: Children of the planet─listen! Heed the voice of our great mother.

Japanese.Text:
星の嘆き　星の悲しみ　星の苦しみ
星は　いまも悲鳴をあげている

English.Text: Hear how she weeps─how she suffers! How she cries out, even now, for deliverance from pain─a pain that we, her children, are inflicting upon her!

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンの海を見よ
生命の失せた海を！

English.Text: If you want proof, then look to the waters─devoid of their vibrancy!

Japanese.Text: 魔晄が海の命を削っている

English.Text: And what is to blame for this? Mako.

Japanese.Text:
海の命を軽んじれば
やがて人の命も尽き果てる

English.Text: Shinra's "miracle" has befouled your seas. But I promise you─it will not stop there!

Japanese.Text:
この海のように
ゆるやかに滅び去ろう

English.Text: It will come for your shores, your crops─the air you breathe!

Japanese.Text:
ライフストリームを絶やしてはならぬ
我らの命が　星とともにあらんことを！

English.Text: The lifestream must be preserved! It is the essence of our planet─the very thing that sustains us─and we must not bleed our mother dry!

Japanese.Text:
ガボン牧場のチョコボ運送
最近　見ないよな

English.Text: You seen Gabe lately? Feels like he hasn't come by in ages.

Japanese.Text:
なんか　また神羅にやられたって噂よ
もう廃業するんじゃないかな

English.Text: I heard that Shinra cracked down on him and the birds again. He might have to close down the business for good this time.

Japanese.Text:
マジか　グラスランドから
木材仕入れられないと　困るな

English.Text: You gotta be kidding me. Seriously? Then how in the hell are we supposed to get all the lumber we need?

Japanese.Text:
ガボンさんのチョコボ運送
再開したってさ！

English.Text: Whaddya know: Gabe and his birds are back in business!

Japanese.Text: ちょっと値上げしたみたいだけどな

English.Text: Bumped his rates up a little to boot.

Japanese.Text: それだけ　やる気あるってことでしょ

English.Text: Just shows he's got faith in the brand.

Japanese.Text:
へへ　さっそく
なんか運んでもらおうぜ

English.Text: I better hurry up and put in an order.

Japanese.Text: なんの騒ぎだったんだよ

English.Text: What was that about?

Japanese.Text: あの人　ソルジャーだよな？

English.Text: That guy was a SOLDIER, right?

Japanese.Text: アバランチの捜索に来たのか？

English.Text: Prob'ly came lookin' for Avalanche.

Japanese.Text: バイク　うるさかったなあ

English.Text: That bike about burst my eardrums.

Japanese.Text: 戦いになるのかと思ったぜ

English.Text: I was sure a fight was gonna break out.

Japanese.Text:
さっきのバイクの人
かっこいい～！

English.Text: Did you see the guy on the motorcycle? What a hunk!

Japanese.Text: 神羅は面倒しか起こさない

English.Text: Shinra only knows how to raise mayhem.

Japanese.Text:
マイフレンドって
呼ばれてみたいかも！

English.Text: Oh, I'd like to be his friend...

Japanese.Text: もう　いい迷惑！

English.Text: Ugh! What an asshole!

Japanese.Text:
もしかして
アバランチがこの村にいるの？

English.Text: Wait a minute─does this mean that Avalanche is here?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスが来るらしいな
いまが文句を言うチャンスじゃないか？

English.Text: Rufus is comin' to Junon! Now's our chance to raise some hell and be heard!

Japanese.Text:
漁に行くぞ
神羅がなにしようが関係ねえ

English.Text: I'm a fisherman, not a businessman. Shinra ain't no concern of mine.

Japanese.Text:
魚焼きまくって　けむたくして
パレードを妨害してやる

English.Text: Oughta hold a big ol' cookout─let their parade choke on the smoke.

Japanese.Text:
上で式典だってよ
さっさと終わってくれないかな

English.Text: Can't wait for that damned parade of theirs to be over and done with.

Japanese.Text:
新社長になるからって
神羅は　変わらないよな

English.Text: Just 'cause there's a new president doesn't mean Shinra's gonna do a one-eighty.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス神羅が来てるんだって！
見に行きたいわ～

English.Text: Isn't that something. The new president─here, in Junon!

Japanese.Text:
社長が代わって
ここの暮らしもよくなるといいな

English.Text: Life down here's been hard. Maybe a change in leadership will help with that.

Japanese.Text:
新社長は　ボーナス大盤振る舞いとか
してくれないかな

English.Text: Think the new prez will, iunno, throw us a bone? We're hurtin'.

Japanese.Text:
パレードって盛りあがるよね
テレビで見なきゃ

English.Text: Not every day that a parade comes to town! It'll be televised, right?

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンの青年団が
騒がなきゃいいけど

English.Text: Hope the Crow's Nest folks don't try anything stupid.

Japanese.Text: なにか事件でも起きたのか

English.Text: What's going on? Did something happen!?

Japanese.Text: おいおい　どうなってんだよ

English.Text: This is all too much!

Japanese.Text: ここは安全なのか？

English.Text: My knees are knocking...

Japanese.Text: ちくしょう　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: This is terrible... What do we do?

Japanese.Text: 助けてくれ……

English.Text: Can't help but be worried.

Japanese.Text: なに　どうなってるの？

English.Text: This better not be a joke...!

Japanese.Text: えっ　もしかしてヤバい状況？

English.Text: Someone...do something.

Japanese.Text: いったい　なんなの？

English.Text: What in the world is that?

Japanese.Text: これ　まずいんじゃない？

English.Text: That can't be good...

Japanese.Text: なにも起きないで　お願い……

English.Text: It's nothing serious, right?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスが襲撃されるなんて
いい気味だよ

English.Text: Man I wish I'd been there when they tried to kill the son of a bitch.

Japanese.Text:
上へのエレベーターは
封鎖されたままなんだ

English.Text: Elevator's been shut down since shit hit the fan upstairs.

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの警備が強化されちまったよ

English.Text: Security's been real tight ever since the parade.

Japanese.Text: 新社長を襲ったのはアバランチなのか？

English.Text: Was the assassin with Avalanche, or...?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスを狙ったのは
ウータイなんだよな？

English.Text: Everybody knows that Wutai was behind the attack.

Japanese.Text: ルーファウスさん　無事なのかしら

English.Text: You don't think Rufus was hurt, do you?

Japanese.Text:
あたしたちの生活は
なにも変わらないのよね

English.Text: Was stupid of me to think a new president would do anything for us.

Japanese.Text: 神羅カンパニーの今後が心配だわ

English.Text: Shinra's gonna be out for blood, you'll see.

Japanese.Text:
相手がアバランチでもウータイでも
戦争はイヤかな～

English.Text: The last thing we need is for a war to break out. Got enough problems already.

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンの青年団
盛りあがってるんでしょうね

English.Text: Bet you anything the folks over in the Crow's Nest are eating this up.

Japanese.Text:
上の騒ぎの次は　戦争の噂
どうなっちまうんだ

English.Text: First an assassin at the parade, and now a war!? Gimme a goddamn break...

Japanese.Text:
戦争が起きたら
ここも巻き込まれるのか

English.Text: We got no beef with the SRC. They wouldn't start trouble here.

Japanese.Text:
反神羅のやつらが手を結べば
神羅もヤバイよな

English.Text: I tell ya, Shinra better pray the SRC don't come around here recruitin'.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　ジュノンの大砲がありゃ
安心だよな

English.Text: No one would dare take on Junon's cannon. We'll be fine.

Japanese.Text:
連絡会ってのは
サイドジュノンも関わってんのかね

English.Text: So...the Crow's Nest is working with the SRC, then?

Japanese.Text:
なにがあっても
子供たちだけは守らないとね

English.Text: The safety of our children has to be our top priority.

Japanese.Text: 私たちまで　狙われないと良いんだけど

English.Text: Hey, you don't think they'd try to hit us here, do you?

Japanese.Text:
暗殺とか戦争よりも
髪のいたみのほうが深刻

English.Text: Shinra and its war can get bent. It's these friggin' split ends I'm worried about!

Japanese.Text:
神羅との戦いは望んでいたはずなのに
いざとなると
やめてほしいって願っちゃう

English.Text: I always wanted someone to stick it to Shinra, but if that means turning Junon into a warzone? I dunno...

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス様だけは
生き残ってくれないかしら

English.Text: Rufus'll come out on top. The rich and powerful always do.

Japanese.Text: よしよし　いい輝きだな

English.Text: Don't worry, little lady. I'll fix you up good as new.

Japanese.Text:
いつか漁に出られる日のために
しっかり磨くぞ

English.Text: Then one day we can take to the seas again and do what we do best.

Japanese.Text: きゅっきゅっきゅーっと

English.Text: We'll get you lookin' shiny and new in no time.

Japanese.Text: 僕のことも磨いてほしい……

English.Text: Wish he'd give me the same TLC.

Japanese.Text:
おんや　珍しいねえ
旅人がこの村にやってくるなんてねえ

English.Text: Been an age since we've seen travelers like yourselves. No one save Shinra folk ever bother with us.

Japanese.Text:
よければ　道具屋や武器屋で
買い物をしていってくれんか？

English.Text: Don't suppose ya might consider stockin' up on provisions while in town?

Japanese.Text:
わしの店はもう潰れて無いが
まだ　あの店はやっとる

English.Text: My own store's long gone, but those ones there are still holdin' on.

Japanese.Text:
ひやかしだけでも良いんじゃ
客が来るだけでも嬉しいからのう

English.Text: I'm sure they'd welcome you with open arms, even if you don't end up buying anything from 'em.

Japanese.Text:
戦争の後に
神羅が上の街を作ってから……

English.Text: I swear, ever since Shinra came and built that blasted hunk of junk above us...

Japanese.Text:
魚も　さっぱりとれんわ
海が汚れてしもうてな

English.Text: These waters have been so polluted with filth that I haven't seen a single fish! What's a man of the sea like me s'posed to do?

Japanese.Text:
また　戦争になるんか？
戦争にかこつけて神羅はやりたい放題だ

English.Text: So─we're in for another war, are we? Great. Now Shinra'll have even more excuses to go forth and do as they please.

Japanese.Text:
海の次は
空まで汚されるかのう……

English.Text: You mark my words, they'll start muckin' up the sky next.

Japanese.Text:
同じことの繰り返し　いったい
いつまで続くんじゃろうな

English.Text: The world turns and turns, but somehow they keep comin' out on top. Is there nothin' we can do to put an end to it?

Japanese.Text:
エレベーターは使用禁止だってよ
ジュノンでの仕入れも延期しろとか

English.Text: Elevator's on lockdown for us bottom-feeders... Which means no new provisions today.

Japanese.Text: なんだよ　くそ

English.Text: Friggin' bullshit...

Japanese.Text:
おかげで　今日もメシは
うちで作った干物だぞ

English.Text: Hope I've still got a chunk of that homemade jerky lyin' around...

Japanese.Text: 俺たちも干からびろってのか

English.Text: They tryin' to starve us out?

Japanese.Text: なんだ　新社長就任パレードって

English.Text: An inauguration parade... Ya gotta be shittin' me.

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウスってのは
相当な見栄っぱりだな

English.Text: How narcissistic can one rich asshole be?

Japanese.Text:
わざわざジュノンに来てまで
目立ちたいのかよ

English.Text: We get it, Rufus. You're a big boy now!

Japanese.Text: ああもう　毎日塩漬け干物づくし

English.Text: Every damn meal, pickled friggin' fish. I'm sick of it.

Japanese.Text:
新社長に代わっても
俺たちの生活はなんも変わらねえよ

English.Text: Doesn't matter who's at the head of the table─we're always gonna be forced to eat scraps.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の漁船はデカイから
揺れが少ないのはいいよな

English.Text: Shinra's rigs're sturdy as all hell─so big they barely rock!

Japanese.Text: おう　船酔いもナシだ

English.Text: Which means no more seasickness.

Japanese.Text:
甲板の掃除やら網の片付けやら
雑用だけど
海に出る仕事につけただけマシだぜ

English.Text: Granted, swabbin' the deck and untanglin' nets ain't glamorous work, but better to be out there than stuck on shore.

Japanese.Text:
昇進したら
自分の船を持てるって話なんだ

English.Text: Plus it gives us more opportunities to prove that we're officer material!

Japanese.Text:
俺の船が先か
おまえの船が先か　競争だな

English.Text: Who d'ya think'll get licensed first─me or you? Wanna make a bet?

Japanese.Text: え～と　なんだっけ……

English.Text: Okay, where was I?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　みなさん！
あたし　サイドジュノンの
反神羅青年団から来ました

English.Text: My friends! I represent the anti-Shinra forces of the Crow's Nest.

Japanese.Text:
みんなで力を合わせて
神羅から海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Do you believe the company has gone too far? That they must be stopped?

Japanese.Text:
神羅はきれいな海を
魔晄で汚しました

English.Text: Shinra's mako has ruined our ocean.

Japanese.Text:
いつもくさいし
変な形のお魚しかとれなくなりました

English.Text: It has tarnished our beaches─destroyed our livelihoods!

Japanese.Text:
あたし　おいしいお魚を
お刺身で食べたいんです

English.Text: When was the last time you all felt safe eating your own catch?

Japanese.Text:
プリップリで
脂がのった　新鮮なお刺身！

English.Text: The last time you had fish so fresh you could eat it raw?

Japanese.Text:
えっ　お客さん？
い……いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Wait. You want to buy something? Here? Okay!

Japanese.Text: やった　お客さんだ～！

English.Text: Omigosh, actual customers!

Japanese.Text: またのご利用　お待ちしてまーす！

English.Text: Come back again... Please?

Japanese.Text: ほんと　ありがとうございました！

English.Text: Thank you so, so much!

Japanese.Text: たまには買い物してやらないと

English.Text: Sometimes window-shopping ain't enough.

Japanese.Text:
流行りもの
置いてないんだよな～

English.Text: Talk about a lame selection...

Japanese.Text: 上からの仕入れが大変みたいね

English.Text: They must've cracked down on the supply route.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　どれにしようかな

English.Text: Hmm. Didn't think it'd be this tough to decide.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい　強くなってくれ

English.Text: Hey there─looking to augment your folios?

Japanese.Text: へへへ　さあどうする？

English.Text: So, what'll it be?

Japanese.Text: まあ　いい感じってとこか？

English.Text: Well, hope you found what you needed.

Japanese.Text: また寄ってくれよ！

English.Text: Come back soon!

Japanese.Text: マンガは置いてねえのか？

English.Text: So they don't have comics?

Japanese.Text: なんか古い本ばっかだな

English.Text: They got any new books here?

Japanese.Text: 古本のニオイっていいわ

English.Text: I just love that old-book smell.

Japanese.Text: 危ない本はないかな

English.Text: Where d'they keep the smutty stuff?

Japanese.Text:
いらっしゃい！
くつろいでけよ

English.Text: Hey, good to have ya! Take a load off!

Japanese.Text: よく来た　飲んでけ飲んでけ！

English.Text: You're lookin' parched! Let's get you a drink!

Japanese.Text:
もともと俺の店は　船の上にあったんだ
客が多いと船が沈みかけたほどさ

English.Text: This tavern used to be on a ship in the harbor, you know. Got so low in the water when it was hoppin', you'd think she might sink.

Japanese.Text:
海に　酒樽つるしてよ
波の揺れでカクテルかきまわしてたな

English.Text: Had this thing where we'd toss a bunch of shakers in a barrel─let the waves mix the drinks for us.

Japanese.Text:
本日　神羅カンパニー広報部の
会見が開かれました

English.Text: At an official Shinra press conference held earlier today...

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで行われる
神羅カンパニーの式典は
予定通り　明日開催されます

English.Text: a spokesperson confirmed that the inauguration in Junon will be held tomorrow as scheduled.

Japanese.Text:
軍事拠点である
要塞都市ジュノンでの式典が
どんな内容や規模になるのか

English.Text: What exciting festivities does our new company president have in store for the city?

Japanese.Text:
全世界の注目が
ジュノンに集まっています

English.Text: Make sure to tune in tomorrow to find out.

Japanese.Text:
続いて　ミッドガルへの破壊活動で
指名手配されている反神羅組織
アバランチ捜索関連の続報です

English.Text: We have received new information regarding Avalanche, the anti-Shinra group responsible for multiple terrorist attacks in Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
治安維持部門からの発表によると
アバランチは　現在も逃亡中であり

English.Text: According to a recent statement from Public Security, key members remain at large...

Japanese.Text:
カームに潜伏していた協力者も
逮捕には至っておりません

English.Text: and those who concealed them in Kalm have yet to be apprehended.

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは
カームの協力者も含めて　引き続き
アバランチの捜索を続けていくとの事で

English.Text: Shinra is asking citizens to come forward if they have information concerning Avalanche's current whereabouts...

Japanese.Text: 市民への情報提供を呼びかけています

English.Text: or the identities of their associates.

Japanese.Text:
本日　神羅カンパニーの新たなリーダー
ルーファウス新社長の
就任パレードが行われます

English.Text: Today, the Shinra Electric Power Company is celebrating the inauguration of Rufus Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
開催地となる要塞都市ジュノンには
多くの人々が
新社長の雄姿を見るべく訪れています

English.Text: Many people have flocked to Junon for the chance to see his first official appearance as commander in chief.

Japanese.Text:
式典では今後の神羅カンパニーについて
ルーファウス新社長の
就任演説が　行われます

English.Text: The president will also give his first public address, in which he is expected to outline his vision for the future.

Japanese.Text:
現在　様々な問題を抱える
神羅カンパニーに
新しい風を吹かすことができるのか
期待されています

English.Text: While this remains a difficult period for Shinra, there is hope that the transition will mark a turning point for the company.

Japanese.Text:
なにが式典だよ
勝手ばっかしやがって

English.Text: Ceremony-shmeremony. It's an excuse for them to show off.

Japanese.Text:
上が盛りあがるなら
オレたちも負けちゃいられねえ

English.Text: We know how to live it up too! Let's go till dawn, baby!

Japanese.Text:
式典だかなんだか知らねえが
酒盛りだ！

English.Text: Who cares what the occasion is─I'll drink to it!

Japanese.Text:
上に行けたら　式典に来る男
捕まえられるのに

English.Text: If only I could move up top─maybe there I'd meet the man of my dreams.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチって
まだ捕まってないの？

English.Text: How have they still not caught Avalanche?

Japanese.Text:
無駄遣いする金あるんなら
アタシがもらいたいね

English.Text: Got money for parades but not for the people, huh?

Japanese.Text:
新社長就任パレードか
ドキドキするぜ

English.Text: Parade for the new president's inauguration, huh? Could be interesting.

Japanese.Text:
上には負けねえ
オレたちも盛りあがるぞ！

English.Text: They think they know how to party? They ain't seen nothin' yet!

Japanese.Text: 中継の時も　この場所確保な

English.Text: Gotta keep this spot for the main event.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンでも
アバランチが暴れたりしないかな

English.Text: Would be nice if Avalanche could stir things up around here too.

Japanese.Text:
新社長になっても
あたしたちには関係ないよね

English.Text: Who cares who the new president is? Won't change anything for us.

Japanese.Text: パレードの間に何杯飲めるか　競争ね

English.Text: Gonna need a lot more drinks in me to enjoy the show.

Japanese.Text:
はいはい
みんなたくさん飲んでね！

English.Text: Don't be shy! Keep knockin' 'em back!

Japanese.Text:
あんたたちの酒代が
あたしの稼ぎになるんだよ

English.Text: The more you drink, the more you give back to the community!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　塩味きいてるね

English.Text: Hoo boy... Now that's what I call salty.

Japanese.Text: ここの魚料理はうまいんだよ

English.Text: The chef here really knows how to cook a fish!

Japanese.Text: 俺は船上酒場時代からの常連だよ

English.Text: Been a regular here since the place was still on a ship!

Japanese.Text: うわ　海の砂入ってる～

English.Text: Why is there still sand in my shoe!?

Japanese.Text: ヘルシーな貝料理がオススメよ

English.Text: Shellfish is good for the body and soul!

Japanese.Text:
もうちょっと
カラフルだといいと思うんだけど

English.Text: I'm used to eating food with a little more color...

Japanese.Text: うふふ　遊んでく？

English.Text: Hehe, love the outfit.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　１杯おごってくれない？

English.Text: What I wouldn't give for a drink right now.

Japanese.Text: サイドジュノン反神羅青年団です

English.Text: We're recruiting for Crows Against Shinra!

Japanese.Text: みなさん　神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: Let's stand up to our corporate oppressors!

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Let's take back the sea for Junon!

Japanese.Text: サイドジュノン反神羅青年団です

English.Text: We're recruiting for Crows Against Shinra!

Japanese.Text: みなさん　神羅と戦いましょう！

English.Text: Let's stand up to our corporate oppressors!

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの海を取り戻しましょう！

English.Text: Let's take back the sea for Junon!

Japanese.Text: 臨時ニュースをお伝えします

English.Text: And now breaking news.

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンで行われた
神羅カンパニーの式典で

English.Text: Rufus Shinra, our newly appointed president...

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス新社長が
襲撃される事件がありました

English.Text: was attacked during his inauguration in Junon.

Japanese.Text:
幸い　ルーファウス新社長にケガはなく
業務に支障もないとのことです

English.Text: Thankfully, he was uninjured and was able to assume his new position without delay.

Japanese.Text:
治安維持部門の発表によりますと
犯行当時　ウータイ人とみられる
不審な女性が式典会場の近くで
目撃されたという証言があり

English.Text: Public Security has confirmed that multiple eyewitnesses observed a young woman, believed to be of Wutaian origin, behaving erratically shortly before the incident.

Japanese.Text: 事件との関連を調査中とのことです

English.Text: Authorities are investigating her involvement...

Japanese.Text:
また　アバランチの関与につきましても
今後明らかにしていくとしています

English.Text: as well as her potential connections to Avalanche and other insurgent groups.

Japanese.Text:
先日発生した　反神羅連絡会
およびウータイ暫定政府による
電波ジャックの続報です

English.Text: The illegal broadcast from the Shinra Resistance Committee and the interim Wutaian government has left many fearful of future attacks.

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーは　住民の間で
不安の声が高まっているのを受け

English.Text: The Shinra Electric Power Company regrets the distress inflicted upon the people...

Japanese.Text:
近日中に　ルーファウス新社長による
声明文を発表するとしています

English.Text: and has promised to make a public statement in the near future to address their concerns.

Japanese.Text:
また　治安維持部門は
錯綜する情報に惑わされず

English.Text: Public Security anticipates a rise in misinformation in the coming days...

Japanese.Text:
いつもどおりの生活を心掛けるよう
呼びかけています

English.Text: and is encouraging everyone to go about their lives as normal.

Japanese.Text: よお　いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Hello, hello, hello!

Japanese.Text: フハハ　なんか買ってけよ

English.Text: Hahaha! What can I do ya for?

Japanese.Text: フハハ　いつでも歓迎だ！

English.Text: Haha! Don't be a stranger!

Japanese.Text: そんじゃ　気をつけてな

English.Text: You take care of yourself, okay?

Japanese.Text: 漁に使う銛を探してんだ

English.Text: I'm lookin' for a quality harpoon.

Japanese.Text: 魚釣りの道具も売っているな

English.Text: So they got fishing gear too, huh.

Japanese.Text: 銃でカモメを撃っちゃダメよ

English.Text: Hey─don't go shootin' the seagulls.

Japanese.Text: この剣　買うか迷うわねえ

English.Text: I should just do it. Just buy the sword!

Japanese.Text:
こんな海でも
散歩するのは気持ちいいぜ

English.Text: It's still nice to walk the beach, even with the sea a mess.

Japanese.Text:
海の魔晄色で
今日の運勢占ってるんだ

English.Text: "The brighter the ocean mako, the brighter your day!"

Japanese.Text:
たまには　カモメに
エサやりでもするかなあ

English.Text: Bet the seagulls are hungry. I should feed 'em.

Japanese.Text: さ～て　今日はなにが釣れるかな

English.Text: Alright! Let's see what's biting today!

Japanese.Text:
海を見てボーッとするのが
日課なんだよ

English.Text: Nothing makes you forget a bad day like staring at the ocean.

Japanese.Text:
最近じゃ　網にかかるのは
モンスターばかりよ

English.Text: Lately I've been bringin' in nothing but sea devils...

Japanese.Text: イルカちゃん　かわいいな

English.Text: That dolphin's so adorable.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイのシノビってのが
偵察にでも来たら　いよいよ
終わりが近いのかもしれないよ

English.Text: Bet we'll be hearing rumors of ninjas here soon. After that, won't be long until kaboom...

Japanese.Text:
魔晄色の海でも
深いところは　まだ青いの

English.Text: Ocean may look like it's in dire straits but...life finds a way.

Japanese.Text: ぷりぷり……思い出すのう

English.Text: Boy, oh boy. Now this takes me way back.

Japanese.Text:
漁のあと　とれたての魚をさばいて
その場で食ったもんじゃ

English.Text: Hookin' some nice fish, bringing 'em back to gut and fillet, then eatin' 'em on the spot.

Japanese.Text:
ぷりぷり……
港のおなごもたくましくてのう

English.Text: You didn't wanna mess with the gals workin' the port, neither. Hoo.

Japanese.Text: な～に昔の話じゃ　ホッホ

English.Text: Oh, listen to me, goin' on about the old days.

Japanese.Text:
右よし　左よし
異状な～し！

English.Text: Nothing here, nothing there...all clear!

Japanese.Text:
子供たちが安心して遊べるように
海を監視してるんだ

English.Text: Thanks to our tireless efforts, the ocean remains safe.

Japanese.Text: 干物作りは　とっても奥が深いのよ

English.Text: With all the ways to cure fish, it's practically an art form.

Japanese.Text:
右よし　左よし
異状な～し！

English.Text: Clear right, clear left...and we're good!

Japanese.Text:
釣り人も来るから
万がいちに備えてるの

English.Text: Gotta stay vigilant. Never know when fiends'll strike.

Japanese.Text:
お～い　エサだぞ～
集まれ集まれ！

English.Text: Alright, everyone, come and get it! Don't wanna miss feedin' time, do ya?

Japanese.Text:
ほ～ら　食え食え
いっぱい食えよ

English.Text: That's it. Eat up now. I know ya must be starving.

Japanese.Text:
昔は釣り舟が
たくさん出ていたのよ

English.Text: Back in the day, it was lousy with fishing boats...

Japanese.Text: ショータイム　はじめるぞ！

English.Text: It's showtime, people!

Japanese.Text: ショータイム　やるよ～！

English.Text: The show's about to start!

Japanese.Text: よ～しよ～し

English.Text: Good job out there.

Japanese.Text: えらかったね

English.Text: You did great.

Japanese.Text: あの子　大丈夫か？

English.Text: She gonna be okay!?

Japanese.Text: 自警団はどこいったんだ

English.Text: Shouldn't someone be on patrol!?

Japanese.Text: はやく浜にあがるんだ！

English.Text: Get out of the water! Now!

Japanese.Text: きゃあああ　危ない！

English.Text: Hey! Look out!

Japanese.Text: なんとかしなきゃ

English.Text: We gotta save her...

Japanese.Text: 誰か　助けてあげて！

English.Text: Somebody do something!

Japanese.Text: 事故がなくて　本当に良かったよ

English.Text: What a relief this didn't turn out worse.

Japanese.Text: なんとか無事だったな

English.Text: I'm so glad she wasn't hurt.

Japanese.Text: おぼれかけたのに　元気だなあ

English.Text: Wow, that didn't faze her at all.

Japanese.Text: あの子　たくましいわね

English.Text: That girl's certainly something, isn't she?

Japanese.Text: やっぱり魔晄の海は危険だよ

English.Text: We really need to shut that reactor down.

Japanese.Text:
あんな危ないのが
海にひそんでるんだね

English.Text: Don't wanna think about what else is lurking in these waters...

Japanese.Text:
上の式典が終わるまで
船は出せねえんだ　すまんな

English.Text: Sorry, the ship won't be leaving port until the festivities are over.

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルへ行きたいんなら
ジュノン港まで運んでやろうか？

English.Text: If you're thinking of heading to Costa del Sol, I'd be happy to take you to the port.

Japanese.Text:
あとは連絡船に乗り換えて
気がつけば　コスタ～ってなわけよ

English.Text: Ya gotta book a ticket on the ferry, but once you're aboard, it's a straight shot to paradise.

Japanese.Text: どうする　乗ってくか？

English.Text: Well? You comin'?

Japanese.Text: コスタ・デル・ソルに行くなら　乗ってくか？

English.Text: Headed for Costa del Sol? Hop aboard!

Japanese.Text: よし　面舵いっぱ～い！

English.Text: And we're off! Be there before ya know it!

Japanese.Text: 乗りたくなったら　いつでも声をかけな

English.Text: Gimme a shout whenever you wanna hitch a ride.

Japanese.Text: ここは　子供しか入れないよ

English.Text: Only kids allowed in here.

Japanese.Text: 大人は入れませ～ん

English.Text: No grown-ups.

Japanese.Text:
昔は岸から離れなくても
魚がとれたんだがな

English.Text: In the old days, you could make ends meet just fishin' off the shore.

Japanese.Text:
いまじゃ　沖合まで行かなきゃ
漁ができないんだ

English.Text: Now you gotta go out into the bay to get yourself a nibble.

Japanese.Text:
でっかい船で魚を乱獲すりゃあ
そりゃ　もうかるさ

English.Text: 'Course, if you trawl the waters with a company ship, you're bound to rake it in.

Japanese.Text:
けど　俺みたいな
昔かたぎの漁師に言わせりゃ

English.Text: Ain't any easier or more efficient way to fish, true.

Japanese.Text:
効率がいいだけで
魚の気持ちがわからねえよ

English.Text: But if ya ask me, it's like bitin' the hand that feeds.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の船に乗ってたとしても
ジュノンの漁師魂は忘れたくねえよな

English.Text: I respect the sea, and it'll be a cold day in hell before I work a Shinra ship.

Japanese.Text:
この海の底には海底魔晄炉があるんだ
グツグツと　いまも魔晄を吐き出してる

English.Text: Believe it or not, there's a reactor at the bottom of this bay, sucking mako from the seabed like a man dying of thirst.

Japanese.Text:
海底魔晄炉の魔晄エネルギーは
ジュノンの兵器生産に使われる

English.Text: And all that energy gets used for─you guessed it─weapons production.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイとの戦争が起これば
ここは真っ先に狙われるだろうね

English.Text: Unsurprisingly, that makes it a prime target if we got into another war with Wutai.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ　ご利用ですか？

English.Text: Welcome. Need some rooms?

Japanese.Text: いってらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Have a nice day.

Japanese.Text:
アハハハ
君も青年団に入るのか？

English.Text: Lemme guess─lookin' to join up?

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンにようこそ
いいとこだろう？

English.Text: Welcome to the Crow's Nest. Pretty sweet, right?

Japanese.Text:
新しいジュノンを作るんだ
具体的なことは　まだ考えてないけど

English.Text: We're building a new republic! Dunno what that means, but...it's happening!

Japanese.Text: 豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: Help us take back our seas!

Japanese.Text: 次はどこにポスター貼りに行くかな

English.Text: Where's the best spot to put up a poster, y'think?

Japanese.Text:
あたし　アバランチに
知り合いがいるんだ

English.Text: I have a friend in Avalanche! Well, acquaintance.

Japanese.Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
サイドジュノンへようこそ！

English.Text: All those willing to fight against Shinra's tyranny are welcome in the Crow's Nest!

Japanese.Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
共に戦おう！

English.Text: Crows Against Shinra welcomes all those who believe in freedom!

Japanese.Text:
外はモンスターだらけだ
気をつけていけ

English.Text: Careful! Monsters have the run of the hills around here!

Japanese.Text:
反神羅青年団の同志よ
また会おう！

English.Text: Make sure to come back to us alive and well, fellow freedom fighter!

Japanese.Text:
新人の活動は
ビラ配りとかポスター貼りとか
雑用ばっかなんでしょ？

English.Text: I get that we're brand new to the CAS, but handing out flyers and posting signs is getting old quick.

Japanese.Text: 何年所属しても同じらしい

English.Text: Well, better get used to it.

Japanese.Text:
街頭演説とかデモ行進は
先輩が仕切るってよ

English.Text: Only senior members get to do the cool stuff, like the rallies.

Japanese.Text:
はあ　私は神羅と戦いたくて
志願したんだけど

English.Text: I didn't sign up to carry stacks of paper around Junon.

Japanese.Text:
そういう危ないのは
アバランチに入れってさ

English.Text: Then ya joined the wrong people. Maybe consider Avalanche?

Japanese.Text:
ジュノンの美しく豊かな海を
取り戻しましょう

English.Text: We're gonna reclaim these waters and make 'em beautiful again!

Japanese.Text:
ついに神羅と戦えるのね！
ビラ配りの毎日とは　おさらばよ

English.Text: I could kiss the SRC right now! So long flyers, and hellooo war!

Japanese.Text:
うちは街頭演説とかやって
最前線はアバランチとウータイの連中に
まかせるんだってさ

English.Text: Easy. Our place is on the streets, rallying people to the cause─not the front lines.

Japanese.Text: 後方支援も立派な戦いだって

English.Text: It's a boring job, but someone's gotta do it.

Japanese.Text:
もういい！
そんなんだったら出ていくわ

English.Text: Yeah, well, that "someone" isn't gonna be me!

Japanese.Text:
海を神羅から取り戻したあとは
どうするんだ？

English.Text: So...what's the plan once we take back our waters?

Japanese.Text:
海底魔晄炉を占拠して
オレたちの管理にするんだろ

English.Text: First we occupy the offshore reactor─bring it under our control.

Japanese.Text:
だが　魔晄炉を使い続けたら
魔晄汚染は減らないぞ

English.Text: Then what? Keep using it? Mako's ruining our lives.

Japanese.Text: 水力か風力に変えればいいんじゃね？

English.Text: Convert it to a..."hydropower" plant?

Japanese.Text: オレたちにできるかな

English.Text: So you're an engineer now?

Japanese.Text: あっ！　神羅に頼むか

English.Text: Hey...I got it! We ask Shinra to...

Japanese.Text: あら　新人さんね

English.Text: I take it you're new to the Nest...?

Japanese.Text: はあ～　うめえ

English.Text: Mm, that's the stuff.

Japanese.Text: 空　大きいな～

English.Text: The sky stretches on forever...

Japanese.Text:
ふわ～あ……
鳥の数　かぞえるの飽きたな

English.Text: Wish there was something better to do than count birds.

Japanese.Text: ふわ～あ　ねむ～い……

English.Text: I've never been so sleepy...

Japanese.Text: きゃははは　笑える～

English.Text: Hahaha, you're hilarious.

Japanese.Text: はあ～　すいこまれそう～

English.Text: Wow... Was the sky always this big?

Japanese.Text: 武闘派はお断りよ

English.Text: Violence isn't the answer.

Japanese.Text: 演説ばかりで疲れちゃった

English.Text: These people need to get off their soapboxes.

Japanese.Text:
アンダージュノンが嫌で出てきたのに
顔見知りばっかりだよな

English.Text: Wanted to get away from Under Junon, but all I see are the same faces.

Japanese.Text: 世間はせまいよ

English.Text: Small world, I suppose.

Japanese.Text:
よっし　星命学の聖地
コスモキャニオンでも目指すか

English.Text: Screw it. I should just go to Cosmo Canyon and study planetology.

Japanese.Text: 世界は広いよ

English.Text: It's a big world out there.

Japanese.Text:
