あたし　クレア先輩みたいな
大恋愛にあこがれるわ

English.Text: Claire's really lucky. Talk about a love story for the ages.

Japanese.Text: ディランとはここで出会ったのよね

English.Text: She met Dillan here, didn't she?

Japanese.Text:
トビーは
あなたのことがイイらしいわ

English.Text: Maybe Toby could be your Dillan.

Japanese.Text:
でも　トビーは
あなたにアタックしてたよね

English.Text: The same Toby who was making moves on you?

Japanese.Text:
っていうか
あいつは誰でも手当たり次第か

English.Text: No way. That guy's too big a flirt for my taste.

Japanese.Text: 軽い男なんて最悪

English.Text: Maybe I'm just over men in general.

Japanese.Text: わたしは　あなたのことが好き

English.Text: Then would you consider dating...me?

Japanese.Text: えっ……

English.Text: Huh?

Japanese.Text: あたしたちコンドル観測隊のかわら版

English.Text: Our latest newsletter's looking pretty good!

Japanese.Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』
みんな　読んでくれるかな

English.Text: Clear Skies: A Condor-watcher's Guide... Hope people read it.

Japanese.Text:
うんうん　ここは
コンドルさんのお散歩ルートだから
危ないこともあるって　伝えなきゃね

English.Text: They better. It's a seriously important topic! We have to respect the condor, so it can respect us. We're the ones intruding on its home, after all!

Japanese.Text:
『安全第一　コンドル予報』最新号！
今回はゲストを迎えての観察会だね

English.Text: Latest condor newsletter's up! Still can't believe we had such a good sighting. That was a real stroke of luck for our guests!

Japanese.Text:
うん　コンドル観察の魅力を
伝えたいんだ

English.Text: Oh my gosh, I know! I just wish more people could've been there to see it.

Japanese.Text: もっとメンバーが増えるといいよね

English.Text: Well, maybe this issue'll get us more members.

Japanese.Text:
うんうん　これからもがんばって
かわら版作ろう！

English.Text: And if not this one, the next! I've already got ideas for articles!

Japanese.Text:
仕事に困ったら
掲示板で探すって聞いたけど

English.Text: I heard the best way to get work was through the noticeboard, but...

Japanese.Text: 俺たちにできそうな仕事はねえなあ

English.Text: There isn't a single job here we can handle.

Japanese.Text:
ここに来てから
なまっちまったしな

English.Text: I'm just so outta shape since moving to the Nest...

Japanese.Text: おまえ　昔からなんもしてないだろ

English.Text: Um, when have you ever been in shape?

Japanese.Text:
コンドルの丘には
でっかいコンドルが飛んでくるんだ

English.Text: I'm trying to spot the eponymous bird of Condor Hill.

Japanese.Text:
コンドルは閉ざされた島の
守り神らしいんだが
その島には　近寄る方法がない

English.Text: Apparently, it protects the island─not sure from whom, though, seeing as there's no way for us to get over there.

Japanese.Text:
観測隊の連中も
ここから見守るしかないんだ

English.Text: Only thing we can do is try to catch a glimpse from a distance.

Japanese.Text:
岬の灯台は
共和国時代から使われていた
歴史ある建物なんだ

English.Text: The lighthouse on the cape dates back to the old republic. Man, if those walls could talk...

Japanese.Text:
はい　あそこなら
モンスター監視任務で行きました

English.Text: Speaking of, didn't we send people out there to watch for bandits or something?

Japanese.Text:
最近　妙なヤツが入り込んだみたいで
トビーさんたちが調べてるんだよ

English.Text: Toby's team, yeah. Some yahoo thought it'd be the perfect place to hang their hat.

Japanese.Text: 盗賊に荒らされたりしなきゃいいですね

English.Text: Well, I hope they don't trash the place.

Japanese.Text:
おうよ　遺跡を守るのも
青年団の重要な仕事だ

English.Text: We'll make sure they don't. Preserving republic sites is an important part of the job!

Japanese.Text:
子供たちに　神羅の悪行の歴史を
伝えなきゃならないからな

English.Text: Not about to let Shinra scrub the world and its shameful history clean.

Japanese.Text:
岬の灯台　なんでも屋とかいう
店になってたんだとよ

English.Text: So that rando up in the lighthouse? Was a merc who thought to set up shop.

Japanese.Text:
あんなところに
お店開いたんですか？

English.Text: Seems like a dumb place to do that.

Japanese.Text: はは　儲かりそうにはないよな

English.Text: Haha! Yeah, that's what I said.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　貴重な文化遺産が
無事でなによりだ

English.Text: But they left the place as they found it, so s'all good.

Japanese.Text: 青年団の同志よ　調子はどうだい？

English.Text: Hey there, fellow freedom fighter. How goes it?

Japanese.Text:
ここはサイドジュノンだ
疲れてるなら休んでいくといい

English.Text: Welcome to the Crow's Nest! Feel free to rest up here if you need to.

Japanese.Text:
モンスターが荒れてる
気をつけろよ

English.Text: Keep a sharp eye out for monsters.

Japanese.Text: 青年団の同志よ　無事を祈る

English.Text: Farewell, fellow freedom fighter─and stay safe!

Japanese.Text: はい　歴史の授業を始めますね

English.Text: Okay, everyone. Who's ready to learn some history?

Japanese.Text:
むかしむかし
ジュノンには大きな船をつなげて作った
海の上の街がありました

English.Text: Our republic's capital, Junon, was built on top of giant ships that floated just offshore.

Japanese.Text: ジュノンと神羅は　戦争になりました

English.Text: But many years later, Shinra started a war...

Japanese.Text: 戦争は　神羅が勝ちました

English.Text: A war that Shinra ended up winning.

Japanese.Text:
負けたジュノンは
海に沈んでしまいました

English.Text: And then they sank our beautiful, floating city.

Japanese.Text: 神羅は　海の底に魔晄炉を作りました

English.Text: Shinra then built a giant underwater reactor.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄の影響で
お魚さんは死んでしまいました

English.Text: But the reactor's mako started killing the creatures of the sea!

Japanese.Text:
みんなのお母さん　お父さんは
みんなが大きくなるまえに
神羅と戦わなければならないの

English.Text: The mako hurts creatures on land too. And if we don't act fast, it'll even start hurting us.

Japanese.Text:
みんなが　お魚さんみたいに
ならないように

English.Text: That's why we have to work together to stop Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
ここの生活は楽じゃないと思うけど
がまんしましょう

English.Text: So never forget, children, that the ocean is counting on you.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　みんなで復唱ね

English.Text: And what do we always say?

Japanese.Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

English.Text: No tears until our waters are crystal clear.

Japanese.Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

English.Text: No tears until our waters are crystal clear!

Japanese.Text: はーい！

English.Text: Okay!

Japanese.Text: 泣きません　海が青く戻る日まで

ウータイの連中が
なんかやったんだって？

English.Text: Heard Wutai's makin' moves against Shinra!

Japanese.Text:
いよいよ俺たちの時代が来るな
気合い入るぜ

English.Text: It took a while, but our time's finally come! Let's do this, people!

Japanese.Text:
反神羅グループを結ぶ連絡会
マジであったのか！

English.Text: There're people going around connecting anti-Shinra forces? Since when!?

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会の同志って
ここにもいるのかしら

English.Text: Hey, do you think there are any undercover SRC reps in our area?

Japanese.Text:
暴力反対！
荷物をまとめて逃げ出さなきゃ

English.Text: I'm so outta here. War is not what I signed up for.

Japanese.Text:
戦争じゃなくて
豊かな海を取り戻したいだけなのに

English.Text: I don't want a war. I just want an ocean that doesn't stink of mako.

Japanese.Text: いいか　みんな聞いてくれ！

English.Text: People of the Crow's Nest, listen!

Japanese.Text:
俺たちの故郷　ジュノンの海
本当の色を覚えているか

English.Text: Look at our ocean! Look at it! What do you see!?

Japanese.Text:
昔はな　真夏の青
どこまでも澄んでいたんだ

English.Text: I'll tell you what you see! The green taint of Shinra's poison!

Japanese.Text:
それがいまじゃ
魔晄で汚染され　生態系は乱れ
大切な魚もとれなくなった

English.Text: This poison has ruined our seas! Destroyed their beauty! Left them as barren as Corel's desert!

Japanese.Text: ぜんぶ　神羅が悪いんだ！

English.Text: And is Shinra gonna answer for this crime!?

Japanese.Text:
仕方ないとあきらめるのか
いいや　俺たちはあきらめない！

English.Text: No! Not unless we make them! Not unless we hold them to account!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　俺たちは
もういちど豊かな海を取り戻したいと
立ち上がった

English.Text: We're here for one reason, and one reason only: to rid our waters of everything Shinra!

Japanese.Text:
心血を注ぎ　ビラを配り
街頭で署名を募った

English.Text: So we pound the pavement. Get the word out. Make the people mad as we are!

Japanese.Text:
だが　俺たちの活動を受けても
神羅はなにも変わらない

English.Text: But we know how Shinra operates. Our anger alone won't be enough to drive them out!

Japanese.Text:
それはなぜか
わかるよな　みんな！

English.Text: And while I know that this is painful for us to admit...

Japanese.Text: まだ　俺たちの力が足りないからだ

English.Text: We Crows lack the strength to topple their might!

Japanese.Text:
もっと同志を集めよう
署名も　もっともっと必要だ！

English.Text: So we have to galvanize the people, collect more signatures! Post more flyers!

Japanese.Text:
豊かな海を取り戻したいという
想いがあるのなら
どうか　力を貸してほしい

English.Text: If we want to restore Junon's waters to their brilliant blue, then we cannot rest for even a moment!

Japanese.Text:
共に戦おう
ジュノンの豊かな海を取り戻そう！

English.Text: We can win this fight if we stand tall and stand together! Who's with me!?

Japanese.Text: いいか　みんな聞いてくれ！

English.Text: Hear me─all of you!

Japanese.Text:
俺たちが夢見た　神羅カンパニーとの
戦いの日が近づいている

English.Text: This is the moment we've been dreaming of! Shinra's day of reckoning!

Japanese.Text:
いまこそ
俺たちの想いを振り返るときだ

English.Text: Now is the time to remind ourselves why we fight!

Japanese.Text: おう！

English.Text: Yeah!

Japanese.Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Tell 'em!

Japanese.Text: なんだ～！

English.Text: What's up!?

Japanese.Text: 聞くぜ！

English.Text: We hear ya!

Japanese.Text: おう！

English.Text: Woo!

Japanese.Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Preach!

Japanese.Text: なにさ！

English.Text: Hell yeah!

Japanese.Text: なんだ～！

English.Text: We're listening!

Japanese.Text: そうだそうだ！

English.Text: Damn straight!

Japanese.Text: ああ！

English.Text: Yeah!

Japanese.Text: そのとおり！

English.Text: Exactly!

Japanese.Text: 異議なし！

English.Text: You know it!

Japanese.Text: よし！

English.Text: Alright!

Japanese.Text: そうだそうだ！

English.Text: It's about time!

Japanese.Text: そのとおり！

English.Text: You said it!

Japanese.Text: 異議なし！

English.Text: You know it!

Japanese.Text: うおおお！

English.Text: Yeah!

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉建設の事故以来
行き場がねえんだ

English.Text: Ain't had no honest work since that damn reactor blew.

Japanese.Text: 石炭の時代は　もう来ねえよなあ

English.Text: So much for the glory days... Coal ain't worth squat.

Japanese.Text: おまえも人生詰んでるのか

English.Text: One day at a time, am I right?

Japanese.Text: 村の調和を乱すなよ

English.Text: Don't go causin' trouble now.

Japanese.Text:
どん詰まりの北コレルへ
ようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to nowheresville, North Corel.

Japanese.Text:
バレットのやつ　いまさらよく
のこのこ戻ってきたな

English.Text: I heard tell Barret came waltzin' back into town after all this time.

Japanese.Text: 炭坑の穴に突き落としてやろうか

English.Text: Now's our chance to dump his ass down a mine shaft!

Japanese.Text: いや　魔晄炉のほうがいいだろ

English.Text: I do you one better─dump him in the reactor.

Japanese.Text:
あそこから出てくるモンスターに
フタしねえと

English.Text: Use him as a plug to stop the monsters from pourin' out.

Japanese.Text: 自業自得ってヤツよ

English.Text: That's what they call "poetic justice"!

Japanese.Text:
おう　魔晄炉建設推進派のリーダー
バレット様に塞いでもらうのが筋だな

English.Text: Damn straight. He's the one who pushed for it in the first place. It's the least the sumbitch can do to make amends.

Japanese.Text:
あいつが　魔晄炉を作ろうだなんて
言わなきゃ　オレたちの村は
静かなまま暮らせたんだ

English.Text: Mako is the future, my ass. More like the death of everything good in our lives.

Japanese.Text: おう　ミーナって覚えてるか？

English.Text: Hey. You remember Myrna?

Japanese.Text: バレットの嫁さんだろ

English.Text: Barret's wife, right?

Japanese.Text: ありゃ　いい女だった

English.Text: And a mighty fine woman too.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　あいつには
もったいねえくらいのな

English.Text: Hear, hear. Better than that bastard deserved.

Japanese.Text:
こんな姿になっちまって
またいっしょに働きたいぜ　相棒

English.Text: Look at you─all in pieces. Sure wish we could go to work again, like the good ol' days.

Japanese.Text:
ガタゴトガタコト
お山を行くよ～ってな

English.Text: Chugga chugga choo choo, chugga chugga choo choo, o'er the hills we gooo... Like that.

Japanese.Text:
おまえが出してた音が
なつかしいぜ

English.Text: What I wouldn't give to hear your whistle blow.

Japanese.Text:
ガキは気楽でいいな
俺も戻りてえよ

English.Text: Look at 'em. Not a care in the world. I envy that.

Japanese.Text:
あの頃　列車がひっきりなしに走って
大人はみんな忙しそうに働いて

English.Text: Me, I envy the folks who got to work when the trains ran round the clock and there were more jobs than bodies to fill 'em.

Japanese.Text: 毎日　明日が来るのが楽しみだったよな

English.Text: Used to be the future was full of promise...

Japanese.Text:
ガキの頃
大人は汗と炭まみれで真っ黒で
かっこよかったよな

English.Text: I looked up to the adults comin' home caked in soot and sweat after a hard day's work. Don't see that no more, though.

Japanese.Text:
いまのガキどもは
昼間から飲んでる俺たちを
どう思ってんだろうな

English.Text: Gotta wonder what the youngins think of us. Sittin' around, drinkin' the day away...

Japanese.Text:
なんとも思ってないだろ
こんな大人しか知らねえんだから

English.Text: Doubt they think much anything about it. They've never known nothing else.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の生活保護じゃ　ぜんぜん足りねえ
野垂れ死ねってことかね

English.Text: Shinra 'spects us to live off the scraps they toss our way? May as well tell us to go die in a ditch.

Japanese.Text:
あんたが　働きもせず
酒ばっか飲むからだ

English.Text: That's 'cause you spend your time drinkin' 'stead of lookin' for honest work.

Japanese.Text: 神羅はよくやってくれてるほうだよ

English.Text: Shinra'll take care of you if you pull your weight.

Japanese.Text: 無茶しなきゃ　なんとかなるし

English.Text: Buckle down and your day will come.

Japanese.Text:
だからみんな昼間から
道端でゴロゴロしてんだ

English.Text: Exactly. You don't do your bit, you ain't owed shit.

Japanese.Text:
へたに働けば
なんももらえなくなるからな

English.Text: It's your own damn fault for pissin' away the day bitchin' and moanin'.

Japanese.Text:
てめえ　オレの酒
飲みやがったな！

English.Text: Where do you get off, drinkin' all my booze!?

Japanese.Text:
うっせえ！
細かいことでガタガタぬかすな

English.Text: Aw, shut up. I can drink whatever the hell I want!

Japanese.Text: どうせ　俺が恵んでやった酒だろうが！

English.Text: I'm the one who paid for it in the first place!

Japanese.Text: はあ　お腹すいた

English.Text: I could eat a chocobo...

Japanese.Text: いっくぞ～！

English.Text: Gonna leave you in the dust!

Japanese.Text: 楽勝だぜ

English.Text: This is nothin'!

Japanese.Text: いっくよ～！

English.Text: Here I go!

Japanese.Text: かんたん　かんたん

English.Text: Easy as ABC!

Japanese.Text:
お兄さん
はやく出ていくほうがいいよ

English.Text: I wouldn't recommend stickin' around for long.

Japanese.Text: やった～！

English.Text: Did you see that!?

Japanese.Text: らっくしょ～！

English.Text: How do ya like that?

Japanese.Text: できた～！

English.Text: Hah! I made it!

Japanese.Text: 大成功！

English.Text: I could be a tightrope walker!

Japanese.Text: ふん　遊べる場所はないわよ

English.Text: Ain't nothin' here for you.

Japanese.Text: 騒ぎを起こさないでほしいわ

English.Text: We ain't gonna put up with any mischief.

Japanese.Text: ここじゃ　よそ者は歓迎されないよ

English.Text: People round here don't take kindly to outsiders.

Japanese.Text: ツウコウリョウよこせ～！

English.Text: You gotta pay the toll!

Japanese.Text: １ギルくれ～

English.Text: One gil─pay up!

Japanese.Text: なんか　くれよ～

English.Text: Give us somethin', wouldja?

Japanese.Text: おこづかい　ほしい

English.Text: Got any gil for me? Huh? Huh?

Japanese.Text: いらないもの　もらってあげる

English.Text: I'll take anything you don't want. Anything!

Japanese.Text: おやつ　ちょうだい

English.Text: Got any candy?

Japanese.Text: なんだ旅人か　めずらしいな

English.Text: Well I'll be. Not often we get visitors.

Japanese.Text:
モンスターに襲われたって
助けねえぞ

English.Text: Don't expect us to come runnin' if a monster jumps ya.

Japanese.Text:
北コレルじゃ　自分の身は
自分で守るのがルールだ

English.Text: In Corel, it's every man, woman, and child for themselves.

Japanese.Text:
コレル山は　昔は静かな山だったが
いまじゃモンスターの巣窟だ

English.Text: Used to be this mountain was quiet as a dormouse─harmless as one, too. Fiends didn't bother us none.

Japanese.Text:
ここも　いつ襲われるか
わかったもんじゃない

English.Text: Now they eye us like we're their next meal...

Japanese.Text:
モンスターが襲ってきたら
真っ先に食われて
真っ先に楽になれるな

English.Text: Almost wish they'd get on with it already─put us outta our misery. This kind of livin' takes its toll on you...

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉なんて作らなきゃ
あたしの旦那はまだ生きてたのかもって
いまだに　ふと思っちまうんだ

English.Text: Not a day goes by I don't wonder, "Would my husband still be here if we hadn't let them build that damn reactor?"

Japanese.Text:
楽して儲けようなんて
欲かいた罰かね

English.Text: Suppose we brought it on ourselves. Thinkin' we could have everything easy.

Japanese.Text:
あたしが自警団なんてやってるのも
罪滅ぼしなのかもしれないね

English.Text: Maybe that's why I joined the watch. No more pretendin'─an honest life.

Japanese.Text:
あいつのところに
はやく行ってやるのさ

English.Text: And a short one too. If I'm lucky.

Japanese.Text: バカ言ってないで　命は大事にしなよ

English.Text: Don't you go talkin' that nonsense. Your life's a gift.

Japanese.Text: なんだ　客か

English.Text: Huh. A customer.

Japanese.Text: 見るなら買ってけよ

English.Text: No window-shoppin', y'hear?

Japanese.Text: ふん……

English.Text: Hmph...

Japanese.Text: じゃあな

English.Text: See ya...

Japanese.Text: ひひひ　悪くねえマテリアだ

English.Text: Gotta say, not a bad selection.

Japanese.Text: こいつは高くさばけそうだぜ

English.Text: Bet this one'll fetch a ton of gil.

Japanese.Text:
店長おどして奪い取るだけか
楽勝だな

English.Text: And all's we gotta do is tighten the screws. Like takin' candy from a baby.

Japanese.Text:
強盗にやられて廃業だなんて
ひでえ話だ

English.Text: What kinda dumbass'd rob a place that rarely gets customers?

Japanese.Text: 店主は　元気にしてっかな

English.Text: I hope the owner's doing alright...

Japanese.Text: とうとう廃業しちゃったのね

English.Text: Had to close up shop for good, huh?

Japanese.Text:
強盗に入られたんだって
気の毒ね

English.Text: I heard they got their shit took. Damn shame, that.

Japanese.Text:
遅い　遅すぎる
下見からの報告はまだか

English.Text: Something's wrong. Where the hell is he? Man shoulda been here hours ago.

Japanese.Text:
あせるなって　店は逃げねえよ
計画立ててる時が楽しいんじゃねえか

English.Text: Easy now. Ain't like the shop's gonna up and walk away. This just gives us more time to plan.

Japanese.Text:
ふん　マテリアの横流しのほうは
問題ないんだろうな

English.Text: And you sure you got a buyer who can pay good gil for this materia?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　心配ない
ルートは確保した

English.Text: Yeah, no worries there. I know a guy.

Japanese.Text: あとはブツさえ手に入りゃあ……

English.Text: All we gotta do is take what ain't ours.

Japanese.Text:
なんだ　これは水だぜ
ホンモノは買えねえからな

English.Text: Whatchu lookin' at? It's water, case you're wonderin'. Can't afford to buy the real stuff.

Japanese.Text:
頼まれても　やらねえぞ
買ってくれるなら考えるけどな

English.Text: Ain't givin' you none, if that's why you're starin'. Then again...everything's got its price.

Japanese.Text: おまえのせいで仕事がねえんだ

English.Text: It's your fault we ain't got no work!

Japanese.Text: さっさと出てけ！

English.Text: Get the hell outta here!

Japanese.Text: 謝罪だけじゃ許されねえぞ

English.Text: Apologies ain't gonna cut it!

Japanese.Text: お願い　家族を返してよ！

English.Text: Give me back my family, you monster!

Japanese.Text: なにもかも奪われたのよ

English.Text: You stole everything from us!

Japanese.Text:
どんな思いで
生きてきたと思ってるの！

English.Text: Do you have any idea what we've been through!?

Japanese.Text: 文句ばっかじゃ腹が減るだけだ

English.Text: Whatever... Whinin' never got nobody nowhere.

Japanese.Text: バレットに絡んでも仕方ねえ

English.Text: No point pickin' a fight now.

Japanese.Text: 俺らにできることって　なんだろうな

English.Text: There's gotta be somethin' we can do to move forward.

Japanese.Text:
私たち　神羅に
利用されただけなのかもね

English.Text: We were only ever tools to Shinra─to be used and thrown away.

Japanese.Text: ここも　昔は良かったのよ

English.Text: I just...miss what we used to have.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉がある暮らしに
夢を見ていたんだよね……

English.Text: We weren't askin' for much─just a little more...

Japanese.Text:
ひいいっ　すまねえ
次はうまくやるから殴らないでくれ！

English.Text: Sorry! I'm sorry! I promise I'll do it right next time! Just don't hit me!

Japanese.Text:
落ち着け　ボスはもういねえよ
誰もおまえをボコボコにはしねえ

English.Text: Hey, deep breaths. The boss ain't here. No one's gonna hurt you, promise.

Japanese.Text: 急に昔のことを思い出すんだ

English.Text: I was...I was there.

Japanese.Text:
冷や汗が止まらねえ
頭が真っ白になっちまう

English.Text: God, it just...felt so...real.

Japanese.Text:
コレルプリズンは生き地獄だったんだ
無理もねえよ

English.Text: I understand. Believe me, I do. We'll get through it together.

Japanese.Text:
ひと山当てたら　こんな陰気な村
さっさとおさらばしてやるんだ

English.Text: The second I strike it rich, I'm puttin' this godforsaken hellhole behind me.

Japanese.Text:
おうよ　こんなところに居続けたら
骨の髄まで不幸がしみついちまう

English.Text: Yeah, no shit. This dump ain't even fit for wererats, let alone people. Can't wait to leave.

Japanese.Text: さっさとしてくれよ

English.Text: Hurry it up, wouldja?

Japanese.Text: 面倒だねえ

English.Text: You better buy something.

Japanese.Text: まいど

English.Text: Thanks.

Japanese.Text: 満足かい？

English.Text: You good now?

Japanese.Text:
こんなの読むより
働いたほうがいいな

English.Text: If we ain't got work, may as well read, I suppose.

Japanese.Text: 分厚いのなら　腕を鍛えられそうだ

English.Text: Bet the extra thick ones would make for good training weights.

Japanese.Text: ちんぷんかんぷん……

English.Text: It's all gibberish to me.

Japanese.Text: わあ～　きれいな表紙

English.Text: Wow... What a gorgeous cover.

Japanese.Text:
腹が減ったら　むかし食った
うまいもんを思い出せば
腹いっぱいになれるぞ

English.Text: When you're hungry, remember something great you ate. Then you can eat the memory!

Japanese.Text:
退屈したら　炭坑時代を思い出せば
仕事したつもりになれるぞ

English.Text: And when you're bored, remember the good ol' days. The coal and the gil and the glory!

Japanese.Text:
ハッハッハ　俺はしあわせ！
いまがいちばん自由で豊かだぞ？

English.Text: Ahaha! They can't take your past from ya! And when you live in the past, you don't need no future!

Japanese.Text: 買い物なんて　いいご身分で

English.Text: Look at moneybags here goin' shoppin'.

Japanese.Text: 金あるなら恵んでくれよ

English.Text: Spread that wealth around, why don't ya?

Japanese.Text: 見るからには　買うんだろうな

English.Text: I trust you ain't just window-shoppin'.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: Welcome.

Japanese.Text: どうも

English.Text: Bye.

Japanese.Text: ありがとよ

English.Text: Thank you.

Japanese.Text: かっこいいねえ　買えないけど

English.Text: That's some mighty fine stuff. Not that I can afford it...

Japanese.Text: 物騒だから欲しいんだけどねえ

English.Text: Wouldn't need 'em if it weren't for the state of the world.

Japanese.Text: 眺めるたびに　みじめになるわ

English.Text: Somehow just lookin' only makes me feel worse.

Japanese.Text:
う～ん
高い　高すぎる

English.Text: Nah. Way too expensive.

Japanese.Text:
あの鳥　炭坑で
空気チェックのために育ててた
ピヨ子だよな？

English.Text: Hey, isn't that one of the birds we raised to check for damps? Lil' Chirpie?

Japanese.Text: 子連れなんて　大きくなったもんだ

English.Text: Ain't little no more. Got a chick of her own now even.

Japanese.Text:
いっしょに炭坑に入ってたときは
ちっこかったのにな

English.Text: She used to be no bigger 'n' a chunk of coal back when she was in the tunnels with us.

Japanese.Text:
ちっこいピヨ子が
いちばん優秀だったよな

English.Text: Couldn't've asked for a better partner than lil' Chirpie.

Japanese.Text: 何度も助けられたよ

English.Text: We'd be long dead without 'er.

Japanese.Text:
ビビりだから
ちょっと空気が薄くなると
すぐ大騒ぎしてくれるんだよな

English.Text: She was a jumpy little thing, wasn't she? Raised holy hell at the first whiff of gas.

Japanese.Text:
おかげで　俺たちはまだ生きてる
ピヨ子さまさまだ

English.Text: That she did. And a lotta good folks are better off for it.

Japanese.Text: ピヨ子の子供がいなくなったってよ

English.Text: Lil' Chirpie's chick's gone missing.

Japanese.Text:
ピヨ子も砂漠を
探しまわってるんだろうな

English.Text: She's prob'ly lookin' all over the desert for him.

Japanese.Text:
あいつは　俺たちの守り神だ
無事だといいがな

English.Text: Hope they're alright. Always feel safer when they're around...

Japanese.Text: ピヨ子も子供も　無事だったってよ

English.Text: Lil' Chirpie brought her chick back home.

Japanese.Text: ああ　よかった

English.Text: Well, that's a relief.

Japanese.Text:
ビビりで　うまくモンスターから
隠れてたんだろう

English.Text: That sixth sense of hers prob'ly kept 'em safe.

Japanese.Text:
村のガキどものアイドルだからな
探してくれたやつに感謝だ

English.Text: Oughta thank whoever found 'em. Kids would've been crushed if those birds were never seen again.

Japanese.Text: うわ～　鳥さん親子？

English.Text: Is that the mommy? And is that the baby!?

Japanese.Text: かわいいね～

English.Text: They're so cute!

Japanese.Text: 名前　なんだろ？

English.Text: Did you guys give it a name yet?

Japanese.Text: でっかい鳥は　お母さん？

English.Text: Is the super-big one really his mom?

Japanese.Text: あの子　飼えるかな

English.Text: Think my mom would let me keep him?

Japanese.Text: ピヨピヨ～！

English.Text: Chirp chirp chirp!

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉事故のせいで
うちの人も亡くなったの

English.Text: Been four years, and not a day goes by I don't think of my husband.

Japanese.Text: 旦那の形見のこの銃は　私のお守り

English.Text: His old gun's the only thing I've got left to remember him by.

Japanese.Text:
きっといまでも
私のそばに居てくれるの

English.Text: Makes me feel safe─like he's still here with me.

Japanese.Text:
まいったな　車輪がイカれちまった
配給の食材を届けなきゃなんねえのに

English.Text: It's no use. Wheel's busted. How're we supposed to move all these rations now?

Japanese.Text:
サカキの爺さんがいりゃ
修理を頼めるのにな

English.Text: If old man Sakaki was here, he'd have her up and rollin' in a flash.

Japanese.Text: まあ　頼むにはひと苦労だが

English.Text: Not that you'd ever wanna rely on him...

Japanese.Text:
サカキの爺さん
どんな道具も作っちまうし
大抵のもんは直せるから
ありがたいんだけどな

English.Text: Yeah, I hear ya. Could make any kinda tool you'd want─fix up just about anything─but, man, was he a pain to work with.

Japanese.Text:
なにもしてねえのに怒鳴るから
ビビるよな

English.Text: Ain't that the truth. Always yellin' his head off about this or that.

Japanese.Text: 留守だとホッとするけど　困るな

English.Text: Lot quieter without him, but─puts us up a creek.

Japanese.Text: 旅からは　いつ帰ってくるんだろう

English.Text: Wonder when he'll come back from his "journey."

Japanese.Text: あの時　ダインに賛成してればな

English.Text: Hahhh... If only we'd listened to Dyne back then.

Japanese.Text:
ぜんぶ　バレットのせいさ
あいつが強引に押し切りやがったから

English.Text: It's Barret's fault. He wore everyone down till they had no choice but to follow his lead.

Japanese.Text:
ダインのやつ
いまはアンダーソーサーにいるらしい

English.Text: I hear Dyne's been hangin' around the Dustbowl these days.

Japanese.Text:
へえ　あいつも
ワルに転じちまったのか

English.Text: Oh yeah? So he's fallen in with that crowd too, has he...

Japanese.Text: まあ　元気にやってりゃそれでいいさ

English.Text: Well. To each their own I guess.

Japanese.Text:
生きてりゃ
いいことあるかもしれないしな

English.Text: I wouldn't give up on the man just yet.

Japanese.Text:
この村には　神羅が最低限の生活物資を
届けてくれるんだよ

English.Text: Shinra throws us a bone every so often, y'know. Sends us supplies.

Japanese.Text: むかし　魔晄炉建設事故があってね

English.Text: There was an accident at the reactor long ago, see.

Japanese.Text: その事故の補償のつもりかもしれないが

English.Text: So it's their way of compensatin' us.

Japanese.Text:
シロン先生が神羅に掛けあってくれて
どうにか補償を勝ち取ってくれたんだよ

English.Text: 'Cept Doc Sheiran had to raise hell to get us even that much. Dunno where we'd be without him.

Japanese.Text:
シロン先生が食事の配給とかしてるのは
病人を減らして
楽したいからだって言ってたわ

English.Text: Doctor Sheiran's been distributing meals to the people in town. Says it's because he wants to keep them healthy and out of his clinic.

Japanese.Text:
ここだけの話　配給のごはんに
お薬を入れてるの

English.Text: Just between us, though, he's actually been mixing supplements into the meals.

Japanese.Text: お薬のおかげで　みんな健康なのよ

English.Text: And it's working. Folks are looking healthier than ever!

Japanese.Text:
炭坑時代から
この診療所とシロン先生だけは変わらず
ここにありつづけてるんだ

English.Text: If there's one thing you can count on, it's Doctor Sheiran. He's been here since the old mining days.

Japanese.Text:
コレル村の事件のとき　先生は
ここで仕事をしていて難を逃れたけど
村にいたご家族は亡くなられて

English.Text: The doc was here when everything went down in Corel. Unfortunately, his family wasn't. Terrible shame.

Japanese.Text:
先生が村のために色々してくれるのは
家族を守れなかったことへの
罪滅ぼしなのかもな

English.Text: Them and all the others are probably why he works so hard. His way of making up for all the lives he couldn't save that day.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉建設中に　ケガしてね

English.Text: Got myself injured while working on the reactor back in the day.

Japanese.Text:
ここに運びこまれたときには
おったまげたよ

English.Text: Found myself here when I woke up. Wasn't none too happy about that.

Japanese.Text:
もとは炭坑の診療所だったらしいけど
古めかしい設備しかなくて
不安になったもんだ

English.Text: This used to be a coal miners' clinic, see, and all the equipment was ancient as hell. Didn't trust it one bit. Reckoned I was done for.

Japanese.Text: まあ　医療は機械がするもんじゃない

English.Text: But it's doctors who do the operatin', not their equipment.

Japanese.Text:
わしが元気なのは
先生の腕がいいんだろうな

English.Text: And little did I know, I was in some of the best hands in the world.

Japanese.Text:
先生に診てもらえば
たいていの病気は　すぐに治るのよ

English.Text: The doctor here always knows just how to treat my aches and pains. He's such a dear.

Japanese.Text:
おかげで　あたしゃ
こんなにピンピンよ

English.Text: Why, I'm as spry as a spring chocobo thanks to him.

Japanese.Text: 家にいたら　退屈で死んじまいそうでね

English.Text: If I stayed cooped up at home all the time, I'd die of boredom.

Japanese.Text:
ここにくりゃ知り合いと会えるし
ありがたいよ

English.Text: But here I can see all my friends and acquaintances. It does an old lady good to get out and chew the fat.

Japanese.Text:
まずい酒が
もっとまずくなっちまった

English.Text: Thanks, ya managed to make this taste worse.

Japanese.Text:
謝罪の歌でも歌えよ
鉱山でよく歌ってたろ

English.Text: What─you gonna do some song an' dance 'bout how sorry you are?

Japanese.Text:
おいおい
また魔晄炉でも建てるのか？

English.Text: Come to build us another reactor? First one was plenty!

Japanese.Text:
あらあら
バレット様のお帰りだね

English.Text: Look who decided to come back home!

Japanese.Text:
村を捨てて
あんたは気楽なもんねえ

English.Text: What "glorious dream" ya come peddlin' now?

Japanese.Text: あたしの家族を返して！

English.Text: You took everything from me!

Japanese.Text:
たくさん噛んでね
お腹いっぱいになるから

English.Text: Keep chewin', okay? It'll make you feel full.

Japanese.Text:
あっ　ディオの
ヒゲキーホルダーの金具付けも
はじめることにしたんだ

English.Text: Oh, we got these keychains shaped like Dio's mustache now too. They're sure to sell.

Japanese.Text:
うん　それも手伝う
不良品があったらもらいたいな

English.Text: I'll help with those too! Maybe if there's a broken one I can keep it?

Japanese.Text: シロン先生の配給で～す！

English.Text: Get your free rations!

Japanese.Text:
たっぷりあるので　慌てず
順序よく並んでください

English.Text: Doc Sheiran made sure there's plenty to go around, so don't worry.

Japanese.Text: しっかり食べて　元気出しましょう

English.Text: Please line up in an orderly fashion!

Japanese.Text:
星の民よ　いまこそ
星とつながり　星の叫びを聞け

English.Text: Children of the planet, hearken to our mother. Open your heart and heed her mournful cries!

Japanese.Text:
儲け話　みなさんに
特別に教えちゃいます！

English.Text: Looking to make some quick gil? Then I have got some news for you, friends!

Japanese.Text: マテリア投資なら必ず儲かります

English.Text: All you need to do is invest in materia!

Japanese.Text:
まず　確実に高騰する新作マテリアを
安く大量に買い付け
マテリアの値があがったら
一気に売りさばく

English.Text: First, you buy up new orbs on the cheap: ones that are sure to prove valuable. Then, once their price skyrockets, you sell 'em for a huge profit!

Japanese.Text:
投資額をドーンとあげれば
儲けもドーンとあがります～！

English.Text: Once you've made a tidy sum, you can invest in even more and start raking in the gil!

Japanese.Text:
どうです　簡単でしょう？
いますぐ借金してでも始めるべきです

English.Text: Easy as pie, right? Anyone can do it! And if you need a little something to get started, I can help you out with a small loan.

Japanese.Text:
すぐにもうかるから
返済も　すぐに終わります

English.Text: You'll be able to pay it back in no time flat!

Japanese.Text:
コレルは　かつて多くの星の民が
星に帰られた地

English.Text: For she suffers as you do. She too weeps for what she has lost.

Japanese.Text: お金なら　いつでもご用意しますよ

English.Text: Just say the word and I'll be more than happy to get you good folks set up.

Japanese.Text: いいねえ！

English.Text: Count me in!

Japanese.Text:
残された者は　悲しみ　迷い
憎しみに囚われている

English.Text: She knows your pain, your sadness, your grief. She knows your anger.

Japanese.Text: だまされるな　オレ

English.Text: Don't fall for it.

Japanese.Text: 返せなかったら　逃げりゃいいか

English.Text: Could always book it if I can't pay.

Japanese.Text: マテリアなら安心だよな！

English.Text: Materia's sure to skyrocket.

Japanese.Text: 『ドーン』か～！

English.Text: Time to rake it in!

Japanese.Text: ふ～ん　すぐに返せるんだ

English.Text: Wow. Sounds like a cinch to pay off.

Japanese.Text: 借りちゃおっかな～？

English.Text: Maybe I should get in on this.

Japanese.Text: うんうん　儲かりそうね！

English.Text: Cushy life, here I come!

Japanese.Text: 子供の将来のために……

English.Text: This money'll give my kids a chance...

Japanese.Text: 投資って　なにするの？

English.Text: So how do we...invest?

Japanese.Text: いまこそ　星を救うために行動せよ

English.Text: So join in her lament! Share in her rage!

Japanese.Text:
身のうちにある星を見いだし
ともに響け

English.Text: Come! Raise your voice and join in our righteous chorus!

Japanese.Text:
炭坑でも　給食があったな
体が資本だからって豪勢だったよ

English.Text: The lunches we got as miners were much better. Those were meals that put meat on your bones.

Japanese.Text:
うまいメシだが　石炭まみれで
メシも真っ黒だったけどな

English.Text: Though I will say this much: I sure don't miss eatin' food seasoned with soot.

Japanese.Text: 毎日　このごはん

English.Text: Same shit, different day.

Japanese.Text:
おいしいのか　まずいのかも
もうわからないのよ

English.Text: Can't even tell anymore if it's good or bad. It's just food.

Japanese.Text:
ううん……
おいしいって思いながら食べなきゃ
シロン先生に悪いわ

English.Text: No, no─shouldn't think like that. I should be thankful for all Doc Sheiran's done for us.
Ten, twenty, thirty...

Japanese.Text:
ぜんぜん腹いっぱいにならない
オレの胃袋　穴でもあいてるのか

English.Text: I don't understand. How am I still hungry? Is there a hole in my stomach or something?

Japanese.Text:
そう　星を救うことは
わが身を救うことにほかならぬ

English.Text: For our mother's sake, and for ours. For what we do for the planet, we do for ourselves.

Japanese.Text: 休むなら　好きにしろ

English.Text: Take whatever beds're open.

Japanese.Text: いいな　物を盗むなよ？

English.Text: No stealin' or you're out. Got that?

Japanese.Text: さっさと出てけ

English.Text: It's time you moved on.

Japanese.Text: ふん　ダニがおみやげだ

English.Text: Keep the bedbugs. They're on the house.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉建設のときに村にきた
神羅のスカーレットさんが
忘れられないんだ

English.Text: Back when the reactor was being built, there was this Shinra exec: Scarlet. I'll never forget her.

Japanese.Text:
真っ赤なドレスがすてきで
冷たく笑うのよ

English.Text: She wore these stunning red dresses, and the way she laughed...

Japanese.Text:
それに　とっても
いいにおいがするんだよね

English.Text: Can still smell her perfume. Wish I knew what it was.

Japanese.Text:
あの人の言うことなら
なんでも聞いちゃうかも

English.Text: I'd follow that princess to the ends of the world if she let me.

Japanese.Text:
ぺっぺっ　ぺっ！
砂まじりの酒はここの名物だな

English.Text: Pff... Pff... Puh! Gotta love that dusting of sand on every drink.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠がどんどん広がってる気がするけど
いつか世界が砂で覆われちまうのかもな

English.Text: Feels like this goddamn desert grows bigger every day. Maybe it'll swallow the whole world.

Japanese.Text:
いつまで　この暮らしに
耐えるつもりですか？

English.Text: No one should ever have to live like this.

Japanese.Text:
せっかくの才能を
埋もれたままにするのは罪です

English.Text: It hurts my soul to see your talents go to waste.

Japanese.Text:
楽して稼げる
いい仕事を紹介しますよ
あなたなら　必ず成功できます

English.Text: Fortunately, we got a job that's right up your alley. Man of your ability'd be rollin' in gil before he knows it.

Japanese.Text:
俺の才能を見抜くとは
あんたたち　見る目あるな！

English.Text: Haha! Well, it's clear you've both got eyes for skill.

Japanese.Text: ぜひ　仕事を紹介してくれ

English.Text: Think I'll take you up on that offer.

Japanese.Text: 仲間を　できるだけ集めてきてください

English.Text: Go and gather as many people as you can.

Japanese.Text:
みなさんには　新商品を
試食していただきたいのです

English.Text: People with real discerning palates to taste-test food.

Japanese.Text: 謝礼は弾みます

English.Text: Make it worth your while.

Japanese.Text:
連れてきた人数に応じて
ボーナスをつけましょう

English.Text: You get a bonus dependin' on how many folks you bring in.

Japanese.Text:
しかも　試食は食べ放題
お酒も飲み放題ですよ

English.Text: Whole thing's buffet style─unlimited food, drink. The works.

Japanese.Text:
おお　金持ちのやることは
スケールが違うな

English.Text: We get all that? For free? Rich people're somethin' else.

Japanese.Text:
友達も家族も親戚も
みーんな連れてくよ！

English.Text: You got a deal! I'll tell my friends, family─everybody!

Japanese.Text:
ヘヘヘ　いいカモがひっかかった
今月のノルマ達成　ちょろいな

English.Text: Hahaha... Talk about easy marks. Guess I won't have to worry about meeting this month's quota.

Japanese.Text:
困ってるヤツばっかだから
楽して稼げるって言えばすぐ釣れる

English.Text: Right? They're so desperate for gil that they'll believe any bullshit ya feed 'em.

Japanese.Text:
もっと営業かけて　カモを集めよう
今月のＭＶＰをとってやる

English.Text: Keep 'em comin'. If we can haul in more suckers, we got a good chance at comin' out on top this month.

Japanese.Text: おう　のしあがろうぜ！

English.Text: Yeah, we got this in the bag.

Japanese.Text: もうプリズンで踏みつけられたくねえ

English.Text: No one'll be able to treat us like dirt now.

Japanese.Text: 砂漠に出たって　いいことないぜ？

English.Text: Wouldn't recommend going out there, 'less you got a death wish.

Japanese.Text: 暑さにやられて幻覚見るなよ？

English.Text: We ain't gonna save you if you get heatstroke.

Japanese.Text:
あるかわからないお宝を探しに
砂漠をさまようなんて　絶対ゴメンだ

English.Text: Hell no. I ain't dyin' in the desert lookin' for treasure that might not exist.

Japanese.Text:
ここでくすぶってたら
死んだも同然じゃねえか

English.Text: Way I see it, wastin' away here ain't no better.

Japanese.Text:
いっそ死んだつもりで
探しに行こうぜ

English.Text: Least this way we got a shot at a better life!

Japanese.Text:
お宝って　しゃべるゴブリンだの
動きまわるサボデンダーが
守ってるってやつだろ？

English.Text: The treasure. The one that's guarded by a talkin' goblin, dancin' cactuars, and other weird shit.

Japanese.Text:
そんなの
暑さにやられて見た幻覚だよ

English.Text: Dumbass made that up definitely had heatstroke.

Japanese.Text:
でも『サボテン大王』ってマンガにも
書かれてるって

English.Text: But there's a whole series about the Cactuar King!

Japanese.Text: なあ　これは真実だよな！

English.Text: And comic books, they ain't never lie!

Japanese.Text:
炭坑閉鎖のうわさを聞いて
廃棄物あさりに駆けつけたのが運のツキ

English.Text: Heard through the grapevine the mine was shuttin' down, so I spent every last gil I had to get here quick.

Japanese.Text:
全財産をはたいてきたのになにもなくて
結局　ここに閉じこめられちまった

English.Text: Figured I could make a killing scavenging parts...only to find a big, fat load of nothing...

Japanese.Text:
ああ　なつかしの故郷に帰りたい
でも先立つものがない

English.Text: So now I'm stuck here. Flat broke. Don't even have anything worth hawking to pay my way back home...

Japanese.Text:
ボブは　ゴールドソーサーの
役者で大当たり

English.Text: Bob made it big as a performer in the Gold Saucer...

Japanese.Text:
ブッチは　コスタで始めた
アイス屋が大当たり

English.Text: And Bruce has his ice cream shop in Costa del Sol...

Japanese.Text:
ああ　いつかはオレだって
大当たりするさ

English.Text: I'll make it out too one of these days. I will.

Japanese.Text: ガツーン　大当たり～！

English.Text: Going...going...gone!

Japanese.Text: うわ～　はずした！

English.Text: Swing and a miss!

Japanese.Text:
見晴らしがいいところで食えば
カスカスのメシも　すこしはマシになる

English.Text: Take it from me, even the foulest food'll taste halfway decent if you eat it somewhere nice.

Japanese.Text:
ハハハ　これが
生活の知恵ってやつよ

English.Text: Hahaha... That's a little pearl o' wisdom I picked up.

Japanese.Text: 最近　行方不明になるヤツらが多いな

English.Text: Been a lotta people up and vanishin' lately.

Japanese.Text:
消えるのは
羽振りが良くなったヤツばかりって話だ

English.Text: And they always seem to poof right when things're lookin' up for 'em.

Japanese.Text:
マジかよ　オレの親友も
なにも言わずにいなくなっちまったんだ

English.Text: That so? Y'know, I haven't seen or heard from this one friend in a while now...

Japanese.Text:
あやしい商売に
手を出したんじゃないよな？

English.Text: Could be they got caught up in some shady business.

Japanese.Text: 世の中　うまい話なんてないぜ

English.Text: If it sounds too good to be true, it is.

Japanese.Text:
この村じゃあ　いいヤツはたいてい
悪いヤツだ　覚えとけ

English.Text: Shouldn't be too quick to trust friendly types, 'specially if they're "here to help."

Japanese.Text: お……おう

English.Text: Guess so.

Japanese.Text: 急いで　今日中にあと３００個！

English.Text: Pick up the pace. We need three hundred more.

Japanese.Text:
ディオクッキーの
袋詰めしなきゃならないのよ

English.Text: And we have to pack up these Dio Cookies.

Japanese.Text:
うん　ディオシール貼り
手伝うね

English.Text: Okay. I'll help put on the Dio stickers.

Japanese.Text: やってやらあ！

English.Text: C'mon, bring it!

Japanese.Text: やんのか　コラ！

English.Text: You gonna hit me or what!?

Japanese.Text: まだまだ　もう１戦だ！

English.Text: I ain't done yet! I want a rematch!

Japanese.Text: 次は負けねえぞ！

English.Text: You're goin' down next time!

Japanese.Text: ひいい　もう許してくれ

English.Text: Aah! Please, no more...

Japanese.Text: だまして……すんません

English.Text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry!

Japanese.Text: こらしめてやるよ！

English.Text: You're in for it now!

Japanese.Text: 俺たちをナメやがって！

English.Text: Hah, look down on us, will ya!?

Japanese.Text: ヒュ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Japanese.Text: オラオラ　いけよ！

English.Text: Hell yeah! That's what I like to see!

Japanese.Text: ビビんなよ～！

English.Text: What are ya, chicken!?

Japanese.Text: もっとやれ！

English.Text: Keep 'em comin'!

Japanese.Text: ほら　そこだ！

English.Text: Right there─get 'em!

Japanese.Text: キャ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Japanese.Text: いけいけ～！

English.Text: Come on, hit 'em! Hit 'em!

Japanese.Text: ぶっとばせ！

English.Text: Make 'em feel it!

Japanese.Text: キレがないよ！

English.Text: Give 'em hell!

Japanese.Text: ああ～……

English.Text: Ugh...

Japanese.Text: おお～！

English.Text: Woohoo!

Japanese.Text: ヒュ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Japanese.Text:
はあ　ぜんぜん酔えねえよ
マスター　この酒ほとんど水だろ

English.Text: Hey...barkeep. You sure this shit's booze? 'Cause it tastes more like chocobo piss to me.

Japanese.Text:
文句があるなら出てけよ
それで　二度と店には来るな

English.Text: Don't like what I serve? Leave. And be sure to let the door hit your ass on your way out.

Japanese.Text:
なあ　キッツイのくれよ
火をつけたら燃えあがるようなヤツをよ

English.Text: Listen, man. I'm just asking for somethin' harder, y'know? Somethin' that'll knock my socks off!

Japanese.Text:
明日からの行き先をなくしたくなけりゃ
出された酒を　おとなしく飲んでな

English.Text: I suggest you drink your drink─or you find yourself another bar to patronize. Got me?

Japanese.Text:
ああ？　見ねえ顔だな
ここじゃ　よそ者は歓迎されねえぞ

English.Text: Huh... Ain't seen you before. Just so you know, outsiders ain't welcome here.

Japanese.Text:
酒場の殴りあいは
炭坑時代からの恒例行事だ

English.Text: Barroom brawls've been a time-honored tradition since the minin' days.

Japanese.Text: はは　よそ者は挑戦もできねえよ

English.Text: Haha... Not that outsiders can participate.

Japanese.Text: マテリア投資の取り立ては順調か？

English.Text: So, how's the investment squeeze comin'?

Japanese.Text: 楽勝っす

English.Text: Just like you said it would!

Japanese.Text:
全員とっつかまえて
トラックに詰めこみました

English.Text: We already got 'em all rounded up in the truck. They ain't goin' nowhere.

Japanese.Text:
いつでもかっさばいて
売り飛ばせます

English.Text: Got room to spare, but we can roll out whenever.

Japanese.Text:
いいぞ　さらえるだけさらったら
ドロンだ

English.Text: Well, if that's the case, then I say we squeeze in a few more.

Japanese.Text: ヒヒヒ　楽勝っす！

English.Text: Heh heh heh... You got it, Boss.

Japanese.Text: ああ　やり直してえなあ

English.Text: Wish I could go back and do it all over again.

Japanese.Text: どっかに別の世界ないかなあ

English.Text: Try settin' off for a parallel world, maybe...

Japanese.Text: ほら　おとなしくしな

English.Text: No funny business!

Japanese.Text: たっぷり　お仕置きしてやるからな！

English.Text: Y'all ain't gonna like what comes next!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　あんた
バレットの連れの人だよね

English.Text: Oh, y'all the folks who came into town with Barret.

Japanese.Text: 色々と　すまなかったね

English.Text: Sorry about all...you know.

Japanese.Text:
バレットが　文句言われても受け止めて
村の子供たちのために頑張ってる姿を見て

English.Text: I know it can't've been easy seein' the way we talked to him, And still you went and helped the youngins...

Japanese.Text: 俺たち　恥ずかしくなってさ

English.Text: Made us realize how foolish we'd been acting.

Japanese.Text:
いつまでも　過去にとらわれてるばかりじゃ
なにも変わらない

English.Text:
Thing about the past is, it's gone.
And it ain't comin' back.

Japanese.Text:
この村を　すこしずつでも
変えなきゃって思ったんだ

English.Text: And what really matters now is Corel's future.

Japanese.Text:
んで　あたしたちにもできること
考えたんだよ

English.Text: So, we asked ourselves what we might could do to work toward a better one.

Japanese.Text:
コレルプリズンから来てるグリードたち
あんたも気づいたろ？

English.Text: I'm sure you noticed that some boys from the prison set up shop in town.

Japanese.Text: 俺たちも　見て見ぬフリしてたんだけどな

English.Text: We turned a blind eye to 'em at first, but...

Japanese.Text:
あたしたちを食いものにしてるコイツらを
まずこらしめてやろうってね　決めたわけよ

English.Text: No longer. It's high time they learned what happens when folks try to take advantage of us.

Japanese.Text:
店の中で　きっちりお仕置きしてるから
見てってくれよ

English.Text: You're welcome to watch their "education" in the bar if you want.

Japanese.Text:
詐欺グループのグリードたちを
捕まえたんだ

English.Text: We caught those hustlers out of Corel Prison.

Japanese.Text: いまは順番にお仕置き中だよ

English.Text: Folks're linin' up to say hello.

Japanese.Text: グリードの連中にも　同郷のヤツがいる

English.Text: Some of them came up around here, believe it or not.

Japanese.Text:
いつか仲良く　昔のコレル村みたいに
暮らせるといいな

English.Text: Maybe one day they'll get their shit together and do right by their kin.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　すぐには変わらないだろうけどよ
すこしずつやっていくさ

English.Text: Change doesn't happen overnight. Just gotta keep chippin' away at it. Bit by bit.

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーの裏方で働ける連中は
ここじゃ超一流の仕事人だよ

English.Text: The lucky people who get to work behind the scenes at the Gold Saucer─now those ones are the top earners.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　給料は
しぼりとられてるらしいけどね

English.Text: Though they're still squeezed out of damn near every last gil, I hear.

Japanese.Text:
おれ　ゴールドソーサーの
着ぐるみなんだけど……

English.Text: Wearing that costume all day gets kinda old.

Japanese.Text: うわ　これ秘密だった！

English.Text: Oh! I mean, uh...

Japanese.Text: 聞かなかったことにしてくれクポ！

English.Text: I don't work at the Gold Saucer, kupo!

Japanese.Text: 終わった　またしても遅刻

English.Text: Shit... Late again. I'm in for it now.

Japanese.Text: またリーダーに嫌味言われる

English.Text: My boss is gonna rake me over the coals.

Japanese.Text:
減給かな
まさか　クビはないよな？

English.Text: Wait, he wouldn't fire me, would he? A pay cut, sure, but...

Japanese.Text:
はあ　やっぱり
サボっちゃおうかな～

English.Text: Maybe I oughta skip work today.

Japanese.Text:
踊りながら掃除するの
キツいのよね

English.Text: Having to dance while I clean is brutal.

Japanese.Text: プロペラよ～し　ロープよ～し！

English.Text: Propeller good, ropes good! All clear!

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサー行きロープウェイ
これに乗れば　いつでも黄金の楽園行き

English.Text: Step right up! This ropeway is your one-way ticket to a golden paradise!

Japanese.Text:
たまに頭のネジがはずれる
オレの整備だ　絶対安全だぜ！

English.Text: Safe and reliable! My head's got more loose screws than this thing!

Japanese.Text:
今日で何連勤？
体調も悪いし　休んじゃえば？

English.Text: How long's it been since you had a day off? You need to rest. You're practically falling apart!

Japanese.Text:
僕のショーを楽しみにくる
お客様のために　がんばらなきゃ！

English.Text: But what about all the people who look forward to my show? I can't let them down.

Japanese.Text:
お客さんは休みで遊びに来てるのに
ゴールドソーサーで働く人は休めない

English.Text: I get that, but we work our asses off for weeks on end, entertaining people who can actually afford to take a vacation...

Japanese.Text:
そんなんで
おもてなしできるのかな？

English.Text: and we're left with what? A crummy paycheck and aching feet?

Japanese.Text:
いいんだよ　夢の仕事なんだ
休みナシでも失いたくない

English.Text: But this is my dream job. I'd never forgive myself if I lost it just 'cause I wanted a break.

Japanese.Text:
パパ　帰ってこなかったね
また『ざんぎょう』？

English.Text: Daddy's not back yet. Is he, um, doing overtime again?

Japanese.Text: きっとそうね

English.Text: I'm sure he is.

Japanese.Text:
パパが着てるモーグリは
人気者だから　忙しいのね

English.Text: You know how much everyone up there loves Daddy's moogle costume!

Japanese.Text: うん　きっとそう

English.Text: He'll be back any minute.

Japanese.Text: うんうん　今日も順調だな

English.Text: Glad to see everything's running smoothly today.

Japanese.Text:
次の便までに　ゴールドソーサーで
調達してもらったもんを配る準備だ

English.Text: Need to get the goods from the Gold Saucer ready by the time the next gondola comes round, though.

Japanese.Text:
イイぞ……
ああ　気持ちイイ……

English.Text: Oh, if only I could stay like this forever. Forever and ever...

Japanese.Text:
こんなに楽しくて
給料も……イイ

English.Text: The pay is so good...and the work is even better.

Japanese.Text:
これぞ天職……
ああ　やめられない～

English.Text: I was born for this job. Truly, I was! And nothing but death will ever keep me from it.

Japanese.Text: ビーチが俺を呼んでるぜ！

English.Text: The beach is calling my name!

Japanese.Text:
あっちいな～
海に飛び込んで冷やすか

English.Text: Only way to beat this kinda heat is to go for a swim!

Japanese.Text: 太陽がまぶしいっす　はじけるっす！

English.Text: The sun is shinin' and I'm ready to live it up!

Japanese.Text: バカンス　バカンス～

English.Text: Surf and sun, here I come!

Japanese.Text: ハハハ　日焼け止めを忘れるなよ

English.Text: Heh... Just don't forget to put on sunscreen!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　恋の予感がする！

English.Text: Smell that? Love is in the air!

Japanese.Text: 次の出航はいつなの？

English.Text: When do we set sail?

Japanese.Text: 明日の早朝ですね

English.Text: Tomorrow morning, bright and early.

Japanese.Text:
船でいろいろあった後なんだ
今日くらいは酒を飲んでもいいだろ？

English.Text: So soon after everything? I could use a night out─and a lotta drinks.

Japanese.Text: ダメです

English.Text: I bet...

Japanese.Text:
コスタでアモール
いっしょに参加しない？

English.Text: Wanna join me in Costa del Amor?

Japanese.Text:
ナンパのフリして
お酒にありつこうって魂胆ですね

English.Text: And give you an excuse to hit the sauce? I don't think so.

Japanese.Text: 嫌なことを早く忘れたいんだよ

English.Text: Look, I just wanna black out for a bit!

Japanese.Text:
キレイな海だ　思わず飛び込みたくなる
フッ　またフラれちゃったよオレ

English.Text: So beautiful. The deep, blue sea... Heh... Could dive right in─never come up.

Japanese.Text: オレのなにが　ダメなんだあああ！

English.Text: Why did you leave meee!

Japanese.Text:
コスタでアモール
オレのためのイベントがやってきたぜ！

English.Text: Costa del Amor is exactly what I need to heal my broken heart!

Japanese.Text:
今度こそ　やってやる
やってやるぞおおお！

English.Text: I'll find real love this time. You'll see!

Japanese.Text:
アモールの夜は明けない
太陽の光が眩しくて　涙が出そうだ

English.Text: They say night's darkest before the dawn, but at this point, it feels like morning'll never come.

Japanese.Text: またフラれたよ　チクショーーー！

English.Text: Why doesn't anyone out there love meee!?

Japanese.Text:
だ～か～ら～！
おたくから買ったばかりのクルーザーが
壊れてんの

English.Text: Ugh... How many times do I have to tell you? The yacht you sold me is trash!

Japanese.Text: そんなはずがあるから電話してんだよ

English.Text: For crying out loud, I just bought it!

Japanese.Text:
おまえじゃ話にならん
責任者を出せ！

English.Text: Look: you're clearly incapable of helping. Put the manager on!

Japanese.Text: やっと休みとれたよ～！

English.Text: Finally, a real vacation!

Japanese.Text: 彼氏のヨットで　クルージングするのよ

English.Text: I can't wait to go out on my partner's yacht!

Japanese.Text: ジュノンの式典　大変だったみたいね

English.Text: And well-deserved, after what went down in Junon.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　表彰式でトラブルもあったけど
パレードは盛りあがったよ

English.Text: It wasn't so bad. I mean, the ceremony was a disaster, but the parade was a hit!

Japanese.Text: ルーファウスさんは大丈夫なの？

English.Text: So is the president okay?

Japanese.Text:
そりゃあ　オレが守ってるんだ
社長はぜんぜん無事　ケガひとつないよ

English.Text: 'Course he is. I was on guard duty! Thanks to me, he made it through without a single scratch.

Japanese.Text: コスタでアモールってなに？

English.Text: What's this "Costa del Amor"?

Japanese.Text: えっ？　し……知らない

English.Text: Uh, I... No idea!

Japanese.Text: 覗いてみよう

English.Text: Let's find out!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　ええ～？
それより　ほかのところ行こうよ

English.Text: Or we could maybe check out something else...? Like, literally anything else!

Japanese.Text: コスタでアモール　恨むぞ……

English.Text: I "Costa del abhor" this friggin' place...

Japanese.Text:
ああ　自分のカノジョ
ずっと浮気してたみたいで
アモールでこっちの男と
鉢合わせしたっすよ

English.Text: Get this: not only was my girl cheating on me this whole time, but the scumbag she's been seeing is the one who invited her here in the first place!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　あつ～い
ぜんぶ脱いじゃおうかな

English.Text: God, it's so hot... I'm melting like a popsicle!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　遠距離恋愛は難しいなあ
新しいパートナーを探さないと

English.Text: Man, this long-distance shit is one big recipe for disaster. Next time, I'm dating local.

Japanese.Text: ねえねえ　早く海に行こうよ！

English.Text: C'mon, I wanna go to the beach already!

Japanese.Text: 私はショッピングに行きたいわ

English.Text: Daddy will take you. I need to shop!

Japanese.Text:
うう……はしゃがないでくれよ
船酔いのせいで　吐きそうなんだ

English.Text: Ugh... Easy there, ladies. Daddy's not goin' anywhere until his stomach settles.

Japanese.Text: コスタ～！

English.Text: Hang loose!

Japanese.Text:
こちらの連絡船は　昨晩のモンスター襲撃を受け
航路の安全が確認されるまで　運休中です

English.Text: Safety is our top priority─and in light of last night's "incident," we are temporarily suspending operations.

Japanese.Text: 再開は　明日を予定しております

English.Text: We aim to be back on schedule by tomorrow.

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　こちらはジュノン港経由
アンダージュノン行きです

English.Text: Hang loose! We offer service to Under Junon by way of Junon proper.

Japanese.Text:
いちど　ジュノン港で
連絡船から小型船に乗り換えてもらいますが

English.Text: Once we arrive in port, passengers must transfer to a smaller vessel...

Japanese.Text: アンダージュノンまで　しっかりとお運びします

English.Text: But you'll be in good hands all the way to your destination!

Japanese.Text: 乗船されますか？

English.Text: Will you be joining us?

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　こちらはジュノン港経由
アンダージュノン行きです

English.Text: Hang loose! We offer service to Under Junon by way of Junon proper.

Japanese.Text: 乗船されますか？

English.Text: Will you be joining us?

Japanese.Text: それでは　良い船旅を～!

English.Text: Have a wonderful trip!

Japanese.Text: またのご利用を　お待ちしておりま～す

English.Text: We look forward to serving you again soon!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　こちらはただいま整備中です
申し訳ございません

English.Text: Hang loose! Our copter is currently undergoing maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　こちらはゴールドソーサー行きです
ご利用になりますか？

English.Text: Hang loose! This copter is bound for the Gold Saucer. Will you be riding with us today?

Japanese.Text: ゴールドソーサーへ向かいますか？

English.Text: Ride to the Gold Saucer?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text:
それでは
黄金の楽園へ　しゅっぱ～つ！

English.Text: Then without further ado, your gilded paradise awaits. Let's go!

Japanese.Text:
海より先に
まずはショッピングでしょ！

English.Text: I think I'll do a little shopping before I hit the beach!

Japanese.Text: またいつでも　お声がけくださ～い

English.Text: If you change your mind, come on back and let me know!

Japanese.Text: もう服の下に水着きてるんだよね

English.Text: I've got my suit on, and I'm ready to go for a swim!

Japanese.Text:
シャワーを浴びたら
ビーチに遊びに行くんだ

English.Text: Just need a quick shower, then it's time to beach out!

Japanese.Text: ふわ～あ　遊びすぎて寝不足

English.Text: Too much partying, not enough sleeping.

Japanese.Text: はあ　無事到着してよかったよ

English.Text: I'm just happy to be back on dry land.

Japanese.Text:
昨日のモンスター騒ぎは
なんだったんだ？

English.Text: What's this I hear about an attack on the ship?

Japanese.Text:
まさか　船がモンスターに
襲われるとはな

English.Text: You're never safe from fiends─not even in the middle of the ocean!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たちのせいで
モンスターが来たの？

English.Text: You don't think those creeps in black robes summoned them, do you?

Japanese.Text:
モンスター騒ぎのせいで
ぜんぜん眠れなかった

English.Text: Those monsters gave me such a fright, I couldn't sleep a wink.

Japanese.Text:
コスタの海にも
モンスターがいるのかな

English.Text: I wonder if I need to worry about monsters here too.

Japanese.Text:
昨日はビーチで
いろいろと騒ぎが起こったらしいな

English.Text: You hear about that mess on the beach? Glad I wasn't there.

Japanese.Text:
コスタで過ごす休日くらいは
物騒な世の中のことは忘れたいよ

English.Text: I came here to forget the woes of the world, but there's trouble even in paradise.

Japanese.Text:
今日はゆっくり
ビーチで泳げればいいんだが

English.Text: Hope I can enjoy the beach in peace today.

Japanese.Text:
昨日　ビーチで
なにかあったの？

English.Text: Uh...did something happen yesterday?

Japanese.Text:
海にモンスターなんて
バカンスが台無しよ

English.Text: Nothing kills the vibe like a bunch of uglies mucking up the beach.

Japanese.Text:
昨日暴れたのはアバランチ？
それとも　ウータイ？

English.Text: Was it a terror attack by Avalanche? Or maybe Wutai?

Japanese.Text:
真っ黒なマント着てて
暑くないのかな

English.Text: Man, they must be sweltering under those robes...

Japanese.Text: 気味の悪い連中がいるな

English.Text: Those guys've gotta be up to something...

Japanese.Text:
おいおい
黒マントもコスタでバカンスか？

English.Text: Oh, c'mon. Don't tell me those guys are here on vacation.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントを着てれば
日焼け対策にはなるわね

English.Text: Maybe they're onto something... No way they get sunburned!

Japanese.Text: コスタに黒マントなんて　野暮よねえ

English.Text: Those robes? Here? How gauche.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントには
近寄らないほうがいいって聞いたよ

English.Text: I heard we should steer clear of those guys in black robes.

Japanese.Text: 街の地図はないかな？

English.Text: You got a map of town?

Japanese.Text: ツアーの迎えが　まだ来ないんだが

English.Text: Our tour guide should've been here by now...

Japanese.Text:
スタッフのお姉さんは
今日　何時までお仕事？

English.Text: Do you know what time that tour guide is getting off work?

Japanese.Text:
写真映えするスポットに
行きたいんですけど

English.Text: So where can I shoot some sweet selfies!?

Japanese.Text: 日傘が買えるお店を教えてください

English.Text: Where can I purchase a nice parasol?

Japanese.Text: コスタのダンス　どこで習えますか？

English.Text: Where can I learn that cute dance they do here?

Japanese.Text: もはや　お客様を止められるライバルはいない

English.Text: I must say, you're leaving your competition in the dust!

Japanese.Text:
次が最後ですよ　道のりは遠いですが
お客様ならきっとできる

English.Text: Only one more license remains. The road ahead is long, but I have no doubt you'll roll to the finish in no time!

Japanese.Text: がんばってください！

English.Text: Keep on rollin'!

Japanese.Text:
うおお　おめでとうございます
ウィリーマスターライセンス達成しました！

English.Text: Wow! Congratulations! It is my honor to present you with this Wheelie Master License!

Japanese.Text:
お客様のウィリーへの愛情は
コスタに語り継がれる伝説となるでしょう

English.Text: You, my friend, have become a living legend today─the lone rolling star of Costa del Sol!

Japanese.Text:
こちらは　マスターに到達されたお客様にのみ
お渡ししている景品です　ぜひお受け取りください

English.Text: This prize is reserved for those who have proven themselves a demon on wheelies! Here─you earned it!

Japanese.Text:
では　これからも安全運転で
ウィリーの旅をお楽しみください

English.Text: Once again, congratulations! May you keep rolling safely and smoothly!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　おお　ウィリーマスター
今日もウィリー　楽しんでますか？

English.Text: Hang loose! Well, well, if it isn't our resident Wheelie Master! How's it rolling?

Japanese.Text: おお　よく乗りこなしてるな

English.Text: I gotta say, you're pretty good with that thing!

Japanese.Text:
そのウィリーさばき
素人ではないな

English.Text: You're no amateur. I can definitely tell that much!

Japanese.Text: オススメのデートコースを教えてくれよ

English.Text: Where's the best place for a romantic dinner?

Japanese.Text:
キャ～！
いっしょに乗ってみた～い

English.Text: Hey there! Mind if I hitch a ride?

Japanese.Text: うわ　すごい上手なウィリー乗りね

English.Text: Wow! I dunno how you keep your balance!

Japanese.Text:
おお　コスタの道の
すべてを知っている走りだ！

English.Text: Damn! You must know Costa del Sol like the back of your hand!

Japanese.Text: そのウィリーさばき　もはや達人だな

English.Text: I've never seen anyone ride so well. You're a wheelie wizard!

Japanese.Text: 新しい恋　見つけちゃお！

English.Text: I'm on the hunt for new love, baby!

Japanese.Text:
あなたの走り
街のウワサになってるわよ

English.Text: I dunno if you know, but your wheelie skills are the talk of the town!

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　そのウィリーで
どこでも連れてってよ！

English.Text: Hey there! When are you gonna take me for a ride on that thing?

Japanese.Text:
ウィウィウィ……
ウィリーマスターだよ！

English.Text: Whoa... I'm in the presence of the Wheelie Master!

Japanese.Text:
そのウィリーさばき
もはや神がかっているぞ！

English.Text: You're not just the master─you're a god on wheels!

Japanese.Text:
スタッフのお姉さんは
アモール探し　しないの？

English.Text: Any of these helpful ladies looking for a little "amor"?

Japanese.Text:
キャ～！
ウィリーマスターよ～

English.Text: Oh my god. It's the Wheelie Master!

Japanese.Text: 最高のウィリー乗りがお通りよ！

English.Text: Make way for the Wheelie Master, everyone!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソル・リゾートに
ご予約のお客様は
こちらまでお集まりくださ～い

English.Text: Passengers with reservations at Costa del Sol Resort, please step right this way!

Japanese.Text: それでは　ホテルまでご案内いたします

English.Text: Now that we're all here, if you'll please follow me.

Japanese.Text:
ロイヤルコーストにご予約のお客様は
こちらまでお集まりくださ～い

English.Text: All passengers with reservations at the Royal Coast, right this way please!

Japanese.Text: それでは　ホテルまでご案内いたします

English.Text: And with that, let's escort you to your lodgings!

Japanese.Text: コスタ　まじヤバくね？

English.Text: This place is insane.

Japanese.Text: キラキラ感　すごすぎ

English.Text: I am living for the vibes here.

Japanese.Text: これはテンションあがるっしょ！

English.Text: I'm legit so hyped for this vacay.

Japanese.Text: コスタでアモール　ヤバくない？

English.Text: This Costa del Amor thing is low-key kinda cute.

Japanese.Text: 最高のパートナーをゲットしたる

English.Text: I'm gonna bag a total smoke show!

Japanese.Text: 水着もタダでもらえるってマジ？

English.Text: They're just giving out swimsuits? Gagged.

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは
神羅の莫大な投資によって築かれた
常夏のリゾートです

English.Text: This tropical paradise was developed with the assistance of the Shinra Electric Power Company.

Japanese.Text:
その中でも華やかな建物が並ぶ
ここ　メインストリートは
みなさまもよくご存知でしょう

English.Text: While you'll find sun-kissed architectural delights throughout town, none shine brighter than those on Main Street.

Japanese.Text:
ショッピングを始め　グルメに音楽
アトラクションと
存分にバカンスをお楽しみいただけます

English.Text: Here you can enjoy shopping, fine dining, live music, and more─everything you need for your vacation!

Japanese.Text:
こちらの美しいビーチは
コスタ・デル・ソルで
いちばんにぎわう観光スポットですね

English.Text: This gorgeous beach is the crown jewel of Costa del Sol's many tourist attractions.

Japanese.Text:
海水浴はもちろん　サーフィンや
ダイビング等の色々なマリンスポーツが
お楽しみいただけます

English.Text: We have services that cater to all kinds of activities. Swimming, surfing, diving, you name it!

Japanese.Text:
世界一といわれるコスタの太陽は
私どもの誇りですが

English.Text: I think you'll soon find that there's no better place to bask in the summer sun.

Japanese.Text:
熱中症対策に
冷たいお飲み物と日焼け止めは
忘れずにお願いいたします

English.Text: But don't bask too long! At least not without plenty of cold drinks and lots of sunscreen!

Japanese.Text:
この大きな建物が　かの有名なホテル
『ロイヤルコースト』です

English.Text: This grand structure is the Royal Coast, one of our resort's most famous hotels.

Japanese.Text:
海岸へのアクセスの良さと
プライベートビーチを望む
バーレストランが人気です

English.Text: Not only does it boast its own private beach, it also features a lovely bar and grill.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の役員の方はもちろん
各界の著名人も　よく
お忍びで滞在されています

English.Text: It's a popular spot for celebrities and Shinra executives looking for an escape from the public eye.

Japanese.Text:
こちらは　コスタでナンバーワンの
リゾートホテル
『コスタ・デル・ソル・リゾート』です

English.Text: Here we have one of our most luxurious hotels: the Costa del Sol Resort.

Japanese.Text:
伝統と格式に裏打ちされた
ホスピタリティを提供するホテルとして
高い評価を受けております

English.Text: Due to its enduring reputation for quality service, reservations must be made well in advance.

Japanese.Text:
こちらは私個人のオススメでして
コスタが誇る名店
『バール・デル・ソル』です

English.Text: This one's a personal favorite of mine: Bar del Sol, where you can really let your hair down!

Japanese.Text: へえ　面白そうなイベントやってる

English.Text: Yo, this "amor" thing they're doing sounds great!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ産の魚介や野菜をもちいた
伝統料理はもちろん　厳選された材料で
手間ひまかけて作られたドリンク類

English.Text: Enjoy a fine meal made with local seafood and vegetables, or kick back with a cocktail crafted by their talented mixologists.

Japanese.Text:
趣向をこらした内装から
リラックスした雰囲気まで
申し分ございません

English.Text: With the exquisite décor and relaxing atmosphere, you'll find plenty to love here!

Japanese.Text:
ご興味がおありのお客様は
ぜひ　お立ち寄りくださいませ

English.Text: Even if you only have a moment to spare, be sure to check it out!

Japanese.Text:
こちらは立ち乗り二輪車
ウィリーのレンタル屋
『ウィリー・フォーユー』でございます

English.Text: Want to cruise the streets and feel the wind on your face? Live that dream at Wheelies 4 U!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーに乗れば
スイスイと楽しく移動できますよ

English.Text: Getting around's a snap on these two-wheeled fun machines!

Japanese.Text:
広い街での観光で
お疲れにならないように
ご利用をオススメしております

English.Text: Rent one to see all Costa del Sol has to offer without running yourself ragged!

Japanese.Text:
かわいい子がいるなら
参加してもいいよ

English.Text: An event with this many cuties? Okay!

Japanese.Text:
とにかく
ムッキムキの筋肉が見たいの！

English.Text: Bring on the beefcake! I'm starving!

Japanese.Text: コスタ～　太陽の楽園へようこそ～！

English.Text: Hang loose! Welcome to the land of sun, surf, and fun!

Japanese.Text:
ふりふり～　ゆらゆら～
楽しみましょ～！

English.Text: Welcome! Get into the groove in our slice of paradise!

Japanese.Text:
コスタでアモール
ご参加くださいませ～

English.Text: Find the love you've been dreaming of in Costa del Amor!

Japanese.Text:
ふりふり～　ゆらゆら～
恋を見つけましょ～！

English.Text: True love is out there! Just follow the rhythm of your heart to find it!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　オススメ観光スポットは
こちらでご案内してま～す

English.Text: Hang loose! Wanna know what Costa del Sol has to offer? Then we've got you covered!

Japanese.Text: どのスポットについて聞きますか？

English.Text: What would you like to learn about?

Japanese.Text: メインストリート

English.Text: Main Street.

Japanese.Text: ビーチ

English.Text: The beach.

Japanese.Text: <button=ex-story>ホテル

English.Text: <button=ex-story> Hotels in the area.

Japanese.Text: ホテル

English.Text: Hotels in the area.

Japanese.Text: レストラン

English.Text: Restaurants in the area.

Japanese.Text: 聞くことはない

English.Text: Nothing.

Japanese.Text: メインストリートには　様々なお店がございます

English.Text: You'll find a bevy of fantastic shops lining Main Street.

Japanese.Text:
ショッピングをご希望でしたら　立ち乗り二輪車
『ウィリー』でまわるのがオススメですよ

English.Text: If you plan to spend the day shopping, I'd recommend getting a wheelie. They're fun and convenient!

Japanese.Text:
コスタのビーチでは　海水浴はもちろん
サーフィン　ダイビングやチョコボートなど

English.Text:
Our beach is host to a number of fun activities!
Surf, scuba, and even chocoboat!

Japanese.Text: 色々なマリンスポーツを　お楽しみいただけます

English.Text: But chilling with a cocktail is also a great option.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　本日はイベントデーなので
リゾートウェア着用でないと　ビーチに入れません

English.Text: Because of today's event, however, proper attire is mandatory. Beachwear or bust, I'm afraid.

Japanese.Text: ゆるっとオシャレして　おでかけくださいませ

English.Text: But don't worry─our shops have a killer selection.

Japanese.Text:
ホテルといえばやはり　ロイヤルコーストと
コスタ・デル・ソル・リゾートの２つが有名ですね

English.Text: While we have plenty of options, you can't go wrong with either the Royal Coast or Costa del Sol Resort.

Japanese.Text:
ほかにも　たくさんホテルはございますが
どこも満室でして

English.Text:
Unfortunately, according to my records,
every hotel is booked solid today.

Japanese.Text: 飛び込みでの宿泊は　少々難しいかと

English.Text:
Unless there's a cancellation,
it'll be hard to find a room.

Japanese.Text: そうそう

English.Text: That said...

Japanese.Text:
新しいホテル『シーサイド・ジョニー』が
街外れの静かな場所にリニューアルオープンしました

English.Text: there's a hotel just outside of town─Johnny's Seaside Inn. It's celebrating its grand reopening!

Japanese.Text: これから人気になりそうなので　応援してるんです

English.Text: Place is so new, it's likely accepting walk-ins. Try there first!

Japanese.Text: コスタが誇る名店　バール・デル・ソルでは

English.Text: Bar del Sol is a hot spot that is not to be missed.

Japanese.Text:
シーフード料理から　トロピカルドリンクまで
当地ならではのメニューを取りそろえております

English.Text: Not only do they serve the best seafood around, but they also have amazing drinks that'll knock you off your feet!

Japanese.Text: 飲み過ぎ食べ過ぎには　ご注意くださいませ

English.Text:
Be careful not to overindulge.
We don't want you getting sick!

Japanese.Text: コスタ～！　お客様はラッキーだ

English.Text: Hang loose! Today's your lucky day.

Japanese.Text:
ただいま　コスタの観光を
さらにお楽しみ頂けますように

English.Text: There's a surefire way to make seeing the sights even more magical:

Japanese.Text:
『ウィリーキャンペーン』へのご参加を
提案しております

English.Text: by taking them in on a state-of-the-art wheelie!

Japanese.Text: よろしければ　お話だけでも聞いていってください

English.Text: If you're interested, we're doing a special promotion. Whaddya say?

Japanese.Text:
キャンペーンは　立ち乗り二輪車ウィリーに乗って
あちこち観光するだけ　簡単ですよ！

English.Text: Just hop on one of these babies and ride around town at your leisure─that's it! No strings attached.

Japanese.Text:
しかも　ウィリーの走行距離によって
景品がもらえます

English.Text: You can even win fabulous prizes depending on how far you travel!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　どうです？
ウィリーキャンペーン　参加しますよね

English.Text:
So how about it, friend?
Interested in taking a roll around Costa del Sol?

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！
ウィリーキャンペーン　参加しますよね

English.Text: Hang loose! So, ready to take one of our wheelies for a spin?

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　ウィリーキャンペーン
ご参加ありがとうございます

English.Text: Hang loose! Thanks again for taking that wheelie of ours for a test drive!

Japanese.Text: ウィリーキャンペーンに参加しますか？

English.Text: Participate in the wheelie event?

Japanese.Text: ウィリーの走行距離を報告しますか？

English.Text: Report wheelie distance?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: ええ　もったいない！

English.Text: What!? But it's such a good deal!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーキャンペーンは
いつでも　ご参加できますので

English.Text:
Well, if you change your mind,
you know where to find me!

Japanese.Text: また　お声がけくださいね

English.Text: I'll be right here waiting for ya!

Japanese.Text:
はい　ありがとうございます！
お客様はウィリーキャンペーンに登録されました

English.Text: Now that's what I like to hear! And just like that, you're registered and ready to get rolling!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーをレンタルしてビュンビュン走りまわって
景品　ゲットしちゃってください

English.Text: All you need to do is pick a wheelie to rent, ride it to your heart's content, then claim your prize when you're done!

Japanese.Text: お客様のウィリー走行距離は――

English.Text: Let's see what the odometer says, shall we?

Japanese.Text: おっと　記録更新はありませんね

English.Text: Hmm... Doesn't look like you've broken any records this time.

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーで　もっとビュンビュンと
コスタの旅を楽しんでみてください！

English.Text: But hey─keep rolling around Costa del Sol and you'll get those numbers up in no time!

Japanese.Text:
おめでとうございます
ルーキーライセンス達成しました！

English.Text: Congratulations! You've ridden enough to earn yourself a rookie license!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーは　魔晄エネルギーの消費も少なく
星に優しい乗り物なんですよ

English.Text: The great thing about wheelies is how little mako they use. They're super eco-friendly!

Japanese.Text: 引き続き　ウィリーの旅をお楽しみください

English.Text: So keep doing the planet a favor and enjoy your wheelie time!

Japanese.Text:
おめでとうございます
ベテランライセンス達成しました！

English.Text:
Congratulations!
You've earned yourself a veteran license!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーの乗り心地はいかがでしょうか
ふむ　その顔は満足していらっしゃいますね！

English.Text: How have you been enjoying your time on that wheelie? That's the look of one satisfied customer!

Japanese.Text: それでは　景品をお受け取りください

English.Text: And this prize is sure to lift your spirits even more!

Japanese.Text:
おめでとうございます
エキスパートライセンス達成しました！

English.Text:
Congratulations!
You now qualify for an expert license!

Japanese.Text: ここはオシャレさんが多いな

English.Text: Gosh, I feel so underdressed.

Japanese.Text:
観光客が減るまで
しばらく別荘で過ごすか

English.Text: Maybe I'll wait at the villa until the crowds thin out a bit...

Japanese.Text:
コスタに来たなら
とにかく楽しまなくちゃ

English.Text: For how much I'm paying, I expect only the best!

Japanese.Text:
バール・デル・ソルっていう
いい酒場があるんだよ

English.Text: Have you been to Bar del Sol? It's great!

Japanese.Text: ビーチで泳ぐか　ここで遊ぶか迷うな

English.Text: Kinda wanna hit the beach, but I'm having a great time here.

Japanese.Text: さあ　思いっきりバカンスを楽しむぞ！

English.Text: Who's ready to party in paradise!? This guy!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　ジョギング日和！

English.Text: Talk about perfect jogging weather!

Japanese.Text: ハハハ　やっと長期休暇とれたんですよ

English.Text: Yes! Finally, a long vacation!

Japanese.Text:
コスタは　神羅が開発した
リゾートなんだよ

English.Text: Shinra can't be all bad if they built a place like this...

Japanese.Text: バカンスは楽しまなきゃ損よ

English.Text: The only bad vacation is the one you waste!

Japanese.Text:
ホテルは　どこも
予約でいっぱいだってさ

English.Text: Man, all the hotels are totally booked up.

Japanese.Text:
私『コスタでアモール』で出会った
神羅の兵士と
結婚することになったんです

English.Text: I met a hunky Shinra trooper through Costa del Amor, and now we're getting married!

Japanese.Text:
ウータイのシノビって
どこに潜んでいるかわからないでしょ？

English.Text: I keep thinking how those Wutai ninjas could be hiding just about anywhere.

Japanese.Text: 怖いよね～

English.Text: Scary, huh?

Japanese.Text: はあ　コスタは心の避難所なのですよ～

English.Text: Ahhh, this place is a refuge for the soul!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　どこ行こうか？

English.Text: Where would you like to go, honey?

Japanese.Text: どこでも　いっしょなら楽しいし

English.Text: Oh anywhere, so long as we're together!

Japanese.Text: ウィリーに乗る？

English.Text: Take some wheelies?

Japanese.Text: ううん　歩きで大丈夫

English.Text: No, we'll get a better feel for the place on foot.

Japanese.Text: そろそろ　なにか食べようか

English.Text: It's about time to grab some grub!

Japanese.Text: 私　モンスターバーガー食べたい！

English.Text: I'd kill for a Monster Burger right now!

Japanese.Text: 緊張してます？

English.Text: Nervous, huh?

Japanese.Text: うう　はい……

English.Text: A little...

Japanese.Text: サーフィン　やってみたくない？

English.Text: Let's you and me go catch some waves.

Japanese.Text: オレ　じつは泳げないんだよね

English.Text: Actually...I can't swim.

Japanese.Text: いやはや　これが噂のコスタでござるか

English.Text: Oh my, so this is the fabled Costa del Sol!

Japanese.Text:
どこもかしこも
カップルばかりでござるな

English.Text: Oh my, there's lovers as far as the eye can see!

Japanese.Text:
マジで　男ふたりで
コスタに来ちゃったよ

English.Text: Look at all these couples. We're the only pair here that isn't dating!

Japanese.Text: おまえが　来たいっつったんだろ

English.Text: You're the one who was dyin' to come.

Japanese.Text:
こんなステキなバカンスに
連れてきてくれるなんて感激

English.Text: How much did this cost you? No, don't tell me, I'll just feel guilty.

Japanese.Text: 君の喜ぶ顔が見たくてね　奮発したんだ

English.Text: Honestly, the expense was completely worth it to see you so happy.

Japanese.Text:
さっき声かけてきた人たち
割とよくなかった？

English.Text: You know, those people hitting on us earlier were kinda cute.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　６５点

English.Text: They were maybe sixes or sevens.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　そろそろビーチに行かない？

English.Text: Do you maybe wanna head down to the beach now?

Japanese.Text: うん　もっと２人ではじけたいな

English.Text: Totes! You and me gotta let loose!

Japanese.Text: 射的　楽しかったな

English.Text: That was some sharp shooting!

Japanese.Text: 次はクイーンズ・ブラッドやりたい！

English.Text: I wanna play Queen's Blood next!

Japanese.Text:
ふたりでゲームをクリアしたら
水着がもらえるんだって

English.Text: Says if we win a game together, we both get free swimwear!

Japanese.Text:
着ないよ　着ないからね
絶対無理だから！

English.Text: Oh no. I wouldn't be caught dead wearing one of those skimpy suits!

Japanese.Text: ウィリーに乗ってデートしない？

English.Text: You wanna ride some wheelies?

Japanese.Text: うん　それ面白そう！

English.Text: Oh, sure! Sounds like fun!

Japanese.Text:
今日は　ロイヤルコーストで
ピアノコンサートがあるんですって

English.Text: I heard there's a piano concert going on at the Royal Coast today!

Japanese.Text: いいね　聴きにいこう

English.Text: Sold! Let's check it out!

Japanese.Text: 俺たちのアモールは　深まったよな？

English.Text: Tell me: how deep is your "amor"?

Japanese.Text: うん　もうお腹いっぱい

English.Text: Deeper than you can even begin to imagine.

Japanese.Text: さあ　じゃんじゃん買い物するわよ～！

English.Text: Okay! This girl's gonna shop till she drops!

Japanese.Text: バール・デル・ソルでアモールしようか

English.Text: Why don't we drink "amor"?

Japanese.Text: うん　そのほうが大胆になれるかも

English.Text: Ooh, yeah! Give me "amor" of that!

Japanese.Text: 今日はどのレストランに入ろうかな

English.Text: So many restaurants to choose from...

Japanese.Text: あっ　日焼け止めを塗るの忘れてたわ

English.Text: Oh, shoot! I totally forgot to put on sunscreen.

Japanese.Text: さあ　次はあっちのお店にいくわよ

English.Text: Okay! Next, I wanna hit that store.

Japanese.Text: ちょっと待ってくれよ

English.Text: Hang on a sec, babe.

Japanese.Text: 踊れるクラブってどっかにないの？

English.Text: Isn't there anywhere around here I can just dance!?

Japanese.Text: 待ってたら売り切れちゃう！

English.Text: I can't─it's a timed sale!

Japanese.Text: さすがに買い込みすぎじゃない？

English.Text: Haven't you bought enough already?

Japanese.Text: 次は　どこのお店に行くの？

English.Text: So...where to next, babe?

Japanese.Text: 考え中～

English.Text: Still thinking!

Japanese.Text:
コスタでアモールのゲームでも
やりにいかない？

English.Text: A game might help you think... And give me a break.

Japanese.Text: それは時間がもったいないからダメ！

English.Text: No time for games─I need to shop!

Japanese.Text:
ここのお店はね　最近
最高評価の星がついた
いま話題のレストランなんだよ

English.Text: Not sure if you've heard, but this restaurant recently received a 5-star rating. It's the hottest spot in town!

Japanese.Text: よく予約が取れたわね

English.Text: I'm amazed you got a reservation!

Japanese.Text:
卓越した創作料理を
キミに味わってほしくてね

English.Text: What can I say? I'll stop at nothing to get the best for my baby.

Japanese.Text: ワインの品ぞろえも最高なんだ

English.Text: Speaking of, check out the wine selection!

Japanese.Text:
喉カラッカラ
ワインがぶ飲みしちゃいそう

English.Text: How divine! I'm so parched, I could drink a whole bottle!

Japanese.Text:
ビーチまで行く道って
こっちであってる？

English.Text: This street'll take me straight to the beach, right?

Japanese.Text:
気候が暖かいからか
みんなユルくて陽気なのよね

English.Text: Even though it's hella hot around here, everyone's super chill.

Japanese.Text: では　参るぞ

English.Text: Now then... Sally forth.

Japanese.Text: 失礼　殿下が通られます

English.Text: Make way! Royalty coming through.

Japanese.Text: 道を　おあけください

English.Text: Come now, make way.

Japanese.Text: このピエロ　ぜんぜん動かないね

English.Text: I've been watching for a while, and he hasn't moved a muscle!

Japanese.Text: こんなに暑いのに　すごいな

English.Text: Not easy in this heat, that's for sure.

Japanese.Text: チップを弾んであげましょう？

English.Text: He's definitely earned a tip!

Japanese.Text: 暑いから　カクテルよりお水が欲しい

English.Text: As much as I'd love a cocktail, I need to stay hydrated.

Japanese.Text:
バカンスだもの
出会いには期待しちゃう

English.Text: Anything can happen on vacation. Maybe I'll fall in love!

Japanese.Text:
あちらのホテル
とても気に入りましたわ

English.Text: That hotel was exquisite. I wish we never had to leave!

Japanese.Text:
ふむ　では神羅に話を通して
買い取ろうか

English.Text: In that case, I could ask my friends at Shinra to help me buy it out...

Japanese.Text: あら　いいんですの？

English.Text: Oh, you'd do that for me?

Japanese.Text: 旅行の記念だよ

English.Text: Call it a souvenir.

Japanese.Text:
こんなステキなリゾートを
作っちゃうなんて
神羅カンパニーに感謝しなきゃ！

English.Text: This place is paradise. Mad props to the Shinra people who designed it.

Japanese.Text: ハネムーン以来のコスタね　あなた

English.Text: You know, I think the last time we came here was our honeymoon!

Japanese.Text:
あの頃と同じように
またビーチではしゃごう！

English.Text: Why don't we take a walk along the beach─like we did back then?

Japanese.Text:
ボクはゴールドソーサーの
アトラクションで遊びたかったな

English.Text: Ugh, the beach is so boring. I wanna go to the Gold Saucer!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは
神羅カンパニーの社員が使う
保養地としても有名なの

English.Text: Might as well call it "Costa del Shinra" for all the company executives you see here on vacation!

Japanese.Text: 次の配達先はどこ？

English.Text: Where's my next drop-off spot?

Japanese.Text: ビーチまでピッツァ２枚　了解！

English.Text: Two pizzas, down on the beach. Copy that!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　それと何度も言ってるけど
ピザじゃなくて“ピッツァ”な
気をつけて

English.Text: Oh, and double-check the order next time, will ya? Last guy wanted pepperoni but got peperoncino instead.

Japanese.Text: 次はスパゲッティを２皿　了解！

English.Text: Okay! Two plates of spaghetti, comin' right up!

Japanese.Text:
あと　これも大切だから言っておくけど
スパゲティじゃなくて
“スパゲッティ”だから

English.Text: And be careful: we gave some guy a bowl of spaghettoni, and he was not happy. Folks are picky about their pasta.

Japanese.Text:
あの　すみません　すみません
頼み事を聞いてもらっていいですか

English.Text: Um, excuse me, miss? Sorry to be a bother, but would you mind lending me a hand?

Japanese.Text: どうかしましたか？

English.Text: Sure, what's wrong?

Japanese.Text:
財布をなくしてしまって
困ってるんです

English.Text: I lost my wallet, and I can't seem to find it anywhere!

Japanese.Text:
あなたのその　ワンちゃんの鼻で
探してもらえたりできませんかね？

English.Text: If it isn't too much trouble, do you think you could have your dog, like, sniff around for it?

Japanese.Text: この子にそんなこと　できるかな？

English.Text: My girl's well-trained, but I don't think she can do that...

Japanese.Text: よっしゃあ　ホテルまで競争だ

English.Text: Okay─last one to the hotel's a rotten egg!

Japanese.Text:
お兄ちゃんには負けん
気合いじゃあ！

English.Text: You're going down, bro! You'll see!

Japanese.Text: じゃあ次は　ビーチまで競争だ

English.Text: Alright, sis. Bet you can't beat me to the beach!

Japanese.Text: へへ～　お先じゃあ！

English.Text: Heh heh... Betcha I can!

Japanese.Text: まとが小さすぎないか？

English.Text: Gimme a break─that's way too small!

Japanese.Text: 俺の腕前　よく見ときな

English.Text: Just watch: I'm gonna get a bull's-eye!

Japanese.Text: 射的は構えが大事なんだ

English.Text: It's all about how you hold it.

Japanese.Text:
わたし　本物の銃のほうが
上手にできそう

English.Text: I swear, I'd do a whole lot better with a real gun.

Japanese.Text:
よ～く狙って
気合いとともにぶっぱなすのよ！

English.Text: Aim carefully, breathe out, then fire!

Japanese.Text: うまく当たるかな～？

English.Text: I hope I can hit something.

Japanese.Text:
波の音を聞きながら
カードバウトも悪くないね

English.Text: Must be nice to play QB while listening to the waves crash.

Japanese.Text:
今日は頭がさえてるから
負ける気しないよ

English.Text: I am on today. Hope y'all ready to lose.

Japanese.Text:
コスタのバウターはどれほどか
お手並み拝見だな

English.Text: I'm eager to put the local cardslingers through the card wringer.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
やったことないんだけど

English.Text: I can't say I've ever played this "Queen's Blood" thing.

Japanese.Text: 勝つまでやるわよ～！

English.Text: I am in it to win it!

Japanese.Text: カードバウト　盛りあがってる？

English.Text: Are ya hyped up for the match?

Japanese.Text: はあ　かわいい動物いっぱい

English.Text: Cuteness overload...

Japanese.Text:
はっくしょん！
俺　アレルギーなんだ

English.Text: Achoo! Ugh, allergies...

Japanese.Text: みんなモフモフだねえ

English.Text: They're so fluffy! Ooh!

Japanese.Text: 噛んだり　吠えたりしない？

English.Text: Barking's fine, but no biting.

Japanese.Text:
お手！
はい　お手！

English.Text: Shake! Shake!

Japanese.Text: 追いかけっこやりたい

English.Text: I wanna play tag!

Japanese.Text: エサだよ～　ほれほれ！

English.Text: Want some food? Here ya go!

Japanese.Text: どの子を応援しようかな

English.Text: I wonder which one I should root for.

Japanese.Text: ウィリーの動力源は魔晄なのか

English.Text: Do the wheelies run on mako engines?

Japanese.Text:
うわわわ
ボク　初心者なんです！

English.Text: Oh crap, oh crap, I've never done this before!

Japanese.Text: ふんふん　スイ～スイ～っと

English.Text: Hm-hm-hm-hmm... Vroom vroom!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーでビーチに入ったら
怒られるよね？

English.Text: You'll get chewed out if you take a wheelie on the beach.

Japanese.Text: ちょっとどいて　あたし練習中～！

English.Text: Watch out! I have no idea what I'm doing!

Japanese.Text: なるほど　これは楽チンだね

English.Text: Oh, I get it! This is easy!

Japanese.Text: ハッピーテンダーってなに？

English.Text: What the hell is a "caper"?

Japanese.Text:
街中探しまわったけど
見つからねえよ
