分離独立した派閥だからね

English.Text: Everyone knows the space rangers began as part of the Gilgamesh Army, but they broke away to fight back against the corrupt leadership.

Japanese.Text: 事の発端はギルガメッシュ軍の腐敗さ

English.Text: So the Army is obviously in the wrong.

Japanese.Text: そうかしら

English.Text: I wonder...

Japanese.Text:
宇宙騎士団がクーデターを起こしたから
ギルガメッシュ軍は防戦しているだけよ

English.Text: The space rangers basically staged a coup, so the Gilgamesh Army is just defending itself.

Japanese.Text:
宇宙の平和を乱しているのは
むしろ　宇宙騎士団のほうじゃない？

English.Text: So really, the rangers are the ones who're disturbing the galactic peace.

Japanese.Text:
いや　宇宙全域を支配下に置こうとする
ギルガメッシュ軍の思想は危険だよ

English.Text: No way. The real danger is the Gilgamesh Army's obsession with galactic domination.

Japanese.Text: 実際に　何度か行動も起こしているし

English.Text: Like, it's literally their entire shtick.

Japanese.Text:
ギルガメッシュ軍の目的は
支配ではなく融和だよ

English.Text: Their purpose isn't control, it's to create harmony between the systems.

Japanese.Text:
宇宙騎士団を設立した初代総統も
任命式の際に　そう宣言してるだろ？

English.Text: I mean, that's what their first commander in chief declared during the inaugural address. Don't you remember?

Japanese.Text: 有名な『ギルガメッシュ宣言』だね

English.Text: The Gilgamesh Proclamation, yes.

Japanese.Text:
とはいえ　いまのギルガメッシュ軍が
あの宣言を履行できているかは疑問だね

English.Text: Though I doubt anyone would say their current approach is conducive to "harmony."

Japanese.Text:
我こそは泣く子も黙る宇宙騎士！
今日も宇宙の平和を守るために戦うのだ

English.Text: I'm the galaxy's most incredible space ranger! And I'm gonna fight my hardest today to preserve peace for all!

Japanese.Text: おお　団長殿がいれば百人力です！

English.Text: Our victory is assured now that we have you on our side, Commander!

Japanese.Text:
ギルガメッシュ軍も恐れをなして
逃げていくことでしょう！

English.Text: The evil forces of Gilgamesh don't stand a chance against you!

Japanese.Text: うむ　まかせておけ！

English.Text: They sure don't! Leave 'em to me!

Japanese.Text:
あらあら　昨日はすぐに撃墜されて
大泣きしてたけど　大丈夫なの？

English.Text: Okay, "Commander"─but if we get shot down again, let's not make a scene like yesterday.

Japanese.Text: お母さん　それは言っちゃダメ！

English.Text: Mom! You promised not to talk about that!

Japanese.Text:
この美しいフォルム
いや～　機能美の極致だな

English.Text: That ship is a beauty! The perfect combination of form and function.

Japanese.Text:
本当に宇宙で飛べるように
設計されてるんだって

English.Text: I still can't believe that the design is actually feasible.

Japanese.Text:
宇宙開発部門のエンジニアが
監修したって聞いたな

English.Text: Developed by an engineer from Space and Aeronautics, I hear.

Japanese.Text:
あ～あ　なんで神羅は
宇宙開発を凍結しちゃったんだろ

English.Text: All that work for a display piece. Why did Shinra have to put the program on ice?

Japanese.Text:
開発を進めてたらいまごろ
宇宙に行けたかもしれないのにな

English.Text: Good question. They'd probably have ships in orbit right now if they'd kept it going.

Japanese.Text: またランキングに入れなかった……

English.Text: Ugh, missed the leaderboard again.

Japanese.Text: プレイが雑になってるよ

English.Text: Your game's sloppy, that's why.

Japanese.Text:
敵の挙動をもっとよく見ないと
あと　音もちゃんと聞いてね

English.Text: You need to pay more attention to enemy behavior. And listen closely for audio cues.

Japanese.Text:
五感をフルに使わないと
ランキング入りは難しいよ

English.Text: You're gonna have a tough time getting on the board if you don't make use of all your senses.

Japanese.Text:
はい　師匠
ありがとうございます！

English.Text: Thank you, ma'am! I'll take that to heart!

Japanese.Text:
次は　わたしがやるから
しっかり目に焼きつけて

English.Text: Alright, I'm up next. Watch and you might learn something!

Japanese.Text:
はい　師匠
勉強させていただきます！

English.Text: Understood! I'll watch your every move!

Japanese.Text: 新兵諸君　ポイントを交換するかね？

English.Text: Greetings, recruit. Here to exchange points?

Japanese.Text: 出撃のまえに　ポイントを交換しておくか？

English.Text: Care to exchange your points before takeoff?

Japanese.Text: 宇宙騎士団に　栄光あれ！

English.Text: Make us proud, space ranger!

Japanese.Text: それでは　健闘を祈る！

English.Text: Best of luck out there, ranger!

Japanese.Text: 今日はどんなバトルが見られるかな？

English.Text: What kinda brawls are we gonna get to see today!?

Japanese.Text:
このヒリつくような熱気
たまんねえ～

English.Text: I'm so friggin' hyped for this. It's gonna be insane!

Japanese.Text: 最後の一撃　めっちゃよかったな！

English.Text: That last hit!? That was the stuff of legends!

Japanese.Text:
入るまえに
プロテインジュース買おうぜ

English.Text: Better grab a protein shake before heading in!

Japanese.Text: 急げ　目当ての試合が始まっちまう！

English.Text: Hurry up! The match I wanna see is starting!

Japanese.Text:
やっぱ　３Ｄバトラーより
生身の殴りあいだよ

English.Text: Real flesh-and-blood fights top that virtual shit any day!

Japanese.Text: 血沸き肉躍る戦いは　健康にいいぞ！

English.Text: A little rough-and-tumble brawling's good for the health, don'tcha think?

Japanese.Text: さて　マッスルを愛でにいきますか

English.Text: Time to go marvel at some glorious muscles!

Japanese.Text: 目を付けてるバトラーが出るんだよね

English.Text: This one fighter I absolutely adore is competing today!

Japanese.Text:
わあ　カワイイ～
みんな連れて帰りたい！

English.Text: Oh. My. God. Look how cute they are! I want them all!

Japanese.Text: 差し入れにプロテインを買ってきたの

English.Text: I bought some protein powder to drop off backstage!

Japanese.Text:
ダメです　そんなに置くとこないだろ？
１つだけならいいよ

English.Text: Oh c'mon, you can't be serious. Where would we even put them? Let's just keep it to one.

Japanese.Text: そんな～　せめて２つ！

English.Text: Aww! At least let me get two!

Japanese.Text:
デブチョコボとデブモーグリは
絶対に連れて帰りたい～！

English.Text: You heard her. The chocobo and moogle are a pair! It'd be cruel to tear them apart!

Japanese.Text: だから　ダメだって

English.Text: You know we don't have room.

Japanese.Text:
それによりによって
なんでそのデカい２つなんだよ

English.Text: Look at the size of them. We'd have to throw away furniture!

Japanese.Text:
なんだ　いまのネコ？
動いたぞ

English.Text: Am I crazy, or did that stuffed cat just move?

Japanese.Text: ねえ　いまのネコちゃんが欲しい～！

English.Text: If I can only have one, I want him!

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドポイントの交換は
こちらでお受けしておりマッスル！

English.Text: Muscle in and exchange your Gold Saucer Points for fabulous prizes!

Japanese.Text: ポイントを交換されマッスルか？

English.Text: Been workin' on your Point gains, bro?

Japanese.Text: またのお越しを　お待ちしておりマッスル！

English.Text: We hope to see your sinewy self again soon!

Japanese.Text: 今日は荒々しい肉弾戦が見たいな～

English.Text: I can't wait to see sweat drippin' and fists flyin'!

Japanese.Text:
ありがとうございマッスル
それでは　よい筋肉ライフを！

English.Text: Thank you so much, bro! And remember: gotta hustle for that muscle!

Japanese.Text:
昨日の一撃ＫＯの試合　見た？
歓声でコロシアムが震えてたよ

English.Text: Did you see yesterday's match? It was a one-hit KO! The crowd lost their minds!

Japanese.Text:
うしろの席だから双眼鏡を持ってきたの
これで汗の粒まで見えるわ

English.Text: I brought binoculars since I'm in the nosebleeds. I'll be able to see the beads of sweat on their skin!

Japanese.Text:
あんなに体格差があったのに
技術でねじ伏せちゃうなんてすごすぎ

English.Text: You see how buff the other team was? Makes you realize brains really are better than brawn.

Japanese.Text: サボテンダーは試合に出る？

English.Text: Are there gonna be any cactuars?

Japanese.Text: さっきの必殺技　ボクもやりたい！

English.Text: I wanna learn how to do that superspecial move too!

Japanese.Text:
次のバトル
誰が勝つか予想しようよ！

English.Text: Hey, so which fighter do you think's gonna win the next battle!?

Japanese.Text: 鍛えたら　私もバトラーになれる？

English.Text: I'm gonna train to be a fighter someday!

Japanese.Text:
いちばんマッスルなのは
ディオ園長だよ！

English.Text: Dio's got the most muscles outta everyone!

Japanese.Text: どのバトラーもカッコいいね！

English.Text: All the fighters are so cool!

Japanese.Text:
神羅の警備兵がいるな
なにかあったのか？

English.Text: That's a whole lotta Shinra guards. Somethin' goin' down?

Japanese.Text: やけに警備が厳重だな

English.Text: Not skimpin' on security.

Japanese.Text: お偉いさんでも見に来てんのかね

English.Text: Maybe some Shinra bigwig's here.

Japanese.Text: なんで神羅の兵士がいるんだろう

English.Text: What're Shinra troopers doing here?

Japanese.Text: 神羅の偉い人が遊びにきたんだって

English.Text: I heard one of the higher-ups is here on vacay.

Japanese.Text: 兵隊さんがコロシアムに出るの？

English.Text: They tryin' their luck in the colosseum?

Japanese.Text:
目撃情報を集めたら
園長に報告しろ

English.Text: Report back to the director once you've taken witness statements.

Japanese.Text: 遺体の収容場所は確保できたか？

English.Text: Found a place to transport the bodies?

Japanese.Text: ほかのスクエアの状況を確認してくれ

English.Text: Get me a sitrep on the other squares.

Japanese.Text:
現在　調査中です
なにもお答えできません

English.Text: I need you to step back please. This is a crime scene.

Japanese.Text: ゲストの避難が最優先よ

English.Text: Evacuate the guests first.

Japanese.Text: こちらは現在　封鎖中です

English.Text: This area is currently on lockdown.

Japanese.Text: 申し訳ありません　お通しできません

English.Text: I'm sorry, but I can't let ya through here.

Japanese.Text:
マッスルコロシアム始まって以来の
ビッグイベントだな

English.Text: Has the colosseum ever hosted a match this big before?

Japanese.Text:
第２のウォール・マーケットが
誕生しちまうかもな

English.Text: We might just witness the birth of another Wall Market.

Japanese.Text: ディオ軍団のメンバーが気になるな

English.Text: I am dyin' to know who Dio's Champions are.

Japanese.Text:
俺は　ディオ園長の筋肉を信じる
筋肉は絶対に負けない！

English.Text: Dio's rippling muscles'll carry the day, you'll see. Nobody can stop those buns of steel!

Japanese.Text:
コルネオを舐めてると痛い目にあうぜ
そういうヤツを何人も見てきたよ

English.Text: Dio's champs're in for a world of hurt if they think the family's going down easy, tell ya that much!

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーを守るためにも
ディオ園長を応援しないと！

English.Text: I'm pulling for Dio! The Gold Saucer wouldn't be the same without him.

Japanese.Text:
ディオ軍団とコルネオファミリー
どっちが勝つと思う？

English.Text: Who you think's gonna come out on top? The Champs or the Family?

Japanese.Text:
こういうビッグイベントがあるから
ゴールドソーサーって飽きないのよね

English.Text: This kinda stuff is exactly what keeps me coming back. There's always something going on!

Japanese.Text:
ウォール・マーケットを知ってる人なら
この試合のヤバさがわかるわよね

English.Text: Anyone who knows anything about Wall Market could tell you just how much is riding on this match.

Japanese.Text:
コルネオは神羅から逃げてるんでしょ
こんなに目立って大丈夫なの？

English.Text: Can Corneo afford to do something like this? Isn't he on the run from Shinra?

Japanese.Text: クラウド　がんばれ！

English.Text: You got this one, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　期待してるぞ

English.Text: I'm counting on you to win it all, man!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　応援するぜ

English.Text: Don't let anyone stop you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさんなら　絶対勝てる！

English.Text: You show 'em who's boss, alright!?

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　がんばって～！

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! You rock!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　いいぞ！

English.Text: Hell yeah, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　勢いにのってけ！

English.Text: C'mon, you got this in the bag!

Japanese.Text: アンタなら絶対勝てるよ　クラウド

English.Text: C'mon, Cloud! I wanna see you kick some ass!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　がんばって！

English.Text: I'm rootin' for you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　いけるよ！

English.Text: I believe in you, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　勝ってください！

English.Text: Can we take a selfie? I mean, if you're not too busy!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　ファイト！

English.Text: Time to knuckle down and bring it home!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　やっちゃって！

English.Text: Show us how it's done, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさ～ん　ハイタッチして～！

English.Text: Hey, Cloud! Gimme a high five!

Japanese.Text: キャ～　こっち見てクラウド～！

English.Text: Cloud, Cloud! Over here!

Japanese.Text: 勝ったら　いっしょにお祝いしようね！

English.Text: Let's share a bottle if you win this one, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーを守ってくれて
ありがとな！

English.Text: Thanks a lot for standing up for the Gold Saucer!

Japanese.Text: すげえイイ試合だったぞ！

English.Text: Holy shit, that ruled!

Japanese.Text: またディオ軍団で出場してくれよ！

English.Text: Lookin' forward to your next fight, Champs!

Japanese.Text: 連戦連勝だったな　お疲れさん！

English.Text: Wow! You guys were unstoppable!

Japanese.Text: あんたの剣さばき　シビれたよ！

English.Text: Gotta say, you're one hell of a swordsman!

Japanese.Text: ディオ軍団　最高だったわよ！

English.Text: Omigosh, you guys seriously cleaned up!

Japanese.Text:
コルネオをぶっ飛ばしてくれて
ありがとね～！

English.Text: Thanks for showing that ugly skeezeball who's boss!

Japanese.Text:
ナイスファイト！
最高の試合だったわ

English.Text: Nice one! That's the best match I've seen in a minute!

Japanese.Text:
コルネオランドにならなくて
ホントよかった

English.Text: Glad we dodged that bullet. Can you imagine?

Japanese.Text:
ルーファウス社長が出てくるなんて
スペシャルにもほどがあるでしょ

English.Text: That match lived up to its billing! Didn't think the president would show!

Japanese.Text:
明日　ここバトルスクエアにてネーミングライツを
賭けた決戦　スペシャルマッチを開催いたします！

English.Text: Tomorrow, Musclehead Colosseum will host an epic contest to decide the fate of the Gold Saucer!

Japanese.Text: 観戦希望の方はチケットをご購入ください！

English.Text: Pick up your tickets for the match before it's too late!

Japanese.Text:
我らがカリスマディオ園長が明日ゴールドソーサーを
背負いスペシャルマッチに挑みます！

English.Text: The very destiny of the Gold Saucer rests upon the shoulders of our Director Dio and his mighty champions.

Japanese.Text: 皆様　応援をよろしくお願いします！

English.Text: Let's make sure they know we're all rooting for them!

Japanese.Text:
まもなく
スペシャルマッチが始まります

English.Text: The battle of the ages is here!

Japanese.Text:
ウォール・マーケットからの刺客
コルネオファミリーが

English.Text: To the victor go the naming rights to the Gold Saucer!

Japanese.Text:
ディオ軍団とネーミングライツを賭けて
熱いバトルを繰り広げます！

English.Text: This clash will pit the Corneo Family against Dio's Champions!

Japanese.Text: 決して　お見逃しのないように！

English.Text: You won't wanna miss it!

Japanese.Text:
これより　園長率いるディオ軍団とコルネオ
ファミリーがマッスルコロシアムにて激突します！

English.Text: Director Dio is about to lead his champions into battle against the Corneo Family at the Musclehead Colosseum.

Japanese.Text:
観戦チケットは　まだございます
いっしょにディオ園長を応援しましょう

English.Text: Tickets are still available, so grab yours now and show your support for the director!

Japanese.Text:
熱い戦いの後には　プロテインを飲んで
上質な筋肉を手に入れましょう！

English.Text: You want real gains!? Then you wanna slam one of our protein shakes after your match!

Japanese.Text:
ディオ園長も毎日飲んでいる
特製プロテイン　ぜひみなさんもどうぞ

English.Text: The director himself drinks one every day! So get with the winning program already!

Japanese.Text: はあ～　ふんっ！

English.Text: Hrg... Hn!

Japanese.Text: 今日もキレてるッスよ　兄貴！

English.Text: Whoa! You're friggin' jacked today!

Japanese.Text: ふう～　むんっ！

English.Text: Hmph! ...Arg!

Japanese.Text:
すげえッス
ベヒーモスの背中みたいッス！

English.Text: Those muscles are insane! You're cut like a behemoth!

Japanese.Text: むう～　せいっ！

English.Text: Urhn... Hya!

Japanese.Text: これなら　次の試合も楽勝ッスね！

English.Text: Whoever's facing you in your next match is so dead!

Japanese.Text: そろそろ出番だ　絶対に勝つぞ！

English.Text: This is our time, guys! We're gonna win this thing!

Japanese.Text: おう！

English.Text: Rah!

Japanese.Text: 勝ったら　みんなで飲み明かそうぜ！

English.Text: And when we do, we're gonna party!

Japanese.Text: おう！

English.Text: Hooah!

Japanese.Text:
俺さ　この試合に勝ったら
彼女にプロポーズするんだ

English.Text: I'm counting on you all, 'cause once we've hit it big...I'mma ask my girl to marry me.

Japanese.Text: お……おう

English.Text: Yeah... Hmm...

Japanese.Text: なんか　すごく負けそうな気がしてきた

English.Text: Dunno about this next fight... Hope we don't blow it.

Japanese.Text:
マッスルコロシアムの観戦チケットは
こちらで販売中です

English.Text: Come and get your spectator tickets for the Musclehead Colosseum!

Japanese.Text: 極限のバトルに酔いしれてみませんか？

English.Text: Watch the best of the best duking it out!

Japanese.Text:
コロシアムに参戦をご希望のお客様は
出場者用カウンターへお声がけください

English.Text: Is spectating not enough? Wanna step inside the ring!? Head to our entrants' counter to learn more!

Japanese.Text:
スペシャルマッチのチケットが
残りわずかとなっています！

English.Text: We still have a few tickets left for today's special contest!

Japanese.Text:
観戦をご希望のお客様は
お早めに　お買い求めください！

English.Text: Don't miss your chance to see this once-in-a-lifetime event!

Japanese.Text:
園長のＴシャツを買えるのは
ここだけ！

English.Text: Lookin' for a Dio T-shirt? We got you covered!

Japanese.Text:
プロテインを飲むのに最適な
マッスルカップも　ごいっしょにどうぞ

English.Text: Got Musclehead cups too─perfect for knocking back protein shakes!

Japanese.Text:
忠犬スタンプのぬいぐるみ
入荷しました～！

English.Text: Stamp plushies right here! Get 'em before they're gone!

Japanese.Text:
デブチョコボとデブモーグリの
『ふくふくセット』はいかがですか？

English.Text: Buy a fat chocobo and moogle and save with our Pudgy Pair combo!

Japanese.Text:
『チョコサボトン』を連れて帰って
ご自宅をゴールドソーサーにしませんか

English.Text: Grab our trio of iconic mascots, and take home a piece of the Gold Saucer!

Japanese.Text: 電気系統のトラブルってなんだろ

English.Text: What's this "electrical trouble"?

Japanese.Text: ほかのスクエアはやってんのかな

English.Text: Are the other squares still running?

Japanese.Text: これからどうする？

English.Text: Well, now what?

Japanese.Text: しかたないよ　また来ればいいさ

English.Text: Oh well. Gotta come back another time.

Japanese.Text: せっかく並んだのに～

English.Text: All that waiting for nothing!

Japanese.Text: いったん　ホテルに戻る？

English.Text: Back to the hotel for a bit?

Japanese.Text: いつごろ再開するのかな

English.Text: Wonder when they're gonna start it back up.

Japanese.Text:
電気系統のトラブルにしては
ちょっと大げさすぎない？

English.Text: Seems like overkill for electrical problems, don'tcha think?

Japanese.Text:
申し訳ありません
すみやかに　移動をお願いします

English.Text: Once again, we are terribly sorry for the inconvenience!

Japanese.Text: スタッフの誘導に従って　お進みください

English.Text: Please follow the nearest staff members' instructions!

Japanese.Text: ただいま　出入口が非常に混雑しています

English.Text: The entrance is heavily congested.

Japanese.Text: お急ぎの方は　Ｇモーグリをお使いください

English.Text: If you're in a hurry, please use a guide moogle.

Japanese.Text:
申し訳ありません
Ｇモーグリでの移動をお願いします

English.Text: We strongly encourage you to make use of the guide moogles.

Japanese.Text:
うう　高いところ
怖くないよな？

English.Text: I'm... I'm totally not scared of heights, y'know.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラに乗るのって
これで何度目だっけ？

English.Text: So this'll be our, what─fifteenth ride?

Japanese.Text: ふう　座ってゆっくりできそうだな

English.Text: Whew... Can finally get off my feet for a bit.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラに乗りながら
次　どこ行くか決めようぜ

English.Text: Let's figure out what we wanna do next once we're on the Skywheel.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラって１周するのに
どれぐらいかかるんだろ？

English.Text: How long you think one full trip around the Skywheel takes?

Japanese.Text: ゴンドラ　楽しみだね

English.Text: Ooh, I'm so excited!

Japanese.Text:
並びながら　おしゃべりしてる時が
いっちばん楽しいかも

English.Text: I don't mind the long lines much at all. They give us more time to chat!

Japanese.Text: やっぱり　カップルが多いね

English.Text: Wow, look at all the couples.

Japanese.Text: ドキドキしてきた……

English.Text: My heart's pounding...

Japanese.Text: まあ　ゴンドラは外せないよね

English.Text: You can't pass up a ride on the Skywheel.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラに揺られながら
ステキな思い出を作ってみませんか？

English.Text: There's no better place to make lasting memories than amongst the stars.

Japanese.Text:
さあ　恋人の手をとって
黄金の景色を巡る旅に出かけましょう

English.Text: Embark on a magical journey into the sky and see our golden paradise like never before!

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラの旅に出る準備は
整いましたか？

English.Text: Are you ready to embark on an adventure through the skies?

Japanese.Text:
大切な人との特別な時間を
お楽しみください

English.Text: We hope this experience is one that you'll cherish for the rest of your life.

Japanese.Text:
ポイントで　恋人へのプレゼントを
購入されてみてはいかがでしょう？

English.Text: Why not exchange some of your points and get a gift for that special someone?

Japanese.Text: ゴールドポイントをご利用ですか？

English.Text: Care to spend some of your points?

Japanese.Text:
ゴンドラに乗って
ステキな思い出を作ってくださいね

English.Text: If you're looking to escape the crowds, why not try the Skywheel?

Japanese.Text: 引き続き　ゴールドソーサーをお楽しみください

English.Text: We hope you continue to enjoy your time at the Saucer.

Japanese.Text:
ヒヒヒヒヒ……
俺も吊られてみたいわ～

English.Text: Hehehe... I'd love to have his job.

Japanese.Text:
ここの部屋は　死体みたいに
よく眠れるんだよな

English.Text: Here at the Haunted Hotel, I can sleep like the dead...

Japanese.Text:
なんか背筋がゾクゾクしてきた
実はオレ　霊感があるんだよね

English.Text: I'm getting this tingling up and down my spine... Wait. Maybe I've got some kinda sixth sense?

Japanese.Text:
ここのベッドで寝ると
不思議な夢を見るらしいわ

English.Text: Something tells me I'm going to have the worst nightmares when I go to bed.

Japanese.Text: 本当に　幽霊が出る部屋があるんだって

English.Text: I heard one of the rooms is literally haunted.

Japanese.Text:
ルームサービスもオススメよ
トンベリロボが料理を運んでくれるの

English.Text: The room service here is next level. A tonberry robot delivers your food right to your doorstep!

Japanese.Text:
ヒヒヒ……お憑かれのようですね
休憩されますか？

English.Text: Hehehe... Is fatigue haunting your every footstep? Take a load off.

Japanese.Text:
永遠に目覚めないかもしれませんが
よろしいですか？　ヒヒヒ……

English.Text: Care to rest in peace with us? Our beds are so comfortable, you'll sleep like the dead!

Japanese.Text: またいつでもお越しください　ヒヒヒ……

English.Text: We hope you drop in again soon. Hehehe!

Japanese.Text: いってらっしゃいませ　ヒヒヒ……

English.Text: Farewell, and take care. Hehehe!

Japanese.Text: なにか　ご用かしら？

English.Text: How can I help you...?

Japanese.Text: うふふふふ……

English.Text: Hee hee hee...

Japanese.Text: イヒヒヒヒ……

English.Text: Mwahaha...

Japanese.Text: ウヒヒヒヒヒ！

English.Text: Gahaha!

Japanese.Text: キャアアア！

English.Text: Aaah!

Japanese.Text: うふふふ……

English.Text: Heh...hehehe...

Japanese.Text: 友達から聞いた話なんだけど

English.Text: So a friend told me this story.

Japanese.Text:
深夜零時ごろ
部屋の外から物音がしたんだって

English.Text: One evening, right around midnight, he hears a sound outside his room.

Japanese.Text:
それでドアスコープを覗いてみたら
そこには　トンベリロボがいて

English.Text: So he gets up, goes over to the door and looks through the peephole. Sees an old tonberry robot.

Japanese.Text:
血のしたたる包丁を握りしめながら
ゆ～っくり　ゆ～っくり……
廊下を歩いていたんだと

English.Text: Battered little thing with a huge knife dripping blood as he shuffles down the hallway─real slow─till he's out of sight...

Japanese.Text: マジかよ……

English.Text: C'mon, man...

Japanese.Text:
むかし　心ない客に壊された
トンベリロボがいたらしい

English.Text: Oh, it's true. Was looking for the jerk who smashed it up.

Japanese.Text:
そいつは　夜な夜なホテルを徘徊し
マナーの悪い客を見つけ出しては
グサッ……グサッ……グサッ！

English.Text: Night after night, that tonberry stalks the hotel halls─seeking revenge. And if it crosses paths with ill-mannered guests that remind it of the one who did it wrong...

Japanese.Text: 包丁を突き刺してるって話だ

English.Text: Stab! Right through their heart.

Japanese.Text: トンベリロボのうらみ　おっかねえな

English.Text: A robot with a grudge... Scary stuff.

Japanese.Text:
聞いて　モルボルの部屋が取れたの！
ずっと泊ってみたかったんだ

English.Text: You won't believe this, but I finally got the malboro room. I've heard it's to die for.

Japanese.Text:
アメニティが全部モルボルなんだよね
たのしみ～！

English.Text: I can't wait to spend an entire night surrounded by malboro everything.

Japanese.Text:
いいな～
私は今回もマンドラゴラ

English.Text: Now that's the stuff of dreams. I'm in the mandragora room, myself.

Japanese.Text:
悲鳴の目覚ましで早起きして
ゴールドソーサーを楽しむつもり

English.Text: There's no better way to start your day at the Gold Saucer than to be woken by the sound of screams.

Japanese.Text: いいね！

English.Text: I love it.

Japanese.Text:
さて　モルボルも取れたし
次はどの部屋に泊まろうかな～

English.Text: But now that I've managed to book the Malboro Suite, which should I try next? Decisions, decisions...

Japanese.Text:
ベヒーモスルームを狙いたいけど
ファミリータイプなんだよね

English.Text: I'd like to stay in the behemoth, but alas, that one's reserved for families only...

Japanese.Text:
あっ　じゃあいっしょに泊まろうよ
折半すれば安くなるし

English.Text: Oh, I know! Why don't we book it together? Half the cost, double the fun.

Japanese.Text:
いいの？　やった
ベヒーモスで全ルーム制覇なんだよね

English.Text: Are you sure? That would be perfect! One night in the behemoth room is all I need to complete my suite conquest!

Japanese.Text:
私　数日前にゾンビに噛まれたんです……
ポイントを交換するなら　いまのうちですよ

English.Text: Just so you know, I was bitten by a zombie a few days ago. If you want to exchange your points, you'd better hurry before I turn.

Japanese.Text:
はあはあ……もうダメかも
ゴールドポイントを　はやく……！

English.Text: I think it's starting... Quick─your points, before it's too late!

Japanese.Text: 私の意識があるうちに　また来てくださいね

English.Text: Come back soon! Because I don't think I have that much time left.

Japanese.Text: いますぐ逃げて　私がゾンビになるまえに……

English.Text: Run while you still can! Before I get you too!

Japanese.Text:
はあはあ……
ゴールドポイントを　はやく……

English.Text: Giiive meee poiiints...

Japanese.Text: ありがとうございました……

English.Text: Thaaank youuu...

Japanese.Text: 歌詞コンテストの結果　楽しみだよね

English.Text: I can't wait to see who wins the contest!

Japanese.Text:
歌詞コンテストは俺がもらったぜ
最高傑作を応募したからな！

English.Text: There's no way I didn't win the contest. Those are the absolute best lyrics I've ever written!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　もうこんな時間？
ワンダースクエアしか遊んでないのに

English.Text: Is that seriously the time!? But I've only done Wonderment Square so far!

Japanese.Text:
子供がワンダースクエアから
動こうとしないんです

English.Text: I'm dying to see the rest of the park, but my kid refuses to budge!

Japanese.Text: さてと　どのゲームで遊ぼっかな

English.Text: Now let's see, which game should I play?

Japanese.Text: よし　負けたほうがおごりだぞ！

English.Text: You asked for it! Loser's buying tonight!

Japanese.Text:
３Ｄバトラーこそ戦略を練らないと
勢いで戦っても勝てないぜ？

English.Text: Can't win at 3D Brawler with aggression alone. Positioning is key so you can punish mistakes.

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーにきても
やっぱりカードバウトしちまうんだよな

English.Text: I know there's all kinds of things to do here, but I always end up playing cards.

Japanese.Text: 興奮しすぎて　もう大変！

English.Text: The lights, the sounds─everything! I'm flipping out!

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと休憩
目がチカチカしてきちゃった

English.Text: Okay, time out! All these lights are hurting my eyes.

Japanese.Text:
ふふふ……
私の腕前を見せる時がきたわね

English.Text: Heh heh heh... Time to unleash my inner gamer girl.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　どのゲームから勝負する？

English.Text: So which game should I beat you at first?

Japanese.Text:
ウェルカムショーで３Ｄバトラーを見て
やってみたいと思ってたんだよね

English.Text: After I saw 3D Brawler in the welcome show, I knew I had to try it!

Japanese.Text:
バイクゲームに熱中してたら
友達に置いていかれたんだけど

English.Text: I got a little too into that bike game... My friend left and I didn't even notice!

Japanese.Text:
ママはお芝居　パパはコロシアム
僕はゲーム　自由時間サイコ～！

English.Text: Mom's watching a play, and dad's off at the colosseum, which means I get to play all the games I want. This rules!

Japanese.Text:
３Ｄバトラーなら
大人にだって負けないよ

English.Text: No one can beat me at fighting games─not even a grown-up!

Japanese.Text:
パパを３Ｄバトラーで
コテンパンにしたら　すねちゃった

English.Text: My dad acted like a big baby when I kicked his virtual butt!

Japanese.Text:
神羅のバイク部隊に入るために
いまからＧバイクで練習しとくんだ

English.Text: I gotta practice as much as I can with G-Bike if I wanna make it into the mobile unit!

Japanese.Text: ねえねえ　なにして遊ぶ？

English.Text: Hey, what game are we gonna play now!?

Japanese.Text:
わあ～　すごい
おあそびの天国みたい！

English.Text: Whoooa! This place is like game heaven!

Japanese.Text:
うちのママ　バイクに乗ると
性格が変わるんだよね

English.Text: My mom is like a completely different person when she plays that bike game.

Japanese.Text:
ここに今度
新しいゲームができるんだって

English.Text: Apparently they're working on setting up a whole new game here!

Japanese.Text:
噂ではスノー……
いや　やっぱナイショ

English.Text: Rumors say it's a snow─ Um, actually, I'll leave it a surprise.

Japanese.Text: なに　教えてよ

English.Text: C'mon, don't leave me hanging!

Japanese.Text:
できてからのお楽しみ～！
またいっしょに遊びにこようね

English.Text: You'll see once it's done! We'll come back and play it together.

Japanese.Text: さあ　おえかきショータイムの始まりよ

English.Text: Okay, everyone─let the art show begin!

Japanese.Text: なにができあがるか　当ててみてね！

English.Text: Try and see if you can guess what I'm painting!

Japanese.Text: は～い　これで完成！

English.Text: Aaand all finished!

Japanese.Text:
ばうわう　ばうわう
『忠犬スタンプ』のできあがり！

English.Text: Bow wow wow! Bow wow wow! If you guessed Stamp: you're right!

Japanese.Text: おっ　すげえコーナリング！

English.Text: Now that's some sick cornering.

Japanese.Text:
スタートで
もたついたのが響いてるな

English.Text: That slow start's gonna cost 'em later.

Japanese.Text: いまのライン取り　俺もマネしよう

English.Text: I oughta stick to that racing line too.

Japanese.Text: Ｇバイク　かっこいいよね

English.Text: G-Bike is the coolest game.

Japanese.Text:
すっごく遅いけど
安全運転って感じでイイね

English.Text: Takin' it real slow, huh? Nothin' wrong with playin' it safe.

Japanese.Text:
あらら～　ボロボロじゃん
このバイカーの後ろは乗りたくないな

English.Text: Oof. Talk about a rough ride. Wouldn't wanna hop on the back of that bike.

Japanese.Text:
どうだった　オレの超絶コンボ！
やばかったろ～

English.Text: That combo I landed was sick. I was playin' out of my mind!

Japanese.Text:
いや　せっかく仲良くなった女の子を
ボコボコにしてどうすんだよ

English.Text: Yeah, you must be out of your mind to beat the crap outta that girl. She was flirting with you!

Japanese.Text: どっか行っちゃったじゃねえか！

English.Text: You scared her off, dude!

Japanese.Text:
ふっ　素人が相手でも手を抜かないのが
真の３Ｄバトラーってワケよ

English.Text: Hmph! A true 3D Brawler never pulls his punches, no matter the opponent!

Japanese.Text: なあ　こいつをボコボコにしようぜ

English.Text: I'm about to "pull some punches" right into your idiot face!

Japanese.Text:
カードの用意はいいですか？
さあ　レッツ・バウト！

English.Text:
Got your deck in order?
If so, then it's time to throw down!

Japanese.Text:
凄腕のバウターたちがそろっていますよ
さあ　レッツ・エンジョイ！

English.Text: We've got a number of superstar cardslingers here today! Go on, show 'em what you got!

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　ほかのゲームをレッツ・エンジョイ！

English.Text: S'all good. Hope you find some other games to enjoy!

Japanese.Text: 遊びたくなったら　またきてくださいね！

English.Text: Be sure to come on back next time the card bug bites!

Japanese.Text: ハァ～イ　ゴールドポイントは貯まってる～？

English.Text: Hey there! Got a big pile of points to trade me?

Japanese.Text: ヤッホ～　ポイントの交換所はここだよ～！

English.Text: Yoo-hoo! You can trade your points in right here. With me!

Japanese.Text: ポイントが貯まったら　またきてね～！

English.Text: Make sure to come back once you've racked up more points!

Japanese.Text: それじゃ　バイバ～イ！

English.Text: Bye! Hope to see you again!

Japanese.Text:
今日は頭がさえてるから
負ける気しないよ

English.Text: I am on today. Hope y'all ready to lose.

Japanese.Text:
ぼく　クイーンズ・ブラッド
好きなんですよ

English.Text: I'm actually really into Queen's Blood right now.

Japanese.Text:
勝ち負けより　楽しい時間を
過ごせたかどうかが大切なんですよ

English.Text: Phew! Competition's so hot, I'm starting to feel a little feverish!

Japanese.Text: 頭ガンガンする……知恵熱かな？

English.Text: My head is pounding... Maybe I'm putting too much thought into this game.

Japanese.Text: よっしゃ　燃えてきた～！

English.Text: Now I'm really gettin' fired up!

Japanese.Text:
勝負が終わったら　すぐ結果の分析
それが強くなるコツ

English.Text: Reflect on your matches as soon as they're over─while it's all still fresh. That's how you get good.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
見てるだけでも面白いな

English.Text: Queen's Blood's just as much fun to watch as it is to play.

Japanese.Text: カードバウトの調子はどうだ？

English.Text: Just watching stresses me out...

Japanese.Text: なるほど　そうきたか

English.Text: Ooh, that's a good play!

Japanese.Text: 集中集中　がんばって！

English.Text: You got this! Just keep your head in the game!

Japanese.Text: ここが正念場だぞ

English.Text: It's do-or-die now!

Japanese.Text:
どんなバウトが見れるのかな
ワクワクする！

English.Text: I just hope we get to see some real matches today.

Japanese.Text: 次はクイーンズ・ブラッドやりたい！

English.Text: Maybe I'll give Queen's Blood a try.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
やったことないんだけど

English.Text: I can't say I've ever played this "Queen's Blood" thing...

Japanese.Text: むむ　オリジナリティあふれる一手

English.Text: Huh. Never seen anyone try that before.

Japanese.Text: おお　そこから逆転狙うのね！

English.Text: Hey, it's okay! You haven't lost yet!

Japanese.Text: ふう　最高だった……

English.Text: That was transcendent.

Japanese.Text: 鳥肌が　まだおさまらん

English.Text: I've still got goose bumps all over.

Japanese.Text: 主演の女優がマジで圧巻だったな

English.Text: The leading lady was absolutely stunning.

Japanese.Text:
あの人数で踊ってピッタリ合うの
やばくないか？

English.Text: All those dancers in perfect sync? What a show!

Japanese.Text: 胸がいっぱいで動けないや

English.Text: I'm still reeling from that performance.

Japanese.Text: うう……本当によかった～

English.Text: Oh... It was just so beautiful!

Japanese.Text: どうしよう　まだドキドキしてる

English.Text: My heart's still racing! I can't make it stop!

Japanese.Text: セットの作り込み　すごくなかった？

English.Text: That set design was like nothing I've ever seen!

Japanese.Text: 始まってすぐに泣いちゃうんだよね

English.Text: I just start bawling the second the show starts!

Japanese.Text:
その日から　サボテンダーを従えて
砂漠の秘宝を守るようになりました

English.Text: And from that day on, he took his place as guardian of the treasure of the sands.

Japanese.Text: 舞台に集中しすぎて疲れちゃった

English.Text: Their performance was just so enthralling!

Japanese.Text: もしかしたら　いまでも砂漠のどこかでは

English.Text: Some believe that he's still out there, somewhere...

Japanese.Text:
秘宝を狙う盗賊とゴブリンたちが
バトルを繰り広げているのかもしれませんね

English.Text: doing battle with anyone who would try to steal the precious treasure of the sands.

Japanese.Text: ご清聴　ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you all for listening.

Japanese.Text:
これより休憩タイムとなります
次の公演まで　しばらくお待ちください

English.Text: After a short break, we'll return with the next show. Be sure to stick around for it!

Japanese.Text:
ご機嫌うるわしゅう　我がお客様
ゴールドポイントはお持ちかな？

English.Text: Good day and well met, most esteemed guest. Perchance you have points for me?

Japanese.Text:
お客様のゴールドポイントは
我が命を懸けて　交換いたしましょう

English.Text: May I say what a tremendous honor it is to exchange these points for you.

Japanese.Text: お客様と再会できる日を　心待ちにしています

English.Text: I shall eagerly await our next interaction.

Japanese.Text:
またいつか　この僕に
お客様のポイントを託してください

English.Text: I pray you will entrust me with your points again. Till then, adieu.

Japanese.Text: はやくワンダースクエアに行きたい～

English.Text: I wanna go to Wonderment Square!

Japanese.Text:
役者って　歌っておどって
楽しそうだね

English.Text: Being an actor looks so fun! You get to sing and dance!

Japanese.Text: ふわあ……寝ちゃった～

English.Text: I fell asleep.

Japanese.Text: 拍手しすぎて　手がまっかっか！

English.Text: I clapped so much my hands turned red!

Japanese.Text:
おはなしは難しかったけど
キレイだったね

English.Text: I couldn't follow the story, but it was super pretty!

Japanese.Text:
あんないっぱいのセリフ
どうやって覚えるんだろ？

English.Text: How do they remember all their lines? There's so many!

Japanese.Text: 当日券は　もうないってよ！

English.Text: Oh, damn... They're all sold out!

Japanese.Text:
ＶＩＰ席を予約しておいたから
ワインを飲みながら　ゆっくり見ようよ

English.Text: I scored us VIP seats, so we can sip some nice wine and enjoy the show!

Japanese.Text:
この劇場
ドレスコードってあったっけ？

English.Text: Uh-oh, does this theater have a dress code?

Japanese.Text: 街の小さな劇場とは　なにもかも違うな

English.Text: This place blows our town's piddly theater right outta the water!

Japanese.Text:
うしろの席から見ると
役者の実力がわかるぞ

English.Text: I prefer the cheap seats. Actors play to the back row anyway!

Japanese.Text:
不朽の名作をどうアレンジしてるか
見ものだな

English.Text: Loveless is such a classic. I can't wait to see this troupe's spin on it!

Japanese.Text: いつか俺も　ここの舞台に立つぞ！

English.Text: One day, I'm gonna be singing on that stage.

Japanese.Text: ギリギリでナイトショーが取れたよ

English.Text: I managed to nab some tickets for the night show!

Japanese.Text: かなり難解な話だけど　寝ないでね

English.Text: This might be hard to follow, but try to stay awake.

Japanese.Text: 神席すぎて　心臓が持つか心配

English.Text: I can't believe I got the best seat in the house!

Japanese.Text: 開演の前に　お化粧を直しとこっと

English.Text: Better fix my makeup before curtain-up.

Japanese.Text:
ホテルがサプライズでＶＩＰ席を
用意してくれたの　新婚祝いだって！

English.Text: This place is so nice! They gave us VIP tickets for our honeymoon!

Japanese.Text:
ＶＩＰ席のお料理
どれも美味しかった～

English.Text: The food in the VIP seats was to die for!

Japanese.Text:
トップスターもいいけど
私は脇役のほうが味わい深くて好き

English.Text: The lead was great, but it was the supporting cast that really stole the show.

Japanese.Text:
今夜の『LOVELESS』は　演出も音楽も
すべてが特別な豪華版らしいよ

English.Text: From what I've heard, they're pulling out all the stops for tonight's production of Loveless!

Japanese.Text:
歌詞コンテストは俺がもらったぜ
最高傑作を応募したからな！

English.Text: There's no way I didn't win the contest. Those are the absolute best lyrics I've ever written!

Japanese.Text:
この公演をずっと楽しみにしてたんだよ
まさか　上演してくれるとは

English.Text: I'm so glad they put this show together. I've been waiting forever to see it in person!

Japanese.Text:
『Gエディション』は
観客参加型の特別なプログラムらしいぜ

English.Text: The G Edition of the show allows for audience participation. Isn't that exciting?

Japanese.Text:
歌詞コンテストの作品を読んだけど
フラワーなんとかって人のが良かったな

English.Text: I read all the entries for the songwriting contest, and I really liked the one by that Maycomb person.

Japanese.Text: 歌詞コンテストの結果　楽しみだよね

English.Text: I can't wait to see who wins the contest!

Japanese.Text:
『LOVELESS・Gエディション』は
主演女優が降板して
ずっとお蔵入りしてたんだって

English.Text: Apparently, the reason Loveless got shelved for so long is 'cause the lead actress quit without warning.

Japanese.Text:
わたし　八番街育ちだからね
『LOVELESS』にはうるさいわよ

English.Text: I grew up in Sector 8, so trust me when I say I know everything about Loveless.

Japanese.Text: 新機軸の『LOVELESS』だったな！

English.Text: I've never seen Loveless like that before!

Japanese.Text: 最後に出てきた歌手って誰？

English.Text: Who was that singer at the end of the show?

Japanese.Text:
エンディングの曲って
歌詞コンテストのやつだろ？

English.Text: Was the final number the one from the songwriting contest?

Japanese.Text:
女神役の役者が良かったな
次の作品も絶対に見るよ

English.Text: That talent who played the Goddess was divine! I need to see what they're in next.

Japanese.Text:
うう……俺
感動でなにも言えねえ

English.Text: ...I don't know what to say... That was beautiful.

Japanese.Text: こんな舞台　はじめて！

English.Text: I've never seen a play like that before!

Japanese.Text:
フラワー・キーパーさんの歌詞
胸に染みたわ

English.Text: Maycomb Blume's lyrics hit me like an arrow straight to the heart.

Japanese.Text: 最後の曲　販売されたら絶対買う！

English.Text: I hope they release that song as a single. I need it!

Japanese.Text: アルフリードのファンになっちゃった

English.Text: I think I just became Alphreid's number one fan!

Japanese.Text: 本当にお芝居の中にいるみたいだった

English.Text: Wow... It felt like I was right there in the middle of the action.

Japanese.Text:
申し訳ございません
本日の前売り券は完売となっております

English.Text: I repeat─advance tickets for tonight's performance have sold out!

Japanese.Text:
当日券は　開演の１時間前より
先着順での販売となります

English.Text: Same-day tickets will be available for purchase one hour before the show!

Japanese.Text: ご希望のお客様は　お並びください

English.Text: Please line up here to wait!

Japanese.Text:
同じ演目を何度も見てるけど
毎回違うから　まったく飽きないよね

English.Text: I've seen this show I don't know how many times, but somehow it never hits me the same way.

Japanese.Text:
内容は同じでも　役者の体を通すことで
いい意味で揺らぎが生まれるんだよな

English.Text: It's great how a play can feel so different just by switching up the performers and adding new nuances.

Japanese.Text:
そうそう　私ぐらいになると
役者がミスしてくれたほうが嬉しいよ

English.Text: I know, right? I've even come to appreciate those unexpected moments when an actor flubs their lines.

Japanese.Text: わかる　アドリブが増えて面白いよな

English.Text: Yeah, me too. I say bring on the ad-libs!

Japanese.Text:
勉強になるかと思ったけど
うちの劇団とはスケールが違いすぎたわ

English.Text: I figured these actors could teach us a thing or two, but they're so good, they put our troupe to shame.

Japanese.Text: でも　脚本は負けてないと思いました

English.Text: But hey, at least we know your scripts are good.

Japanese.Text: 劇場の大きさはどうしようもないとして

English.Text: Too bad our stage is too small for them.

Japanese.Text:
問題は座長の脚本をうまく演じられない
僕たち役者陣の実力不足かと

English.Text: But the real problem is us. We can't do your characters justice. We just don't have the acting chops...

Japanese.Text:
劇団員を導けていない時点で
座長である私の力が足りてないのよ

English.Text: No, the fault lies with me. As the director, I'm the one who needs to bring it all together.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　最高峰を確認したことで
進むべき道が明確になったわね

English.Text: ...At least seeing the best of the best in action has helped us learn what we need to improve.

Japanese.Text:
ですね　さっそく帰って
稽古をしましょう！

English.Text: Right! So let's head back and work on our craft!

Japanese.Text:
ただいま　アルフリード様の
メモリアルブックの予約を受付中です！

English.Text: We're now accepting pre-orders for commemorative Alphreid photo books!

Japanese.Text: 初回限定版は　なんとサイン付き！

English.Text: The limited first edition comes autographed!

Japanese.Text:
メモリアルブックをいま予約すると
お渡し会の参加券がついてきます

English.Text: Buy now for a ticket to a meet and greet, and get your book from the hero himself!

Japanese.Text: この機会にぜひ　お買い求めください！

English.Text: Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity!

Japanese.Text:
今日見る『LOVELESS』は
古来より伝わる叙事詩が原作の舞台だ

English.Text: Not every family gets to see Loveless, or reads the epic upon which it's based.

Japanese.Text:
社交界では必須の教養だから
よく見ておくように

English.Text: A cultured young man will be expected to know it quite well.

Japanese.Text:
原作のほうなら読んだよ
最後がよくわからなかったな

English.Text: But I already know it. I just didn't understand the ending.

Japanese.Text:
その感想は正しい　原作の最終章は
いまだに発見されてないからな

English.Text: That's because it is not the ending. The final portion of the poem remains lost to time.

Japanese.Text:
その謎に多くの人間が魅了されてきた
かくいう私も　そのひとりだ

English.Text: Many a passionate individual has found themselves enthralled by the mystery of it─myself included.

Japanese.Text:
甘美な謎が不朽の名作にしたってワケか
僕にはすこしロマンチックすぎるな

English.Text: So it's the mystery that makes it a timeless classic? I suppose...but I could do without the sappy romance.

Japanese.Text:
イベントスクエアにお越しの皆々さま
これより『サボテン大王』を始めます！

English.Text: Attention all Event Square guests! Our Cactuar King show is about to begin!

Japanese.Text: 準備は　よろしいですか？

English.Text: Is everyone ready?

Japanese.Text:
それでは　灼熱の砂漠に
皆様をご案内しましょう！

English.Text: We're about to be whisked off to the desert, where cactuars reign supreme!

Japanese.Text:
ある日　キッドＧという名前のゴブリンが
サボテン王国を目指して旅をしていました

English.Text: Once upon a time, a goblin named Kid G set out for the faraway kingdom of the cactuars.

Japanese.Text:
何日も何日も砂漠を歩き続け
ようやく　サボテン王国に辿り着きます

English.Text: He walked for days and days across the hot sand, until finally he reached his destination.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　そこに立ちふさがる
色とりどりのサボテンダーたち！

English.Text: All of a sudden, he was surrounded by colorful cactuars!

Japanese.Text:
キッドＧは好戦的な笑みを浮かべ
グローブを握りしめます

English.Text: Kid G grinned menacingly, clutching his glove.

Japanese.Text: カーンと鳴り響くゴング！

English.Text: "Klang!" rang the gong!

Japanese.Text:
すばやく動きまわるサボテンダーたち
華麗なフットワークで応戦するキッドＧ

English.Text: The cactuars sprang into action, but Kid G was even faster!

Japanese.Text: ジャブ　ジャブ　ストレート！

English.Text: Jab! Jab! Straight!

Japanese.Text:
強烈なパンチが次々と決まり
見事ノックアウト　カンカンカン！

English.Text: With his every punch, he scored knockout after knockout! Ding ding ding!

Japanese.Text:
すると　激しい戦いを終えたキッドＧのまえに
王冠を被ったサボテン大王がやってきました

English.Text: Soon, only one cactuar remained: a big one, with a shiny crown on his head─the king!

Japanese.Text:
キッドＧは大王に　いにしえの盟約に従い
砂漠の秘宝を守りにきたのだと告げました

English.Text: Kid G told the king that he'd come to protect the treasure of the sands─to honor and fulfill an ancient pact.

Japanese.Text: 大王に認められたキッドＧは

English.Text: The king welcomed Kid G.

Japanese.Text:
減給かな
まさか　クビはないよな？

English.Text: Shit... Late again. I'm in for it now.

Japanese.Text: 終わった　またしても遅刻

English.Text:
Wait, he wouldn't fire me, would he?
A pay cut, sure, but...

Japanese.Text: バトルスクエアの迫力　ヤバかったね！

English.Text: Man, everything about Battle Square was badass!

Japanese.Text:
くっそ～
クラウドに賭けときゃよかった

English.Text: Son of a bitch! Shoulda just trusted my gut!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　勝ってくれて
本当にありがとう！

English.Text: I can't thank you enough for winning, Cloud! You're the best!

Japanese.Text: なんだ　なんだ？

English.Text: What the hell was that?

Japanese.Text: おいおい　どうなってんだよ

English.Text: World's gettin' kinda crazy, huh?

Japanese.Text:
あそこにいるのって
究極の遊び人だろ？

English.Text: Yo. Isn't that the Ultimate Party Animal?

Japanese.Text: おお　神羅課長が勝負するのか？

English.Text: Oh snap, is the UPA gonna throw down?

Japanese.Text: 挑戦者のお手並み拝見といこうか

English.Text: Alright then, let's see what this challenger can do!

Japanese.Text: 究極の遊び人からの挑戦状だって！

English.Text: The Ultimate Party Animal's putting on his own event!

Japanese.Text: 神羅課長に勝てるワケないのに

English.Text: Like anybody'd have a chance against that dude!

Japanese.Text: だれが神羅課長に挑戦するの？

English.Text: I wonder who's gonna take on the champion.

Japanese.Text: やっぱ強えな　神羅課長

English.Text: Yep, nobody can touch the king.

Japanese.Text: いい勝負だったのに　残念だったな

English.Text: That was a great match. Shame about the end.

Japanese.Text: リベンジ　楽しみにしてるぞ

English.Text: I'm looking forward to round two!

Japanese.Text: 究極への道は険しいわね

English.Text: The road to the top is rough and winding.

Japanese.Text: 応援してるから　次も頑張って

English.Text: You can do it─I believe in you!

Japanese.Text: 神羅課長が強すぎるのよ

English.Text: That guy's something else, huh?

Japanese.Text:
すげえな！
究極の遊び人に勝っちまいやがった

English.Text: Dude, how crazy is it that you beat the party animal!

Japanese.Text: まさか　神羅課長が負けるなんて

English.Text: I can't believe the UPA actually lost.

Japanese.Text: ナイスファイト　面白かったぞ！

English.Text: Killer fight, dude! Great stuff!

Japanese.Text: 究極の遊び人が負けたってホント？

English.Text: The Ultimate Party Animal seriously lost?

Japanese.Text: うそ　挑戦者が勝っちゃったの？

English.Text: The party animal lost!? No way!

Japanese.Text: 神羅課長に遊びで勝つなんて……

English.Text: Didn't think anyone partied harder than him.

Japanese.Text:
最高峰の遊び人バトル
シビれたぜ！

English.Text: That was wild─like, clash-of-the-gods wild!

Japanese.Text: 究極の遊び人になった気分はどうだ？

English.Text: How's it feel to be crowned the new UPA?

Japanese.Text: すげえ３Ｄバトルだったな！

English.Text: I've never seen a match like that!

Japanese.Text: ふたりの遊びっぷりに感動しちゃった

English.Text: You two were amazing─inspirational!

Japanese.Text: クラウドと神羅課長　どっちも最高！

English.Text: Both of you guys belong in the party animal hall of fame!

Japanese.Text: 究極の遊び人・クラウドの誕生だね

English.Text: I can't believe I got to witness the birth of a new legend!

Japanese.Text: 欲しいものは奪う　それがグリードよ

English.Text: You want something, you take it. That's just the way of the world.

Japanese.Text:
なんだコラ
見せモンじゃねえぞ

English.Text: What, what!? You got a problem, asshole?

Japanese.Text: また　馬鹿がカモられにきやがった

English.Text: Get a load of pretty boy here.

Japanese.Text: いいナリしてんじゃねえか

English.Text: You look like you got gil to spare.

Japanese.Text: くそ　ケツまでじゃりじゃりだぜ

English.Text: I swear, all this sand up my ass...

Japanese.Text:
コルネオの野郎が消えて
ブツが　余ってるようです

English.Text: Yeah, there's plenty to go around now that Corneo's in the wind.

Japanese.Text: あら　迷子かしら？

English.Text: Hey, honey. You lost?

Japanese.Text: へえ　面白いじゃないか

English.Text: Sounds like easy pickin's.

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサー潜入チャレンジ
またも失敗……

English.Text: I'll get into that golden paradise one of these days, I swear!

Japanese.Text:
次は　キグルミを着て
忍びこんでみよっかな？

English.Text: Oh! Maybe if I got my hands on a moogle costume...

Japanese.Text: ここはクズの見本市さ

English.Text: Welcome to society's trash heap.

Japanese.Text: プリズンオークションへ　ようこそ

English.Text: Welcome one and all!

Japanese.Text:
本日も　選りすぐりの商品を
取りそろえております

English.Text: We've got a fine selection for today's auction.

Japanese.Text: ぜひ　お買い逃がしのないように

English.Text: You're not gonna wanna miss out on these goods!

Japanese.Text:
それでは　まずは
１０００ギルから始めましょう

English.Text: The bid for our first lot starts at a thousand gil!

Japanese.Text:
皆様　暑い中
よくいらっしゃいました

English.Text: We thank you for joining us on this sweltering day.

Japanese.Text:
本日の商品も
すべて　ゲス様からの贈り物です

English.Text: As usual, everything here was kindly provided by the boss.

Japanese.Text:
ボスに感謝しつつ
競りを始めていきましょう

English.Text: So let's show our gratitude with some sky high bids!

Japanese.Text:
では　最初の商品は
１０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: This first lot'll be opening at one thousand gil!
Fifteen hundred!

Japanese.Text:
痛い目にあわないうちに
出ていきな

English.Text: If you value your life, get out.
Two k!
Four k!
Eighteen hundred!

Japanese.Text: 俺は３０００だ

English.Text: Three thousand!
Five thousand!
Thirteen hundred!

Japanese.Text: ３０００でどうだ

English.Text: Three k here!
Forty-five hundred!

Japanese.Text: さあ　ほかにいらっしゃいませんか？

English.Text: I know that's not all you folks got!

Japanese.Text:
早くしないと
落札してしまいますよ？

English.Text: Better speak up fast or you're gonna miss your shot!

Japanese.Text: あんた　目をつけられてるよ

English.Text: You're drawing a lot of attention.

Japanese.Text: いいですか皆様　後悔しませんか？

English.Text: Don't want anyone leavin' here with regrets, now do we?
I'll go fifty-three hundred!

Japanese.Text: こっちは７０００よ

English.Text: Seven thousand!

Japanese.Text: ９０００でどうだ

English.Text: Nine thousand!
Six thousand!
Seventy-five!

Japanese.Text: もう　８０００ギルよ！

English.Text: Argh─ Eight thousand!
Dammit. Five and five!

Japanese.Text: 俺は７７００だ

English.Text: Seventy-seven hundred!

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　８８００よ

English.Text: Eight thousand eight hundred!

Japanese.Text:
プリズンなんて言われてるけど
いいとこだろ？

English.Text: Not half bad for a prison, am I right?

Japanese.Text: ちくしょう　１００００だ！

English.Text: Aw, dammit! Ten thousand!

Japanese.Text:
１２０００！
これ以上はねえだろ

English.Text: Twelve thousand! Ain't no one goin' higher!

Japanese.Text:
２５０００！
絶対　渡さねえぞ

English.Text: Twenty-five k! Try beating that, y'all!
Ten thousand! You heard me!

Japanese.Text: １３０００　これが限界よ！

English.Text: Thirteen thousand! I know y'all ain't got more!

Japanese.Text:
２００００
もう　どうにでもなれ！

English.Text: To hell with it! Twenty thousand!

Japanese.Text: ほかにいませんね

English.Text: Any other bids?

Japanese.Text: では　落札です！

English.Text: Then it's sold!

Japanese.Text:
これは　もういらっしゃらないでしょう
おめでとうございます　落札です！

English.Text: Going once, going twice...and sold! Congratulations.

Japanese.Text: すばらしい　見事落札です！

English.Text: Sold! Better luck next time, folks.

Japanese.Text: それでは　次へいきましょう

English.Text: Moving on to our next lot...

Japanese.Text:
こちらの商品も
１０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: We'll start the bidding at a thousand gil again.

Japanese.Text:
続きまして　新しい商品です
こちらも１０００ギルからいきましょう

English.Text: And for the next lot, we have this lovely piece. I'm looking for a thousand gil.

Japanese.Text:
では続いての商品です
皆様　準備はよろしいでしょうか

English.Text: Are y'all ready for this next one? I hope so, 'cause it is one dazzlin' piece of work!

Japanese.Text: １０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: Do I hear a thousand?

Japanese.Text: 金持ち連中の顔を覚えとけよ

English.Text: Pay attention. Remember their faces.

Japanese.Text: おっ　やんのか？

English.Text: "Private meetup"?

Japanese.Text:
金が余ってるみたいだからな
いただいちまおうぜ

English.Text: Hey, if these folks wanna piss away all their gil, I say we help 'em.

Japanese.Text: 連中が競り勝ったブツを盗めねえかな

English.Text: Think we can help ourselves to the "goods" too?

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　そんでまた
その盗品を――

English.Text: That's a fine idea. Then we can take 'em right back here and...

Japanese.Text: オークションに出すってワケだ

English.Text: Put 'em up for auction!

Japanese.Text: 出せ　出してくれ！

English.Text: Please, you gotta get me outta here!

Japanese.Text: 金なら　盗んででも用意する！

English.Text: If it's gil you want, I know about a big score!

Japanese.Text: 妻は　妻は無事なんだろうな？

English.Text: Is my wife alright? Is she? I need to know!

Japanese.Text:
なんでもいい
食べ物をくれないか

English.Text: I'm so hungry... I'll take anything...

Japanese.Text: 俺は　だまされただけなんだよ！

English.Text: It ain't my fault! They made me do it!

Japanese.Text: 終わりよ　なにもかも……

English.Text: Oh god, this is it. It's all over.

Japanese.Text: ちょっと　あんた助けてよ！

English.Text: You! You have to help me! Please!

Japanese.Text: やだ……やだ……

English.Text: No, no, no... This can't be happening!

Japanese.Text: 助けて　なんでもするから！

English.Text: Get me outta here. I'm begging you!

Japanese.Text: みず……水をちょうだい

English.Text: Water... Just a few drops of water...

Japanese.Text:
静かにしろ！
ったく　うるさいヤツらだ

English.Text: Put a sock in it! C'mon...

Japanese.Text:
ゲヘヘ　こいつらを見るのが
楽しくてさあ

English.Text: Hehehe! Piss and moan some more, why don'tcha!

Japanese.Text:
心配すんな　悪いようにはしねえからよ
まあ　イイようにもしねえがな

English.Text: Don't you worry, we ain't gonna hurt ya. Promise. Though that's the least of your troubles.

Japanese.Text:
あと３日の我慢だ　いや４日だったか？
まあ　とにかく我慢だ

English.Text: All you gotta do is tough it out for three more days. Or was it four? Eh, it'll fly by.

Japanese.Text:
しっかり反省するんだね
反省したところで　出られないけどね

English.Text: Should take this time to think about the choices that brung you here. Not that it'll help you get out.

Japanese.Text:
ピーチクパーチクうるさいよ
いくら叫んでも　助けは来ないよ

English.Text: Knock it off with all that whining! No one's comin' for ya, so just shut the hell up!

Japanese.Text: ゲス様の命令で　みんな釈放したよ

English.Text: Had to cut 'em all loose. Solemn Gus's orders.

Japanese.Text: クソ　つまんねえな

English.Text: Shit. What am I s'posed to do now?

Japanese.Text: ああ～　ヒマだ

English.Text: Thanks for puttin' me out of a job.

Japanese.Text:
人を商品にするのはやめるってさ
俺は　賛成だよ

English.Text: Just between you and me, I'm one hundred percent behind letting everyone go.

Japanese.Text:
なんだい？
アタシらは反省なんてしないよ

English.Text: What? You think I feel bad for makin' money?

Japanese.Text: 釈放はゲス様の命令だ　仕方ないね

English.Text: No room for argument when it's a direct order from the boss man himself.

Japanese.Text: お兄さん　いまヒマ？

English.Text: Hey! Lookin' for a way to kill time?

Japanese.Text: う～ん　お金は持ってなさそうだね

English.Text: Don't have a gil to your name, do you?

Japanese.Text:
キレイな顔
ねえ　いっしょに働かない？

English.Text: Careful now. Handsome face like yours is bound to draw some attention.

Japanese.Text: うん　遊んでく？

English.Text: So... You come here often?

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーでは味わえないこと
したくない？

English.Text: Screw the Saucer. Down here's where the real fun happens.

Japanese.Text: なに見てんの　お金とるわよ

English.Text: Take a picture, pal. It'll last longer.

Japanese.Text:
ヒャッハー！
ならず者の楽園へ　ようこそ

English.Text: Hah! Welcome to the outlaws' paradise!

Japanese.Text:
へへへ　俺たちグリードが
丁重におもてなしするぜ！

English.Text: We'll be sure to give y'all the royal treatment! Hahaha!

Japanese.Text:
金はあるか　腕っぷしに自信はあるか？
ないならいますぐ帰んな

English.Text: Well? You got gil or you got skills? Gonna need one or the other if you wanna survive down here!

Japanese.Text: グリードの街へ　よく来やがった

English.Text: Best watch your step when you're on our turf!

Japanese.Text:
死にたくなけりゃ
俺たちのルールに従うんだな

English.Text: We're the law around here, so don't piss us off if you wanna see tomorrow!

Japanese.Text: ヒャッホー！

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Japanese.Text:
コレルプリズンによく来たな　ベイビー
ここは地獄よりもヘビーな楽園だぜ

English.Text: So nice of you to drop in on us down here! Just so you get an idea of where you're at, hell's got nothing on this place.

Japanese.Text:
お遊びのつもりなら
ママのところに帰んな

English.Text: If you're lookin' for an easy time, best go crawlin' back to mommy.

Japanese.Text: あは　あははは……

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Japanese.Text: ほら見て　新しい人が来たよぉ

English.Text: Ooh, lookie here! New guy.

Japanese.Text:
あはははは　すご～い
チョコボ人間だぁ

English.Text: Hehe... Wow! Never seen a chocobo-man before.

Japanese.Text:
新しい世界に新しい人
最高だわぁ

English.Text: New world with new people and...new people things!

Japanese.Text: こんにちはぁ　チョコボ人間さん

English.Text: Hey, it's the chocobo-man. Wassup?

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　チョコボ人間さんに
エサをあげなきゃ

English.Text: Hey, choco-man! C'mere! I got some feed for you.

Japanese.Text: あは　あはははは

English.Text: Hahaha!

Japanese.Text:
うふ　うふふふふ
どうぞぉ？

English.Text: Hahaha! Dig in!

Japanese.Text: かあーっ　やっぱキくな

English.Text: Woo! That hits the spot.

Japanese.Text:
なにが入ってんのか
わかんねえのが　最高だよな

English.Text: I dunno what's in it, but damn does it taste good.

Japanese.Text:
へへへ　今日はアタリだぜ
頭がクラクラしやがる

English.Text: Hehe! Yeah, it's good shit! Goes down smooth and warms ya up quick.

Japanese.Text: だあ～　熱くなってきやがった

English.Text: I'm just gettin' started!

Japanese.Text:
そうか？　オレは
なんか寒くなってきた

English.Text: Yeah? Well, uh... I think I'm gonna call it.

Japanese.Text: オレは　気持ち悪くなってきた……

English.Text: Hrng... I ain't...feelin' so good.

Japanese.Text: この酒　なにが入ってんだ？

English.Text: Seriously, what the hell's in this?

Japanese.Text:
いいか新入り
金だ　なにごとも金

English.Text: Listen up, shithead. Round here, it's all about that gil.

Japanese.Text:
ここじゃ　お金がないと
安全も買えないの　わかった？

English.Text: If you can't pay your dues, then you're as good as dead. Got me?

Japanese.Text:
わっ　わかったから
もう殴らないでくれ！

English.Text: I got it. Just don't hit me anymore!

Japanese.Text:
うふふ　でも
痛い目をみないと覚えないでしょ？

English.Text: Pain makes the lesson stick. We're doing you a favor.

Japanese.Text:
よかったじゃねえか
これでひとつ賢くなったろ

English.Text: Bet you're glad we learned you real good. Ain'tcha, bitch?

Japanese.Text:
それじゃあ
安全を金で買ってもらおうか

English.Text: This is the part where you pay me if you wanna stay my new best friend.

Japanese.Text: かっ　金はないんだ

English.Text: But...I don't got any gil!

Japanese.Text:
大丈夫　心配しないで
お金を作る方法なら色々あるから

English.Text: Don't you worry your pretty little head about that. There are plenty of ways to earn your keep around here.

Japanese.Text: 姐さん　次のヤマですが――

English.Text: So, Boss, about our next job...

Japanese.Text: しっ　声を落としな

English.Text: Shh! Keep it down, idiot.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルからの
横流し品を狙います

English.Text: Could hit a shipment of black market goods out of Midgar.

Japanese.Text: 金　落ちてねえか？

English.Text: Keep a close watch on your wallet.

Japanese.Text:
オレ　砂漠の砂を
売ろうと思ってんだ

English.Text: They say you can sell sand with the right spin, but...

Japanese.Text: クソ　また値上がりしてやがる

English.Text: Goddammit! Another price hike!?

Japanese.Text: ったく　ロクなもんがねえな

English.Text: There anything here that ain't shit?

Japanese.Text:
いちどでいいから
上で買い物したいな

English.Text: I'd love to check out the shops up top at least once.

Japanese.Text:
今日は水だけ
お酒は買わない　絶対

English.Text: Just water today. No alcohol. No sir.

Japanese.Text: 砂漠の巣穴へようこそ　兄弟

English.Text: Lookin' for a place to hole up? You found it.

Japanese.Text: 独房のように　ぐっすり眠れるぜ

English.Text: Quiet as solitary─guaranteed.

Japanese.Text: またいつでも来な　兄弟

English.Text: Feel free to drop by any time.

Japanese.Text: いい監獄ライフを　兄弟

English.Text: Enjoy your stay in hell, brother.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　そこのお兄さんに
話しかけてみない？

English.Text: Hey, how 'bout that handsome fella over there?

Japanese.Text:
はあ　おまえってホント
面食いだな

English.Text: You know there's more to people than just looks.

Japanese.Text: 顔がイイに越したことないでしょ

English.Text: But appearance still counts for a lot.

Japanese.Text:
あのね　そうやって選り好みするから
ノルマを達成できないのよ

English.Text: And this is why you never make your quota. You need to stop being so damn picky.

Japanese.Text: おい　砂が入ってんぞ？

English.Text: Hey! There's sand in my drink!

Japanese.Text:
相変わらず　ウスいな！
ここの酒はよ

English.Text: Dunno why I bother. This stuff's more water than booze.

Japanese.Text:
いくら飲んでも酔えねえ
どうなってんだ

English.Text: What the hell's a guy gotta do to get shit-faced around here!?

Japanese.Text: クソ　有り金ぜんぶスっちまった

English.Text: Son of a bitch... Musta been pickpocketed.

Japanese.Text:
ひっく……
サボテン酒の砂割り持ってこい！

English.Text: Shot of cactuar rum, and cut it with some sand!

Japanese.Text:
あれ……？
あれ　財布がない！

English.Text: Huh? Shit! My wallet's gone!

Japanese.Text:
フワフワするぅ
飛んでるみたぁ～い

English.Text: Hahaha, I'm flying! I'm flying!

Japanese.Text:
知ってる？　神羅の酒って
魔晄の味がすんの

English.Text: Ever wonder what mako tastes like? Take a swig of Shinra booze and you'll know.

Japanese.Text:
おえ　このカクテル
下水でも入ってんの？

English.Text: Gross! Was this cocktail cut with sewage!?

Japanese.Text:
まあ　いいか
どうせ１ギルも入ってなかったし

English.Text: Eh. Not like it had anythin' in it anyway.

Japanese.Text:
うふふ
ボーッとしてるからすられるのさ

English.Text: That's what you get for spacin' out.

Japanese.Text:
さて　本日の収穫は……って
１ギルも入ってないじゃないの！

English.Text: Now, what'd I score today? Huh!? There isn't even a single gil in here!

Japanese.Text:
飲んだくれの酒場
ベイル・ジャンパーへようこそオマエら
行くぜ！

English.Text: Welcome to Bail Jumper, where all the good boys and girls go to drink 'emselves blind! Kick it!

Japanese.Text:
神羅もゴールドソーサーもクソくらえ
監獄から　世界を変えるぞ！

English.Text: Shinra and the Gold Saucer can eat our shit! This hellhole's ours─and so's the world!

Japanese.Text:
今日も　盗んだギターを
かき鳴らしにきたぜ？

English.Text: We stole their guitars to bring the people our sweet music.

Japanese.Text: 盛りあがっていけよ　オマエら！

English.Text: Y'all ready to make some noise!?

Japanese.Text:
クソみたいな世界を
いっしょにブッつぶそうぜ！

English.Text: C'mon! We'll burn this mother down!

Japanese.Text: 行くぜ　オマエら！

English.Text: Let's give 'em hell!

Japanese.Text:
ワン　ツー
ワンツースリーフォー！

English.Text: One! Two! One two three four!

Japanese.Text:
しっかり働いて
ゲス様にショバ代を払えよ

English.Text: Keep your noses to the grindstone, people! You better pray you're able to make rent!

Japanese.Text: 滞納は許されねえからな

English.Text: 'Cause you'll be eatin' more than just late fees!

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様のおかげで
安心して　店をやれてんだ

English.Text: Remember: it's thanks to Gus that y'all get to do your business in peace.

Japanese.Text: ちゃんと感謝しねえとな

English.Text: So show him some gratitude!

Japanese.Text:
悪さしてる奴はいねえか？
殴りたくて　ウズウズしてんだ

English.Text: Any y'all folks up to no good? 'Cause these fists of mine've been itchin' for a fight.

Japanese.Text:
ルールを破った奴は出てこい
気持ちよく殴らせてくれる奴でもいいぞ

English.Text: Don't be shy now! I know some of y'all done some shit, so speak up! Don't make me start beatin' on people to get answers!

Japanese.Text:
これが今月分
こっちは　先月分だ

English.Text: Here's this month's payment. And this is for last month.

Japanese.Text: 確かに　あとは先々月の分だね

English.Text: I seem to recall you still owe us for the month before that too.

Japanese.Text:
えっ　いや
それは払ったはずだが

English.Text: What? No, I'm sure I already paid that.

Japanese.Text: いや　受け取った覚えはねえなあ

English.Text: Oh yeah? 'Cause I ain't got no memory of it.

Japanese.Text: ばかな　ゲス様に確認してくれ

English.Text: Just check with Gus. I know he'll back me up.

Japanese.Text:
なんだい
アタシたちを疑ってんのかい？

English.Text: Now hold on. You callin' me a liar?

Japanese.Text: ったく滞納しといて　ひどい話だよ

English.Text: Man with your kinda debt oughta be more careful with his words.

Japanese.Text:
てめえ　こっちはいつでも
値上げできるんだぞ？

English.Text: Keep talkin' like that and you might have to start payin' a premium.

Japanese.Text: わかった……払うよ

English.Text: Alright, alright. I'll pay.

Japanese.Text: 店で騒ぐヤツは　ぶっ飛ばす

English.Text: Make a peep and you're gone. That's a promise.

Japanese.Text: シィー……　静寂がこの店のルールだ

English.Text: Shhh! Silence is sacrosanct.

Japanese.Text: 武器は大切にな

English.Text: Take care of your weapons.

Japanese.Text: 整備は欠かすなよ

English.Text: Don't skimp on gear.

Japanese.Text: うるせえぞ！

English.Text: Shut up!

Japanese.Text: ルール違反者には売らねえよ

English.Text: I don't sell to rulebreakers.

Japanese.Text: とっとと　出てけ！

English.Text: Get your ass outta here!

Japanese.Text: はん　油断したな

English.Text: I told you: be quiet or beat it!

Japanese.Text: 絶対　音を立てんなよ

English.Text: Word of warning: don't make a peep.

Japanese.Text: そ～っと　そ～っと……

English.Text: Careful now... Silent as the grave...

Japanese.Text:
しっ　静かに
ぶっ飛ばされっぞ

English.Text: Shh! Be quiet. Else you'll get it.

Japanese.Text: この店……緊張する

English.Text: This place and its rules, I swear...they terrify me!

Japanese.Text: 足音に注意

English.Text: Whatever you do, do it quietly.

Japanese.Text: 騒いだら　追い出されるわよ？

English.Text: You'll get tossed out if you make any kinda noise.

Japanese.Text:
いらっしゃいませ
ワタシの　ワタシの店へようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to my humble establishment. Please─peruse the selection.

Japanese.Text:
強くなりたいなら
ワタシの店に　おまかせを

English.Text: If you're looking to get stronger, my store has everything you'll need!

Japanese.Text: また　ワタシの店に来てくださいね！

English.Text: My store will always be open to you!

Japanese.Text: ワタシの店はどうでした　最高でしたよね？

English.Text: What do you think of my store? Be honest─it's the best you've ever seen, right?

Japanese.Text: サボテン大王の新刊はどこだ

English.Text: Now, where's the latest issue of Cactuar King?

Japanese.Text: ゲス様の自伝があるはずなんだが

English.Text: Gus's book should be around here somewhere...

Japanese.Text:
これこれ！
ゲス様の『孤独のアウトロー』

English.Text: It's Gus's autobiography! Meditations on the Outlaw Life!

Japanese.Text: 本を盗んでも　すぐバレんのよ

English.Text: Only steal a book if you're lookin' to get caught.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Come on in!

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の自伝
『孤独のアウトロー』が入荷したよ

English.Text: Meditations on the Outlaw Life─Gus's autobiography─now in stock!

Japanese.Text: グリードのボス　ゲス様の自伝だよ

English.Text: Read the only thing worth reading: your boss's book!

Japanese.Text:
読んだだけで強くなれる
保証モンの名著だ

English.Text: The wisdom contained therein will give you the strength to take on the world!

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』
買ってって！

English.Text: Buy Gus's Meditations or I'll stab the shit outta you till you do!

Japanese.Text:
中身は単純明快！
文字はわずか　誰でも読める

English.Text: Don't read so good? Not a problem. Book's mostly pictures anyway.

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』
よろしくね～！

English.Text: Take home Gus's Meditations on the Outlaw Life today!

Japanese.Text:
なんで　グリードのオレが
宣伝してんだ！

English.Text: How the hell did I get roped into this bullshit?

Japanese.Text:
みかじめ料を取りにきたら
店主に押しつけられて　このザマよ

English.Text: I just came to collect Gus's dues, not stand around hawkin' his damn book.

Japanese.Text: うちはゲス様御用達の　チョコボショップだよ

English.Text: This here shop's got Gus's seal of approval.

Japanese.Text: チョコボも　目立っていかないとね

English.Text: No one wants a run-of-the-mill chocobo.

Japanese.Text: しっかりチョコボを　着飾ってやるんだね

English.Text: You have fun gussyin' up that bird of yours!

Japanese.Text: ゲス様みたいに　ド派手にしてやんな

English.Text: Go on and make 'em as flashy as Gus.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: 'Sup.

Japanese.Text: なんか用か

English.Text: Need something?

Japanese.Text: じゃあな

English.Text: See ya.

Japanese.Text: まいどあり

English.Text: Thanks.

Japanese.Text: 毎回思うが　見事なもんだな

English.Text: I don't know how you make such masterpieces.

Japanese.Text: そりゃどうも

English.Text: Thank you kindly.

Japanese.Text:
アンタほどの職人が
なんで　こんなとこにいるんだ

English.Text: What's an artist like you doin' in a place like this, anyway?

Japanese.Text:
べつに　ここだったら
自由に彫れるってだけさ

English.Text: Workin'. Free to live my life as I see fit here.

Japanese.Text: なんか　やべえモンでも彫ったのか

English.Text: Craziest tat you ever did?

Japanese.Text:
まあ　いろいろと
素っ裸のプレジデントとかね

English.Text: Oh, I don't know... Buck-naked President Shinra?

Japanese.Text:
ハハハ　マジかよ
とんでもねえな！

English.Text: I almost wanna meet that man!

Japanese.Text: ほら　笑うとズレるよ

English.Text: Don't laugh or it'll look like shit.

Japanese.Text:
ひとつ　教えておいてやるぜ
ここの砂漠は超危険だぜ？

English.Text: Word of advice if you're thinkin' of goin' out there: don't. Desert's a death trap.

Japanese.Text:
まずは　砂嵐！
巻き込まれたら右も左もわからねえ

English.Text: First you got your sandstorms. Get hit by one of those and you won't know up from down.

Japanese.Text: あとは迷子になって干からびるだけよ

English.Text: May as well say your prayers and wait for the end.

Japanese.Text:
そして　流砂！
いっぽ足を踏み入れたら最後
あとはなにもできずゆっくり沈むだけよ

English.Text: Then there's quicksand. Stumble into that and kiss the sky goodbye as you count the seconds till you say hello to a slow, painful demise.

Japanese.Text: せいぜい　気をつけるこった

English.Text: Wouldn't wish that on no one.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　どんだけ気をつけようが
死ぬときは死ぬけどな

English.Text: Though even if you avoid both those hazards, the desert'll find another way to get ya.

Japanese.Text:
兄ちゃん
身ぐるみ剥がされんなよ

English.Text: Be careful not to lose it all. Like me.

Japanese.Text:
クソ　あんなの
イカサマに決まってる！

English.Text: Dammit! Anyone with eyes could see they were cheatin'!

Japanese.Text:
ひっひっひ
今夜はうまい酒が飲めそうだ

English.Text: Heh heh heh... I'm gonna be drinkin' good tonight!

Japanese.Text: 俺の全財産が……

English.Text: That was everything I had to my name...

Japanese.Text:
なあ　金を貸してくれ
ぜったい取り返すからよ

English.Text: Hey there, buddy. Got any gil to spare? I promise I'll pay you back.

Japanese.Text:
おい　上に密告すんじゃねぞ
捕まっちまうからな

English.Text: Don't even think about snitchin'. 'Less you feel like diggin' your own grave.

Japanese.Text: さて　次は誰をカモろうかね

English.Text: Now then... Which lucky idiot's gonna be my next mark?

Japanese.Text:
お金に困ってない？
うちは利息も安いわよ

English.Text: Strapped for gil, honey? We've got the lowest interest rates around.

Japanese.Text: 引き際を見失ったら終わりさ

English.Text: Miss your chance to throw in your cards, and it's over.

Japanese.Text:
素人が手を出すんじゃないよ
捕まりたくないだろ？

English.Text: This place ain't for amateurs, so unless you wanna piss your money away─beat it.

Japanese.Text: 見たぞ　すげえパーティーだったな

English.Text: You see that!? What a show, man!

Japanese.Text:
まさか　ジョーカーを
倒しちまうなんて

English.Text: Where are the screams? The precious screams of pain!?

Japanese.Text: すげえ　やっちまったのかよ！

English.Text: That was the shit! You're a stone-cold killer!

Japanese.Text: マジかよ　生きて帰ったか

English.Text: How did you survive that? What are you?

Japanese.Text: ジョーカーをいじめやがって

English.Text: How dare you, you...bully!

Japanese.Text: ヒュ～　盛りあがったな！

English.Text: Ain't never seen anything that intense!

Japanese.Text: ゲスパーティー　最高！

English.Text: Now that was quality entertainment!

Japanese.Text:
おまえ　ビーストバトルグラウンドに
出たんだって？

English.Text: You fought in the Beast Battleground? You're crazy!

Japanese.Text: あ～ん　ゾクゾクしたわ

English.Text: Oh, that was thrilling!

Japanese.Text: 最高のパーティー！

English.Text: How the hell did you do that!?

Japanese.Text:
キャーーー！
あたしの応援　聞こえた？

English.Text: Didja hear me cheerin' you on!? Didja!?

Japanese.Text:
あんた　やるわね
アタシとやらない？

English.Text: You're not half bad. Wanna tussle with me next?

Japanese.Text:
フォーウ
ゲスパーティー最高！

English.Text:
Woo!
More! I wanna see more!

Japanese.Text: フォーフォーフォーウ！

English.Text: Woo-ha-hoo!

Japanese.Text:
まあな　あばらがイッちまったが
なんとか生きて帰ってきたよ

English.Text: It was nothin'. May've busted a rib, but I made it back in one piece.

Japanese.Text: 挑戦するだけでもすげえよ　尊敬する

English.Text: That's still impressive, man. For real─respect.

Japanese.Text:
水をさして悪いが　そいつ
死んだフリして踏まれただけだぞ

English.Text: Hate to break it to you, but all dumbass here did was play dead while the monsters trampled him.

Japanese.Text:
おまえ　ゲスパーティーに出るって
ホントか？

English.Text: You seriously sign up for the boss's challenge?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　ずっと挑戦したいって
思ってたんだ

English.Text: Bet your ass I did. Always wanted to put my skills to the test.

Japanese.Text: すっげえなあ

English.Text: Damn, man. You're somethin' else.

Japanese.Text:
でもよ　ゲスパーティーって
５人組じゃないとダメだろ？

English.Text: Wait, but...don't you need a group of five people to compete? Who else you got?

Japanese.Text: そうなのか？

English.Text: Whoa...really?

Japanese.Text:
クソ　せっかくジョーカーと戦えると
思ったけど　あきらめるしかないか

English.Text: Damn. I had no idea you couldn't fight solo. Was looking forward to showin' off, but rules are rules.

Japanese.Text: 俺が５人　集めてやろうか

English.Text: I'll round up some guys for you!

Japanese.Text:
大丈夫　大丈夫！
すご～く残念だけどあきらめるよ

English.Text: Nah, s'all good! Don't wanna risk anyone else's lives, you know?

Japanese.Text: あいつら　強すぎてやる気しねえ

English.Text: They're so far outta my league. Ain't no point in playing.

Japanese.Text: 流れ者のバウターらしいな

English.Text: Never heard of travelin' card sharks.

Japanese.Text: 誰かヤツらを負かしてくれねえかな

English.Text: Can't anyone beat these cheats for us?

Japanese.Text: つまんないな～

English.Text: This ain't even a contest.

Japanese.Text: あいつら　早く帰ってくれないかな

English.Text: Wish they'd hurry up and move on already.

Japanese.Text:
強すぎると
賭けが成立しないのよね

English.Text: What's the point if you already know who's gonna win? This is bullshit.

Japanese.Text:
今日は　どんなヤツが
血祭りになるかな～！

English.Text: I can't wait to see who gets ripped to shreds today!

Japanese.Text:
悲鳴を聞いてると
心が安らぐんだよな

English.Text: Nothing soothes the soul quite like howls of agony.

Japanese.Text:
ここで育成されたモンスターを買いに
世界中から　バイヤーが集まるって話だ

English.Text: Buyers from all over come here for our monsters. These murder babies are the best of the best.

Japanese.Text:
ハハ　やっちまえ
やられちまえ！

English.Text: Hahaha! Get 'im! Tear his head off!

Japanese.Text:
アタシ　モンスターの飼育員を
目指してんの

English.Text: It's my dream to be a caretaker of monsters.

Japanese.Text: さあ　アンタの悲鳴を聞かせてよ

English.Text: I can't wait to hear what you sound like when you scream.

Japanese.Text: 骨は拾ってやるよ　残ってたらね

English.Text: I'll take good care of your bones. If there's any left!

Japanese.Text: ゲスパーティー　イイぃ！

English.Text: Yeah, bring it! I wanna see some blood!

Japanese.Text: フォウ！

English.Text: Woo hoo!

Japanese.Text: ジョーカーを味わいな

English.Text: This asshole doesn't stand a chance!

Japanese.Text: ゲスパーティーへ　ようこそ！

English.Text: Oh, you're in for it now, shithead!

Japanese.Text: フォウ！

English.Text: Woo hoo!

Japanese.Text: アハハハ　がんばってね！

English.Text: Ahahaha! Good luck!

Japanese.Text: ヒャッハー！

English.Text: Yee-haw!

Japanese.Text: どけどけ！

English.Text: Outta the way!

Japanese.Text: イヤッホー！

English.Text: Woohoo!

Japanese.Text: 気持ちイイ～！

English.Text: Yeah! Be the wind!

Japanese.Text:
どうよ　このモンスターマシン
３年かけて改造した自慢の逸品よ

English.Text: Check it! I've spent three years working on this baby, and now she's complete! Sweet, huh?

Japanese.Text: かっけ～！

English.Text: Goddamn!

Japanese.Text:
そんなのに乗ってる
アンタの気がしれないよ

English.Text: I can't believe you actually ride that thing in public.

Japanese.Text: なんだ　うらやましいのか？

English.Text: Sounds like someone's jealous.

Japanese.Text:
大切なのは見た目じゃなくて
稼げるかどうかだよ

English.Text: Doesn't matter how sweet it is if it doesn't get you paid, you know.

Japanese.Text: それは　男もバイクもいっしょ

English.Text: Like a looker who can't hold down a job.

Japanese.Text:
見てくれよ
神羅の純正パーツを手に入れてよ！

English.Text: Take a look at this! It's got that official Shinra logo and everything.

Japanese.Text:
おいバカ　隠せ！
盗まれちまうぞ

English.Text: Gah! Put that shit away! You wanna get rolled?

Japanese.Text: そうビビんなって

English.Text: Man, you worry too much.

Japanese.Text:
いや～　ゲス様に
高い金払った甲斐があったぜ！

English.Text: I paid Gus a fortune for this. You know I gotta flaunt it!

Japanese.Text:
んで　そのパーツを使うバイクは
どこだよ？

English.Text: So...you gonna put it on your bike or what?

Japanese.Text:
バイクは盗まれちまった
ううう……

English.Text: My...my pride and joy...someone took her!

Japanese.Text: やんのか！

English.Text: You wanna go!?

Japanese.Text: やんのか？

English.Text: Just try it!

Japanese.Text: やん……のか……

English.Text: You...you wanna go...?

Japanese.Text: やん……のか……？

English.Text: Just...just try it...

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様バンザーイ！
ここは　プリズンの王
ゲス様の屋敷よ

English.Text: All hail Solemn Gus─king of Corel Prison! Show respect─or get wrecked!

Japanese.Text:
屋敷の中では　礼儀正しくな
釘バットのサビになりたかねえだろ

English.Text: Listen up, assholes. Watch your manners inside the mansion─or else it's a rusty nail bat to the head for you!

Japanese.Text: なにコソコソしてんだ　コラ？

English.Text: Whatchu doin'? Sneakin' around and shit?

Japanese.Text: 勝手に歩きまわんなよ

English.Text: Don't let me catch you wanderin'.

Japanese.Text:
あやしいマネしやがったら
わかってんだろうな？

English.Text: One false move and we'll be all over you like that!

Japanese.Text: 目ざわりだよ　消えな

English.Text: Get outta my sight, shithead!

Japanese.Text:
ぶっ飛ばされるまえに
出ていくんだね

English.Text: Either you leave on your own or we drag your ass outside.

Japanese.Text: ウロチョロすんじゃないよ

English.Text: Hey! No loiterin'.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボか　モーグリか
サボテンダーか……

English.Text: Maybe a chocobo? Or a moogle? Though I could go for a cactuar...

Japanese.Text:
いっそ　トンベリ？
どっきりでモルボル？

English.Text: There's always the tonberry... Or a malboro for shock value.

Japanese.Text:
『戦争上等』
『来やがれウータイ！』
『砂漠でピース』……

English.Text: "Make art, not war!" "Do your worst, Wutai!" "Corel belongs to the people!"

Japanese.Text: う～ん　なんて描こうかな

English.Text: Nah, not feelin' it.

Japanese.Text:
『ようこそ　反神羅連絡会』
とかでもいいかも！

English.Text: Oh, I've got it! How about "Saluting the SRC"?

Japanese.Text:
いいよな　おまえらは野菜が食えて
ちょっとぐらい俺が食っても
バレねえよな？

English.Text: How come y'all get to eat veggies? It ain't fair. No one'll notice if I sneak a few, right?

Japanese.Text:
砂あびって　気持ちいいのか？
俺もやってみようかな

English.Text: Do sand baths really feel that good? Maybe I should try it.

Japanese.Text:
この毛並みなら　いけそうだね
次のレースは死んでも勝ちな

English.Text: Yeah, I'd say you're lookin' pretty good. Better win the next one even if it kills you.

Japanese.Text:
世話なんて　適当でいいんだよ
情が移ると別れがつらくなっちまうだろ

English.Text: Best not to get too attached, y'know. Only makes it harder when the time comes to say goodbye.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボの砂あびはね
体をキレイにするだけじゃなく
リラックス法でもあるんだ

English.Text: Dust baths aren't just for keeping chocobos clean; they also help them de-stress. Two birds with one bath!

Japanese.Text: やっても　変わらないと思う？

English.Text: Think it doesn't make a difference?

Japanese.Text:
でもね　やるのとやらないのとじゃ
ぜんぜん違うよ

English.Text: Well it does, believe me. Makes 'em into whole new birds!

Japanese.Text:
なにより　羽で砂が舞う光景が
美しくてね

English.Text: The way they roll around, kicking up a giant cloud of sand...

Japanese.Text: 君もいちど　見てみるといいよ

English.Text: I promise it'll take your breath away.

Japanese.Text: おまえも飲むか？

English.Text: Care for a drink?

Japanese.Text: 見ろよこの銃　すげえだろ

English.Text: Check my piece. Pretty sweet, right?

Japanese.Text:
俺はチョコボレースより
ビーストバトルグラウンド派だね

English.Text: The chocobo races are all you. I'm more of a Beast Battleground guy.

Japanese.Text: また　チョコボを盗んでこねえと

English.Text: Gotta steal another chocobo soon.

Japanese.Text: 部屋を荒らすんじゃねえぞ

English.Text: Don't you go messin' up the place.

Japanese.Text: ゲス様は仕事中よ

English.Text: Gus is busy at the moment.

Japanese.Text: あら　遊びにきたの？

English.Text: Hey there, honey. Sit with us awhile.

Japanese.Text: うふふ　新入りの洗礼は受けた？

English.Text: Have you gone through the initiation yet?

Japanese.Text: 今月のみかじめ料はどうなってる

English.Text: Everyone pay their dues in full for the month?

Japanese.Text:
とどこおりなく　滞納している店も
順次回収する予定です

English.Text: We're gonna do some rounds soon. Remind folks who've fallen behind.

Japanese.Text:
３ヶ月以上滞納した店は
見せしめに　つぶせ

English.Text: Anyone more than three months in the hole─you make an example of 'em.

Japanese.Text: 了解しました

English.Text: Yes, sir!

Japanese.Text:
この子は『バルチャー』
ゲス様のお気に入りなの

English.Text: Gus has a thing for vultures─keeps 'em as pets.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠の道案内が
この子の得意技なのよ

English.Text: They're trained to lead people lost in the desert to safety.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠でこの子を見つけたら
ついていくといいよ

English.Text: If you spot one of 'em out in the sands, best follow it.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　アタシもゲス様に
かわいがってもらいたいわ

English.Text: I wish Gus treated me half as good as he does his vultures.

Japanese.Text:
ハゲタカのバルチャーなら
砂漠に飛んでったよ

English.Text: If you're lookin' for vultures, look to the desert skies.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠であの子を見つけたら
ついていくといいよ

English.Text: And should you spot one while you're lost, follow it.

Japanese.Text:
アタシも　あの子みたいに
得意技を探さなきゃね

English.Text: Talented things. Gotta learn me some skills like them.

Japanese.Text: そこだ　行け行け行け！

English.Text: Yeah, you got 'em! Go, go!

Japanese.Text: なにしてんだ　バカチョコボ！

English.Text: You call that runnin', you stupid bird!?

Japanese.Text:
そこだそこ
殴れ　蹴れ　潰せ！

English.Text: Now's your chance! Punch 'em! Kick 'em! Crush 'em!

Japanese.Text: なにしてんだい　突っ込むんだよ！

English.Text: What're you doin'!? Run, damn you!

Japanese.Text: ほらそこ　嚙みつきな！

English.Text: C'mon, you can't just let 'em pass you like that!

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと　野菜あげたのに
この恩知らず！

English.Text: I feed you greens and this is how you repay me!?

Japanese.Text:
最近　見慣れない
モンスターが飛んでるんだ

English.Text: Been spying some strange fiends flying around the jungle lately.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉に異変があって
青年団が調査中だよ

English.Text: Somethin's up with the reactor, but the GYC's on top of it.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉から　なにかの大きな声が
聞こえるんだよ

English.Text: Stick around and you're bound to hear the "howling" from the reactor.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉に悩まされるのは
もう慣れちゃったわ

English.Text: Oh, the old reactor's being creepy again? Shocker.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉に　黒いモヤみたいなのが
見えるときがあるのよ

English.Text: Every now and then I see these weird, black clouds near the reactor.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉から妙な音が響いてきて
動物たちがおびえて　騒がしいのよ

English.Text: Animals've been acting strange recently. Probably 'cause of the reactor noise that's been stressing people too.

Japanese.Text:
まかせてください
チョコボと遊ぶの得意です！

English.Text: Oh you can count on me. I love playing with chocobos!

Japanese.Text: 本当にわかってる？

English.Text: You know what you're in for?

Japanese.Text:
ゴンガダケの栽培には
切り倒した　木の切り株を使うんだ

English.Text: Interested in learnin' how we cultivate our mushrooms? Well, we start with a freshly cut stump.

Japanese.Text:
乾燥させた切り株に
種菌ってのを植えたら
あとはひたすら待つ

English.Text: Once the surface is good and dry, we sprinkle the spores─and that's it! Honestly, waitin's the hard part.

Japanese.Text:
おや　旅人が来るなんて
めずらしいね

English.Text: Oh, hey there. Don't often get people passing through our village.

Japanese.Text:
たまに　オンボロの飛行機が
飛んでいるのよ

English.Text: Hey, you ever see that old rattletrap of a plane in action?

Japanese.Text: アクロバット飛行なんてしちゃってさ

English.Text: Can't believe it's actually capable of performing stunts.

Japanese.Text:
飛行機雲はキレイなんだけど
村に落ちてこないのを祈るしかないわね

English.Text: The vapor trails it leaves behind are pretty enough, but...I'm dreadin' the day it comes crashin' down in the middle of town.

Japanese.Text:
そういえば最近
オンボロの飛行機　見ないわね

English.Text: Whatever happened to that rickety old plane? Used to be a fixture in the skies above Gongaga.

Japanese.Text: なんだか　さびしいわ

English.Text: If I'm being honest, I kinda miss it.

Japanese.Text:
うん　神羅の人たちか？
その剣すごいな～

English.Text: Hot damn, now that is a sword. With gear like that, y'all gotta be Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
なんもない村だけど
ゆっくりしていってよ

English.Text: What we lack in luxuries, we make up for in rustic charm.

Japanese.Text:
この村の特産品は
ゴンガダケっていうんだ

English.Text: Our little village's claim to fame is the delicious Gongaga mushroom!

Japanese.Text: 村の野菜は　新鮮でうまいぞ

English.Text: You're not gonna find fresher produce anywhere else!

Japanese.Text: めずらしいねえ　お客さんなんて

English.Text: Visitors? Heh, pleasant surprise.

Japanese.Text: 動物たちにエサはあげないでね

English.Text: Remember: no feeding the wildlife.

Japanese.Text: 遠いところから　よく来たねえ

English.Text: My my... What a trek you must've made to get here!

Japanese.Text:
うちの野菜
よかったら食べていく？
