Japanese.Text: どこかへ　行ってしまわれました

English.Text: And here I thought we were out of the woods...

Japanese.Text:
なにしろ　パイプ周辺はモンスターが多くて
わたしらでは　手が出せないのです

English.Text: I can't just send anyone either. Fiends're nesting near the site and they'll attack anyone who gets close.

Japanese.Text:
せめて　状況の確認だけでも
代行してくれる人がいれば……

English.Text: Where am I going to find someone who can repair a pipeline and handle monsters?

Japanese.Text:
やっほ～！
わたし　なんでも屋のキリエ

English.Text: Hello, hello, hello! It's everyone's favorite merc: Kyrie!

Japanese.Text: 実は　魔晄パイプの修理をするはずだったんだけど

English.Text: So, here's the sitch: I was s'posed to fix that pipeline...

Japanese.Text:
ほかの仕事が入っちゃって
ここを離れることになったの

English.Text: but I accidentally double-booked myself─whoops! So I had to peace out.

Japanese.Text: いやはや　売れっ子はツライねえ

English.Text: Ah, the burden of being the golden girl.

Japanese.Text:
というわけで　メモに
パイプ修理に必要な部品を書いておいたから

English.Text: Anyway! I left you─whoever you are─an itemized list of everything you need.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　しっかり修理するなら
部品はたくさんあるといいけど

English.Text: Although...if you wanna make sure the pipe stays fixed, the more parts, the better.

Japanese.Text:
そのへんはまかせるね～
ああ　そうそう

English.Text: But who's counting, right? Oh, which reminds me...

Japanese.Text:
部品は　この先の
パイプのスクラップ置き場にあるから探してみて

English.Text: You should find a few scrap heaps near the pipelines─rummage through those for materials.

Japanese.Text:
そんじゃ　あとは頼んだ
バイバ～イ！

English.Text: And I think that about covers it! Thanks and good luck!

Japanese.Text:
やっほ～　なんでも屋さん
部品集めは順調ですか～？

English.Text: Greetings, my fellow merc! Are we working hard, or hardly working?

Japanese.Text:
いきなりなんだけど　実は他の仕事が入っちゃって
ここを離れることになったの

English.Text: Speaking of work, I just stumbled on another job, so I'm gonna leave this one in your capable hands.

Japanese.Text:
というわけで
魔晄パイプの修理　よろしくね！

English.Text: I hate to bounce, but I'm sure you'll get that pipe patched up.

Japanese.Text: そんじゃ　バイバ～イ！

English.Text: Catch ya later. Peace!

Japanese.Text: 集めた部品で修理しますか？

English.Text: Use the parts you've collected to fix the pipe?

Japanese.Text: 修理する

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: 修理しない

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: ちゃんと修理できんだろうな

English.Text: And you're sure that you can fix this?

Japanese.Text: なんだ！

English.Text: Company!

Japanese.Text: なんだってんだよったく

English.Text: Damn, that was a tough bastard.

Japanese.Text: 漏れた魔晄の影響だろう

English.Text: Mako probably mutated 'em.

Japanese.Text: 報告に戻ろう

English.Text: Let's head back.

Japanese.Text: ああ　みなさん

English.Text: Oh good, you're back.

Japanese.Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄がちょろちょろとですが
流れ始めました

English.Text: Our mako supply's looking better by the minute─the tank's filling up, bit by bit.

Japanese.Text:
たとえ　最低限の応急処置だとしても助かりました
ありがとうございます

English.Text: The flow isn't quite what it should be, but so long as we can provide power, it will suffice for our needs.

Japanese.Text:
みなさん　いい感じに修理してくださり
ありがとうございます

English.Text:
You did an impressive job on those repairs.
Thank you all so much.

Japanese.Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄の供給が再開しました
いやはや　これでひと安心です

English.Text: Now that we've got some mako to spare, we can finally restore power to most homes. What a relief!

Japanese.Text: おお　みなさん

English.Text: Ah, you're back!

Japanese.Text:
頑丈に修理していただいたみたいで
まことに　ありがとうございます

English.Text:
You must've done a real bang-up job out there.
Tank's practically full again!

Japanese.Text:
おかげさまで　魔晄がじゃぶじゃぶと
タンクに流れ始めました

English.Text:
I don't think our supply's ever been this good.
We've more than enough for our needs!

Japanese.Text: 前より　勢いがよくなった気がします

English.Text:
Don't know what you did to that pipe,
but thank god you did!

Japanese.Text:
では　こちらが報酬です
お納めください

English.Text:
Here, a little something for your troubles.
Please, I insist.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　あんたらアバランチだろ？
宿屋のブロードから　話は聞いてるよ

English.Text: Oh, y'all must be the ones with Avalanche, right? Broden told me a little bit about ya.

Japanese.Text: うまく神羅から逃げてるみたいだな

English.Text: On the run from Shinra, eh?

Japanese.Text: あんたらか　うまく逃げてるみたいだな

English.Text: Hey. Glad to see Shinra hasn't caught you yet.

Japanese.Text: ちょうど良かった　仕事を頼めないか

English.Text:
Seein' as you're here,
mind helpin' me with something?

Japanese.Text: 俺はオリバー　ここの農場主だ

English.Text: I'm Oliver, by the way. Owner of this farm.

Japanese.Text:
実は　夜な夜な
うちの家畜が襲われて困ってるんだ

English.Text:
Got fiend trouble.
Every night it comes after my livestock.

Japanese.Text:
犯人は　モンスターだろう
探し出して　退治してくれないか？

English.Text:
Least I assume a fiend's to blame.
Think you could find and deal with it?

Japanese.Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Japanese.Text: モンスターの特徴は？

English.Text: What do you know about it?

Japanese.Text: あんたとブロードの関係は？

English.Text: How do you know Broden?

Japanese.Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Sure, we'll deal with it.

Japanese.Text:
おそろしく頭のいいヤツさ
罠を仕掛けても　ものともしない

English.Text:
Not much, save the bastard's smart as hell.
Managed to evade every trap I've set.

Japanese.Text: ハンターも雇ってるが　いまのところ成果ナシだ

English.Text:
Even hired a hunter to get rid of it,
but that was a bust.

Japanese.Text:
俺は　グラスランドの自然が大好きでね
守りたいと思えば　反神羅の旗を掲げることになる

English.Text: The ecosystem here is somethin' special─worth protectin'. Don't want Shinra messin' it up, and I'm not afraid to say so out loud.

Japanese.Text: そんな俺たちみたいのを　繋ぐヤツがいるのさ

English.Text: One day some like-minded folks came round.

Japanese.Text:
ブロードやアバランチとは
その縁で知り合ったんだ

English.Text: They put me in touch with Broden and Avalanche.

Japanese.Text: 立場は違うけど　情報交換は欠かさないよ

English.Text:
Impressive, the way that committee's
able to connect people.

Japanese.Text: 助かる

English.Text: 'Preciate it!

Japanese.Text: そのワンちゃん　あんたが飼ってるのか？

English.Text: That your dog there? Mind if I pet him?

Japanese.Text: 犬扱いは　やめたほうがいい

English.Text: I don't...but he might.

Japanese.Text: おお　よしよし　かわいいねえ

English.Text: Who's a good boy? It's you!

Japanese.Text:
あはは　元気がいいな
犬の嗅覚なら　追跡できるかもしれない

English.Text: Somethin' tells me he's not all bark! Hey, y'know, your pup might be able to track the fiend's scent.

Japanese.Text: いちど　犯行現場を調べてみてくれないか？

English.Text: Maybe try sniffin' around the scene of the crime?

Japanese.Text:
これ以上　家畜が減ると
廃業もありえない話じゃない　まいるよ

English.Text: Truth be told, I'm one murdered animal away from losin' the whole farm. Goddamn fiends...

Japanese.Text: 神羅は認めてないが

English.Text: Shinra'd never cop to it...

Japanese.Text:
凶暴なモンスターが増えたのは
魔晄炉のせいに決まってる

English.Text: but all these monsters wouldn't be runnin' around if it wasn't for their reactors.

Japanese.Text: ここか

English.Text: Here.

Japanese.Text: ここだね

English.Text: This is it.

Japanese.Text: わかるか？

English.Text: So?

Japanese.Text:
犯行から数日経過しているな
生ぐさいほかの獣のニオイも混ざっている

English.Text: It's been several days since the attack, so the scent isn't fresh. Other animals have come and gone as well.

Japanese.Text: 追跡は難しいだろう

English.Text: This won't be easy.

Japanese.Text:
かなりニオイが消えちゃってる
追いかけるのは難しいかも

English.Text: The smell's really faded. Not sure how much help my nose is gonna be here.

Japanese.Text: チョコボに嗅がせてみるか

English.Text: Think a chocobo could handle it?

Japanese.Text:
ふん　チョコボの嗅覚が優れているとはいえ
これは無理だろう

English.Text:
Hmph. Their sense of smell is indeed impressive,
but this trail is still quite poor...

Japanese.Text: ……が　試したいなら止めはしない

English.Text: Though if you wish to try, I won't stop you.

Japanese.Text:
やってみてもいいけど
チョコボの鼻でも　どうかなあ

English.Text: It's worth a try. They might be able to pick up more than I can, but I wouldn't bet on it...

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: わかったみたいだぞ

English.Text: He's got something.

Japanese.Text: んん？

English.Text: Wha─?

Japanese.Text: えっ　ホント？

English.Text: What? Really?

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text:
ふん　私も見当はついている
答えあわせといこうか

English.Text: Hmph... Well, I still have a faint impression of the scent. Together we can find the beast.

Japanese.Text:
へえ～　オイラはまったくわかんなかったのに
チョコボの嗅覚って　やっぱりすごいね

English.Text: Wow... Not gonna lie, I couldn't smell anything. I had no idea chocobos were that good at tracking!

Japanese.Text: ここで新たな獲物を襲ったようだな

English.Text: There was a struggle here not long ago.

Japanese.Text: ここでまた獲物を襲ったみたい

English.Text: Smells like a really fresh kill here.

Japanese.Text: 今度はレッドが調べてみるか？

English.Text: You wanna track it from here on out?

Japanese.Text: 今度はナナキが調べてみるか？

English.Text: You wanna track it from here on out?

Japanese.Text: いや　まずはチョコボにまかせてみよう

English.Text: No. The chocobo has led us this far, after all.

Japanese.Text: ううん　チョコボにまかせるよ

English.Text: Nah... Think the chocobo's got this.

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: 私はチョコボが間違えないように　サポートしよう

English.Text: I can help guide the bird─ensure it doesn't stray.

Japanese.Text: オイラ　がんばってサポートするね

English.Text: Well, I'm happy to lend my nose if needed!

Japanese.Text: チョコボに嗅がせてみるか

English.Text: Maybe a chocobo could track it.

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: あいつだ

English.Text: There!

Japanese.Text: あいつ？

English.Text: Found 'em!

Japanese.Text: どうした？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text:
神羅のビルに居たせいで
私の鼻は　すっかりなまってしまったらしい

English.Text: It's my sense of smell. Since my imprisonment in the Shinra Building, it hasn't been the same.

Japanese.Text:
私だけでは　ここまで追跡できなかっただろう
チョコボのおかげだ

English.Text: Before, I wouldn't have had any trouble tracking that scent. Now, though...

Japanese.Text:
オイラ　なんの役にも立たなかった
鼻には自信があったのに

English.Text: Tracking's always been kind of "my thing," but...I was worse than useless today.

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: ふん　チョコボに弟子入りすべきかもな

English.Text: Heh... Perhaps this bird is willing to take on an apprentice.

Japanese.Text:
へへへ……
なぐさめてくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks for trying to cheer me up.

Japanese.Text:
オイラ　立派な戦士になるためにも
この鼻から鍛え直すよ

English.Text: Going to have to seriously step up my sniffing game if I'm ever gonna be a real Watcher.

Japanese.Text:
おおそうか　倒してくれたか
大変だったろ

English.Text:
You got him, didja? Made that bastard pay?
Nice goin'.

Japanese.Text: もしかして　君が活躍してくれたのかな

English.Text: And I bet you were a big help too, weren't ya!

Japanese.Text:
あはは　ご機嫌ナナメなワンちゃんに
ごほうびだ

English.Text: You'll be singing a different tune when you see what I got for ya.

Japanese.Text: ほら！

English.Text: Here!

Japanese.Text: こっちは　あんたへの報酬だ

English.Text: Don't worry, I didn't forget you.

Japanese.Text: 話は変わるが　ブロードが体調を崩しているらしい

English.Text: Changin' gears a bit, but...I heard Broden's not feeling so hot.

Japanese.Text:
もしカームに寄ることがあったら
見舞ってやってくれ

English.Text: If you swing by Kalm again, mind checkin' on him?

Japanese.Text:
俺も　ブロードの見舞いに行きたいんだが
家畜の世話が忙しくてね

English.Text: Much as I wanna look in on Broden myself, I can't leave the farm unattended.

Japanese.Text: 俺の代わりに　ブロードを見舞ってやってくれ

English.Text: Bit of an ask, I know, but you mind checking on him?

Japanese.Text: 俺は　グラスランドの自然を守りたいんだ

English.Text: We've gotta preserve what's left of the grasslands, y'know?

Japanese.Text: 自然を守るためにも　神羅をなんとかしないと

English.Text: Land won't last much longer if Shinra keeps doin' what they do.

Japanese.Text: そうか　ブロードはニブルにいるのか

English.Text: What─you found him where? Nibelheim?

Japanese.Text:
まさか魔晄中毒だったとは……
クソ　ぜんぶ神羅のせいだ

English.Text: Can't believe Broden was mako poisoned this whole time... Goddamn Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイの放送　見たか
ようやく神羅を叩きのめす時がきたんだ

English.Text: Saw that broadcast outta Wutai. 'Bout time Shinra got a taste of their own medicine!

Japanese.Text: もちろん　あんたらも参加するよな

English.Text: You're onboard, right? With the war.

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会への参加方法は
アバランチに聞けばわかるかな

English.Text: Hey, you think someone from Avalanche would know who to contact about joining the SRC?

Japanese.Text: 君たちか　神羅をうまくまいたようだな

English.Text:
Oh, you're back...
I guess that means you managed to shake Shinra.

Japanese.Text: 君たちか　元気そうだな

English.Text: Back again? Well, you're always welcome.

Japanese.Text: あんたは　体調が良くないらしいな

English.Text: We heard that you've been feelin' under the weather lately.

Japanese.Text: へえ　情報が早いな　心配してくれるのか

English.Text:
Word gets around fast...
Didn't expect you to worry about me.

Japanese.Text: だったら　頼みを聞いてくれ

English.Text: But since you're here...can I ask you a favor?

Japanese.Text:
知り合いに　風車の部品の仕入れを
頼まれていたんだが　この体調じゃ難しい

English.Text: A friend of mine wanted me to help her fix one of the old republic windmills, but...I'm in no condition to do that.

Japanese.Text: 代わりに　やってくれないか？

English.Text: Do you think...you could instead?

Japanese.Text:
どうする　彼には世話になった
借りは返すべきだろう

English.Text: I think we should help. If not for him, we'd probably be back in Hojo's lab.

Japanese.Text:
ほら　この街から逃げる時に助けてもらったし
恩は返さないと

English.Text: Let's help him out. I mean, he did save our skins when we were on the run from Shinra. We owe him.

Japanese.Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you say?

Japanese.Text: 体調は大丈夫なのか

English.Text: You don't look so good. What's wrong?

Japanese.Text: あんたと神羅の関係は？

English.Text: How involved with Shinra were you?

Japanese.Text: なぜ神羅と敵対している？

English.Text: Why're you pissed at Shinra?

Japanese.Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: We'll do it.

Japanese.Text: 頭痛とめまいが　ひどくてね

English.Text: You know, headaches and dizziness.

Japanese.Text:
若い頃に　色々無理をしたせいかな
ガタがきているのかもしれない

English.Text: Probably my misspent youth. Paying the price for it now. Hindsight's twenty-twenty...

Japanese.Text: 頭痛とめまい　ほかには？

English.Text: Headaches and dizziness, huh...? Anything else?

Japanese.Text:
ときどき　声が……
私を呼ぶ声が　聞こえる気がするんだが

English.Text: Sometimes I hear...voices, I guess? Calling for me─urging me to go somewhere.

Japanese.Text: いや　なんでもない

English.Text: Sounds pretty crazy, saying it aloud.

Japanese.Text: 若い頃は　軍に所属していた

English.Text: I was a company grunt years ago.

Japanese.Text:
両親が亡くなったのを機に
神羅を抜けて　家業を継いだってわけさ

English.Text: But when my parents died, I got out to take care of the family business. Been running the place ever since.

Japanese.Text:
話せば長くなる
簡潔に言えば　家族と故郷を奪われた

English.Text: I'll spare you the grisly details, and just say they stole my life from me. My family. My home.

Japanese.Text: 恨むには　じゅうぶんな理由だろ

English.Text: Is that reason enough for you?

Japanese.Text: 故郷は　ここではないのか

English.Text: But I thought Kalm was your home.

Japanese.Text: あれ　ここは故郷じゃないの？

English.Text: Wait... I thought Kalm was your home.

Japanese.Text:
この街はいちど　神羅によって破壊されてる
再建されても　故郷という気はもうしない

English.Text: Not anymore. This isn't the Kalm I grew up in. My Kalm was destroyed by Shinra, and this? A soulless imitation...

Japanese.Text: ここにいるのは　恨みつらみを忘れないためさ

English.Text: but I stayed, 'cause I won't let myself forget what those bastards took.

Japanese.Text: ふん　不健康な生き方だ

English.Text: Hmph. Living in hate can poison a man.

Japanese.Text:
つらいね　悔しいね
ねえクラウド　力になろうよ

English.Text: I...I can't even imagine how that must feel. C'mon, Cloud. Let's lend him a hand.

Japanese.Text: 助かる

English.Text: Thank you.

Japanese.Text:
詳しいことは　ミルドという女に聞いてくれ
海沿いの廃集落に住んでいる

English.Text: My friend's name is Mildred. You should be able to find her somewhere around the old settlement, out on the cliffside.

Japanese.Text: 風車が目印だ

English.Text: Look for the windmills.

Japanese.Text: 君たちか　神羅をうまくまいたようだな

English.Text:
Oh, you're back...
I guess that means you managed to shake Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
どこに神羅の関係者がいるかわからない
あまり目立たないようにな

English.Text: You never know who might be a Shinra collaborator. Watch what you say and who you say it to.

Japanese.Text: 休んでいくなら　歓迎するよ

English.Text: You're welcome to stay the night, if you want.

Japanese.Text:
すまんな　依頼人の名前はミルドだ
ちょっと変わってるが　悪いヤツじゃない

English.Text: Sorry to put you to the trouble. Just to reiterate, my friend's name is Mildred. She's an odd duck, but a true sweetheart.

Japanese.Text:
ミルドには　凄腕が行くと伝えておこう
よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: I'll go ahead and tell her that...that help's on the way. Thanks again for doing this.

Japanese.Text: ブロードの友達？

English.Text: Did Broden send you?

Japanese.Text: 来てくれて　ありがとう

English.Text: I'm glad for the company.

Japanese.Text: どうだい　美しいだろ

English.Text: Ain't she a sight to behold?

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代のものだ
神羅とは設計思想から違う

English.Text:
A relic of the Republic of Junon.
Shinra can't make 'em like this, lemme tell ya.

Japanese.Text: 私はこいつを　どうしても動かしてみたくてね

English.Text:
I'm itching to scrape the rust off─
get her moving again.

Japanese.Text:
それなのに　ピッチ制御用のギアだけが
どうしても手に入らないんだ

English.Text: Easier said than done, unfortunately. The rotor's missing a key component, one that's a bitch to find.

Japanese.Text:
というわけで　君たちには
ギアを手に入れてきてもらいたい

English.Text: Which is where you come in! I'm gonna need your help to get me that part.

Japanese.Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: So, whaddya wanna know?

Japanese.Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: What do you want to know?

Japanese.Text: ギアの入手方法

English.Text: How to obtain the part.

Japanese.Text: ギアを作るための素材

English.Text: What transmutation materials we need.

Japanese.Text: ブロードとの関係

English.Text: How you know Broden.

Japanese.Text: ブロードは神羅でなにを？

English.Text: What happened between Broden and Shinra.

Japanese.Text: ブロードは治るのか？

English.Text: If Broden will get better.

Japanese.Text: 特にない

English.Text: Nothing. We're good.

Japanese.Text:
現在は生産されていない部品だ
アイテムクラフトで作れるはずだ

English.Text: Not through any shop, that's for sure. It's outta production, so you'll have to make it yourself.

Japanese.Text:
おっ　すでにクラフトチップは持ってるみたいだね
さすがブロードの友達　優秀じゃないか

English.Text: But that oughta be easy for you, seein' as you already found the chip. Nice work. Broden was right to send you my way.

Japanese.Text:
じゃあ　次は
レシピどおりの素材を集めてきてくれ

English.Text: Now all that's left to do is put that transmuter of yours to work.

Japanese.Text:
まずは　クラフトチップを
手に入れるところからだね

English.Text: So, first things first...the transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text:
レシピがわかれば　そのあと
素材をそろえてクラフトするだけさ　簡単だろ？

English.Text: Once you got that squared away, it should be as easy as poppin' in the materials ya need. Piece of cake, right?

Japanese.Text: お話はうかがっていました

English.Text: Perhaps I can be of service.

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代の情報でしたら
ライフスポットを解析してみてください

English.Text: If you wish to learn more about the Republic of Junon, I recommend visiting lifesprings.

Japanese.Text:
クラフトチップが眠る場所や
ほかにも　色々とわかるはずです

English.Text: The knowledge they contain will reveal the location of transmuter chips...

Japanese.Text:
というわけで　ワールドレポートの調査
よろしくお願いしますね！

English.Text: as well as other points of interest. I hope that helps your search!

Japanese.Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Okay. Lifesprings it is.

Japanese.Text:
草原を駆け巡りながら
いにしえの知識を探索するのも悪くない

English.Text: Fine by me. Only fitting that we learn the history of the planet as we seek to cross her.

Japanese.Text: おさんぽ　おさんぽ　おっさんぽ～！

English.Text: Oh boy! An adventure! C'mon!

Japanese.Text:
まずは　クラフトチップを
手に入れるところからだね

English.Text: So, first things first...the transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text:
レシピがわかれば　そのあと
素材をそろえてクラフトするだけさ　簡単だろ？

English.Text: Once you got that squared away, it should be as easy as poppin' in the materials ya need. Piece of cake, right?

Japanese.Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Right. Let's check some lifesprings.

Japanese.Text:
クラフトチップは見つけたようだね
じゃあ次は　アイテムクラフトだ

English.Text: Step one was scoring a transmuter chip─which you did. So now we put that baby to work.

Japanese.Text:
必要な素材は　グラスランドに生息する
ケツァルコアトルという鳥から採れるんだが

English.Text: As for the ingredients...you'll need to bag the quetzalcoatl─this rare bird─to get what you need.

Japanese.Text:
なんだ　すでに素材はそろってるじゃないか
あとはアイテムクラフトでギアを作るだけだよ

English.Text: Huh? Oh, you already procured the stuff? Well, aren't you an efficient one. In that case, only thing left to do is to transmute the part.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉の影響か　最近は見かけなくてね
どうだい　探せそうかい？

English.Text: Not that anyone's seen it lately. Sure Shinra's to blame for that too...but maybe you'll have better luck.

Japanese.Text: ライフスポットの解析を進めよう

English.Text: Time to tap into some lifesprings.

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: うん

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: ふむ　いわゆる幼馴染みというやつだな

English.Text: We go way back... Like, way back.

Japanese.Text:
ふたりとも　若い頃に街を出てね
世界中の風景を見てまわったよ

English.Text: The two of us skipped town when we were young, y'know. Thought we'd experience what the world had to offer.

Japanese.Text:
それから彼は神羅軍に入隊し
私はエンジニアになったというわけだ

English.Text: Eventually, we went our separate ways. He joined the military, and I became an engineer.

Japanese.Text: 優秀な兵士として　活躍していたみたいだよ

English.Text: Well, turned out he was a natural-born trooper.

Japanese.Text:
しばらくして　なにか特別な実験に参加すると言って
連絡が取れなくなってね

English.Text: Was even handpicked to take part in a "supersecret" experiment. It wasn't long after that we lost contact.

Japanese.Text: 再会した時には　彼は神羅を抜けていた

English.Text:
By the time we reconnected,
he'd already put that life behind him.

Japanese.Text: なんの実験だ？

English.Text: What "experiment"?

Japanese.Text: さあ　詳しくは教えてくれない

English.Text: Have to ask him...though I doubt he'd tell you.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　彼の体調の悪化は
その実験の後遺症ではないかと私は考えている

English.Text: Certainly won't tell me, at any rate. Whatever they did to him, though, has somethin' to do with his condition. I just know it.

Japanese.Text:
医者にも診てもらったようだが
原因がわからないらしい

English.Text: He's been to doctor after doctor, but all the tests come back inconclusive.

Japanese.Text:
私も　かつて失われた技術の中に
治療方法がないかと調べているんだが

English.Text: So I'm digging through old republic archives, looking for something that might help─something a doctor might overlook.

Japanese.Text: いまのところ　おてあげだ

English.Text: Just hope I find what he needs soon...

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Windmill's countin' on ya, friend.

Japanese.Text: 共和国の風車だ　美しいだろ

English.Text: Magnificent, isn't it? A republic original.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　なんとか動かせないものか

English.Text: If only there were some way to get it moving again.

Japanese.Text: なにか　質問はあるかな？

English.Text: So, what d'ya wanna know?

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
いま発見されたクラフトチップが

English.Text: Excellent! It seems you've found the transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text:
ミルドさんが探されている
『風車のギア』のレシピです

English.Text: With it, you'll be able to create the item Mildred needs.

Japanese.Text:
あとは　レシピどおりの素材をそろえて
作るだけですね

English.Text: You need only collect the requisite materials and craft the part.

Japanese.Text:
もし　素材が見つからない場合は
ライフスポットの解析を進めてみてください

English.Text: If you're having trouble tracking them down, then you may want to try analyzing more lifesprings.

Japanese.Text: 珍しいクラフトチップを発見しましたね

English.Text: That's quite the transmuter chip you've found.

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代に使われていた
風車の部品が　作れるようです

English.Text: In fact, it was once used in the construction of windmills.

Japanese.Text:
現在は入手困難な部品なので
もしかしたら　誰か探されているかもしれません

English.Text: Given its rarity, I would not be surprised if someone had need of such technology.

Japanese.Text: ケツァルコアトルの討伐を確認しました

English.Text: Confirmed: quetzalcoatl defeated.

Japanese.Text: コングラチュレーション　クラウド様！

English.Text: Amazing work as always, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
皆様の勇姿　わたくし
しかと目に焼きつけましたよ

English.Text: Your heroic victory over that vicious creature was a feast for the eyes!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　ＭＡＩがうるさかったら
いつでも言ってくださいね

English.Text: I suppose it falls to me to make MAI's presence more tolerable.

Japanese.Text:
あれ？
音量が小さく……ちょっと――

English.Text: How do you─ Volume levels decreasing!? Wait!

Japanese.Text:
あらためましてクラウドさん
モンスターの討伐　ご苦労様でした

English.Text: Now then, allow me to congratulate you on your victory over that beast...

Japanese.Text: おかげさまで　貴重な生体データが手に入りました

English.Text: and thank you for the valuable biological data!

Japanese.Text:
それと　入手された『ケツァルコアトルの爪』は
とても珍しい素材です

English.Text: You were likewise able to obtain something of great import: the beast's talon!

Japanese.Text:
クラフトで　使えるかもしれません
なくさないようにしてくださいね

English.Text: I suspect that it can be used in the creation of something astounding!

Japanese.Text: それに　これで『風車のギア』を作成できますね

English.Text: You should now be able to craft the requisite part for the windmill.

Japanese.Text:
早速クラフトして
ミルドさんに届けてあげましょう

English.Text: No doubt Mildred is impatiently awaiting its delivery.

Japanese.Text: 風車のギアを渡しますか？

English.Text: Hand over the gear?

Japanese.Text: 渡す

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text:
おお　すばらしい！
やっぱり共和国スタイルの部品は美しいなあ

English.Text: Now that is a quality design! No Shinra knockoffs can compare to republic ingenuity!

Japanese.Text: 早速　風車にセットしてみよう

English.Text: Okay, time to see if she works!

Japanese.Text: わははは　きたきたきた～！

English.Text: Hahaha! Hot damn, look at that!

Japanese.Text: すごいすごいすごい　見てくれ！

English.Text: It's amazing─incredible! Wow...

Japanese.Text:
海風を受けてブレードがまわっている
興奮する～！

English.Text: The blades are spinning─actually spinning! What a sight!

Japanese.Text: あとは　どれぐらいエネルギーを生み出せるかだな

English.Text: Oh, I can't wait to find out how much power it can generate!

Japanese.Text:
願わくば　昔みたいにブロードといっしょに
この光景を見たかったんだがな

English.Text: I wish Broden was here for this. He'd've loved to see these windmills running again. Maybe one day.

Japanese.Text:
とにかく　ありがとう
夢がひとつ叶ったよ

English.Text: Well, anyway...thank you. You've helped me fulfill a dream of mine.

Japanese.Text: これから　カームへ戻るのかい

English.Text: Guess you're heading back to Kalm?

Japanese.Text: そのつもりだ

English.Text: That's the plan.

Japanese.Text: ブロードに会ったら　伝えてくれ

English.Text: When you see Broden, you tell him...

Japanese.Text:
『さっさと体調を治せ
　そして　いつかまた旅に出よう』ってね

English.Text: "Hurry up an' get better, wouldja? We got a whole wide world to see..." Or, something along those lines.

Japanese.Text:
願わくば　昔みたいにブロードといっしょに
この光景を見たかったんだがな

English.Text: I wish Broden was here for this. He'd've loved to see these windmills running again. Maybe one day.

Japanese.Text: ブロードに会ったら　伝えてくれ

English.Text: When you see Broden, you tell him...

Japanese.Text:
『さっさと体調を治せ
　そしていつかまた　旅に出よう』ってね

English.Text: "Hurry up an' get better, wouldja? We got a whole wide world to see..." Or, something along those lines.

Japanese.Text: やはり　共和国の技術は面白いなあ

English.Text: Something about republic tech just speaks to me...

Japanese.Text:
さすがに　魔晄と比べれば
エネルギー変換率はおとるか

English.Text: But when it comes to energy output, it can't hold a candle to mako.

Japanese.Text:
風車のデータをとったら
次は　なにを蘇らせようかな

English.Text: Once I figure out how these windmills work, I bet I can get even more old tech running!

Japanese.Text:
共和国と神羅の技術のいいところどりができたら
すばらしいと思わないかい？

English.Text: Imagine combining Junon engineering with Shinra's. I mean, the possibilities'd be endless!

Japanese.Text: なるほど　ブロードはニブルで療養中か

English.Text: Oh...so Broden's getting treatment near Nibelheim, huh?

Japanese.Text: いっしょに旅に出るのは　しばらくおあずけだな

English.Text: Guess I'll just have to keep those travel plans of ours on the back burner.

Japanese.Text:
そうか
ミルドのやつ　はしゃいでたろ

English.Text: That so...? If Mildred's happy, I'm happy.

Japanese.Text: 『また旅に出よう』と伝えろと

English.Text: She said you've got a world to see.

Japanese.Text:
そりゃ楽しみだ
ずっと　働きづめだったからな

English.Text:
She just wants an excuse to travel.
But...I am overdue for a vacation.

Japanese.Text: 思いきって　長期休暇もいいかもな

English.Text: Think I've been working myself too hard lately.

Japanese.Text: そうしたほうがいい

English.Text: Rest would do you good.

Japanese.Text: うん　そうだね

English.Text: Yeah... Think some rest would do you good.

Japanese.Text:
ひどく嫌なニオイがする
まるで宝条の実験室にいた――

English.Text:
What is this terrible scent?
It's reminiscent of...Hojo's lab.

Japanese.Text:
あのね　すごく嫌なニオイがするんだ
まるで宝条の実験室にいた――

English.Text:
Do you smell that? It's terrible...
and it reminds me of...Hojo's lab?

Japanese.Text:
旅だ……
そうだな　旅に出ないと

English.Text: It's time... Time to go. To leave...

Japanese.Text:
旅だ……
そうだな　旅に出ないと

English.Text: It's time... Time to go. To leave...

Japanese.Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Urng... Eh... Uh...

Japanese.Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Aaah...hih... Aaah!

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫か？

English.Text: You okay?

Japanese.Text:
元ソルジャーの宿命さ
いわゆる……劣化だ

English.Text: It's just...the degradation. Every SOLDIER's gotta make their peace with it.

Japanese.Text: だから　普通の医者にはわからない

English.Text: Now you know why I can't see any old doctor.

Japanese.Text: おまえも　ソルジャーなんだろ

English.Text: You're a SOLDIER too, aren't you?

Japanese.Text: 元ソルジャーだ

English.Text: Ex-SOLDIER, actually.

Japanese.Text:
悪いな　不安にさせるつもりはなかった
それに必ずこうなるわけじゃない

English.Text: Didn't mean to scare you. The symptoms aren't always the same. And who knows? You might be one of the lucky ones...

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Right...

Japanese.Text: まだ若いんだ　まっすぐ生きろ

English.Text: Just...don't take your youth for granted, alright?

Japanese.Text:
やりたいことをやれ
神羅の呪縛に屈するものか　なあ？

English.Text: You only get one shot at life...and you can't let Shinra take it from you. You can't let them win.

Japanese.Text:
ミルドの風車を見るためにも
はやく体を治さないとな

English.Text: Need to rest...get my strength up. So I can see Mildred's windmills.

Japanese.Text:
ソルジャーには　いろんな噂がある
いちいち気にするな

English.Text: People love to spread rumors about SOLDIERs. Don't you pay them any mind.

Japanese.Text:
劣化の噂は聞いていたが　正直なところ
実際に襲われるまで　信じていなかったんだ

English.Text: I'd heard the rumors about cellular degradation, but didn't believe 'em. Didn't want to believe 'em─till I had no choice.

Japanese.Text:
軍から抜けて再開した宿屋だ
病気なんかで　たたむわけにはいかない

English.Text: I left the service to keep this place and my parents' memory alive. I'll be damned if I lose it too 'cause of this...illness.

Japanese.Text:
申し訳ありません
オーナーのブロードは　ただいま不在です

English.Text:
Oh, you're looking for Broden?
I'm sorry, but he's not here at the moment.

Japanese.Text:
はあ……
ブロードさん　どこ行っちゃったんだろ

English.Text:
Where in the world could he have gone...
And when's he coming back?

Japanese.Text:
いらっしゃいませ
ブロードさんから　話は聞いております

English.Text:
Well hello.
You must be the friends Broden mentioned.

Japanese.Text: アバランチの　みなさんですよね

English.Text: The Avalanche friends?

Japanese.Text: いいところにいらっしゃいました

English.Text: I'm so glad you're here.

Japanese.Text:
実は……ブロードさんが
突然いなくなってしまいまして

English.Text:
The truth is, Broden's gone.
Just...up and vanished.

Japanese.Text: かわりに　仕事を引き受けていただきたいのです

English.Text: So could you take on a bit of unfinished business?

Japanese.Text:
依頼人は　オーナーの知り合いで
ミルドさんという方です

English.Text: An old friend of Broden's, Mildred, came by hoping to get his help.

Japanese.Text:
海沿いにある　風車のところにいらっしゃるので
詳しいことは彼女から聞いてください

English.Text: Not sure what for, so best to ask her yourself. She mentioned she'd be out near the windmills─on the cliffside.

Japanese.Text:
詳しいことは　ミルドさんに聞いてください
海沿いにある風車が目印です

English.Text: I'm not sure what she wants, but Mildred said she'd be out near the windmills on the cliffside. Try there first.

Japanese.Text:
オーナー　最近はずっと体調が悪かったので
すこし心配です

English.Text: Between you and me, I'm worried about Broden. I've never seen him this...tired.

Japanese.Text:
ミルドさんとオーナーは　幼馴染みなんです
ふたりとも　昔はヤンチャだったと聞いてます

English.Text: Mildred and Broden grew up together, were thick as thieves at one point...and got into all kinds of trouble, to hear people tell it.

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ

English.Text: Hello there!

Japanese.Text:
ただいま　オーナーのブロードが不在のため
わたくしが代わりに承っております

English.Text: Broden has, uh, stepped out and may not be back anytime soon, but he's brought me up to speed.

Japanese.Text: ミルドさんから聞きました

English.Text: So has Mildred, actually.

Japanese.Text:
なんでも　オーナーの代わりに
仕事を引き受けてくださったとか

English.Text: I understand that you helped her out with her work. That was very kind of you.

Japanese.Text: 助かりました　ありがとうございます

English.Text: And I know that Mildred appreciates it too.

Japanese.Text:
こちら　報酬です
お受け取りください

English.Text: It may not be much, but...we'd like you to have this.

Japanese.Text:
みなさん　ミルドさんから聞きました
無事　風車が動いたみたいですね

English.Text: You're back! I just heard from Mildred. Can't believe she really got the windmill working again.

Japanese.Text: 本当に助かりました　ありがとうございます

English.Text:
Sounded like you were a big help too.
Thank you.

Japanese.Text:
こちら　報酬です
お受け取りください

English.Text: This isn't much, but to show our gratitude...

Japanese.Text:
あとは　オーナーが
無事に帰ってくればいいのですが

English.Text: I'm sure Broden will make it a point to thank you himself once he gets back.

Japanese.Text:
それまでは我々スタッフで
この宿を　守っていこうと思います

English.Text: Whenever that is...but in the meantime, we have things under control.

Japanese.Text:
オーナーも　ミルドさんの風車
見たかったでしょうね

English.Text: Broden would've wanted to see the windmills in motion, I'm sure...

Japanese.Text:
オーナーがいない間は　わたくしがしっかり
お客様をおもてなしします

English.Text: I won't let this place fall by the wayside while Broden's away. I'll keep it running somehow.

Japanese.Text: なんだい　まだウロウロしてたのかい

English.Text: Huh. Didn't think you'd still be hangin' around...

Japanese.Text:
しばらくこのあたりにいる気なら
ひとつ　おつかいでも頼もうかね

English.Text: Well, since you clearly don't have anything better to do, think I could put you to work?

Japanese.Text: 懸賞金の残りを　ある場所まで届けたくてね

English.Text:
The remainder of your bounty─
I need it delivered to someone.

Japanese.Text: 届け先は　この子が知ってる

English.Text: I've already got a porter picked out too.

Japanese.Text: コハダっていうんだ

English.Text: This here's Salmon.

Japanese.Text:
あんたたちの仕事は
コハダのボディガードってところだね

English.Text:
Since he'll be the one makin' the drop,
it's your job to get him there safe.

Japanese.Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Japanese.Text:
引き受けてやってもいいが
誰に届けるかくらい　聞かせてもらおうか

English.Text:
Doesn't seem like too much of a hassle,
but...who exactly is this money for?

Japanese.Text: 息子だよ

English.Text: My son.

Japanese.Text:
しばらく会っちゃいないけどね
勝手に村を出てって　それっきり

English.Text: Haven't seen him in a spell, not since he left town...and never looked back.

Japanese.Text: この金は　手切れ金ってとこさ

English.Text: This gil's me washing my hands of him.

Japanese.Text:
もう　子供って歳でもないし
いい加減　独り立ちしてもらわないとね

English.Text: He's a grown man. Can't be clingin' to his mom's skirts─or her pocket book.

Japanese.Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Japanese.Text: 息子はどこにいる？

English.Text: Ask where her son is.

Japanese.Text: 手切れ金とは？

English.Text: Ask about the money.

Japanese.Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Take the job.

Japanese.Text: サイドジュノンだよ

English.Text: The Crow's Nest.

Japanese.Text:
日陰の暮らしに飽きただの
私のやりかたは　生ぬるいだの

English.Text:
Boy got sick of living under this steel sky...
and my thumb, I suppose.

Japanese.Text:
そういう連中が寄り集まって
ジュノンのはずれで　活動してんのさ

English.Text: So he went into the mountains way east of here. Found some more like-minded idiots.

Japanese.Text:
ったく　家出するならするで
もっと遠くに行けばいいのにさ

English.Text: Kinda sad, if I'm being honest. If you're gonna run away, at least go somewhere interesting.

Japanese.Text: 中途半端ったらないよ

English.Text: Don't half-ass it.

Japanese.Text:
文字どおりの意味だよ
私は村のことで　手いっぱいだからね

English.Text: I meant what I said. Can't afford to take care of this town and his shit.

Japanese.Text:
ここまで育ててやりゃ　もうじゅうぶんだろう
あとは勝手にどこへなり行ってもらおうと思ってさ

English.Text: I raised him best I could─gave him every advantage. But he's gotta learn to stand on his own two feet.

Japanese.Text:
それに私にはこの子もいるしね
ねえ　コハダ

English.Text: 'Sides, I've got someone else to take care of now... Don't I, Sam?

Japanese.Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Japanese.Text: じゃ　よろしくね

English.Text: Much obliged.

Japanese.Text:
報酬は向こうにいるトビーって男から受け取ってよ
手配しといたからさ

English.Text:
Once you make it to the Crow's Nest, find Toby.
He'll make sure you get the reward I promised.

Japanese.Text:
いいかい　コハダにケガなんかさせたら
報酬から差っ引くからね

English.Text:
But if I find a single hair outta place on Sam,
you won't live to enjoy it.

Japanese.Text: ちゃんと　守っておくれよ

English.Text: You keep my boy safe.

Japanese.Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Japanese.Text:
コハダになにかあれば
今度こそ　神羅に突き出すよ

English.Text: Got Shinra on speed dial, so if my dog gets hurt, you get hurt.

Japanese.Text:
なるべく早く済ませてほしいんだ
スッキリしたいからね

English.Text:
You mind hurrying it along?
I just wanna put this whole business to bed.

Japanese.Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Japanese.Text: コハダについていきますか？

English.Text: Follow Salmon?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Japanese.Text:
おう　ちゃんと守ってやっから
心配すんな

English.Text: Don't you worry. Any monster that wants to getcha is gonna have to go through me!

Japanese.Text: バウバウッ！

English.Text: Bow wow!

Japanese.Text:
よう　クラウド
おまえはいつ　家を出たんだ

English.Text:
Hey, Cloud, remind me.
How old were you when ya left home?

Japanese.Text: １４……いや　春だからまだ１３だ

English.Text: Fourteen. Wait, it was spring, so...thirteen.

Japanese.Text:
田舎じゃあ　そんなもんだな
母ちゃんはどう言ってた？

English.Text: Suppose that ain't too unusual for small-town boys like you. What'd your mom have to say?

Japanese.Text:
反対はされなかった
それくらいで村を出るのは普通だったからな

English.Text:
Not much─didn't try to stop me.
Like you said, nothing unusual about it.

Japanese.Text: ああ……

English.Text: But...

Japanese.Text: なんだ？

English.Text: "But"?

Japanese.Text:
２０００ギルくれたんだ
新生活には　それくらい必要だとか言って

English.Text:
Two thousand gil─she offered me that.
"To make a fresh start."

Japanese.Text: ロドナーんちと同じじゃねえか

English.Text: Guess moms're the same all over.

Japanese.Text:
俺は断った　軍に直行だったから
必要なかった

English.Text: I turned the money down, though. Didn't need it, since I was planning to enlist straightaway.

Japanese.Text:
ははははは！
おまえが２０００にこだわる謎が解けたぜ

English.Text: But you still can't help settin' your price at two grand. Sentimental, ain'tcha!

Japanese.Text: なあ　聞けよ

English.Text: Okay, hear me out.

Japanese.Text: 聞いてる

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text: 子供の独り立ちを邪魔する親がいるだろ

English.Text: Know how some parents stop their kids from leavin' the nest?

Japanese.Text:
まだ早いとか　甘いとか
なんだかんだ理由つけてよ

English.Text: Claimin' it's too soon, or they're not ready─any excuse to keep 'em at home.

Japanese.Text: いるのかもな

English.Text: What about it?

Japanese.Text:
いるんだよ　でもオレは
そうはならねえって心に決めてるんだ

English.Text: Loads of parents're like that, but I told myself I'd be different─I'd never keep my little girl from flyin'.

Japanese.Text: マリンの独立心を尊重してやりてえ

English.Text: I don't wanna clip her wings─I want her to soar!

Japanese.Text: ふん

English.Text: Heh.

Japanese.Text:
笑ったな　鼻で笑い飛ばしたな？
オレには無理だとか思ってんだろ

English.Text:
I hear you scoffin'. You think I can't do it.
You think I'll keep her all to myself!

Japanese.Text: まあな

English.Text: Oh yeah.

Japanese.Text:
そうなんだよ　心に決めてはみたものの
ぜんぜん　できる気がしねえ

English.Text: And that's what scares me! As much as I wanna let her fly, I dunno if I'll be able to let go when the time comes.

Japanese.Text:
マリ～ン　マリ～ンって
しがみついて邪魔する気がする

English.Text: Maybe I'll panic─get in her way, hold her down, all to keep her safe!

Japanese.Text: はあ　マリン……

English.Text:
Oh, Marlene, I wish you could be
my baby girl forever...

Japanese.Text: ああ　マリン……

English.Text: Oh my sweet, baby girl...

Japanese.Text: 今度はなんだ

English.Text: What now?

Japanese.Text: 父ちゃん　父ちゃんは……

English.Text: Your daddy... Your silly daddy... He's gonna...

Japanese.Text: がああああ　やっぱ無理だーーー！

English.Text:
He's gonna fail you! Oh, I can't let you go.
I just can't!

Japanese.Text:
落ち着けバレット
マリンが家を出るにしても　まだずっと先だ

English.Text:
Barret! Get your shit together.
Marlene's barely outta diapers. You've got time!

Japanese.Text: だよな　そうだよな

English.Text: Right, right...

Japanese.Text:
そうそう想像　ただの想像
まだまだ先の話だ

English.Text:
I'm just gettin' worked up over nothin'! Yeah!
She won't be leavin' me for a while!

Japanese.Text: たぶんな

English.Text: Then again...

Japanese.Text: おい！

English.Text: Hey!

Japanese.Text:
ここはサイドジュノン
オレたち　反神羅青年団の拠点だ

English.Text: This here's the Crow's Nest, base of operations for our anti-Shinra activities.

Japanese.Text:
悪いけど　いまはアンダージュノンで騒動があって
通せないんだ

English.Text: Sorry, but we're keeping things locked down after the trouble in Under Junon.

Japanese.Text: ここは通せないよ

English.Text: Can't let you through.

Japanese.Text:
ごめんなさい
この先は立ち入り禁止です

English.Text: Sorry, sweetheart. No visitors allowed.

Japanese.Text:
ここはサイドジュノン
あたしたち　ここで反神羅活動してるのよ

English.Text: Up ahead's the Crow's Nest, where our brave resistance fighters come home to rest and regroup.

Japanese.Text: いまはちょっと　ゴタゴタしててね

English.Text: Although it's a little hectic right now...

Japanese.Text: この先は立入禁止よ

English.Text: I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.

Japanese.Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Japanese.Text: コハダ！　どうしてここに

English.Text: Sam? What're you doing here?

Japanese.Text: 傷だらけじゃないか　いったい誰に……

English.Text:
And you're hurt!
You come all this way alone?

Japanese.Text: ワフン　ワフン！

English.Text: Arf arf!

Japanese.Text:
つらかったな
うん　よく我慢した

English.Text: Poor boy... It's okay, you're safe now.

Japanese.Text: なんなんです

English.Text: Who're you?

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと疲れてるか？
ここまで遠かっただろ

English.Text:
Aw... You must be beat, buddy.
Coming all this way just to say hi.

Japanese.Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Japanese.Text: あれ　あなたたちは？

English.Text: Uh, do I know you?

Japanese.Text:
はは！
相変わらず元気いっぱいだな　おまえは

English.Text: Came all this way and you're still full of energy!

Japanese.Text: ワン　ワン！

English.Text: Woof woof!

Japanese.Text: あれ　あなたたちは？

English.Text: Uh, do I know you?

Japanese.Text:
あんたの母ちゃんに雇われた
コハダのボディガードだ

English.Text:
We're Sam's bodyguards.
Your mom hired us to keep him safe.

Japanese.Text: 母ちゃんからあんたに　おこづかいだってよ

English.Text: And to make sure her boy got his allowance.

Japanese.Text: ワン！

English.Text: Woof!

Japanese.Text:
母からの荷物なら受け取れません
俺　家出中なんで

English.Text:
Keep it─I ain't takin' her money.
I can make ends meet on my own.

Japanese.Text: ディラン　お客さんなの？

English.Text: Who're they, Dillan? Friends of yours?

Japanese.Text:
クレア　出てきたら危ないだろ！
転んでケガでもしたら……

English.Text:
Claire, what're you doing out of bed!?
You know you need to stay off your feet.

Japanese.Text:
とにかく　これは受け取れません
コハダといっしょに　お引き取りください

English.Text: I know you came all this way, but I can't accept that. Just make sure Sam gets home safe for me.

Japanese.Text:
がんこなとこは母ちゃん譲りってか？
ったく　しゃあねえなあ

English.Text: You really are your mother's kid. Got her stubbornness and everything. Have it your way.

Japanese.Text: これは　あんたに預ける

English.Text: Why don't you hang on to it?

Japanese.Text: えっ　こんなに！

English.Text: This is a fortune!

Japanese.Text: どうしてもって言うなら　返してもいい

English.Text: If ya really don't want it, I'll take it off your hands.

Japanese.Text: でも　赤ん坊が生まれるまで待て

English.Text: But as a parent, I'm sure you wanna give your kid the best life ya can.

Japanese.Text: 親になれば気持ちが変わる　たぶんな

English.Text:
And in my experience, that don't come cheap.
Think it over.

Japanese.Text: 親になれば……

English.Text: That's true...

Japanese.Text: ワン　ワンワン！

English.Text: Woof! Woof, woof!

Japanese.Text: わかりました

English.Text: We'll take it.

Japanese.Text: ワオーン！

English.Text: Awoo!

Japanese.Text: ディラン　ここにいたのか

English.Text: Dilster! Was lookin' for ya, dude!

Japanese.Text: トビー

English.Text: Toby?

Japanese.Text: 遅くなってすみません

English.Text: Sorry, got a little tied up.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチのみなさんですよね
ロドナーさんから　話は聞きました

English.Text:
Hang on─aren't these guys with Avalanche?
Rhonda said I might run into you!

Japanese.Text:
アバランチ？
まさかあの魔晄炉爆破を成功させた？

English.Text: Avalanche? Wait─you mean they're the ones who blew up those reactors?

Japanese.Text:
そう　まさに僕たちの希望の星！
いやあ　お目にかかれて光栄です～

English.Text:
The superstars themselves! I just wanna say,
it is such an honor to meet you.

Japanese.Text:
実は　みなさんに折り入って
お願いしたいことがありまして

English.Text:
Actually, while you're here,
think I could ask you for a favor?

Japanese.Text:
ディランの件は　え～っと
いちおう解決したんですかね

English.Text:
Seein' as Dillan's, uh, "situation"
seems to be taken care of?

Japanese.Text: おう　バッチリだ！

English.Text: Yep. S'all good.

Japanese.Text:
ということでしたら　さっそく
僕の話も聞いていただけると助かります

English.Text:
Excellent! In that case,
why don't we step into my office for a chat?

Japanese.Text: どうぞ　中へ！

English.Text: Right this way!

Japanese.Text: 母さんはこの子のこと　知っていたんでしょうか

English.Text:
You think my mom knew about me and Claire?
And the baby?

Japanese.Text:
生まれてきたら
ばあちゃんに会いに行ってみるか？

English.Text:
Once you're outta there,
we'll go pay your grandma a visit.

Japanese.Text:
生まれてくる子供のためにも
俺たちの海を取り戻さないとな

English.Text:
These used to be our waters, y'know.
And they will be again someday.

Japanese.Text:
聞こえてるか？
父さん　頑張るからな

English.Text: You hear that? Daddy's gonna make you proud.

Japanese.Text:
聞きましたか　反神羅連絡会の演説！
クレアと子供のためにも　俺は戦いますよ

English.Text: You hear that speech from the SRC? Got me all fired up! I'm ready to fight for my family and their future.

Japanese.Text:
もう　ビラ配りなんかしてる場合じゃないぞ
まずは武器を集めないと！

English.Text:
Handin' out flyers ain't gonna cut it anymore.
It's time to take up arms!

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの方とのご縁
この子が繋いでくれたのかもしれませんね

English.Text:
I'm happy we were able to meet you.
Almost feels like this little one brought us together.

Japanese.Text:
私たちも　反神羅を掲げてはいますが
思うように活動できていない状況で

English.Text:
We despise Shinra just as much as you do,
but with a baby on the way, it's hard to offer aid to the resistance.

Japanese.Text:
この子のためにも　アバランチのみなさんとは
力を合わせて行けたらと思ってます

English.Text: Still, if there's anything we can do to ensure a brighter future for our child, just say the word.

Japanese.Text:
もう　ディランったら……
やる気なのはいいけど　無茶はしないでね

English.Text:
My husband's got spirit, I'll give him that.
I just hope he stays out of trouble.

Japanese.Text:
この子の名前も　そろそろ考えないとね
お義母さんにも相談できたらいいのだけど

English.Text: We really ought to start thinking of names for the baby. Would be nice if Rhonda could give us a few suggestions, but...

Japanese.Text:
こんなタイミングで戦争だなんて
どうなっちゃうのかしら　私たち

English.Text:
War's no good for anyone...
I just pray we get through this. All of us.

Japanese.Text:
大丈夫よ
あなたのことは私が必ず守るわ　大丈夫

English.Text: Don't worry. No matter what happens in this crazy world, Mommy's gonna keep you safe. I promise.

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと　コハダだけ先に帰すなんて
どういうつもりだい

English.Text: Hey! What were you thinking, sending Sam back alone like that!?

Japanese.Text:
ワンコに聞けよ
そいつは　スタンプ以上だぜ

English.Text: He even need us in the first place? Your mutt'd give Stamp a run for his money.

Japanese.Text: それで　あの子は元気にしてたのかい？

English.Text: So...how's my son? Seem okay?

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: 腹んなかのガキもな　知ってたんだろ

English.Text: You gonna stand there and pretend this wasn't all about Claire and her bun in the oven?

Japanese.Text:
ったく　なにが手切れ金だ
意地張りやがってよ

English.Text: Psh... Apple didn't fall far from this stubborn-ass tree, that's for damn sure.

Japanese.Text: ふん　なんのことだか

English.Text: Hmph, wouldn't know about that.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ話は終わりだ　世話になったね

English.Text:
And if you're done makin' wisecracks,
I got work to do.

Japanese.Text:
よ～しよしよし
おつかい　えらかったねえ

English.Text: You did a good job today, boy... Someone's gettin' extra pets.

Japanese.Text:
男の子かねえ　女の子かねえ
こんな楽しみなことってあるんだね

English.Text: Do you think it's gonna be a little boy, or a little girl? I bet you can't wait to find out, either, can ya, Sam?

Japanese.Text:
おや　また来たのかい
たいした用もないだろうに　ヒマだねえ

English.Text: Back again? Figured people like you had better things to do than watch the paint dry in a place like this.

Japanese.Text: まあ　好きなだけいればいいさ

English.Text: Not to say we don't enjoy the company.

Japanese.Text:
なんだいしつこいね
私はヒマじゃないんだ　早く行きな

English.Text: What─just feel like pokin' the bear? 'Cause I do have things to do. Unlike some.

Japanese.Text: ロドナーさんは　どうするつもりなんだ

English.Text: What the hell's Rhonda gonna do about all of this?

Japanese.Text: 当然　神羅と戦うんでしょう？

English.Text: She's gonna take the fight to Shinra, that's what!

Japanese.Text:
ワシらだって　まだまだやれるぞ！
海で鍛えた体をナメてもらっちゃあ困る

English.Text: And when she does, we join her! We're people of the sea─rough waters don't scare us!

Japanese.Text:
このまま泣き寝入りなんて
あたしゃゴメンだよ！

English.Text: If Shinra thinks we'll take this lying down they got another thing comin'!

Japanese.Text:
グレン大佐の演説以来　この調子でね
見張りもまともにできやしないよ

English.Text: Thanks to that Lodbrok guy and his little speech, the town's so riled up I can't get a moment's peace...

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会……
まえにいちど　ここへも来たことがあったよ

English.Text: Y'know, that Shinra Resistance Committee or whatever came here to try 'n' recruit once.

Japanese.Text: そのときは　追い返したけどね

English.Text: Shooed 'em away as quick as I could.

Japanese.Text:
サイドジュノンの連中が
無茶を起こさなきゃいいけど

English.Text: Might've just sent 'em straight into the powder keg that is the Crow's Nest though.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルでのみなさんのご活躍
ニュースで見た時は　胸がスッとしましたよ～！

English.Text: Man, you Midgarinos are somethin' else. When I saw you on the news, I was blown away!

Japanese.Text:
いや～　アバランチの方々に
力を貸してもらえるなんて　本当に夢みたいです

English.Text: And here you are, lendin' me a hand! It's literally a dream come true!

Japanese.Text:
実はですね
岬にある灯台が　いつのまにか

English.Text:
So, here's the situation.
There's this big lighthouse down by the cape...

Japanese.Text:
『なんでも屋ジュノン支店』とかなんとか
よくわからない人に　乗っ取られてしまいまして

English.Text: And someone calling themselves "the Merc of Junon" has turned it into their hideout or something.

Japanese.Text: キリエだな

English.Text: Kyrie...

Japanese.Text:
あれ？
もしかして　お知り合いでしたか

English.Text: Oh. Are they an...acquaintance of yours?

Japanese.Text: まあな

English.Text: Sorta.

Japanese.Text:
なんという偶然
いや　これはもう必然というべきですね

English.Text: What are the chances!? I dunno about you, but I think fate brought us together.

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋？

English.Text: A "merc"?

Japanese.Text:
あれ？
もしかして　お知り合いでしたか

English.Text: Oh. Are they an...acquaintance of yours?

Japanese.Text: いや……

English.Text: No...

Japanese.Text:
あの灯台は　もともと僕たちが
物見台として使っていた場所なんです

English.Text: Anyway, that place has got a killer view. We used to go up there all the time and just chill.

Japanese.Text:
最近は　モンスターも増えてて危ないし
はやく立ち退いてもらいたくて

English.Text: But it's too dangerous with all the monsters around, and that merc hasn't done a thing about 'em.

Japanese.Text:
みなさんのお力で
どうにか　説得してもらえませんかね

English.Text: So I was hoping you could do me a solid and convince that merc to help us out.

Japanese.Text: 依頼を引き受けますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋とは？

English.Text: Ask about the merc.

Japanese.Text: 灯台はどこにある？

English.Text: Ask about the lighthouse.

Japanese.Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Do him a solid.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルやグラスランドで大活躍していた
とのことなんですが

English.Text: They've done many a good deed in Midgar and all throughout the grasslands.

Japanese.Text: ど～も　うさんくさくて

English.Text: Allegedly, that is.

Japanese.Text:
だいたい　なんでも屋ってなんなんですか
聞いたこともないですよねえ

English.Text:
And, like, if they're so good at "doing good,"
then why aren't they doing anything now?

Japanese.Text: 灯台は　この先の岬にあります

English.Text: The lighthouse is up ahead, right on the cape.

Japanese.Text:
もともとは　共和国時代の航海で……
って　それはまあいっか

English.Text: Apparently, it used to guide ships back in the republic days, but that was, like, forever ago.

Japanese.Text: とにかく辺鄙な場所だし　モンスターも出るし

English.Text:
Anyway, it's super outta the way
and crawling with monsters.

Japanese.Text:
あんなところでお客を募っても
誰もこないですよ　ぜったい！

English.Text:
Anyone who thinks customers'll come calling
is outta their mind.

Japanese.Text:
ありがとうございます
みなさんの手腕　拝見させていただきます

English.Text: Yo, you're the best! Y'know, I just knew I could count on you.

Japanese.Text: 誰か　いっしょに――

English.Text: So? You gonna help, or...?

Japanese.Text: 私か？
えっ　オイラ？

English.Text: Wait─me?

Japanese.Text: トラブルのにおいがするんだ

English.Text: You can sniff out trouble.

Japanese.Text: ならば　私が適任だろうな

English.Text: I suppose that does make me the most suitable candidate.

Japanese.Text:
まかせて！
オイラ　厄介事を解決するのは得意なんだ

English.Text: You've got that right. Leave it to me! My nose always knows the right way to go.

Japanese.Text:
ああそうだ　もしお時間があれば
丘のほうにも寄ってみてください

English.Text:
Oh, pro tip! If you ever get the chance,
you oughta swing by the hill too.

Japanese.Text:
運が良ければ
コンドルの姿が見れるかもしれませんよ

English.Text:
You might even catch a glimpse of
the great condor if you're lucky!

Japanese.Text: 興味があれば　ぜひ

English.Text: If you're into that kinda stuff.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの方達と　こうしてお会いできるなんて
夢にも思わなかったな～！

English.Text: Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd end up becoming best buds with Avalanche!

Japanese.Text:
灯台は　この先の岬です
どうぞお気をつけて

English.Text: The lighthouse isn't far─it's right on the cape. Be careful out there!

Japanese.Text: ずいぶんと派手にやっているようだな

English.Text: "Tacky" would be an understatement.

Japanese.Text:
うわ～　すごく目立ってるね
これならぜったい道に迷わないよ

English.Text: Wow, someone really splurged on their advertising budget. Least they'll never have trouble finding the place!

Japanese.Text: キリエ……

English.Text: Kyrie...

Japanese.Text: この商売根性は　尊敬に値するな

English.Text: They certainly poured their energy into the promotional aspect.

Japanese.Text:
へへ　このヤル気満々な感じ
オイラ嫌いじゃないよ

English.Text:
Gotta say, their passion's impressive.
I actually kinda dig it!

Japanese.Text: キリエは中か　行くぞ

English.Text: They'll be thrilled to hear it. Let's go.

Japanese.Text: よく来たな

English.Text: Greetings.

Japanese.Text:
おれがなんでも屋の　キリエだ
報酬は――

English.Text: Kyrie, Merc of Junon. And you are?

Japanese.Text:
って　なんだあ
お客さんじゃなくて　ウチの社員じゃん

English.Text: Aw, man. And here I got all excited thinking I had a customer...

Japanese.Text: こんなところまで出張　ごくろうさまでーす

English.Text: Well, thanks for makin' the trip out here to say hi, fellow merc.

Japanese.Text: 社員になった覚えはない

English.Text: Not your "fellow" anything.

Japanese.Text:
勝手に　なんでも屋を名乗るな
いますぐここから立ち去れ

English.Text:
And quit calling yourself a merc.
You're giving the real ones a bad name.

Japanese.Text: えっうそ　クラウド？

English.Text: Oh my gosh. Cloud!?

Japanese.Text:
キリエ……
ここでなにをしている

English.Text: Kyrie... What the hell are you doing here?

Japanese.Text:
あ～　ちょっとしたビジネス？
おばあちゃんとケンカしちゃってさ

English.Text: Um...just a little business venture? Grandma went off on another one of her tirades.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの外でガッツリ稼いで
見返してやろうと思って

English.Text: I swore to myself I'd make a killing outside the city so I could rub it in her face!

Japanese.Text:
あっそうだ　クラウドもここで働く？
歓迎するよ　新入社員くん

English.Text: Ah, I've got it! Why don't you come work for me? I could use another merc, and you're not half bad.

Japanese.Text: 社員になるつもりはない

English.Text: Not in a million years.

Japanese.Text:
勝手に　なんでも屋を名乗るな
いますぐここから立ち去れ

English.Text:
And quit calling yourself a merc.
You're giving the real ones a bad name.

Japanese.Text: あ～　いっぺんに言われてもわかりませ～ん

English.Text: What even is a merc? Nobody really knows!

Japanese.Text:
それに　元はといえば
ぜ～んぶ　クラウドのせいなんだから

English.Text: And besides─arguably this whole mess can be laid at your feet, mister.

Japanese.Text:
せっかくジュノンにまで進出したっていうのに
だ～れも　なんでも屋さんのこと知らないんだもん

English.Text: I came all the way out to Junon to strike it rich, but nobody knows we're here...or even that we exist!

Japanese.Text:
知名度ゼロ　仕事の依頼もゼロ
ホント　まいっちゃってさ～

English.Text:
Zero publicity, which means zero clients!
I mean, this is Business 101!

Japanese.Text:
仕方ないから　わたしがこうして
大々的に宣伝してあげてるってわけ

English.Text: Since you suck so bad at self-promotion, I had to pick up the slack and come up with an ad campaign.

Japanese.Text: じみ　くらっ　ぶあいそ

English.Text: what's your brand? Tall, blond, and "not interested"?

Japanese.Text: そんなんじゃ　廃業まっしぐらだよ

English.Text: Sounds like a one-way ticket to bankruptcy to me.

Japanese.Text: ……すまない

English.Text: Ahem... Allergies.

Japanese.Text: あっ　ごめん

English.Text: ...Sorry.

Japanese.Text: うわ　なにこの子　しゃべれるの？

English.Text: What!? Shut. Up. This thing can talk!?

Japanese.Text: よろしく

English.Text: Indeed.

Japanese.Text: 獣がしゃべったら　ダメなの？

English.Text: Uh, is that a problem?

Japanese.Text: うわ～　すっごい　かっわい～！

English.Text: Aw, aren't you just the most adorable boy!

Japanese.Text: ねえキミ　わたしのペットにならない？

English.Text: Hey─y'know, I've always wanted a pet of my own!

Japanese.Text: ほら　おいで～

English.Text: C'mere─come to mama!

Japanese.Text: ううう　こわっ！

English.Text: ...Yikes!

Japanese.Text: ざんねん……

English.Text: Okay, scratch that.

Japanese.Text:
残念といえば　こんなに頑張ってるのに
いまだにお客さんゼロでさ～

English.Text: Right! Anyway, as I was saying, I'm putting in all this work for us, yet we haven't managed to bring in a single customer!

Japanese.Text:
このままじゃ　なんでも屋の社長兼
宣伝部長の名がすたる！

English.Text: And if we don't get one really soon, your CEO and PR head is as good as done!

Japanese.Text:
ってことで　さっそく
こんなのも用意してみたんだよね～

English.Text: But not to worry! I put my creative skills to work and came up with this ditty!

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋　なんでも屋 新装開店　なんでも屋～♪

English.Text: There's a new merc─a new merc in town She's, like, the best─the best around♪

Japanese.Text: なんでもやります　なんでも屋～♪

English.Text: She's open for business, so come on down♪

Japanese.Text: いえ～い！
どうどう　宣伝効果バツグンでしょ？

English.Text: Pretty good, right? Folks'll be lining up in no time!

Japanese.Text:
えっ　うそ
モンスター呼んじゃった？

English.Text:
Wait, monsters!?
But what could've drawn them here?

Japanese.Text: おそらく　この不愉快な音のせいだろうな

English.Text: I'm sure your aggressive advertising has nothing to do with it.

Japanese.Text: たぶん　この音のせいだよ

English.Text: Really? You're kidding, right?

Japanese.Text:
なんでも屋さん　お願い！
モンスター退治　得意だよね

English.Text: Please, Cloud! You gotta help me! After all, nobody knows how to take down monsters like a merc.

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋なら　自分でなんとかしろ

English.Text: So hire yourself. You're a pro, aren'tcha?

Japanese.Text:
そう言わずに～！
あっほら　これあげるから

English.Text:
C'mon, don't be petty...
Oh! I'll even give you some of these!

Japanese.Text: いらない

English.Text: Pass.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　このままでは我々も危険だ
行くしかない

English.Text: Wait─our lives are in as much danger as hers now. We have to fight.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　行こう
このままじゃ　オイラたちも危ないよ

English.Text: But if we don't stop those monsters, we're all done for. C'mon!

Japanese.Text:
ほら　なんでも屋さん
よそ見してないで　もっと働いて！

English.Text: C'mon, get rid of those things already, wouldja!? I thought you were supposed to be good at your job!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　油断してたでしょいま
気をつけてよ～？

English.Text: I saw you take that hit, y'know! And they call you the pro? Psh!

Japanese.Text:
こんなやつら
なんでも屋さんなら楽勝だよね～

English.Text: These losers oughta be easy pickin's for a merc like you!

Japanese.Text:
いいねえ　さすが自慢の社員
その調子その調子～！

English.Text: Cleave 'em in two, my loyal subordinate! Wish I could film this; it'd make for a great commercial!

Japanese.Text:
ま～だで～すか～？
待ってるのも飽きたよお

English.Text: Okay, tick tock, tick tock! The boss's gettin' bored and she's not payin' you to have fun out there!

Japanese.Text: はあ　助かった～

English.Text: Whew! Glad that's over.

Japanese.Text:
こんなモンスターウジャウジャな場所じゃ
そりゃ　お客さんなんてこないか～

English.Text: And now I know why I wasn't getting any customers: nobody could get past all those uglies.

Japanese.Text: 学びがあって良かったな

English.Text: I'm glad you learned something.

Japanese.Text: 最初から　わかりそうな気もするけど

English.Text: I'm surprised it took you this long to figure it out.

Japanese.Text: 仕方ない　ここでの営業はあきらめるとしよう

English.Text:
Oh, well...
Guess I'll just have to close up shop and clear out!

Japanese.Text:
じゃあわたし　もう行くから
あと片付けよろしくね　社員くん！

English.Text: Anyway, I'm gonna split, but I'm sure you can take it from here. Catch ya later, fellow merc!

Japanese.Text: おい

English.Text: Hey!

Japanese.Text: いっしょにくる？　ほら　おいで～

English.Text: Wanna leave with mama? C'mon, you know you do...

Japanese.Text: じゃね～！

English.Text: Okay, later!

Japanese.Text: 距離を置きたい種類の人間だ

English.Text: I wouldn't wish her on my worst enemy.

Japanese.Text: オイラ　あの人ちょっとニガテかも

English.Text: Gotta say, somethin' about her really rubs me the wrong way.

Japanese.Text: 同感だ

English.Text: You and me both.

Japanese.Text: みなさ～ん！

English.Text: My dudes!

Japanese.Text:
変な放送が聞こえて外を見たら
モンスターがウヨウヨ移動してて

English.Text:
I saw the monsters headed your way...
and couldn't help but worry...

Japanese.Text:
いや～でも　心配無用でしたね
さすが　アバランチのみなさん！

English.Text: but it looks like I worried for nothing. I should've known Avalanche could hold their own!

Japanese.Text: それで　なんでも屋さんはどうなりました？

English.Text: Out of curiosity, what happened to that merc?

Japanese.Text: 出ていった

English.Text: She moved on.

Japanese.Text:
そうですか
じゃあ　ここは片付けなくちゃ

English.Text:
Bummer. Welp, guess we should
get this place cleaned up.

Japanese.Text:
それよりロドナーさんから聞きましたよ
みなさんも　なんでも屋をやってるって！

English.Text: Oh yeah, Rhonda was telling me you do merc work on the side too. For real?

Japanese.Text:
いや～　最初から言ってくれればいいのに
水くさいなあ

English.Text:
I can't believe you didn't say anything!
Best buds don't keep secrets, y'know.

Japanese.Text: なにかあったら　また力を貸してくださいね

English.Text:
But I hope you'll lend me a hand
the next time I need help!

Japanese.Text:
アバランチに　なんでも屋ですか
いや～　僕たちももっと頑張らないとですね

English.Text: Avalanche by day, traveling mercs by night. I dunno how you dudes find the time to do it all!

Japanese.Text:
この灯台は封鎖しておきます
また誰かが迷い込んだら　危ないですし

English.Text: Feel like we should probably rope this place off. Don't want anyone else wandering inside and making trouble.

Japanese.Text:
お時間があれば
丘のほうにも寄ってみてください

English.Text:
If you ever get the chance,
you oughta swing by the hill too.

Japanese.Text:
運が良ければ
コンドルの姿が見れるかもしれませんよ

English.Text: You might even catch a glimpse of the great condor if you're lucky!

Japanese.Text:
ようこそ　サイドジュノンへ
みなさんなら　いつでも大歓迎です！

English.Text: Hey there! Goes without saying, but you dudes are always welcome here at the Crow's Nest.

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋のお仕事は順調です？

English.Text: How's business? Making bank?

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　今度ここで勉強会を開いてくださいよ
報酬は弾みます

English.Text: Say, you should do a seminar or something─teach us how to fight the power. Stick it to the man!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　みなさん
なんだか　急に騒がしくなっちゃいましたねえ

English.Text: Hey there, buds. Things've gotten pretty crazy lately, huh? What a world!

Japanese.Text: 僕も絶賛　情報収集中です

English.Text: Almost too much to keep track of─but I try!

Japanese.Text:
みなさんは　連絡会とは繋がってないんですか？
ご存知のことがあれば　教えてくださいよ

English.Text: Hey, uh, you wouldn't happen to know anyone in the SRC, would you? If you do, I'd kill for an introduction!

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠にある小型魔晄炉にて
エンシェントマターの反応を観測しました

English.Text: I've detected protorelic signals emanating from a nearby modular reactor.

Japanese.Text:
位置データをお送りしましたので
調査をお願……しま……

English.Text: I'm sending you its location and would like you to in...at...

Japanese.Text:
あらら　砂嵐の影響かな
位置データは届いた？

English.Text: Uh-oh. Sandstorm musta kicked up or something. Transmission go through?

Japanese.Text: ああ……

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: あれは　砂嵐か？

English.Text: This must be the sandstorm.

Japanese.Text:
クラ……ドさ……聞こえ……
嵐の……で　通信……害が………

English.Text:
Clo... ca... me...
Th... s...rm... caus...ence...

Japanese.Text:
つわものの気配に誘われて
這い出でたるは　灼熱地獄

English.Text: Drawn was I to the warrior's presence, and lo! Whither should it lead me but these sweltering sands.

Japanese.Text: なに　こいつ？

English.Text: What is this thing!?

Japanese.Text: おまえは……

English.Text: No way...

Japanese.Text:
おぬしらが探し求めているものは
我のものである

English.Text:
What misfortune for you to venture so far
for treasure already claimed!

Japanese.Text: 手出し無用　早々に立ち去るがよい

English.Text:
You would do well to leave,
that I may collect what is by rights mine.

Japanese.Text: エンシェントマターのこと言ってんの？

English.Text: You think the protorelic is yours?

Japanese.Text:
えんしぇ……んと　またあ？
ええい　そんな奇怪な名前ではないわ

English.Text:
Proto-what now? Relic, you say? Hah!
A ridiculous name unworthy of my treasure!

Japanese.Text:
よく聞け
あれこそは我が伝説の武具　げん――

English.Text:
What you knaves covet is none other than
a prize in my resplendent arsenal: the Gen─

Japanese.Text: うおお　おのれ　力が足りぬ……

English.Text: This form─I can hold it no longer!

Japanese.Text: なんだったの？

English.Text: So, what was that?

Japanese.Text:
よかった　繋がった！
大丈夫ですか　クラウドさん

English.Text:
Oh, thank goodness I finally got through!
Are you alright?

Japanese.Text:
問題ない　それより
さっきのはなんだ？

English.Text: I'm fine─but what the hell was that just now?

Japanese.Text: はい　詳しくは解析中ですが

English.Text: I'm investigating the matter as we speak.

Japanese.Text:
先ほど出現した砂の巨人から
エンシェントマターに似た反応を検出しました

English.Text: In my initial analysis of the sand entity, I detected a protorelic-like signal.

Japanese.Text:
関連は不明ながら　あの巨人も
エンシェントマターを狙っているようです

English.Text: I'm unsure how they're connected, but I fear we might be after the same thing.

Japanese.Text: 面倒だな

English.Text: Of course we are.

Japanese.Text:
また　どこで現れるかわかりません
くれぐれも気をつけてください

English.Text: There's no telling where it might appear next. Please, be careful.

Japanese.Text: エンシェントマターに接近しています

English.Text: The signal is growing stronger.

Japanese.Text: この先に　小型魔晄炉があるはずなのですが

English.Text: Perhaps there is a protorelic in the nearby reactor.

Japanese.Text: もしかして　あれ？

English.Text: Uh, you mean that thing?

Japanese.Text: 形状の変容を確認

English.Text: It's been altered...

Japanese.Text:
神羅以外の何者かによって
増築された形跡があります

English.Text: Though it doesn't appear these modifications were made by Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
なにが待ち受けているかわかりません
慎重に調査をお願いします

English.Text: Whoever's responsible may be waiting within. Proceed with caution.

Japanese.Text:
モンスターの巣
あるいは　砦といったところか

English.Text: It's some sort of monsters' den─a "fortress," if you will.

Japanese.Text:
モンスターの巣かな
もしくは　砦？

English.Text: Smells like a monsters' hideout─or a "fortress"?

Japanese.Text: 絶対あかないって感じだね

English.Text: Whatever it is, I don't think we can get inside.

Japanese.Text: スキャンを実行

English.Text: Commencing scan...

Japanese.Text: 神羅のデータベースにヒット

English.Text: I believe I have a match.

Japanese.Text:
『覇王文書』という古文書に記載された
文様との類似を確認　解読を試みます

English.Text: The symbols resemble those found in the Book of Kings, an ancient tome. Allow me to translate.

Japanese.Text: なるほど……

English.Text: Interesting...

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Well then.

Japanese.Text:
この扉を開放するには　砂漠に点在する
サボテン岩を見つけ出す必要があるようです

English.Text: In order to unlock this door, you'll need to locate a cactuar rock hidden somewhere in the desert.

Japanese.Text: サボテン岩？

English.Text: What kinda rock?

Japanese.Text:
砂漠地方で採取される
サボテンに似た鉱石です

English.Text: A mineral deposit named for its distinct cactuar shape.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんがこの扉に触れたことで
鍵となるサボテン岩が緑色に輝いているはずです

English.Text: Now that Cloud has made contact with this door, the rock we seek should be marked by a green glow.

Japanese.Text: それと……

English.Text: By the way...

Japanese.Text: 近くに　サボテンの形をした像がありませんか？

English.Text: Do you happen to see a cactuar-shaped statue anywhere nearby?

Japanese.Text: それです！

English.Text: That's it!

Japanese.Text:
その像を掲げると　扉の鍵となるサボテン岩まで
みなさんを導いてくれるようです

English.Text: That statue should guide you to the rock I spoke of, which in turn will serve as the key to the door.

Japanese.Text: なにやら　試されているようだな

English.Text: So we must prove ourselves worthy.

Japanese.Text: オイラたち　試されてる？

English.Text: They're really makin' us work for it.

Japanese.Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: I know you can do it!

Japanese.Text:
ねえねえ　あの岩
サボテンみたいじゃない？

English.Text: Hey, check it out. Doesn't that rock kinda look like a cactuar?

Japanese.Text: そんなこともあるだろうな

English.Text: It's just your imagination.

Japanese.Text: これか

English.Text: Aha.

Japanese.Text: これだね

English.Text: Gotta be this.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　なにしてんの？

English.Text: Um...what're you doing?

Japanese.Text: ぐっ……知るか

English.Text: I'm not...doing...anything...

Japanese.Text:
あはは　面白かった～
ねえ　サボテン岩ってほかにもないのかな！

English.Text: Oh, man, that was hilarious. Hey─you think there are any more of these amazing rocks out there?

Japanese.Text: 厄介な仕事になったな

English.Text: Your pliability is most impressive.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　ナイスポーズ

English.Text: Nice work, Cloud. You're pretty flexible!

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉へ戻るぞ

English.Text: Whatever. Let's go.

Japanese.Text:
うわ　かわいい～
なんて言ってんだろ　わかる？

English.Text:
Aw, they're adorable!
But what're they saying? You know?

Japanese.Text:
サボテンダーは代々　エンシェントマターを
『砂漠の秘宝』として守ってきたらしい

English.Text: To them, the protorelic is the "treasure of the sands," it seems, which they have kept safe for generations.

Japanese.Text:
サボテンダーはね　エンシェントマターを
『砂漠の秘宝』と呼んで　ずっと守ってきたみたい

English.Text: I think they're saying the protorelic is the "treasure of the sands," and that they've guarded it for practically forever.

Japanese.Text:
正統な持ち主が現れるまで　秘宝を守ることが
自分たちの使命だと言っている

English.Text: Moreover, they are duty bound to ensure its safety until its "rightful owner" comes to claim it.

Japanese.Text:
正統な持ち主が現れるまで　秘宝を守るのが
サボテンダーたちの使命なんだって

English.Text: And apparently they're supposed to keep it safe until its "rightful owner" shows up, or something.

Japanese.Text: 正統な持ち主？

English.Text: Wonder who that is.

Japanese.Text: そういう神話が　語り継がれているようだ

English.Text: For all we know, it could simply be a myth.

Japanese.Text: うん　そういう神話が残ってるんだって

English.Text: I dunno, but that's how the legend goes, I guess.

Japanese.Text:
サボテンダーの神話？
ホントにそんなのあんの～？

English.Text: You're saying these guys have their own fairy tales? Sounds pretty silly to me.

Japanese.Text:
オレたちの物語を
バカにしないでくれるかい

English.Text: Hang on a sec─who're you callin' a "fairy"?

Japanese.Text: おっと　慌てない慌てない

English.Text: Whoa, no need for all that!

Japanese.Text:
オレはキッドＧ
ゴブリン一族の末裔だ

English.Text: Name's G─Kid G, descended from a long line of goblins.

Japanese.Text:
いまは　いにしえの盟約にもとづき
サボテンダーたちを指揮している

English.Text: I look after these cactuars. It's a duty passed down to me from my forebears.

Japanese.Text: あはっ　しゃべる～

English.Text: Wait─you can talk?

Japanese.Text: 伝えたい想いがあれば　言葉ぐらい獲得するさ

English.Text: Speech ain't that hard, lady: where there's a will, there's a way.

Japanese.Text:
モンスターがしゃべらないなんて
人間の先入観だね

English.Text: Given your present company, I'm shocked you haven't shaken that preconception.

Japanese.Text: ふむ　一理ある

English.Text: He does have a point.

Japanese.Text: わかるわかる！

English.Text: He's got a point!

Japanese.Text:
サボテンダーの聖典　覇王文書の一節
『砂漠の秘宝を求めし者に　試練を与えん』

English.Text: Quoth cactuar scripture, the Book of Kings: "Unto those who seek the treasure of these sands, a trial shall be given."

Japanese.Text:
アンタたちが　秘宝の持ち主にふさわしいか
じっくり見せてもらおうか

English.Text: If you think you've got what it takes to be the treasure's "rightful owner," you're gonna have to prove it first.

Japanese.Text: なになになに？

English.Text: Where'd they all come from!?

Japanese.Text: サバク　ヒホウ　マモレ

English.Text: Protect! Treasure! Forever!

Japanese.Text: ミセロ　チカラ　オモイ

English.Text: Power! Prove! Worthy!

Japanese.Text: タオセ　タオセ　タオセ

English.Text: Trial! Trial! Trial!

Japanese.Text: これは試練だ

English.Text: And now, your trial!

Japanese.Text:
制限時間内にサボテンダーを倒して
力を証明してくれ

English.Text: Take down the cactuars within the time allotted─if you can.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　アンタが挑戦者ってことでいいかい？

English.Text: Oh, it looks like we have ourselves a volunteer!

Japanese.Text: えっ　アタシ？

English.Text: Who? Me!?

Japanese.Text:
そんな実力じゃ　砂漠の秘宝は渡せないな
どうする　もういちどやるかい？

English.Text: 'Fraid I can't just hand over the treasure of the sands after a performance like that. So, you gonna give it another go?

Japanese.Text: ふふん　再戦ならいつでも受け付けるよ

English.Text: You're always welcome to try again, y'know.

Japanese.Text: もう　終わりにするかい？

English.Text: Had enough for today?

Japanese.Text: さあ　正統な持ち主だって証明してくれよ

English.Text: Well then, let's see how "rightful" you really are!

Japanese.Text: さて　見極めさせてもらうよ

English.Text: Okay, now show me what you got!

Japanese.Text: 試練の時間だ

English.Text: Let the trial begin!

Japanese.Text:
『サボテン・ノック』に挑戦しますか？
<color=yellow>【挑戦者：ユフィ】</color>

English.Text: Attempt Cactuar Crush with <color=yellow>Yuffie</color>?

Japanese.Text:
『サボテン・ノック』に挑戦しますか？
<color=yellow>【挑戦者：エアリス】</color>

English.Text: Attempt Cactuar Crush with <color=yellow>Aerith</color>?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: ノーマルモード

English.Text: Normal Mode

Japanese.Text: ミッションモード

English.Text: Hard Mode

Japanese.Text: <button=mission>ミッションモード

English.Text: <button=mission> Hard Mode

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: 思っていたより　やるね

English.Text: Gotta say, I'm impressed.

Japanese.Text: エンシェントマターを渡してもらおうか

English.Text: You gonna hand over the protorelic, then?

Japanese.Text:
ずいぶんと変わった名前で呼んでるんだね
もちろん約束は守るさ　ほら

English.Text:
Never heard anyone call it that before...
But I'm a goblin of my word, so here.

Japanese.Text: それが　砂漠の秘宝……の『カケラ』さ

English.Text: And so, as promised─your piece of the prize.

Japanese.Text: カケラ？　どういうこと？

English.Text: "Piece"? We want the whole thing, shrimp!

Japanese.Text:
秘宝は　いくつかのパーツに分けて
それぞれ砦に隠してあるのさ

English.Text: Then you're gonna need to go around and gather up the other bits─put it together yourself.

Japanese.Text: え～っと　つまり……

English.Text: Riiight. So what you're saying is...?

Japanese.Text: 試練は　まだまだあるってこと

English.Text: That more trials await...

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　次の砦で待ってるよ！

English.Text:
and that yours truly will be your guide.
See ya next time!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
興味深い事態になりましたね！

English.Text: What an unexpected and exhilarating turn of events!

Japanese.Text:
秘宝を守るサボテンダー軍団
それを指揮する　知的なゴブリン

English.Text: An ancient treasure guarded by an army of cactuars and a goblin!

Japanese.Text:
砂漠に現れた謎の巨人
サボテンダーの聖典　覇王文書

English.Text: Not to mention the mysterious giant of the sands, and the Book of Kings!

Japanese.Text:
ボクの体温上昇を検知
ボクはいま　興奮しています！

English.Text: Hah! Increase in body temperature detected. I...believe I'm rather excited!

Japanese.Text:
早速エンシェントマター
いや　『砂漠の秘宝』の反応を観測しました！

English.Text: I've already picked up another signal from the protorelic─or rather, the "treasure of the sands"!

Japanese.Text: 弐号魔晄炉へ　向かってください

English.Text: Head for Modular Reactor 2!

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　小型魔晄炉って
いくつもあるの？

English.Text: Say, how many of these minireactors are there, anyway?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Several.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠には　ゴールドソーサーへ電力を供給するために
建設された小型魔晄炉が　複数基存在しています

English.Text: These modular mako reactors were erected throughout the desert as a means of generating and supplying power to the Gold Saucer.

Japanese.Text: 現在は　土地が枯れて砂漠化が進行しないよう

English.Text: To avoid accelerating the desertification of the region...

Japanese.Text:
稼働基と休眠基を　順番にまわすことで
延命をはかっているようです

English.Text: the reactors are periodically cycled between active and dormant states.

Japanese.Text: キラキラの代償が　アツアツのカサカサか～

English.Text: Who would've thought all that glitz and glamor came at such a high cost...

Japanese.Text:
その魔晄炉も　いまは秘宝を守る砦です
サボテンダーたちの建築技術はすばらしいですね

English.Text: In any case, the reactors have been ingeniously repurposed by the cactuars─and within these fortresses, they may secure their "treasure."

Japanese.Text:
砂にサボテンエキスを混ぜて固めたようですが
耐久性は　神羅製よりも優れているかもしれません

English.Text: I honestly doubt Shinra could produce anything half as resilient as this combination of sand and cactuar nectar.

Japanese.Text: 見ろ

English.Text: Look.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　見て

English.Text: Whoa, do you see that?

Japanese.Text:
うおおおお……
どこだあ　どこに隠した～？

English.Text: Where is it? Where is my beloved treasure!?

Japanese.Text: あいつもまだ　見つけられてないみたい

English.Text: Sounds like he's still looking for the protorelic.

Japanese.Text: 先に手に入れよう

English.Text: We'd better find it first.

Japanese.Text: ぬおおおお！

English.Text: Mvoah!

Japanese.Text: におう　におうぞ

English.Text: I can smell it... Its scent is unmistakable!

Japanese.Text: 近くにあるはずだ

English.Text: It's here somewhere...

Japanese.Text: どこを見ても砂ばかり

English.Text: Sand, sand, everywhere...

Japanese.Text: ぐぬぬ　ここはどこだ？

English.Text: Where am I!?

Japanese.Text: ぬおお　体がたもてん……

English.Text: No, my body cannot hold!

Japanese.Text: 力が　力が足らぬ！

English.Text: My power...it wanes!

Japanese.Text: 暑い～……

English.Text: So very hot...

Japanese.Text: むう　無念……

English.Text: I...regret everything.

Japanese.Text: おのれ　これまでか……

English.Text: Curses, is this the end?

Japanese.Text: ここも　小型魔晄炉だったのですが

English.Text: This is another modular reactor, but...

Japanese.Text: 扉は　反応しませんね

English.Text: I'm not getting a signal here.

Japanese.Text:
いまは　壱号基のサボテン岩探しを
優先でお願いします

English.Text: We should prioritize locating the cactuar rock for Reactor 1.

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　サボテン岩探しといきますか！

English.Text:
Alright then.
Let's start lookin' for those craggy cactuars.

Japanese.Text:
どうしたの？
ほら　はやくはやく～

English.Text: What're you waitin' for? Go on─touch it!

Japanese.Text: やってみるか？

English.Text: Ladies first.

Japanese.Text:
ううん　クラウドのほうが得意だと思う
こういうの！

English.Text: Oh, no. You're way better at the whole "putting yourself in harm's way" thing.

Japanese.Text: えっ　うそ～！

English.Text: Are you kidding me!?

Japanese.Text: ぐぐぐ……　なんで？

English.Text: ...Why me?

Japanese.Text: 無理に動くな　痛めるぞ

English.Text: Word of advice: don't fight it.

Japanese.Text: 経験者は語るか

English.Text: Yes, heed the voice of experience.

Japanese.Text: さすがは経験者！

English.Text: Yeah, Cloud would know.

Japanese.Text: だはあ～　なんでアタシがこんな目に

English.Text: ...What did I do to deserve this!?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉へ戻るぞ

English.Text: Let's head back to the reactor.

Japanese.Text: やっと来たね

English.Text: Sure took you long enough.

Japanese.Text: それじゃあさっそく　第２の試練といこうか

English.Text:
Whaddya say?
Wanna jump right into your second trial?

Japanese.Text: 何度やっても　同じだ

English.Text: You know how this ends.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　こういうのはどう？

English.Text: Do I ever─but do you?

Japanese.Text: でっか！

English.Text: Holy crap!

Japanese.Text: サバク　ヒホウ　マモレ

English.Text: Protect! Treasure! Forever!

Japanese.Text: ミセロ　チカラ　オモイ

English.Text: Power! Prove! Worthy!

Japanese.Text: タオセ　タオセ　タオセ

English.Text: Trial! Trial! Trial!

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　今度は……

English.Text: Let's see, who looks fit to fight?

Japanese.Text:
はいはーい
わたし　やってみたい！

English.Text: Ooh, me! Can I give it a go?

Japanese.Text:
オーケー
では　力を見せてもらおうか

English.Text:
Fine by me!
If the little lady wants to show off, I say let her!

Japanese.Text:
へえ　正直甘く見てたよ
ただの盗賊じゃなかったわけだ

English.Text: Wow, you sure showed me! And I still thought you might be no better than a bunch of bumbling bandits.

Japanese.Text: これで終わりか？

English.Text: We done now?

Japanese.Text:
まさか　秘宝のカケラはあとふたつ
これからが本番さ！

English.Text: Not even close! You've still got two more pieces to collect─and they won't come easy!

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　次は参号魔晄炉で待ってるよ！

English.Text: And with that, I'll see you folks at the next reactor!

Japanese.Text:
あ～でも　そうだな
ちょっと試練をテコ入れする時間が欲しいな

English.Text: Ah, but I could use a bit of time to shore up the next trial, seeing as you kinda breezed through the first two.

Japanese.Text: ここらへんで　いったん休戦しようか

English.Text: How's about we put things on pause?

Japanese.Text: じゃん！

English.Text: Ta-da!

Japanese.Text:
というわけで　試練の準備が整ったら知らせるから
連絡先を交換してよ

English.Text: Here─gimme your contact info. That way, I can hit you up when the trial's good and ready.

Japanese.Text: はあ？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ここは　従ったほうが賢明かと

English.Text: Cloud, I think it would be wise to oblige his request.

Japanese.Text: ありがとう

English.Text: Perfect.

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　連絡がくるのを楽しみにしてて

English.Text: You'll be hearing from me soon. Peace!

Japanese.Text: 秘宝探しは中断か？

English.Text: Our hunt is on hiatus?

Japanese.Text: 秘宝は　おあずけ？

English.Text: So, no treasure?

Japanese.Text:
いまのところ　こちらからは打つ手がありません
おとなしく連絡がくるのを待ちましょう

English.Text: For the time being. I'm afraid our only viable course of action is to await further instructions.

Japanese.Text: あれ　忘れものですか？

English.Text: 'Sup, bro! Forget something?

Japanese.Text:
それとも　さっそく
シーサイド・ジョニーが恋しくなりました？

English.Text: Or did you just miss the unbeatable ambiance of my seaside paradise?

Japanese.Text:
でも　ちょうどよかった
アニキの腕を見込んでお願いしたいことがあって

English.Text: Either way, I'm glad you're here, 'cause I was actually hoping to ask you for a little favor.

Japanese.Text:
アニキ　ちょうどいいところに
アニキの腕を見込んで　お願いしたいことがあって

English.Text: Hey, perfect timing, bro! I was actually hoping to ask you for a little favor.

Japanese.Text: おかげさまで　借金がチャラになったんで

English.Text: As you know, your boy's debt-free.

Japanese.Text:
ここはババーンと　シーサイド・ジョニーを
リフォームしようと思ったんです……が

English.Text: Figured I'd make the most of my financial solvency and give the inn a total makeover! Thing is...

Japanese.Text: 人手が足りないのか

English.Text: You short on hands?

Japanese.Text:
ああ……いや　アニキ
事態はもっとこう　複雑なんです

English.Text:
Ah, if only, my dear bro.
Kinda the opposite problem, actually.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　ジョニー
君はなんで俺なんだ！

English.Text: O Johnny, a name thou hast claimed as thine!

Japanese.Text:
おお　ジョニー
俺が君なら　俺はいったい？

English.Text:
But if thou truly Johnny be,
then who, pray tell, am I!?

Japanese.Text: みたいな　古典的で文学的な問題なんです

English.Text:
So yeah. It's your classic existential crisis.
You get the idea.

Japanese.Text: はあ？

English.Text: Uh...

Japanese.Text: ベッドメイキング　終わったぜ～

English.Text: Beds've all been made─what's next?

Japanese.Text: ええっ？

English.Text: Huh!?

Japanese.Text: あっ　アニキ！

English.Text: Oh, hey bro!

Japanese.Text:
だ～っと　おまえは出てくんな
話がややこしくなる！

English.Text:
I told you to stay outta sight!
You're just gonna confuse 'em.

Japanese.Text:
ほら　買い出しを頼んだろ？
行った行った

English.Text:
Aren't you supposed to be out shopping anyway?
Go on─shoo!

Japanese.Text: ええ～？
