English.Text: Aw...

Japanese.Text:
ちぇっ　なんだよ
俺だってアニキと話したいのに

English.Text: How come he gets to talk to my bro and I don't? So unfair.

Japanese.Text: ……というワケなんです

English.Text: ...See what I have to deal with?

Japanese.Text: ……というワケなんです

English.Text: "...See what I have to deal with?"

Japanese.Text: そっくりな従業員だな

English.Text: He looks just like you.

Japanese.Text: 双子だったのか

English.Text: You have a twin?

Japanese.Text: 忍術の影響か

English.Text: You a ninja?

Japanese.Text:
あはは……
いくらなんでも　そっくりすぎるでしょう

English.Text: Think you're surprised? Imagine how I felt!

Japanese.Text: どーも　求人広告を見て来たんですが

English.Text: Good day, sir! I saw your help wanted ad.

Japanese.Text: うん？　おまえ　どっかで見た顔だな

English.Text: Oh, that's─ Say, you look awfully familiar...

Japanese.Text:
って　俺？
そんなバカな　どうして

English.Text: Too familiar. You look exactly like me!

Japanese.Text:
うわわわ　くるな
こないでくれ　あああ～！

English.Text: N-no, please! Stay back! Don't come any closer!

Japanese.Text: って　そんな怖いヤツ雇いませんよ

English.Text: Okay, that last part was just a joke, but...

Japanese.Text:
はい　実はそうなんです
いまのは生き別れになった双子の弟　ジャニー

English.Text: It's true. Poor Yanni and I were separated at birth when he was ripped from our mother's arms.

Japanese.Text:
弟は　モンスターに育てられるという
波乱万丈な人生を……

English.Text: The creatures that stole him brought him up in the wild as one of their own, and─

Japanese.Text: って　そんなワケないでしょ！

English.Text: No, he's not my twin!

Japanese.Text:
もしかして　アタシのせい？
アタシが　分身の術をかけたせい？

English.Text: This wouldn't have anything to do with me using my ninja skills to create a bunch of clones...would it?

Japanese.Text:
何人か　消えずに残っちゃったみたいで
てか　増えてる？

English.Text: Turns out a few of 'em managed to stick around somehow, and I think they might've even multiplied.

Japanese.Text:
あはは　アタシってば才能ありすぎ～
ありすぎて　術が強すぎたみたい

English.Text: I mean, I never doubted my amazing abilities, but even I didn't realize I was capable of doing that.

Japanese.Text:
あっ　でもでも
おかげで人手は足りてるんでしょ？

English.Text: But hey, look on the bright side─at least you aren't short-staffed!

Japanese.Text:
みんな　リフォームの材料を探しに行ったっきり
ぜんっぜん帰ってきません

English.Text: Oh, but I am. I sent a crew to fetch materials and haven't heard a word from 'em since.

Japanese.Text: 増えたところで　俺は俺ってことです

English.Text: Turns out I can't rely on myself─my other selfs.

Japanese.Text: アニキ～　手伝ってもらえませんか

English.Text: I'm beggin' ya, bro! You gotta help me out here!

Japanese.Text:
ほら俺　キケンな野獣の一面もあるじゃないですか
野放しは　危ないと思うんです

English.Text: A Johnny's a wild beast that can't be tamed─you know that! There's no telling what sorta havoc these bad boys might wreak!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　助けてやんない？

English.Text: Maybe we should lend him a hand?

Japanese.Text: ……わかった

English.Text: ...Fine.

Japanese.Text: さすがはアニキ　話がはやい！

English.Text: Yes! I knew I could count on you, bro!

Japanese.Text:
俺の分身は　材料を探しに
コスタフォールズへ向かったはずです

English.Text: I sent them off to the Costa Falls to look for materials for the renovations.

Japanese.Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: Might wanna start there!

Japanese.Text:
俺の分身たちは
コスタフォールズにいると思います

English.Text: You probably wanna start by having a look around the Costa Falls.

Japanese.Text:
はあ……
みんな　考えナシに動きやがって

English.Text: I suppose I should've known I couldn't be trusted...

Japanese.Text:
あ～　せっかく集めたのに
モンスターの野郎！

English.Text: Man, if it weren't for those uglies, we woulda been done by now!

Japanese.Text:
おまえが　しっかり
持ってなかったせいだろ

English.Text: You're the one who dropped all the stuff we collected!

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと襲われたぐらいで
ビビりやがって

English.Text: Guy like us oughta have more of a backbone.

Japanese.Text:
おまえこそ悲鳴あげて逃げたじゃねえか
うひゃ～ってよ　情けねえ

English.Text: You're one to talk! Who was it that ran off squealing like a little girl?

Japanese.Text:
うるせえ　俺もおまえも
ジョニーなんだから仕方ねえだろ

English.Text: Whatever, bro! You probably woulda done the same thing if you were me─which you are!

Japanese.Text: はあ　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: We're so screwed!

Japanese.Text: アニキ　どうしてここに？

English.Text: 'Sup, my bro!? What're you doin' here?

Japanese.Text: ジョニーに　材料を探すよう依頼を受けた

English.Text:
Johnny sent me to check on you guys.
Help you find materials.

Japanese.Text:
おお　さすがは俺！
最強の助っ人ってワケだ

English.Text:
Whoa, that was pretty smart of me!
No one knows me better than myself.

Japanese.Text: うへ～　なんか気味ワルいなあ

English.Text:
This whole "synchronized talking"
thing is kinda creepy.

Japanese.Text:
実は　材料集め終わったんすけど
モンスターに襲われて　落としちまったんです

English.Text: We had actually already gathered everything we needed, but then we ran into some fiends and had to zipline for our lives.

Japanese.Text:
ジップラインを使って逃げてきたので
たぶん　そのあたりに落ちてると思うんです

English.Text: So unless they took our stuff for some weird reason, everything should still be right where we dropped it. We think.

Japanese.Text: アニキ　お願いしてもいいですか？

English.Text: You'll help us get it all back, won'tcha, bro?

Japanese.Text: できるだけ　多く集めてもらえると助かります

English.Text:
The more pieces ya pick up,
the better off me and me'll be!

Japanese.Text:
けっこー大変そうだね
そうだ　アタシたちも分身しちゃう？

English.Text: This is gonna be tough with just us... Oh! Maybe I could make some clones of me and you to help out!

Japanese.Text: これ以上　かき乱すな

English.Text: That is a terrible idea.

Japanese.Text:
ええ～　面白いと思うけどな～
ほら　想像してみてよ

English.Text: Uh, I think you meant to say "terrific" idea? C'mon, Cloud─just imagine how much fun it could be!

Japanese.Text: うん……？

English.Text: Hmm...

Japanese.Text: ほい！
ほら

English.Text: Well?

Japanese.Text: ほらほら～？

English.Text: What'd I tell ya?

Japanese.Text: ほらほら～

English.Text: What'd I tell ya?

Japanese.Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Japanese.Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ！

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Japanese.Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ？

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Japanese.Text: ユフィちゃんズに　おまかせあれ！

English.Text: This looks like a job for the Yuffie Squad!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　あっちに行ってみよ

English.Text: How 'bout we take a look over there?

Japanese.Text: い～や　あっちのほうが怪しいよ

English.Text: Nah, I think we'd have better luck over there.

Japanese.Text: マテリアはどこだ～？

English.Text: If it's not materia, I'm not interested!

Japanese.Text: ウシシシシ！

English.Text: Heh heh!

Japanese.Text: シュシュシュシュシュ！

English.Text: Sih-sih-sih-sih, hah!

Japanese.Text: クラウド～？

English.Text: Hey, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: クラウド？

English.Text: Uh, Cloud?

Japanese.Text: クラウドってば！

English.Text: Are you even listening to us!?

Japanese.Text: ねっ　楽しそうでしょ！

English.Text: See? Like I said─fun!

Japanese.Text: そうは思えない

English.Text: No. Not fun.

Japanese.Text: ええ～？

English.Text: Boooooo!

Japanese.Text: アニキがきてくれて　これで百人力だ

English.Text: Havin' our bro help out's like havin' a hundred of us.

Japanese.Text:
おうおう　実際
俺たち１００人で戦っても負けるよな

English.Text: Even better. Throw a hundred Johnnys in a fight and we'd still get our asses kicked.

Japanese.Text: そもそも　怖がって誰も戦おうとしねえよ

English.Text: We'd be so scared we'd run before the fight began.

Japanese.Text: アニキ　見つかりましたか？

English.Text: So, you find anything, bro?

Japanese.Text: 集めた材料を渡しますか？

English.Text: Give Johnny the materials?

Japanese.Text: 持っているだけ渡す

English.Text: Yes.

Japanese.Text: 材料について聞く

English.Text: Need to know where they are first.

Japanese.Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No.

Japanese.Text:
あれ？
アニキ　持ってないっすよ

English.Text: Uh, are you pullin' our legs here, bro?

Japanese.Text: アニキ　ちゃんと集めてくださいよ

English.Text: C'mon, don't leave us hangin'. We need your help!

Japanese.Text:
ジップラインのそばに落ちてるはずです
できるだけ　多く集めてもらえると嬉しいです

English.Text: They oughta be all around the ziplines─right where we dropped 'em. You'd be doin' us a solid by trackin' 'em down!

Japanese.Text: アニキ　ちゃんと集めてくださいよ

English.Text: C'mon, don't leave us hangin'. We need your help!

Japanese.Text: これで　最後だよね

English.Text: That's the last of 'em, right?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　はい
たしかに受け取りました

English.Text: Yep, this is definitely some of our stuff!

Japanese.Text:
これなら　ギリッギリですけど
なんとかなりそうです

English.Text: Would've liked all of it, but we're an ingenious guy─we'll make it work.

Japanese.Text:
おお　これだけあれば
しっかりリフォームできます

English.Text: Nice! With this much, we can renovate the hell outta the hotel.

Japanese.Text: さすがは　なんでも屋とシノビすっね

English.Text: And it's all thanks to the merc and his ninja pal!

Japanese.Text:
わお　よくこんだけ見つけてきましたね
これならバッチリです！

English.Text: Whoa! Honestly, we don't even remember collecting this much stuff. You're incredible!

Japanese.Text: やっぱアニキは　規格外の男だぜ

English.Text: You got that right! Our bro's a cut above.

Japanese.Text:
じゃあ　俺たちは材料を持って
シーサイド・ジョニーに戻りますね

English.Text: I guess we better get this haul back to our palace kinda sorta by the sea.

Japanese.Text: これで依頼は完了　いいな

English.Text: Which means our work here is done. Right?

Japanese.Text:
それが　実はほかのジョニーたちが
ボイラー修理に必要な部品を探しに行ってて

English.Text: Well, since ya asked... A couple of the other Johnnys went lookin' for parts to fix the boiler.

Japanese.Text: えっ　ほかにもいんの？

English.Text: Wait─there's more of you?

Japanese.Text: そっちを手伝ってもらえると　嬉しいです

English.Text: Yep─and I bet they could really use your help!

Japanese.Text:
あいつら　共和国時代に建てられた工場跡地に
向かったっぽいんで　よろしくお願いします

English.Text: Think they were headed toward one of those old republic-era factories. Tell 'em Johnny says hi! It's a thing we do.

Japanese.Text: どこだ　共和国時代の工場は？

English.Text: We've been looking for hours. We're never gonna find this place!

Japanese.Text:
やっぱ　俺たちだけで探すのは
無理なんじゃねえか

English.Text: Bet we would've found it already if we had a few more of us to help search!

Japanese.Text:
いいホテルに　温かいシャワーが
ないなんて　ありえないよな

English.Text: Can't call it a seven-star hotel if we can't even offer a hot shower.

Japanese.Text: だよな　はやくボイラーを修理しないと

English.Text: Tell me about it. We really gotta fix that boiler!

Japanese.Text: どこだ　クラフトチップは？

English.Text: Where the hell're we supposed to find a transmuter chip?

Japanese.Text:
やっぱ　俺たちだけで探すのは
無理なんじゃねえか

English.Text: Bet we would've found it already if we had a few more of us to help search!

Japanese.Text:
集中して気配を感じるんだ
ピンときたら　すかさず掘る！

English.Text: We just gotta focus all our brainpower on that chip─feel the chip─and start digging!

Japanese.Text: はあ　おまえがチョコボだったらな

English.Text: Treasure hunting'd be a lot easier if you were a chocobo...

Japanese.Text: クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: アニキじゃないっすか！

English.Text: Hey there, bro!

Japanese.Text: ジョニーに頼まれて手伝いにきた

English.Text: Hey, Johnny said that you needed my help.

Japanese.Text:
ジョニーが？
もしかして　おまえか

English.Text: What? No, I didn't. Wait─was it you?

Japanese.Text: 俺じゃない

English.Text: Not me!

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　俺か？

English.Text: So you're saying it was me?

Japanese.Text: いや　おまえがそんなに気が利くはずない

English.Text: No way. You're too stubborn to ask for help.

Japanese.Text: ああ？　なんだとコラ

English.Text: Hey! You talkin' shit about me?

Japanese.Text: あはは　ウケる～！

English.Text: You two are a riot!

Japanese.Text:
そのまま　ジョニー劇団とかやってみれば？
きっと流行るよ　ねっ！

English.Text:
Have you thought about starting a two-man show?
I bet it'd be a smash hit! Right?

Japanese.Text: 状況は？

俺たち　ボイラー修理に
必要な部品を探してたんですが

English.Text:
Well, we were lookin' for a part to
help us repair the boiler.

Japanese.Text: いまは作られてないっぽくて

English.Text: But it turns out nobody makes it anymore.

Japanese.Text: だったら　いちから作ってやろうと思って

English.Text: Then we thought, "why don't we just make it ourself?"

Japanese.Text: クラフトチップ探しに切り替えたところです

English.Text: So to do that, we're hunting for a transmuter chip!

Japanese.Text: 成果は？

English.Text: Any luck?

Japanese.Text:
このあたりに　共和国時代のバルブ工場が
あったはずなんですけど　見つからなくて

English.Text: None, unfortunately. There's supposed to be a republic-era factory around here somewhere...

Japanese.Text:
アニキ　俺たちの代わりに
探してもらえませんか？

English.Text: You're way better at findin' stuff than us. Mind bein' our bloodhound, bro?

Japanese.Text: あとはまかせろ

English.Text: Okay, I'll take it from here...

Japanese.Text: やった～！

English.Text: Suh-weet!

Japanese.Text: お話はうかがっていました

English.Text: I heard about your plight.

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代の情報でしたら
ライフスポットを解析してみてください

English.Text: If you wish to learn more about the Republic of Junon, I recommend visiting lifesprings.

Japanese.Text:
クラフトチップが眠る場所や
ほかにも　色々とわかるはずです

English.Text: The knowledge they contain will reveal the location of transmuter chips.

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代のボイラーを使ってるホテルなんて
たぶん　ウチぐらいですよ

English.Text: Some folks might say our hotel's boiler is old, but we prefer to think of it as vintage.

Japanese.Text: 共和国時代の工場　見つかりましたか？

English.Text: Speaking of which─found that "vintage" factory yet?

Japanese.Text:
そこに　俺たちが求めるクラフトチップが
眠ってるはずなんです

English.Text: The transmuter chip we're after should be somewhere inside. We're sure of it!

Japanese.Text: こういう時に　チョコボがいれば

English.Text: Sure wish we had a chocobo right about now...

Japanese.Text: あとはまかせろ

English.Text: Okay. I'll take it from here...

Japanese.Text: やった～！

English.Text: Suh-weet!

Japanese.Text:
俺たちが探してるのは
ボイラーバルブのレシピです

English.Text: We're looking for instructions on how to craft a boiler valve.

Japanese.Text:
チップを見つけたら
そのまま　クラフトもやっちゃってください

English.Text: And if you find one of those chips, feel free to just transmute a valve yourself!

Japanese.Text: しれっと仕事を増やしてない？

English.Text: Are you trying to give us even more work?

Japanese.Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: You two are the best!

Japanese.Text: アニキ～！

English.Text: Hey, bro!

Japanese.Text: おお　ここが共和国時代の工場か～

English.Text: So─this is the place, huh? Definitely couldn't have found it without you!

Japanese.Text:
あとは　チョコボを使って
クラフトチップを掘り出すだけです

English.Text: Now all we need is for you to use a chocobo to sniff out that transmuter chip for us!

Japanese.Text:
俺たちが探してるのは
ボイラーバルブのレシピです

English.Text: We're looking for instructions on how to craft a boiler valve.

Japanese.Text:
チップを見つけたら
そのまま　クラフトもやっちゃってください

English.Text: And if you find one of those chips, feel free to just transmute a valve yourself!

Japanese.Text: しれっと仕事を増やしてない？

English.Text: Are you trying to give us even more work?

Japanese.Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: You two are the best!

Japanese.Text:
どうする　アタシたちも分身して
手分けして探す？

English.Text: All I'm saying is we'd find everything much faster if we cloned ourselves too.

Japanese.Text: やめろ

English.Text: No.

Japanese.Text:
なんでも屋もチェーン展開できるじゃん
ウータイ支店　作っちゃおうよ

English.Text: Just think: you could start a mercenary franchise! And I could even help you set up a branch in Wutai!

Japanese.Text:
それに　クラウドがいっぱいれば
神羅との戦争にも勝てるんじゃない？

English.Text: Plus, Shinra wouldn't stand a chance against a Cloud army. You and your buster-sword-wielding buddies'd hack 'em to bits!

Japanese.Text: どうだろう

English.Text: Yeah, right.

Japanese.Text: ほら　想像してみようよ

English.Text: Oh, c'mon─just imagine!

Japanese.Text: ほい！
クラウドがひとり　クラウドがふたり

English.Text: One Cloud...two Clouds...

Japanese.Text: クラウドが３人　クラウドが４人

English.Text: Three Clouds...four Clouds...

Japanese.Text:
うう　無言のクラウドがいっぱい
なんか　息が詰まる

English.Text: I know you aren't much of a talker, but I figured at least one of you would say something. Not really diggin' this vibe.

Japanese.Text: やっぱ　クラウドは増えなくていいかな

English.Text: Yeah... Yeah, I think I'm good with just one Cloud.

Japanese.Text: 俺もそう思う

English.Text: The one and only.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボがいないなら　俺たちが
チョコボになっちまえばいいんだ

English.Text: We don't need a chocobo─'cause we can be our own chocobo!

Japanese.Text: そのとおりだクエ！

English.Text: Hey, that's kweh-ver!

Japanese.Text: さあ行け　ジョニーチョコボ！

English.Text: Right? Now giddyup, Johnny!

Japanese.Text: クエッ　ここ掘れクエ！

English.Text: Here! X warks the spot!

Japanese.Text: そこ　さっきも掘ってなかったか？

English.Text: Wait, didn't we try digging there before?

Japanese.Text: 俺を信じろクエ

English.Text: Kweh'mon─trust me!

Japanese.Text: チップはどこだクエ！

English.Text: Kweh-re's that chip!?

Japanese.Text: おっ　いまなにか光らなかったか？

English.Text: Hey─see that? A glint of light─maybe metal!?

Japanese.Text: 俺の嗅覚を信じろクエ

English.Text: Time to put my sniffer to wark!

Japanese.Text: チップって　どんなニオイがすんだ？

English.Text: Wait. What does a chip smell like?

Japanese.Text: チョコボの嗅覚さえあれば　いっぱつなんですけど

English.Text: Sure wish I had a chocobo's sense of smell right about now...

Japanese.Text: はあ　本物のチョコボさえいればな～

English.Text: I just wish we had a chocobo...

Japanese.Text:
チョコボなら　コスタのレンタルショップで
会員になれば手に入りますよ

English.Text: You can rent a chocobo from that shop in Costa del Sol. Members only, but still.

Japanese.Text:
このあたりに
クラフトチップが埋まってるはずです

English.Text: That transmuter chip's here─I can feel it!

Japanese.Text:
アニキとチョコボの力で
バシッと見つけちゃってください

English.Text: All you and your bird gotta do is start sniffin' and dig that sucker up!

Japanese.Text:
チップを見つけてくれたんですね
ありがとうございます！

English.Text: Whoa, you actually found the chip? Way to go, bro!

Japanese.Text:
あとは　レシピどおりに素材を集めて
クラフトするだけです　がんばってください

English.Text: Once you've got all the necessary materials, you can transmute us a brand-new boiler valve!

Japanese.Text: アニキ　もしかして手間取ってます？

English.Text: Hey bro. You're not...slackin' off, are you?

Japanese.Text:
あとは　レシピどおりに
ボイラーバルブをクラフトするだけですよ

English.Text: That valve isn't gonna transmute itself, y'know─though that'd be sweet.

Japanese.Text: ボイラーバルブを渡しますか？

English.Text: Hand over the boiler valve?

Japanese.Text: 渡す

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text:
おお　これです！
これでボイラーを修理できます

English.Text: Oh, baby, this is it! That boiler is as good as fixed.

Japanese.Text: 熱々のシャワーを提供できます

English.Text: Hot, steamy showers in every room!

Japanese.Text:
んじゃ　ジョニーもぜんぶ見つけたし
報告に戻る？

English.Text: Well, we should probably report back to Johnny now that we've bailed out all the others.

Japanese.Text: ああ　いや……それが

English.Text: Uh, actually...

Japanese.Text: あと　ひとり

English.Text: There's one more.

Japanese.Text: えっ　まだいんの？

English.Text: Where is he!?

Japanese.Text:
シーサイド・ジョニーに　伝説のモンスター
トンベリキングの王冠を飾るんだって

English.Text: Said he wanted to give the hotel royal flair by putting the Tonberry King's crown on display.

Japanese.Text: 砂漠のほうへ　狩りに行ったヤツが

English.Text: Last we heard, he was desert-bound.

Japanese.Text: あいつ　干からびてないといいけど

English.Text: Hope he's not dying of thirst or knife wounds.

Japanese.Text: アニキ　様子を見てきてもらっていいですか

English.Text: You wouldn't mind going to check on him for us, would ya, bro?

Japanese.Text: わかった

English.Text: Not at all.

Japanese.Text: 恩に着ます！

English.Text: You're the best!

Japanese.Text:
それじゃあ　俺たちは
ボイラーを修理しに戻ります

English.Text: Welp, we got a boiler to fix, so we're gonna head back.

Japanese.Text: ジョニーのこと　よろしく頼んます

English.Text: Our other life is in your hands, bro!

Japanese.Text:
わっ　アニキ
なにしてるんですか！

English.Text: Is that a mirage? I can't believe you're here, bro!

Japanese.Text: おまえこそ

English.Text: Me neither.

Japanese.Text:
実は　リフォームの目玉として
伝説のモンスター

English.Text:
Well, I'm glad you are.
Y'see, we're renovating the hotel.

Japanese.Text:
トンベリキングの王冠を
バシッと飾ろうと思ったんですけど

English.Text: And I thought a Tonberry King's crown would give the place that palatial feel.

Japanese.Text: ここから先　進めなくて

English.Text: But it's, uh, somewhere over there.

Japanese.Text:
この先で　トンベリキングを見たって
情報があるんです

English.Text:
Rumor has it the Tonberry King
lives somewhere nearby.

Japanese.Text: でも　ここから歩きじゃ無理なんすよ

English.Text: But there's no way your boy Johnny can get through the desert on foot.

Japanese.Text:
アニキ　もし砂漠へ行くことがあったら
俺の代わりに

English.Text: Listen, bro: I dunno if you were planning to check out the dunes, but if you are...

Japanese.Text:
トンベリキングの王冠を　なるべく傷つけないように
盗んできてもらってもいいですか

English.Text: you'd really be doing me a solid if you brought me back that crown─preferably in the most pristine condition possible.

Japanese.Text: あとは　俺たちにまかせろ

English.Text: Fine. Just sit tight.

Japanese.Text:
まずは　砂漠に入る方法を探さなきゃ
でも　すぐには無理っぽいね

English.Text: I hope you know a way into the desert, Cloud, 'cause I sure don't. Over the mountains? Or something?

Japanese.Text: 珍しいモンスターなら　通信塔で探し出せるよね

English.Text:
Say, I bet one of those towers
could point us in the king's direction.

Japanese.Text: あとは　俺たちにまかせろ

English.Text: Fine. Just sit tight.

Japanese.Text: トンベリキングの居場所なら　もうわかってるよね

English.Text:
We already know where to find the king.
Just gotta pay him a visit.

Japanese.Text: トンベリキングならもう倒しちゃったよ……ね？

English.Text:
Actually, we already dethroned that royal reject.
Didn't we?

Japanese.Text:
くう～　男前がすぎるよアニキ！
ちゃちゃっと王冠　盗んできちゃってください

English.Text:
Your kindness is bringing me to tears, bro!
I eagerly await your safe and fruitful return.

Japanese.Text:
俺　いつまでも待ってますから
忘れちゃうと　干からびちゃいますから

English.Text: Just don't keep me waiting too long. We Johnnys are delicate flowers that wilt in the desert heat.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
トンベリの頂点に君臨する王様　トンベリキングの
居場所らしき情報が見つかりました

English.Text: Good news. I believe I've ascertained the whereabouts of your royal quarry: the Tonberry King.

Japanese.Text: ジョニーさんが　お待ちかねです

English.Text: Johnny wasn't that far off.

Japanese.Text:
彼が干からびてしまう前に
王冠を盗んで　届けてあげましょう

English.Text: Let's not keep your entrepreneurial friend waiting, lest he wither in the heat.

Japanese.Text: トンベリを束ねる　伝説の王様が相手か～

English.Text: This king guy's probably got a horde of tonberries at his command...

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　アタシらも
分身して対抗したほうがよくない？

English.Text: Which means we'll be outnumbered. Unless...

Japanese.Text:
ほら　バレットを増やして
銃弾の雨あられ作戦とか

English.Text: What if we cloned a bunch of Barrets? They'd blast those baddies into oblivion!

Japanese.Text: 相撃ちになるのがオチだ

English.Text: And catch us in the cross fire.

Japanese.Text: え～　じゃあ　ティファは？

English.Text: Okay, what about...Tifa?

Japanese.Text: どんな想像した？

English.Text: Thinking naughty thoughts?

Japanese.Text: 想像しなかった

English.Text: Shut up.
Busted!

Japanese.Text: ユフィ　黙ってくれ

English.Text: I thought ninjas were supposed to be silent.

Japanese.Text:
あっ　ごめんごめん
黙るから　好きなだけ想像して

English.Text: Oh, forgive me for interrupting your fantasies. I'll let you get back to being a perv.

Japanese.Text:
トンベリキングの王冠は盗めるらしいんすよ
上物　期待してます

English.Text: I bet you'll just yoink the crown right off the king's head. Can't wait to see it in person!

Japanese.Text:
俺　いつまでも待ってますから
忘れちゃうと　干からびちゃいますから

English.Text: Just don't keep me waiting too long. We Johnnys are delicate flowers that wilt in the desert heat.

Japanese.Text: アニキ～　砂漠へ行けましたか？

English.Text: Hey, bro! You take a look around the desert yet?

Japanese.Text:
大変お忙しいかと思いますが
トンベリキング探しのほうも頼んます

English.Text: I'm sure you've got a lot of things on your to-do list, but I hope snagging that crown is still one of 'em!

Japanese.Text: ああ～　王冠傷つけちゃったね

English.Text: Ouch... Looks like the crown got a little scuffed in the scuffle.

Japanese.Text:
どうする　これ　ジョニーに届ける？
もう１回戦って盗んでみる？

English.Text: Whaddya think? Should we give it to Johnny anyway─see if he even notices? Or should we try for a nicer one instead?

Japanese.Text:
トンベリキングの王冠　ゲ～ット！
さっそくジョニーに届けてあげよ

English.Text: Another crown snatched by the incomparable Yuffie! Let's hurry up and get this to Johnny!

Japanese.Text:
おお　トンベリキングを倒してくれたんですか？
さっすが俺たちのアニキだ

English.Text:
You took down the Tonberry King─for us!?
Thanks, bro! On behalf of all Johnnys!

Japanese.Text: それで　王冠は？

English.Text: So where's the crown?

Japanese.Text: トンベリキングの王冠　手に入りました？

English.Text: So where's the king's crown? You got it, right?

Japanese.Text: トンベリキングの王冠を渡しますか？

English.Text: Give the Tonberry King's crown to Johnny?

Japanese.Text: キズだらけの王冠を渡す

English.Text: Hand over the marred one.

Japanese.Text: キレイな王冠を渡す

English.Text: Hand over the pristine one.

Japanese.Text: 王冠の入手方法は？

English.Text: Ask how he thinks you'll get the crown.

Japanese.Text: 渡さない

English.Text: Hold on to it for now.

Japanese.Text:
トンベリキングの王冠は盗めるらしいんすよ
上物　期待してます

English.Text: I bet you'll just yoink the crown right off the king's head. Can't wait to see it in person!

Japanese.Text:
くう～！
アニキ　じらしますねえ

English.Text: Ohoho! Looks like someone's playing hard to get.

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　おあずけっすね
了解です！

English.Text: But hey, if you wanna hang on to it a little longer, that's cool.

Japanese.Text:
うん？　えっと～これは……
もうアニキったら　またまたご冗談を

English.Text: Huh? This is...not exactly what I was... Oh, good one, bro! You almost had me thinking you were serious.

Japanese.Text:
伝説の王冠は
もっとキレイでゴージャスなはずです

English.Text: I mean, the Tonberry King's crown is supposed to be regal and resplendent!

Japanese.Text:
アニキ　本当に
このキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: There's no way this hunk a' junk is the crown I was lookin' for...right?

Japanese.Text:
アニキ　本当に
このキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: There's no way this hunk a' junk is the crown I was lookin' for...right?

Japanese.Text: 本当にキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: Hand over the marred crown?

Japanese.Text: 絶対あってる

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: やっぱり違う

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text:
そうですか　アニキがそこまで言うなら
これが伝説の王冠なんですね

English.Text: Huh... Well, uh, if you say so, bro. Guess some legends just don't live up to the hype.

Japanese.Text:
まあよく見たら　このオンボロ感が逆に文学的で
インテリアにはちょうどいい気がしてきました

English.Text: But y'know, the worse-for-wear look does imbue it with a certain old-school charm─perfect for a rustic centerpiece!

Japanese.Text: アニキ　ありがとうございます

English.Text: Thanks again, bro. I owe you one!

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　俺は先に戻りますね

English.Text: I'm gonna take this baby back to the hotel.

Japanese.Text:
時間がある時に　ウチに寄ってください
俺が報酬を用意してると思うんで

English.Text: Be sure to swing by when you have the chance! I'm sure one of me'll have somethin' real nice waiting for ya.

Japanese.Text:
ですよね　その王冠はなにかの間違いですよね
もう　びっくりさせないでくださいよ

English.Text: Whew! For real, I was this close to having a heart attack. The whole deadpan delivery really had me goin'!

Japanese.Text:
伝説の名にふさわしい　キレイな王冠を
トンベリキングから盗んできてください

わたしのほうが　うまいかも

English.Text: Alright, not bad. Though I'm pretty sure I've got better aim.

Japanese.Text:
彼女さんが　彼氏さんを撃ち抜いちゃう？
それもアリね

English.Text: Now here's a woman who knows how to hunt for a man! I like.

Japanese.Text: 剣なら　もっとやれた

English.Text: I'm better with a sword.

Japanese.Text:
なんだろ　ちょっとキュンとしちゃった
ダメなクラウドも　それはそれでアリかも

English.Text: You know...in a weird way, that was actually kinda cute─seeing a guy like you fail that hard.

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　ダメな男も需要はあるってわけね
勉強になるわ

English.Text: Interesting... So there is a market for total losers. The more you know.

Japanese.Text: 銃は　久しぶりだったからな

English.Text: It's been a while since I used a gun, okay?

Japanese.Text:
男の子ががんばる姿
それを眺める　彼女の眼差し

English.Text:
She never once took her eyes off her man.
And the way she stared at him...

Japanese.Text: 結果は　重要じゃないのね

English.Text: The score didn't matter.

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう　いいものを見せてもらったわ
私は水着を仕立てに　店へ戻るわね

English.Text: Thanks, cuties. That was just what I needed. I'll head back, now that the creative juices are flowing again.

Japanese.Text:
ふたりはデートを続けてね
ノエミが　ラン・ワイルドで待ってると思うから

English.Text:
You two, however, still have a date to finish.
Go find Naomi at Run Wild.

Japanese.Text:
ヨルダが　最後のデートを用意してるみたい
チョコボのレンタルショップまで行ってみて

English.Text: You two find Yorda. She should be over by the chocobo stables, just outside of town.

Japanese.Text: さ～て　次はどんなデートかな～？

English.Text: I wonder what the girls have next on the agenda for us.

Japanese.Text: デートの安売りだな

English.Text: More cheap date ideas?

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　考えすぎ
楽しもう！

English.Text: Oh, lighten up. We're trying to enjoy ourselves!

Japanese.Text: 仕事だけどな

English.Text: Tryin' to get paid.

Japanese.Text:
もう　じゃあそう思ってて
わたしは　デートだって考える

English.Text: You're no fun at all today. Well, for the record, I am treating this as a date!

Japanese.Text: 得意じゃないんだ

English.Text: I wish you wouldn't...

Japanese.Text: なにが？

English.Text: Why?

Japanese.Text: デ・エ・ト……

English.Text: 'Cause I'm no romantic.

Japanese.Text: 知ってるよ　すぐわかった

English.Text: Believe me, I know.

Japanese.Text: くっ……

English.Text: Right...

Japanese.Text:
きたきた　おそ～い！
早くしないとレースが始まっちゃうよ

English.Text:
Someone took their sweet time, I see.
Better hurry or the game'll start without you!

Japanese.Text: レースって？

English.Text: What game?

Japanese.Text:
コスタ名物　ラン・ワイルドだよ
ボールを転がして競争するの

English.Text:
Run Wild, of course! Tell me you've heard of it.
It's only the hottest sport in town!

Japanese.Text:
動物に癒やされつつ　白熱するレース！
ねっ　デートにはぴったりでしょ？

English.Text: Not hard to guess why, seeing all those cutie-wooties... I mean, it's the perfect spot for a date!

Japanese.Text: 準備はオッケー？

English.Text: Are you ready to go?

Japanese.Text:
<color=yellow>【ラン・ワイルド　タイムアタック】</color>
挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Enter Run Wild's <color=yellow>Time Trial</color> challenge?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: 準備ができたら　声をかけてね

English.Text: Gimme a shout when you wanna get wild.

Japanese.Text: もういちど　挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Try again?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　わたし　行ってくる

English.Text: Alright...wish me luck, okay?

Japanese.Text:
聞いていなかったのか
これは　動物のレースだ

English.Text: You do know this is for animals, right? Not people?

Japanese.Text:
人間だって動物
ねっ　問題ないよね

English.Text: People are technically animals too. Right? So it's cool!

Japanese.Text: ブッブー　無理で～す

English.Text: Wrong. Not cool.

Japanese.Text: ええ～　そんなあ

English.Text: What? I really can't compete?

Japanese.Text: ペットとか飼ってないの？

English.Text: No, but your pet can.

Japanese.Text:
断じて　ペットではないが……
私の出番のようだな

English.Text:
Though I take umbrage with that nomenclature...
I'm happy to offer my assistance.

Japanese.Text: オイラ　駆けっこしたい！

English.Text: My time to shine!

Japanese.Text: レッドにまかせよう

English.Text: Red's got this.

Japanese.Text: ナナキにまかせよう

English.Text: Nanaki's got this.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　わたしたち　応援団だね

English.Text: Well...I guess we'll just have to be the cheer squad!

Japanese.Text: チーム・レッド　レディ・ゴー！

English.Text: Gimme an R, gimme an E, gimme a D!

Japanese.Text: すごいじゃん　まるで赤いイナズマ！

English.Text: You were like a red bolt shooting across that field!

Japanese.Text: 強い者が勝つ

English.Text: I am quick on my feet.

Japanese.Text: へへ　まあね～

English.Text: Haha! That's me.

Japanese.Text: 今度は　わたしたち３人で競争する？

English.Text: The three of us should go a round sometime! Wouldn't that be fun?

Japanese.Text: 受けて立とう

English.Text: If you enjoy losing.

Japanese.Text: いいね　やろやろ！

English.Text: Yeah, that does sound fun!

Japanese.Text: おしい～！

English.Text: You did real good.

Japanese.Text: スパートをかけるのが　すこし遅かったか

English.Text: Not good enough. I was sloppy.

Japanese.Text: 最後　ちょっとバテちゃった

English.Text: Could've finished stronger...

Japanese.Text: あはは　ドンマイ

English.Text: Next time.

Japanese.Text: こんなはずでは……

English.Text: What a disaster.

Japanese.Text: オイラ　のろまのナナキだ

English.Text: Ugh... I totally screwed that up.

Japanese.Text: ちょっと　調子悪かったのかな

English.Text: Don't beat yourself up. You had an off day, that's all.

Japanese.Text: そういう日もある

English.Text: Yeah, it happens.

Japanese.Text: 気休めは不要　いまから走りこんでくる

English.Text: I don't need your pity. What I need is to train.

Japanese.Text: こんな日はいらない　オイラ練習する！

English.Text: Not anymore it won't─not if I train harder!

Japanese.Text: ふんふん　ペットが繋いだふたりの絆

English.Text: Hm... Their dog is the glue that binds their relationship...

Japanese.Text:
それは　ワンちゃんが動きまわることによって
より強く　かたくなっていく

English.Text: And watching their little guy give it his all out there only served to strengthen their bond...

Japanese.Text:
ピコーン　あたし閃いちゃった
あふれだすイマジネーション！

English.Text: That's it─I'm such a genius! I've got to get this idea down on paper!

Japanese.Text:
こうしちゃいらんない
あたし　お店に戻るね！

English.Text: I need to get back to the shop, like, yesterday!

Japanese.Text:
パイレーツ・ランページでフレンが待ってるから
おふたりさんは引き続き　デートを楽しんでね～！

English.Text: Fran's over at Pirate's Rampage, by the way. She'll make sure the next part of your date is a blast!

Japanese.Text: ヨルダが　最後のデートを用意して待ってるから

English.Text: Yorda's at the stables for the final part of your date.

Japanese.Text:
おふたりさんは
チョコボのレンタルショップへ　ゴー！

English.Text:
So what're you waiting for?
Get those tushies on a chocobo!

Japanese.Text: 新作水着　楽しみだね

English.Text: Wonder what sorta design the girls are gonna come up with.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　どんな水着　好き？

English.Text: Hey─what kinda swimsuit would you wanna see?

Japanese.Text: なぜだ？

English.Text: Me?

Japanese.Text: 参考にしようと思って

English.Text: Yes you. I'm curious!

Japanese.Text: そうだな　機能性が高いものがいい

English.Text: Well, I prefer function over form, so durable...

Japanese.Text:
撥水性が高く　水の抵抗を受け流し
水中での戦闘を想定した水着がいいな

English.Text: Maybe made with non-absorbent materials that allow for full range of motion─in case you need to fight underwater.

Japanese.Text: あはははは　なるほどね～

English.Text: Okey dokey, then...

Japanese.Text:
来たね
とっておきのデートコースを用意したよ

English.Text: There you are! Okay, I've got a great activity for you.

Japanese.Text:
キミたち　まだチョコボレンタルの
会員になってないよね？

English.Text: Before that, though, I need to add your information to the system.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　まずはこれを

English.Text: Here, take this.

Japanese.Text: これで　チョコボを自由に使えるよ

English.Text: It'll let you rent a chocobo whenever.

Japanese.Text: 名前はキュマちゃん　よろしくね

English.Text: That's Kyma. Take good care of her.

Japanese.Text:
ふたりには　この子に乗って
クラムシェルビーチを遊覧してもらいます

English.Text: So the idea is to ride Kyma here and enjoy a romantic stroll along the beach.

Japanese.Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text: かわいい～！

English.Text: Aw!

Japanese.Text:
ただ目的もなく散歩するのもなんだから
貝殻をとってきてもらおうかな

English.Text: But that on its own sounds like a huge yawnfest, so try hunting for shells while you're at it.

Japanese.Text:
せっかくだし
できるだけ　大きいものがいいな

English.Text: How about you bring me the largest one you can find? Sound good?

Japanese.Text: ボクは　ここで待っているから

English.Text: I'll be chillin' back here.

Japanese.Text:
ふたりで　ステキな思い出を作って
貝殻といっしょに届けてね

English.Text: So you two run along and have yourselves one "shell" of a time!

Japanese.Text:
クラムシェルビーチに行ってみて
ステキな貝殻を　楽しみにしているよ

English.Text: What're you still doing here? Get down to the beach and see what kinda shells you can find.

Japanese.Text: 海岸デートを楽しんできて

English.Text: Don't forget to have fun, okay?

Japanese.Text:
クラムシェルビーチには行った？
チョコボに乗って　貝殻をとってきてね

English.Text: Have you been down to that beach yet? Ride Kyma over there, and see if you can find some shells.

Japanese.Text: できるだけ　大きなやつを期待してるよ

English.Text: Just bring back the biggest one you can find.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボデートなんて
わたし　はじめて！

English.Text: I dunno about you, but this is definitely a first for me.

Japanese.Text: 何度か乗っただろ

English.Text: You've ridden them before.

Japanese.Text: それとこれは　べつ

English.Text: I'm not talking about the chocobos.

Japanese.Text: たしかに　貝殻を探すのは初めてだな

English.Text: Oh... You meant the shells, right?

Japanese.Text: はぐらかした

English.Text: Right...

Japanese.Text: もしかして　緊張してる？

English.Text: Wait a second... Are you nervous?

Japanese.Text: まさか　楽な仕事だ

English.Text: About what? Easiest job I've ever had.

Japanese.Text: 緊張してる～！

English.Text: The merc's nervous!

Japanese.Text: 貝殻があるのって　このあたりかな

English.Text: We should be able to find some good shells around here.

Japanese.Text: そのまえに　掃除が必要だ

English.Text: But first, we clean up the trash.

Japanese.Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: Alright, seashells. Ready or not, here we come!

Japanese.Text: まずは　チョコボに乗らないとな

English.Text: Let's saddle up first, then search.

Japanese.Text: ステキな思い出　作らないとね

English.Text: Sounds good. Back on the birds we go!

Japanese.Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: You ready to dig around for those seashells, Cloud?

Japanese.Text: まずは　チョコボに乗らないとな

English.Text: Let's saddle up first, then search.

Japanese.Text: ありゃ　罰ゲーム？

English.Text: Well, that's not what we wanted!

Japanese.Text: そのようだ

English.Text: No, it ain't!

Japanese.Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: Okay! Let's get back to it, shall we?

Japanese.Text: う～ん　失敗

English.Text: That's another "Nope."

Japanese.Text: ありゃ　ハズレ？

English.Text: Next time, for sure!

Japanese.Text: ちいさくて　可愛らしいね

English.Text: It's so teeny-tiny!

Japanese.Text: 面白いかたち　大きさもまずまず

English.Text: Nice, a conch! Decent size one too.

Japanese.Text: うわ　おっきい　いいねいいね～！

English.Text: Whoa, I don't think I've ever seen a shell this big before!

Japanese.Text:
二枚貝の片割れを持っている兵士が
戦場には　大勢いたんだ

English.Text: You know, a lotta troopers take half a shell with 'em when they head out on missions.

Japanese.Text:
家族や恋人と持ち合いっこするんだよね
ロマンチックだよね～

English.Text: I know where this is going! It's meant to be a keepsake for their partner, right? A symbol of their undying love!

Japanese.Text:
その貝殻をだれかに見せると
それは　死の予兆に変わる

English.Text: And an omen of death for the trooper if anyone else sees either one, some people say...

Japanese.Text: ええ～　そんな話？

English.Text: Oh... That took a turn.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　この貝
耳にあてると　波の音がする

English.Text: Y'know, you can hear the ocean if you put this seashell right up against your ear.

Japanese.Text: 反響音だ

English.Text: That's a myth.

Japanese.Text: クラウドも聞いてみる？　はい！

English.Text: Oh, just try it, you spoilsport.

Japanese.Text: 俺は　べつに

English.Text: I'm good.

Japanese.Text: はい！

English.Text: Here.

Japanese.Text: ざざ～　ざざ～　ざぶ～ん

English.Text: Pwsh, bwoo... Caw caw!

Japanese.Text: 静かにしてくれ

English.Text: Keep it down, birdie.

Japanese.Text:
貝殻が大きいから　中身もたっぷりだね
食べごたえありそう

English.Text: Hmm, if these things are all this size, I bet the suckers who live in 'em would make for good eatin'.

Japanese.Text: 味は　どうだろうな

English.Text: Wonder how they taste.

Japanese.Text:
そうだね
でもクラウド　味　気にしなさそう

English.Text: We could ask a local, but you don't strike me as the type to care all that much.

Japanese.Text: まずくても　文句を言わないだけだ

English.Text: I don't. Food's food.

Japanese.Text: ふ～ん

English.Text: Uh-oh...

Japanese.Text:
あっ　聞いたことある
そういう人　ある日とつぜん爆発するって

English.Text: Don't you know what happens to people who say they don't care what their food tastes like? They spontaneously combust.

Japanese.Text: エアリス　これはなんの話だ

English.Text: You're...screwing with me, right?

Japanese.Text: もう　慣れて！

English.Text: I guess we'll see, won't we?

Japanese.Text:
ふう　かなり集まったね
そろそろ　戻ろっか

English.Text: Whew! I think that should just about do it. Okay, ready to go?

Japanese.Text: 満足したか？

English.Text: Are you sure?

Japanese.Text:
その言い方　なんかズルい
クラウドこそ　満足した？

English.Text: Really─leaving the decision to me? What about you, Cloud? Are you sure?

Japanese.Text:
嘘でもいいから
『まだ　もっと一緒にいたい』って答えなくちゃ

English.Text: This is the part where you're supposed to blurt out "I don't wanna go back! I wanna stay here with you!"

Japanese.Text: それが　つぎに繋がるの

English.Text: This date's DOA otherwise.

Japanese.Text: 俺を　困らせようとしているのか

English.Text: Okay, now you're just bein' mean.

Japanese.Text: そういうわけじゃないけど

English.Text: I'm not trying to be mean, I...

Japanese.Text: ごめん……

English.Text: Sorry.

Japanese.Text:
おかえり
さて　どんな貝殻を集めてきたのかな？

English.Text:
Welcome back, you two.
So! Happen to find any neat shells out there?

Japanese.Text: チョコボデートは楽しかった？

English.Text: How was the beach? Romantic?

Japanese.Text: どの貝殻を渡しますか？

English.Text: Which of the shells will you hand over?

Japanese.Text: 二枚貝を渡す

English.Text: The scallop shell.

Japanese.Text: 巻貝を渡す

English.Text: The conch.

Japanese.Text: 巨大な貝殻を渡す

English.Text: The gigantopod shell.

Japanese.Text: 渡さない

English.Text: None.

Japanese.Text: うん？　そんな貝殻ないけど

English.Text: But...you don't have a shell like that.

Japanese.Text: ふふ　まだデートしたりないかい？

English.Text: Don't want your date to end, huh?

Japanese.Text: へえ　可愛らしい二枚貝だね

English.Text: Aw! That's a cute little clam shell.

Japanese.Text: 恋人同士が持つのに　ぴったり！

English.Text: Two halves of a whole─like all good couples!

Japanese.Text: きれいに巻きあげられた螺旋か

English.Text: Oh! I like the spiral on that.

Japanese.Text: 耳を寄せあって　波の音　聞いてみた？

English.Text: You try holding it up to your ear to hear the ocean waves?

Japanese.Text: あっ　忘れてた

English.Text: Oh no! I forgot!

Japanese.Text: こっ　これは……

English.Text: Whoa...

Japanese.Text: すごいでしょ

English.Text: Huge, right?

Japanese.Text: 博物館とかに飾ったほうがよさそう

English.Text: Dang. That thing belongs in a museum or something!

Japanese.Text:
女性を笑顔にするのは　貝殻か思い出か
あるいは　その両方か……

English.Text: I can't help but wonder what is making her smile from ear to ear like that. Is it the shells, or...?

Japanese.Text: うん　おかげで新作水着のモチーフが決まったよ

English.Text: Aha, I've got it! Inspiration has finally struck!

Japanese.Text: ボクは　店に戻るね

English.Text: I know what to make!

Japanese.Text:
あとで　ビーチのイベント会場まで来てよ
水着の発表会を開くから

English.Text:
But! Before I go─swing by the fashion showcase.
We want you front row center!

Japanese.Text: それじゃあ　また

English.Text: See ya there!

Japanese.Text: 今度は　ふたり乗りしてみる？　チョコボ

English.Text: Next time we need a chocobo, I say we ride double.

Japanese.Text: スピードが落ちる

English.Text: And slow down the bird?

Japanese.Text: ゆっくり景色見るのも　いいと思うけどな～

English.Text: Which would make it that much easier to take in all the scenery.

Japanese.Text: 前はゆずれない

English.Text: I'm still steering.

Japanese.Text: いいよ　じゃあ　おじゃましま～す

English.Text: Oh, fine. If you've got to be the man up front...

Japanese.Text: 狙った相手を撃ち抜くなら　この水着で決まり

English.Text:
Wanna shoot your shot?
This swimsuit's got perfect aim.

Japanese.Text: 情熱的な水着で　恋のレースを駆け抜けてみよっか

English.Text: Love might be a game, but you'll never lose in this winning ensemble!

Japanese.Text:
オシャレして　ステキな思い出
拾いに行ってみませんか？

English.Text:
Wanna land a big catch?
With this look, it'll be hook, line, and sinker!

Japanese.Text:
諸君　水着が似合う
美しい肉体が欲しくないか！

English.Text: My friends! Who among you doesn't ache for that perfect swimsuit physique!?

Japanese.Text:
そんなあなたは
ミッドガルのジム『ダンダンダン』へ！

English.Text: You wanna get ripped? You want a hot bod!? Then you better train with the best of the best!

Japanese.Text:
さあ　ごいっしょに
マッスル・ハーモニー！

MetaData.ACTOR: ゼン・ワン＆サン・トー

English.Text: So come join our gym, and muscle maximize!

Japanese.Text: 見にきてくれたんだね！

English.Text: I'm so glad you came!

Japanese.Text:
どうだい？
キミたちのデートが生み出した新作水着は

English.Text:
So? What'd you think of the show?
You were the inspo, after all!

Japanese.Text:
とってもステキ！
でも　わたしたち楽しんだ……だけだよね

English.Text: I absolutely loved it! But the two of us didn't do anything "inspo"-worthy. We just had fun.

Japanese.Text:
コスタを楽しんでる人を見ると
インスピレーションがわくんだよ！

English.Text: That's what we wanted! Happy couples get us inspired and fired up!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは太陽の楽園
みんな　ステキな思い出を作って帰っていく

English.Text: Exactly! This place is more than just a vacay spot─it's a paradise where people come to create lifelong memories!

Japanese.Text: その思い出を彩るのが　私たちの役目

English.Text: And making sure they do is what we do best.

Japanese.Text:
だから　これからも
コスタのマリンブルーな海と

English.Text: So next time you swing by, promise to frolic in the waters...

Japanese.Text: イターナルな空と！

English.Text: Bask in the sun...

Japanese.Text: シャイニングな砂浜を　思う存分楽しんでね

English.Text: Enjoy our town to its fullest, and leave with a smile!

Japanese.Text: そこにいるのは　クラウドくんじゃないか？

English.Text: Do my eyes deceive me? Is that Cloud?

Japanese.Text: あっ　ウォール・マーケットのジムのひと！

English.Text: Oh, hey! You trade the city for the beach too?

Japanese.Text: どうしてここに？

English.Text: What're you doin' here?

Japanese.Text: ジムのみんなと　マッスル合宿に来ていてね

English.Text: Relaxing, really. We're on our yearly beach retreat.

Japanese.Text:
毎年ここで　新しいコスチュームを
作ってもらってるんだよ

English.Text: And commissioning this year's new singlets from these talented young women.

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　ねえ　あとで合宿場に顔を出してくれよ
なんでも屋に頼みたいことがあるんだ

English.Text: Oh, right─that reminds me... Stop by the training facility when you have a moment. We're in need of your particular skills.

Japanese.Text: 考えておく

English.Text: Okay...

Japanese.Text: 新作水着は　キューピットって名前にするわ

English.Text: We should call our new design the Romantico!

Japanese.Text: 来シーズンは　カップルが増えるわよ

English.Text: I'm expecting lots of lovebirds next season.

Japanese.Text: 次は動物用の水着も作ってみようかな

English.Text: I wonder if there's a market for doggy swimsuits.
