English.Text: Okay, let's get this party started!

Japanese.Text: さすがだよ　いちだんと磨きあげたようだね

English.Text: Nicely done! You clearly haven't neglected your training.

Japanese.Text: 完敗だよ　キミは本物のアスリートだね

English.Text: I admit defeat. Hard to compete against an athlete like you.

Japanese.Text:
ぬおお……
なぜだ　なぜ勝てない！

English.Text: No way! My muscles failed me!

Japanese.Text: ぐぬぬ　この悔しさを筋トレにぶつけるぞ！

English.Text: Grr... I gotta train even harder. Get super swole!

Japanese.Text: エクセレント！　おそれいったよ

English.Text: Whew! Looks like I've met my muscle match.

Japanese.Text: ビューティフル！　オレの負けだ

English.Text: Hot damn, girl! That was a whoopin' I won't forget.

Japanese.Text: 師匠の腹筋　思わず見とれちゃいました！

English.Text: Your abs are a work of art! A sculpture of flesh!

Japanese.Text: くう～　師匠はやっぱりすごいな～！

English.Text: Yeah! Nobody's better than my muscle mentor!

Japanese.Text: いい刺激になったよ　ありがとう

English.Text: That match really got my blood pumpin'.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　すこし動きが硬かったかな？

English.Text: Hm... You seem tense. Might wanna stretch─loosen up a little.

Japanese.Text: わはは　喜びに震える俺の筋肉を見よ！

English.Text: Ahaha! Check it─my muscles are twitching with amusement!

Japanese.Text: くくく　今夜のプロテインは美味そうだ！

English.Text: Heh! Nothin' sweeter than a shake laced with victory.

Japanese.Text:
ナイス・トライ！
またいつでもリベンジしてくれ

English.Text: So close! If you want a rematch, I'm good for it.

Japanese.Text:
体はホット　頭はクール！
これが筋トレのコツさ

English.Text: Word of advice, kid: the key to maintaining a hot bod is keeping a cool head.

Japanese.Text:
師匠　勉強になりました
ありがとうございます！

English.Text: I took some notes on your form, coach. Thanks for the demonstration!

Japanese.Text: 師匠の腹筋に　一歩近づけた気がします！

English.Text: I'm one step closer to achieving your perfection!

Japanese.Text: おお　まだいたか

English.Text: Oh, figured you'da moved on by now.

Japanese.Text: おお　いいところにきた

English.Text: Well, didn't think y'all'd be back so soon.

Japanese.Text:
実は　厄介なことになってな
この手紙を見てくれ

English.Text:
Glad you're here, in any case. I got a situation.
See for yourself.

Japanese.Text:
『黒マントの男は預かった
　返してほしくば　１万ギル用意しろ』

English.Text: "We have one of your robed men. If you want him back, it will cost you one million gil.

Japanese.Text: 『受け渡し方法は　おって連絡する』

English.Text: "Agree to the terms, and we'll take care of the rest."

Japanese.Text: 誘拐？

English.Text: What's this?

Japanese.Text: ゆーかい？

English.Text: What's this?

Japanese.Text:
わしが　黒マントを研究しているのを知って
金になると誤解したらしい

English.Text: Beats the hell outta me. Guess some fool got it in their head I was makin' money off my research.

Japanese.Text: どうするつもりだ

English.Text: You gonna pay up?

Japanese.Text: さびれた診療所に　身代金が払えると思うか？

English.Text:
Look at this place.
Can barely afford bandages, never mind a ransom.

Japanese.Text: いや

English.Text: Hmm...

Japanese.Text: ううん

English.Text: Haaah...

Japanese.Text:
そこでだ　おまえさんらに
黒マントの救出を依頼したい

English.Text: Only option is to save the man myself... or hire the right merc to save him for me.

Japanese.Text: 人間など足もとにも及ばない　その五感

English.Text: Or the right merc's friend, to be more precise.

Japanese.Text:
中でも　いかにもききそうなその鼻があれば
犯人の行方など　すぐにわかるだろう

English.Text: Who better to hunt down a criminal than someone who's got a nose for trackin'─one finer than any human could ever possess.

Japanese.Text: まあ　そうだろうな

English.Text: Well, I can't argue with you there.

Japanese.Text: へへへ　まかせてよ！

English.Text: Hehe... Our guy's as good as found!

Japanese.Text: おだてに乗るな

English.Text: That was easy.

Japanese.Text: まずはどうする

English.Text: So where do we start?

Japanese.Text: なにから調べよっか

English.Text: So where should we start?

Japanese.Text: なにから調べますか？

English.Text: What will you ask about?

Japanese.Text: 目撃者

English.Text: Eyewitnesses.

Japanese.Text: 手紙

English.Text: The letter.

Japanese.Text: 黒マント

English.Text: The victim.

Japanese.Text:
ふむ　聞いてまわったが
誰も犯人らしき者は見ていない

English.Text: Spoke with some of the neighbors, but they weren't much help. No one saw anythin' outta the ordinary.

Japanese.Text:
思うに　犯人は黒マントに変装したのだろう
そうすれば　ここじゃだれも気に留めんからな

English.Text: Y'know, could be that the perpetrator threw on a hood to blend in. Doubt anyone'd bat so much as an eyelash at one more robe walkin' around.

Japanese.Text:
ただの手紙だ
あぶってもこすっても　隠しメッセージはナシ

English.Text: What you see is what you get. No hidden codes, ciphers─nothin'.

Japanese.Text: なにも　わからんと思うね

English.Text: But hey, you're the detective.

Japanese.Text: あんた　楽しんでないか？

English.Text: Well, I'm glad one of us is enjoying this.

Japanese.Text:
ほかの黒マントと変わらんよ
意識は混濁し　簡単な会話もできない

English.Text: Curious about the guy who got nabbed? Well, what is there to say? I mean, their most notable traits ain't exactly unique.

Japanese.Text:
名前も家も　身内がいるかもわからん
黒マントから辿るのは　難しいだろうな

English.Text: Not like I can give you a name or next of kin neither. Could try to question the others, but...we both know how that'd go.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　その手紙を私の鼻先に

English.Text: Cloud. The letter, if you don't mind?

Japanese.Text: クラウド　その手紙　嗅がせて

English.Text: Hey, lemme give that letter a sniff.

Japanese.Text:
これは　香水か？
特徴的なかおりが残っている

English.Text:
There's a strong scent, but...
Cologne, perhaps?

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと　いいニオイがする
香水かな？

English.Text:
I'm getting a pretty interesting scent...
Some kind of cologne?

Japanese.Text:
ほう　頼もしいな
おっと　そうだ

English.Text:
How about that─picked up the trail already!
Ah, which reminds me...

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの体液にだけ反応するライトだ
捜索の役に立つかもしれない

English.Text: There's a compound in our robed friends' sweat that glows when exposed to this light. Just hope it helps some.

Japanese.Text: 誘拐するなら　もっと金持ちを狙えばいいものを

English.Text: Kidnapper must not be the sharpest tool in the shed if they think I got money...

Japanese.Text:
黒マントとは　縁があるんだろ
助けてやってくれ

English.Text:
Y'all seem to have a soft spot for these men.
Mind doin' one a good turn?

Japanese.Text: クラウド　行くぞ

English.Text: Follow me, Cloud.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　行こう

English.Text: Just follow me, okay?

Japanese.Text: ニオイは　はっきりわかるのか

English.Text: You can actually smell them?

Japanese.Text: 我が一族の嗅覚は　ヒトの７千倍と言われている

English.Text: My olfactory sense is seven thousand times more sensitive than yours.

Japanese.Text: まあね　バッチリわかるよ

English.Text: Oh yeah. Pretty easily, actually!

Japanese.Text: キーとなる香水だけでなく　汗や体臭

English.Text: Bodily secretions are as distinct as any perfume.

Japanese.Text:
まとっている衣服のニオイなどを分析し
立体的に組み立てる

English.Text: A single sniff of a person's clothing is enough for me to locate them.

Japanese.Text:
香水のニオイは　もちろんだけど
犯人自身のニオイもあるからね

English.Text: I can pick up a person's body odor in a snap, to say nothing of someone's cologne.

Japanese.Text:
さらに　混ざってしまったノイズを
選り分けることも必要だ

English.Text: Though there are a number of competing smells through which I must sift.

Japanese.Text:
ほかにも　いろんなニオイが混ざってるけど
ちゃんと嗅ぎ分けられるんだよ

English.Text: And I can hone in on any scent I want, even if there are lots of other strong ones.

Japanese.Text: 俺は　どんなニオイがするんだ？

English.Text: Huh... What do I smell like?

Japanese.Text:
モンスターを斬り刻んできた
青年のニオイだな

English.Text:
Like a man who's killed his fair share of fiends,
I suppose.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　戦う青年のニオイかな

English.Text:
Like...a guy who's seen his fair share of battles,
I guess.

Japanese.Text: あまり　良さそうじゃないな

English.Text: Like blood and shit, then.

Japanese.Text: 気にするな　私にしかわからない

English.Text: Not literal "shit," no...

Japanese.Text: 気にしない　気にしない

English.Text: I mean, I wouldn't go that far...

Japanese.Text: クラウド　覚えているか？

English.Text: Now's the time for any unfinished business.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド
仕事が途中だ　続けるぞ

English.Text: If I may... Don't forget we have unfinished business.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　覚えてる？

English.Text: They're really makin' us work for it. Let's go!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　追跡の途中だったよね

English.Text: Cloud, we were tracking some black robe, right?

Japanese.Text: ニオイは　この先へ続いているようだ

English.Text: I believe I've picked up their scent.

Japanese.Text: ニオイの追跡を再開する

English.Text: It's time we resumed our search.

Japanese.Text: ニオイは　こっちみたい

English.Text: Think they're this way.

Japanese.Text: ニオイはバッチリ　オイラにまかせて！

English.Text: Okay, got their scent. I'll take it from here.

Japanese.Text:
犯人のニオイは
あそこに続いているようだが……まずいな

English.Text:
Their scent seems to lead straight ahead, but...
Oh, that's not good.

Japanese.Text:
犯人は　あそこへ向かったみたいなんだけど
困ったなあ

English.Text:
Well, their scent leads straight there, but...
Ah man, why now?

Japanese.Text: どうした？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text: いや　ひとまず向かおう

English.Text: Nothing... Let's continue.

Japanese.Text: ううん　とにかく行ってみよ

English.Text: It's nothing... Let's just check it out.

Japanese.Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Ready!?

Japanese.Text: 強敵のニオイだよ！

English.Text: Smells like trouble, guys!

Japanese.Text: うん　どうしたの？

English.Text: Oh, hello there!

Japanese.Text: ニオイが違う　この男は犯人ではない

English.Text:
Different scent.
He has nothing to do with the kidnapping.

Japanese.Text: この人からは　犯人のニオイはしないよ

English.Text: Definitely not a kidnapper. My nose can tell.

Japanese.Text: もしかして　お腹が空いてる？

English.Text: Aw...you must be hungry, huh?

Japanese.Text: 残念　あげないよ

English.Text: Sorry, but this is people food.

Japanese.Text: うそうそ　すこしだけだよ？

English.Text: Whoa, easy there. I can spare a bite!

Japanese.Text: 黒いマントを着た男を見なかったか？

English.Text: See a guy in a black robe come through?

Japanese.Text:
う～ん　そういえばそんな格好をしたやつが
チョコボ車で洞窟のほうへ行くのを見たな

English.Text: Hm, now that you mention it... There was this one hooded fella. With a chocobo carriage─headed toward a cave nearby.

Japanese.Text:
コスタでバカンスより　こうやって
ひとりでキャンプのほうが好きなんだ

English.Text: I'd rather relax in the great outdoors than some hoity-toity beach resort.

Japanese.Text:
よし　いい感じに焼けてきたな
もうあげないよ

English.Text: Now this is what I call a perfectly cooked slab of meat...! Oh no─you already got your bit.

Japanese.Text:
実は　私の鼻にも
ひとつだけ弱点がある

English.Text:
Though I am a skilled tracker,
I have one terrible weakness.

Japanese.Text: あのね　オイラの鼻なんだけど

English.Text:
There's, uh, something you should
know about me and my nose.

Japanese.Text: なんだ

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text: 食欲に負ける

English.Text: My appetite.

Japanese.Text: 食べ物のニオイに　すっごく弱いんだよね

English.Text:
Whenever I catch a whiff of food,
it's all I can think about.

Japanese.Text:
いまもまだ　漂う肉のかおりに引っ張られている
しばらく私の鼻には期待しないでくれ

English.Text:
With this overpowering aroma of meat in the air,
I don't think I'll be able to focus on the kidnapper's scent.

Japanese.Text:
いまも　お肉のニオイで頭がいっぱい
しばらくオイラの鼻には期待しないで

English.Text: And since I can't get the smell of meat outta my nostrils, I...I don't think I'm gonna be a ton of help right now.

Japanese.Text: 笑ったな

English.Text: I heard that.

Japanese.Text: 笑った？

English.Text: Hey!

Japanese.Text: レッドをまくには肉を焼けか

English.Text:
Grilled meat is all it takes to throw
you off your game?

Japanese.Text: ナナキから逃げる時は肉を焼こう

English.Text:
Grilled meat is all it takes to throw
you off your game?

Japanese.Text: クエックエ～！

English.Text: Kweh! Kweh!

Japanese.Text: クエクエッ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh kweh! Kwehhh!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　見ろ

English.Text: Cloud, look.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　見て

English.Text: Cloud, look.

Japanese.Text: 誘拐犯を探そう

English.Text: They gotta be close.

Japanese.Text: シロンにもらったライトを使ってみてはどうだ

English.Text: Time to put the doctor's light to use.

Japanese.Text: シロン先生にもらったライトを使ってみたら？

English.Text: Maybe we oughta try the light Doc Sheiran gave us!

Japanese.Text: 黒マントを見つけたとして　犯人はどうする？

English.Text:
Once we've found our man,
what should we do with his captor?

Japanese.Text:
黒マント　いるかなあ？
犯人もいっしょかな

English.Text:
So if we find our guy...
whadda you wanna do about the culprit?

Japanese.Text:
黒マントを連れ戻せ　それがシロンの依頼だ
犯人のことは　なにも言っていなかった

English.Text:
Well, Sheiran asked us to rescue his patient.
He didn't say anything about how we should deal with the kidnapper.

Japanese.Text: やるか

English.Text: You mean...?

Japanese.Text: どうする？

English.Text: You mean...?

Japanese.Text: 犯人の出方を見て　決めよう

English.Text: We'll figure it out later.

Japanese.Text: 承知した

English.Text: Understood.

Japanese.Text: りょーかい！

English.Text: Copy.

Japanese.Text: 犯人の根城だ　留守のようだな

English.Text: This is the kidnapper's camp. No sign of them...

Japanese.Text: 犯人のすみかみたいだね　いないけど

English.Text: Place reeks of kidnapper. No sign of 'em, though.

Japanese.Text: どうする　待つか？

English.Text: So? Do we wait?

Japanese.Text: 戻ってくるまで　どこかに隠れて待つ？

English.Text: Could hide till they get back─catch 'em by surprise?

Japanese.Text: 助けて！

English.Text: Help!

Japanese.Text:
わたしたち　誘拐されて
監禁されてるの

English.Text:
Some crazy bastard kidnapped us
and stuck us in this cave.

Japanese.Text: うう……ああ……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Japanese.Text: うう……ああ……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Japanese.Text: うう……うう……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Japanese.Text: うう……うう……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Japanese.Text: 彼女たちをどうしますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Japanese.Text: 助ける

English.Text: Help them.

Japanese.Text: 犯人について尋ねる

English.Text: Question them about the kidnapper.

Japanese.Text: 疑う

English.Text: Mention that something seems off.

Japanese.Text:
ありがとうございます
本当に助かります

English.Text:
Oh, thank you so much!
What ever would we have done without you...

Japanese.Text: あなたがマヌケで

English.Text: you shit-for-brains.

Japanese.Text: わかりません　わたし必死に逃げてきて

English.Text:
Huh? Why would we know anything?
We were too freaked out to even look at him.

Japanese.Text: もしかしたら　すごく近くにいたりして

English.Text: The kidnapper could be anywhere...or anyone.

Japanese.Text:
えっ　どういうことですか
わたし？　この黒マント？

English.Text:
Excuse me? I'm suspicious?
Or the robed guy? Who?

Japanese.Text:
このニオイ
クラウド　そいつらが犯人だ！

English.Text: This smell... Cloud. It's them!

Japanese.Text:
このニオイ
クラウド　そいつらが犯人だよ！

English.Text:
This smell...
Cloud─they're the ones we're looking for!

Japanese.Text: バレちまったか

English.Text: Aw, boo.

Japanese.Text: この変装を見破るなんて　賢いワンちゃんね

English.Text: Aren't you a clever little puppy, sniffing out the truth.

Japanese.Text: 誘拐した黒マントは　どこだ？

English.Text: Okay. Where is he?

Japanese.Text: 教えるわけないだろ

English.Text: Think we'd just tell you?

Japanese.Text:
俺たちを誰だと思ってる
泣く子も黙る　クレイジーカップル

English.Text:
We're not your average criminals, kid.
In fact, we're the world's greatest double act!

Japanese.Text: エリー　ア～ンド！

English.Text: Ellie the Elusive!

Japanese.Text: バロウ様だぞ

English.Text: Barry the Brash!

Japanese.Text:
うふふ　あなたを誘拐したら
身代金はいくらかしら

English.Text: I wonder what your friends would've paid for you. Guess we'll never know!

Japanese.Text: へえ　やるじゃねえか

English.Text: Huh. That's some mighty fine killin'.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントの男を返せ

English.Text: Give us the guy or you're next.

Japanese.Text: バロウ　どうする？

English.Text: Ah, shit. Now what?

Japanese.Text:
落ちつけ　エリー
黒マントは俺たちしかわからない所に隠してある

English.Text: Now? Now nothin'. Dog or no dog, they're never gonna be able to find that dude without us.

Japanese.Text: もし返して欲しければ　金を……

English.Text: Hear that? Give us the money or we're gonna─

Japanese.Text: って　ああ？

English.Text: Wha!?

Japanese.Text: う……ああ……
おい　勝手に出てくんじゃねえ！

English.Text: Hey! We told you to stay put!

Japanese.Text: ずっとおとなしかったのに　どうして

English.Text: I knew we should have tied him up!

Japanese.Text: ああ……リユ……オン……

English.Text: Re...union...

Japanese.Text: なんだ　知り合いか？

English.Text: What? Old buddy of yours?

Japanese.Text: ねえバロウ　あいつの目　見た？

English.Text: Barry, look. The kid's eyes.

Japanese.Text: ソルジャーだよ

English.Text: He's a SOLDIER.

Japanese.Text:
どうりで強いはずだぜ
でも　聞いたぞ

English.Text: No wonder he wiped the floor with that monster... But time ain't on his side.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントってのは　ソルジャーの成れの果て
劣化したソルジャーなんだろ？

English.Text: Even the strongest ones don't stay strong for long. Sooner or later, he'll wind up like all the rest─another mumbling, hooded freak.

Japanese.Text: お仲間同士　仲良くしてな！

English.Text: Stay a while! Sure ya got lots to catch up on!

Japanese.Text: バ～イ！

English.Text: Suck it, losers!

Japanese.Text: 追うな　目的は果たした

English.Text: Let 'em go. We got our man.

Japanese.Text: シロンのところへ帰ろう

English.Text: Let's take him back to Sheiran.

Japanese.Text: ご苦労さん　助かったよ

English.Text: Glad to see our man's still alive.

Japanese.Text: 多少傷が増えているが　問題ないだろう

English.Text:
And save for a few scrapes,
none the worse for the wear.

Japanese.Text: ソルジャーが劣化するというのは　本当なのか？

English.Text: Is it true that SOLDIERs' cells degrade?

Japanese.Text: ソルジャーが劣化するって　本当なの？

English.Text: Is SOLDIER degradation real?

Japanese.Text: 正直なところ　わからん

English.Text: Believe me; if I knew, I'd tell ya.

Japanese.Text:
ソルジャーの情報は
ほとんど公開されておらんし

English.Text:
But Shinra keeps a tight lid on
everything SOLDIER-related.

Japanese.Text:
神羅以外の医師が　ソルジャーを診察する機会も
そうそうあるもんじゃない

English.Text: Only doctors with access to those secrets are the company's own. I certainly don't qualify.

Japanese.Text: だからむしろ　わしのほうが聞きたい

English.Text:
If anyone here was gonna have answers,
it'd be you, son.

Japanese.Text: 自覚や兆候があるのか？

English.Text: Been feelin' under the weather?

Japanese.Text: 問題ない

English.Text: Not really.

Japanese.Text: ソルジャーは比較的新しい技術だから

English.Text: The procedure you boys underwent was cutting edge.

Japanese.Text:
加齢　経年によるソルジャーの変化は
神羅だって知らんだろう

English.Text: So much so, I doubt anyone in the company knew what the long-term effects might be...

Japanese.Text: よって　どんな情報も貴重だ

English.Text: The more information we have, the better.

Japanese.Text: やっぱり　血を採らしてくれんか

English.Text: So...change your mind about that blood sample?

Japanese.Text: 断る

English.Text: No.

Japanese.Text:
はははは　まあ
気長に待つことにするよ

English.Text: Hehehe! Well, one of these days I'll win ya over!

Japanese.Text: さ～て　採血を再開するかな

English.Text: Well. I reckon I'd better get back to work.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントは確実に増えている
いまのうちにデータだけでもそろえておかんとな

English.Text: Blood won't draw itself─and given the sheer number of those robes, collecting samples'll take time.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントとソルジャーの血を比較したいんだがな

English.Text:
Still waiting on a SOLDIER sample,
if you catch my drift.

Japanese.Text: ウータイの放送の話を聞いたよ

English.Text: That was a wild statement outta Wutai.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　神羅に抗おうなんて気合いの入ったヤツは
この村にはおらんがな

English.Text: Gotta hand it to the SRC, though: no one around these parts has the guts to stand up to Shinra.

Japanese.Text:
反神羅連絡会とかいう組織も
さすがに　この村は勧誘せんだろうな

English.Text: Probably why they haven't come around lookin' for new recruits. Know better than to waste their time with us.

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーでランデブー
本日の受付は終了しました～！

English.Text: Wheelie Rendezvous is now closed for the day! We'll see you tomorrow, folks!

Japanese.Text:
ランデブーのウィリーは
すべて　貸出中で～す

English.Text: All of our Rendezvous wheelies are taken right now, folks!

Japanese.Text: 『ウィリーでランデブー』のお客さんですか？

English.Text: Oh! You taking part in Wheelie Rendezvous?

Japanese.Text:
すみません　今日の受付は
もう締め切っちゃったんですよ～

English.Text:
I'm so sorry.
We, like, just stopped our wheelie rentals for the day.

Japanese.Text:
そんな～！
ティファ　どうしよう？

English.Text: You're kidding me! What should we do instead, Tifa?

Japanese.Text:
ティファ？
もしかしてミッドガルの？　スラムの？

English.Text: "Tifa"? You're not from Sector 7, are you? In Midgar?

Japanese.Text: えっ？　そうだけど……

English.Text: Huh? Yes, I am...

Japanese.Text:
『ああティファ　キミこそオレの女神
　愛しのマイハニー！』

English.Text: "Oh, Tifa... My light, my love! Nay, my everything!"

Japanese.Text: それって　ジョニー？

English.Text: You're not quoting Johnny, are you?

Japanese.Text: べつに　普通じゃないの

English.Text: What a disappointment.

Japanese.Text: ジョニー君から聞いてたのと　ずいぶん違う

English.Text: See, I was expecting someone very different.

Japanese.Text:
もっと　ミッドガルの　キラキラの
ステキな女を想像してたんだけど

English.Text:
Someone...metropolitan─and chic!
Who lights up every room she walks into.

Japanese.Text: なんで　私がフラれちゃうのかな

English.Text: I have no idea what he sees in you.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　ちょっと　失礼じゃない？

English.Text: Um, excuse me? Stow the 'tude.

Japanese.Text: いいの　いいの

English.Text: It's fine.

Japanese.Text: こういうこと　よくあるから

English.Text: I, uh... I get this all the time.

Japanese.Text: なにそれ　自慢？

English.Text: That some kinda humblebrag!?

Japanese.Text:
おい　ジェニー！
サボってないで　とっととウィリーを回収してこい

English.Text:
Hey, Jenny! Don't just stand there!
Go get the unreturned wheelies.

Japanese.Text:
怒鳴らないで！
もう　みんなして私を見下すんだから

English.Text: Don't tell me what to do! Ugh! How come everyone here thinks they're better than me?

Japanese.Text: 見下しちゃいないだろ

English.Text: I'm just giving you work.

Japanese.Text: 私　辞めます！

English.Text: Screw this! I quit!

Japanese.Text: ああ　またこの流れか……

English.Text: Ugh... Shoulda known this would happen.

Japanese.Text: あんたら　ジェニーの友達だろ？

English.Text: So, you're friends with her, right?

Japanese.Text:
どうだろう　代わりに
ウィリーの回収を頼めないかな

English.Text: Since she quit, would you mind picking up the rest of the wheelies for me?

Japanese.Text: わかりました　やります

English.Text: Yeah, sure. We'll do it.

Japanese.Text: 人がいいにも　ほどがある

English.Text: You don't have to please everyone you meet.

Japanese.Text: ジョニーには　いろいろ責任感じちゃうの

English.Text: I know, but...I still feel like I owe it to Johnny.

Japanese.Text:
だから　ジェニーに良くすれば
すこしは罪滅ぼしになるかなって

English.Text: So I figure, maybe if I do this for Jenny, I'll have given him back something.

Japanese.Text: まあ　自己満足　気休め？

English.Text: Or maybe I just want peace of mind. I guess.

Japanese.Text: さっさと終わらせるね

English.Text: Let's get those wheelies.

Japanese.Text:
コスタをまわるなら
ウィリーが便利ですよ！

English.Text: Tour Costa del Sol in style with our wheelies!

Japanese.Text:
歩き疲れるまえに
ウィリーはどうですか？

English.Text: Save your aching feet and ride a wheelie instead!

Japanese.Text:
ウィリー・フォーユー！
どうぞ　ご自由にご利用ください

English.Text:
We've got Wheelies-4-U!
Feel free to grab any of our rides.

Japanese.Text:
ウィリーは　乗り捨てちゃって大丈夫です
あとでスタッフが回収しておきますんで

English.Text: And don't worry: you can leave it wherever you like when you're done. Our staff will collect it later.

Japanese.Text: 完璧な仕事　デキる女……

English.Text: She did a perfect job. But why?

Japanese.Text:
ジョニー君は　ティファの
ああいうところに惹かれたのね

English.Text:
Is that what Johnny wants in a woman?
An overachiever?

Japanese.Text:
ここもバッチリ　しかも
次の人が使いやすいようにって気遣いまで

English.Text: Perfectly executed─again. And she even made it easy for the next person to grab one.

Japanese.Text: そりゃ　ジョニー君も惚れるわけね

English.Text: If I'm impressed, what must Johnny think of her!?

Japanese.Text:
真心を込めた丁寧な仕事っぷり
ああジョニー君　そりゃ好きになるよね

English.Text: Good god, it's just some dumb wheelies─why does she care? Ugh, of course Johnny would fall for a girl like her!

Japanese.Text: 私　誤解してたな

English.Text: I've been going about this all wrong, haven't I?

Japanese.Text:
あっ　ジェニー！
ウィリーの回収　終わったよ

English.Text:
Jenny! Over here!
We brought all the wheelies back for you.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　いい人すぎる
恥ずかしい！

English.Text: Stop being so nice! I can't take it!

Japanese.Text:
街中のウィリーを
駐車場に入れといてくれよ

English.Text: Leave any wheelies you find in the parking lots.

Japanese.Text: ジェニーにも　困ったもんだ

English.Text: That girl is such a headache.

Japanese.Text:
おう　ご苦労さん
ありがとな

English.Text: Hey, great work. Thanks.

Japanese.Text: ジェニーに　なにかおごってもらいな

English.Text: Jenny really owes ya one.

Japanese.Text: 私　ジョニー君のことはあきらめる

English.Text: I've decided. I'm going to give up on Johnny.

Japanese.Text: あなたがステキすぎて　かないっこないもの

English.Text: There's no way I could ever compete with you.

Japanese.Text: 迷惑かけちゃったおわびに　これ

English.Text: My way of saying sorry. Take 'em.

Japanese.Text: ２枚あるから使ってね　じゃあ

English.Text: There's two cards there, so... Have fun!

Japanese.Text: 待って！

English.Text: Hold up!

Japanese.Text:
アモールカード
１枚は　あなたが使って

English.Text: Thanks, but that's way too generous.

Japanese.Text: えっ？

English.Text: Wha?

Japanese.Text:
ステキな服に着替えて
ジョニーとアモールしちゃう？

English.Text:
This one's for you─and Johnny.
I bet you'll have "amor" fun together.

Japanese.Text:
誤解してるみたいだけど
私とジョニーは　ただの友達だよ

English.Text:
I think you've got the wrong idea.
Johnny and I are just friends─nothing more.

Japanese.Text: ほんと？　ジョニー君の話と違うな

English.Text:
For real? But the way he talks about you,
I figured you were...

Japanese.Text: 彼　そういうところあるよね

English.Text: You know he likes to exaggerate.

Japanese.Text: うんうん

English.Text: True.

Japanese.Text:
それでね　ジョニーって
なにかと危なっかしいでしょ

English.Text:
And of course, he also has
a habit of getting carried away.

Japanese.Text:
だから　彼のことを見ていてくれる人がいれば
安心だなって思って

English.Text: I would feel a lot better if he had someone to back him up─keep him out of trouble.

Japanese.Text: あっ　私にジョニー君を押しつける気でしょ

English.Text: Oh, so you're foisting him on me─is that it?

Japanese.Text: ちがうよ

English.Text: Nothing like that.

Japanese.Text: ああ　ごめん　気にしないで

English.Text: Sorry, forget I said anything.

Japanese.Text: うん　アモールしてみるね

English.Text: Anyway, thanks for the card.

Japanese.Text:
ティファと話して　ジョニー君のことが
まえよりわかった気がするし

English.Text:
I'm glad we got all this straightened out.
Plus, now I know Johnny's a free man!

Japanese.Text: それに　私の気持ちは変わらないもの

English.Text: So I might as well shoot my shot then, huh?

Japanese.Text: じゃあね！

English.Text: Seeya!

Japanese.Text:
コスタ～！　シーサイド・ジョニー
ファストトラベルです

English.Text: Hang loose! Try Johnny's Seaside Travel Service!

Japanese.Text: あっ！

結局　こういうことになったの
あなたたちが背中を押してくれたおかげ

English.Text: Thanks to you, Johnny and I got a little closer, and...well, one thing led to another.

Japanese.Text:
でもね　いまは仕事が楽しくて
恋は　ちょっと後まわしかな

English.Text: But I'm having such a blast working that there isn't time for anything else. Maybe when things calm down.

Japanese.Text: ティファ　ジョニー君に会いにきたの？

English.Text: Tifa? You here to see Johnny?

Japanese.Text:
まあいいけど
でもね　この仕事は絶対ゆずらないから

English.Text: Whatever, it's fine. Do what you want, but don't you even think about taking my job.

Japanese.Text: コスタ～！　新人のジェニーです

English.Text: Hang loose! I'm the new girl, Jenny.

Japanese.Text:
あれ？　私　浮かれちゃってますね
あこがれの人のそばで働けるのが嬉しくって

English.Text: Oops, sorry if I seem like I'm on cloud nine. It's just so wonderful to work with the man of my dreams.

Japanese.Text:
今後とも　シーサイド・ジョニーを
よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: Anyway, what can Johnny's Seaside Inn do for you?

Japanese.Text: ねえ　私をチョコボアドバイザーとして雇わない？

English.Text: Don't suppose you're in the market for a charming young racing consultant?

Japanese.Text:
戦争になったら
いいチョコボから順番に取られちゃうからね

English.Text: I just know Shinra's gonna swoop in and steal our best birds for their troopers.

Japanese.Text: やめてくんないかな

English.Text: War's one dirty business...

Japanese.Text:
聞いたわよ
ゴールドカップ　おめでとう！

English.Text: Well, look who it is─the Gold Cup champ himself!

Japanese.Text: ジョーのやつ　悔しがってたでしょ

English.Text: I bet Joe's absolutely fuming!

Japanese.Text:
みなさん
詐欺師育成セミナーへようこそ

English.Text: Greetings, friends, and welcome to my swindling seminar.

Japanese.Text:
本日は　私が培ってきましたノウハウを
包み隠さず　すべてお教えします

English.Text: Today, for the very first time, I'll be unveiling the art behind the con─teaching you the tricks of my trade.

Japanese.Text:
だまされる人生はここまで
みなさんは　生まれ変わるのです

English.Text:
Gone are the days of getting duped!
Remove the wool over your eyes.

Japanese.Text:
いっしょに
立派な詐欺師になりましょう

English.Text: And instead, join me in the fleecing!

Japanese.Text:
詐欺師に大切なことがなにか
わかりますか？

English.Text: Let's get right to the heart of skillful swindling.

Japanese.Text: もちろん　嘘をつくことです

English.Text: The key is to never tell the truth.

Japanese.Text:
嘘をつくぐらい
簡単だと思われるかもしれません

English.Text: This may sound easy to some, but do not be fooled.

Japanese.Text:
ところが　嘘とは実に奥深く
繊細なものなのです

English.Text: There is a depth to the art of deception. It is a skill you must hone.

Japanese.Text:
そのことを　みなさんに
体験してもらおうと思います

English.Text: And what better way to learn than a little practical application?

Japanese.Text: では　さっそく嘘をついてみましょう

English.Text: Now then, let us begin the exercise.

Japanese.Text:
せっかくなら　どなたかに
嘘を見破ってもらいたいのですが……

English.Text: Ideally, I would ask a passerby to tell truth from falsehood...

Japanese.Text: あなた　いいところに来ました！

English.Text: You, sir, have excellent timing.

Japanese.Text:
我が　詐欺師育成セミナーの
お手伝いをしませんか？

English.Text:
I'm conducting a seminar
and would appreciate your help.

Japanese.Text:
もちろん　タダとは言いません
とても貴重なプレゼントを差し上げますよ

English.Text: And as thanks for your assistance, rest assured you will be handsomely rewarded.

Japanese.Text:
これから　受講生のみなさんに
話しかけてください

English.Text: All you need to do is speak with my lovely pupils here.

Japanese.Text:
４人の嘘つきの中に
１人の『正直者』が混ざっています

English.Text:
Four of these folks are lying,
while one and only one is telling the truth.

Japanese.Text: その正直者を当ててください

English.Text: Your job is to find the odd one out!

Japanese.Text:
挑戦する際には手数料が掛かりますので
ご了承ください

English.Text:
There's also a small fee to participate,
but I'm sure you won't mind.

Japanese.Text:
プリズンの酒場といえば　ベイル・ジャンパー！
『コスモキャニオン』が飲めるのは　あそこだけさ

English.Text: If you're looking for a place to get loaded, then look no further than Bail Jumper! It's the only bar that serves Cosmo Canyons!

Japanese.Text:
酒場のベイル・ジャンパーって知ってるか？
混じりっけなしの高級酒を提供してくれるぜ

English.Text: Hey, you ever heard of a place called Bail Jumper? Got the finest booze around─pure as the driven snow! Not watered down one bit!

Japanese.Text:
ベイル・ジャンパーっていう酒場に行ってみな
名物の『ウスザケ』が　やみつきになるぜ～

English.Text: You oughta drop by Bail Jumper sometime. Their house specialty─"Sunshine"─is like nothing you've ever tasted. Promise!

Japanese.Text:
プリズンの酒場はいいぜえ
ウス～い酒が　たらふく飲めるからよ

English.Text: You know, the bars around here serve drinks so watered down that you can go for hours on end and still not feel it!

Japanese.Text: うへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Japanese.Text: うへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Japanese.Text: ああ～？

English.Text: You got a problem?

Japanese.Text: ああ～？

English.Text: Was it something I said?

Japanese.Text:
おっ　いい飲みっぷりだね～
そいつは当店の名物『ウスザケ』よ

English.Text: Heh, you seem like a guy who can hold his liquor. That's our house specialty─call it "Sunshine."

Japanese.Text: 限界までウスめられた　奥深い味が最高だろ？

English.Text: We take moonshine and water it down so the flavor's juuust still perceptible.

Japanese.Text: 自慢の『ウスザケ』　結構イケるだろ

English.Text: You're hittin' that stuff pretty hard. Good thing it ain't too strong.

Japanese.Text: うちの酒は　ウスくてうまいだろ？

English.Text: It may be diluted, but it's got a refined taste.

Japanese.Text:
武器屋の店長　ああ見えて意外とドジなんだよね
だって　間違って『ポーション』を売ってるのよ

English.Text: The weapon store owner's got a few screws loose if you ask me. I mean, what's he doing selling potions of all things?

Japanese.Text:
武器屋には行った？
騒がしい店だったでしょ

English.Text:
You been to the weapon shop?
It's ridiculously loud in there.

Japanese.Text:
『ポーション』も売ってるから
私は癒やされたいときに行くの

English.Text:
I like it though─helps me relax.
Plus, they sell potions there too.

Japanese.Text: プリズンの武器屋は　私語厳禁

English.Text: No talking allowed in the local weapon shop.

Japanese.Text:
なぜか『エリクサー』が売ってるけど
びっくりして　物音を立てないようにね

English.Text: And that includes any shouts of surprise when you find out they sell elixirs too.

Japanese.Text:
武器屋に『エリクサー』が売ってたから
驚いて声をあげたの　そしたら怒られちまった

English.Text: I gasped when I found out the weapon shop sold elixirs, which immediately got me kicked out for making noise.

Japanese.Text: ふん……

English.Text: Hah...

Japanese.Text: ふわ～……

English.Text: Hey, keep it movin'!

Japanese.Text:
『孤独のアウトロー』が読みたいのによ
魔導書店に置いてねえんだよな

English.Text: I'm dying to read Gus's autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life, but the bookstore still doesn't have it in stock.

Japanese.Text:
魔導書店に　ブラザー・ガスの自伝
『舎弟のアウトロー』が入荷したんだってよ

English.Text: Ya gotta check out Garth's autobiography, Meditations on the Underling Life. It's at the local bookstore.

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』は読んだか？
魔導書店に置いてあるから　覗いてみるんだな

English.Text: Have you read Gus's autobiography Meditations on the Outlaw Life yet? You can pick it up at the local bookstore. I definitely recommend it.

Japanese.Text:
魔導書店に置いてあるロンリー・ゲス様の自伝
『孤独のアウトロー』は読んどいたほうがいいぜ

English.Text: You need to get yourself over to the local bookstore to nab a copy of Gus's autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life. It's a must read, trust me!

Japanese.Text: フヒャハッハ！

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Japanese.Text: フォー！

English.Text: Woo!

Japanese.Text:
おっと　お目が高い　そちらはいま話題の１冊
ロンリー・ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』です

English.Text: Oh, you have an eye for fine literature. That's the first volume of Solemn Gus's best-selling autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life.

Japanese.Text:
孤独だったゲス少年が　なりあがり
プリズンを支配するまでのサクセスストーリー

English.Text: It's the tale of a lonely little boy who dreamed of running his very own prison.

Japanese.Text:
キャッチコピーは
ゲスで上等　笑って生きろ！

English.Text: Like the tagline says, "There's a bit of Gus in all of us!"

Japanese.Text:
読み終わると　前向きになる素晴らしい１冊ですよ
ぜひ　波乱万丈な人生を追体験してみてください

English.Text: You'd be a fool to miss this chance to partake of Gus's wisdom. By the time you've read to the end, you'll see the world in a whole new light.

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様が書かれた『孤独のアウトロー』は
グリードの歴史書としても　オススメですよ！

English.Text: Solemn Gus's Meditations on the Outlaw Life paints a thrilling portrait of the criminal underworld.

Japanese.Text:
あなたも『孤独のアウトロー』を読んで
破天荒な男になってみませんか～？

English.Text: Maybe his inspiring tale will motivate you to become an entrepreneurial hoodlum as well! Who knows?

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の屋敷ってラクガキだらけで可愛いでしょ？
特に『ハッピーテンダー』がキュートなんだよね～

English.Text: Gus's crib is covered in graffiti─like some kinda art museum. My personal favorite is this adorable del Sol cactuar!

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の屋敷のグラフィティは見た？
『ハッピーテンダー』が隠れてるから探してみて

English.Text: You checked out the graffiti at Gus's place? He's got a del Sol cactuar in there. See if you can find it.

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の屋敷の壁には
『忠犬スタンプ』が描いてあるの

English.Text: It's kinda weird, but Gus has a picture of Stamp on his wall.

Japanese.Text: 躍動感があって　すごく可愛らしいんだよね

English.Text: I swear, it looks like it could jump out and start licking your face!

Japanese.Text:
ゲス様の屋敷に描いてある
『忠犬スタンプ』　見た？

English.Text: Hey, did you see the Stamp graffiti over at Gus's crib?

Japanese.Text: 可愛くて　いまにも飛び出してきそうだったでしょ

English.Text: He may be a pup, but he sure looks like a hero!

Japanese.Text: えへへ

English.Text: Hahaha!

Japanese.Text: うふふふ

English.Text: Uh-huh...

Japanese.Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに挑戦してみな
『バグ０』って　レアなモンスターに会えるぜ

English.Text: You should test your might in the Beast Battleground. They've got a rare monster named Bug 0.

Japanese.Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに行ってみたか？
『カロリー０』ってモンスターが強いんだよな

English.Text: Have you tried the Beast Battleground yet? I hear that Type-0 monster's a real toughie.

Japanese.Text:
地下にあるビーストバトルグラウンドには
『テスト０』って名前のモンスターがいるんだと

English.Text: Dunno if you've heard, but there's a special monster named Test 0 in the Beast Battleground.

Japanese.Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに出れば
『テスト０』っていうレアモンスターと戦えるぜ

English.Text: If you visit the Beast Battleground, you might just run into a rare monster named Test 0.

Japanese.Text: ふふ～ん

English.Text: Heh heh...

Japanese.Text: うっへへへー！

English.Text: Heh heh...

Japanese.Text: どなたが正直者か　わかりましたか？

English.Text: Well? Do you think you can figure out who's telling the truth?

Japanese.Text: どなたが正直者か　わかりましたか？

English.Text: Do you know who is telling the truth?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text:
手数料が足りませんね
何事にもお金は必要です　出直してください

English.Text: Hm? Sorry, friend, but you don't have enough gil. Money makes the world go round, you know─come back when you've got some.

Japanese.Text: 嘘か真実か　街を調べて確認されてもいいですよ

English.Text: The truth is out there, as they say. I encourage you to walk around town and find it.

Japanese.Text: <button=RS> 正直者を選ぼう

English.Text: <button=RS> Who is Telling the Truth?

Japanese.Text: 酒浸りのウサン

English.Text: Thirsty Usain

Japanese.Text: 百戦錬磨のトロイ

English.Text: Knucklehead Toya

Japanese.Text: 悪書家のソウ

English.Text: Sloppy Shawn

Japanese.Text: 近視眼のラホ

English.Text: Squinty Rachel

Japanese.Text: 大言壮語のキョギ

English.Text: Blowhard Georgie

Japanese.Text: う～ん残念　不正解です！

English.Text: Oh, too bad! I'm afraid you've been had.

Japanese.Text:
みなさん　嘘がお上手ですねえ
すばらしい！

English.Text:
My pupils have a knack for the art of deception.
Well done!

Japanese.Text:
では　シャッフルして　もういちどやりましょう
今度こそ　しっかりと見極めてくださいね

English.Text: Discerning the truth is a skill, just like telling a lie. Now then, what say we take it from the top and have you try again?

Japanese.Text:
またまた不正解
はい　やり直し！

English.Text:
You've been hoodwinked once again!
Better luck next time, friend.

Japanese.Text:
大正解です
なんという洞察力　すばらしい！

English.Text: Congratulations! Their deception was no match for your powers of perception!

Japanese.Text:
みなさん　世の中には
こういう鋭い方がいらっしゃるのです

English.Text: Beware, my aspiring swindlers: clever ones like this are harder to fool.

Japanese.Text:
そんな人も　しっかりだませるよう
私といっしょに　勉強していきましょうね

English.Text: But so long as you continue to train and apply yourselves, I can teach you to swindle even the toughest marks!

Japanese.Text: はい！

English.Text: Yessir!

Japanese.Text:
では　これは
お約束していた景品です

English.Text: As for you─rest assured that I am a man of my word.

Japanese.Text:
砂漠で野菜は貴重品
嘘はついてないですよね？

English.Text: Those greens are hard to find in a place like this. Quite the handsome reward, wouldn't you say?

Japanese.Text:
みなさん『嘘を隠すなら真実の中』
という言葉をご存知でしょうか？

English.Text: My dear pupils, are you familiar with the phrase "the best lies are told in truths"?

Japanese.Text:
嘘を　うまくつくコツは
真実に混ぜることです

English.Text: The trick to deceiving someone is to pad your fiction with facts.

Japanese.Text:
その　ブレンドテクニックこそが
詐欺師の極意と言っていいでしょう

English.Text: Learn to couch your lies among statements that are true, and you'll be a super-swindler!

Japanese.Text:
その極意がすべて書かれている指南書を
なんと　本日は格安で販売いたします！

English.Text: And as luck would have it, I've brought with me a guidebook that details how to master this art─which I'm offering today at a special low price!

Japanese.Text:
みなさん
いい顔つきになってきましたね

English.Text: My friends, I'm so proud of all the progress you've made.

Japanese.Text:
隙のない眼差し
すっかり詐欺師の顔です

English.Text: That devious look in your eyes tells me you're hungry for more knowledge.

Japanese.Text:
そろそろ
上級者コースに進むときですね

English.Text: Perhaps it's time we move on to some more advanced lessons.

Japanese.Text:
受講料はすこしだけ高くなりますが
ご安心ください

English.Text: The tuition is a bit steeper than before, but do not let that deter you.

Japanese.Text: 詐欺師になれば　すぐに取り戻せますよ

English.Text: You'll make it all back and more once you become a pro like me.

Japanese.Text:
みなさん
ウータイの映像はご覧になりましたか

English.Text: My friends, I presume you've seen the broadcast out of Wutai.

Japanese.Text: 私はあれを見て　心底感嘆いたしました

English.Text: So shocking. I could scarce believe my eyes and ears.

Japanese.Text:
嘘と真実の混ぜ方
話術とボディランゲージ

English.Text: The way they twisted words and visuals, interweaving fact with fiction...

Japanese.Text: どれをとっても一級品です！

English.Text: It was a master class in deception!

Japanese.Text:
実は特別に
録画映像を入手しましたので

English.Text: As it happens, I managed to procure a recording of the broadcast.

Japanese.Text:
みなさんに格別のお値段で
お譲りしたいと考えています

English.Text: And I'm offering copies to you at a very special pupil discount!

Japanese.Text:
話は聞いてるよ　なんでも屋くん
きみ　野菜を探してるんだって？

English.Text: No need to say a word. I already know your story. You're on the hunt for chocobo greens, am I right?

Japanese.Text:
そこでだ　野菜を分けるかわりに
ひとつ仕事を引き受けてくれないか？

English.Text: Well...I'd be willing to scratch your back─provided you'd be willing to scratch mine.

Japanese.Text:
話は聞いてるよ　なんでも屋くん
実は　きみに頼みたい仕事があるんだ

English.Text: No need to say a word. I already know your story. In fact, I've got a very special job with your name on it.

Japanese.Text:
私が仕切っている広場のカジノに
風変わりなカードバウターたちが居座っていてね

English.Text: My casino happens to be plagued by a gaggle of rather...eccentric Queen's Blood players.

Japanese.Text:
彼らを倒してもらいたいんだ
どうだろう　やってくれるかい？

English.Text: I'd love it if someone could take them down a notch or two. So, think you're up to the task?

Japanese.Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: I'll handle it.

Japanese.Text: 助かる

English.Text: Much obliged.

Japanese.Text:
変わった連中だが　腕は立つみたいでね
挑戦者が減ってしまって　困っていたんだ

English.Text: Outlandish though they are, they play a mean game─so mean that it's scaring away my clientele.

Japanese.Text: いちどでも勝ってみせれば　また盛りあがるだろう

English.Text:
I need someone to get out there
and prove they can be beaten.

Japanese.Text:
カードバウターは３人
広場のカジノにいるはずだ

English.Text:
Got three troublemakers in total.
Still looking for action, no doubt.

Japanese.Text: よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Thanks in advance.

Japanese.Text:
それじゃあ　うちのカードを見ていってくれ
カードバウトの役に立つかもしれない

English.Text:
Before you go though, you should take a look
at the cards I have for sale. I guarantee they'll
come in handy.

Japanese.Text: 話は聞いたよ　なんでも屋くん

English.Text: No need to say a word. I know your story.

Japanese.Text:
きみ　カジノにいたカードバウターを
倒してくれたんだって？

English.Text: I also happen to know that you've racked up a few QB wins at the casino.

Japanese.Text:
私は　カジノを仕切っていてね
連中には手を焼いていたんだ

English.Text: As its owner, allow me to express my gratitude. Some players have no restraint.

Japanese.Text:
カードバウターは全員で３人
その調子で　残りも倒してもらえると助かる

English.Text: Incidentally, there are three troublemakers in total. You'd be doing me a favor if you were to beat them all.

Japanese.Text:
そうだな　報酬は野菜でどうかな？
よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Here's an idea: do it and I'll give you some greens in exchange. Sound like a deal?

Japanese.Text:
カードバウターは全員で３人
その調子で　残りも倒してもらえると助かる

English.Text: There are three troublemakers in total, actually. If you were to beat them all, I'd be quite grateful.

Japanese.Text: よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Thanks in advance.

Japanese.Text:
それじゃあ　うちのカードを見ていってくれ
カードバウトの役に立つかもしれない

English.Text: Before you go, though, you should take a look at the cards I have for sale. I guarantee they'll come in handy.

Japanese.Text:
助かったよ　これは礼だ
受け取ってくれ

English.Text:
You did me a great favor.
Take this as a token of my thanks.

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　きみのような凄腕バウターに
オススメのカードがあるんだ

English.Text: Before you go, though, I have some cards I'd highly recommend for a player as skilled as yourself.

Japanese.Text: ぜひ　見ていってくれ

English.Text: You won't want to miss out.

Japanese.Text: 来たね　なんでも屋くん

English.Text: And there's the man of the hour.

Japanese.Text: きみが勝ってくれたおかげで

English.Text: Thanks to your efforts...

Japanese.Text:
下火になっていたクイーンズ・ブラッドに
また　火がついたよ

English.Text: demand for Queen's Blood is back and stronger than ever. It's at an all-time high!

Japanese.Text: これで　しばらくは稼げそうだ

English.Text: Which means my profits should be too.

Japanese.Text:
助かったよ　これは礼だ
受け取ってくれ

English.Text:
You did me a great favor.
Take this as a token of my thanks.

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　きみのような凄腕バウターに
オススメのカードがあるんだ

English.Text: Before you go, though, I have some cards I'd highly recommend for a player as skilled as yourself.

Japanese.Text: ぜひ　見ていってくれ

English.Text: You won't want to miss out.

Japanese.Text:
どれも自慢のカードたちだ
じっくり見ていってくれ

English.Text: Only cards of the highest quality, guaranteed. Browse as long as you like.

Japanese.Text: カードバウトの調子はどうだい？

English.Text: How are your QB games going?

Japanese.Text:
ウータイの放送は見た？
久しぶりに場が動きそうだ　面白くなってきた

English.Text: Did you see Wutai's broadcast? Sounds like things are about to get very interesting. Personally, I can't wait.

Japanese.Text: 依頼している仕事のほうも　しっかり頼むよ

English.Text: Remember: I'm still counting on you to get that job done.

Japanese.Text:
カジノにいるカードバウターたちは
倒してくれたかな？

English.Text: Have you managed to beat any of those Queen's Blood players yet?

Japanese.Text:
強すぎる者がいると　場が硬直してしまう
たまには負けてもらわないとね

English.Text: People lose interest when they start thinking they can't win. That's why it's important to shake things up once in a while.

Japanese.Text:
それと　くれぐれもカジノのことは上に漏らすなよ
牢獄暮らしはゴメンだろ？

English.Text: By the way, don't breathe a word about this to the folks upstairs...unless you want to find yourself behind bars again.

Japanese.Text:
気が向いたら　またクイーンズ・ブラッドを
盛りあげてってくれ

English.Text: I wouldn't mind you stoking more interest in Queen's Blood, if you're ever in the mood.

Japanese.Text: うちのカジノでは　勝ちすぎないでくれよ

English.Text: Feel free to win, but don't let it get out of hand.

Japanese.Text:
飲んだくれの酒場
ベイル・ジャンパーへようこそ

English.Text:
Welcome to Bail Jumper, watering hole
for the dregs of the Dustbowl.

Japanese.Text: あんた　野菜が欲しいんだって？

English.Text: Heard you're in the market for some greens.

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Maybe.

Japanese.Text:
なら　崖の上に畑があるからよ
勝手にとってっていいぞ

English.Text:
If so, I've got a garden up on the cliff.
Everything's yours for the taking.

Japanese.Text:
ずっとほったらかしだが　なんかあるだろ
ほら　これで行けるからよ

English.Text: Assuming there's anything to take. Haven't tended to it in ages. Here, go see for yourself.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　あそこはモンスターが出るからよ
気をつけるんだな

English.Text:
Be sure to keep an eye out for fiends, though.
Place is crawling with 'em.

Japanese.Text:
日当たりがいいところに畑を作ったものの
道が険しすぎてな　ほったらかしよ

English.Text: Found the one place around here that had a spot of green, but the road there's so rough, I stopped goin'.

Japanese.Text:
ずっと　放置しちまってるが
すこしは生き残ってんだろ

English.Text: Haven't tended to those plants in ages, but I'm sure something's still alive.

Japanese.Text:
邪魔になるから　ぼくはここで待ってるよ
野菜　頼んだよ

English.Text: I'll wait right here─leave the green huntin' to you. Wouldn't wanna get in the way.

Japanese.Text:
また行くの？
じゃあ　ここで待ってるね

English.Text:
Goin' for more?
Well, be here if you need me.

Japanese.Text: 野菜　なかったの？

English.Text: Didn't find nothin'?

Japanese.Text: 野菜　手に入ったみたいだね！

English.Text: Got your hands on some greens, huh?

Japanese.Text: おかえり

English.Text: Howdy.

Japanese.Text:
野菜は手に入ったか　そうか……
ほったらかし農業　案外イケるもんだな

English.Text: Got those greens you were after? Well, good. Guess my hands-off farming method works better than I thought.

Japanese.Text:
１杯やってくか？
味の保証はしねえがな

English.Text: Here to wet your whistle? I can fix you a drink if you like.

Japanese.Text: ウスいって文句言いやがったら　ぶん殴るからな

English.Text: Just don't go complainin' that it tastes "weak"─it's delicate.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイのことがあって
酒をちょっと　濃くしたんだ

English.Text: Been watering down the drinks less, what with the news outta Wutai.

Japanese.Text: 酔えるうちに　酔っとかねえとな

English.Text: Can't deal with that shit sober.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの人と聞くと
つい　息子の知り合いかもと期待してしまってね

English.Text: Sorry. Every time someone says they're from Midgar, we can't help but hope that person knows our son.

Japanese.Text: ここと違って　ミッドガルは広いだろうに

English.Text: Couple of bumpkins like us often forget it's a big city.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　すまない
すこし考え事をしていてね

English.Text: Sorry. Just...got caught up in my thoughts.

Japanese.Text: たいしたもてなしもできず　申し訳ない

English.Text: We ain't got much, but make yourselves at home.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　きみか
ザックスからは　なんの連絡もないよ

English.Text:
Oh, hello again.
Still no word from Zack, I'm afraid.

Japanese.Text:
まったく　戦争が始まるまえに
顔くらい見せればいいものを

English.Text: Way the world's going, least he could do is drop us a line─let his folks know he's okay.

Japanese.Text:
また戦争が始まるなんて噂もあるんでしょ？
ザックスも　忙しくなるのかねえ

English.Text: All this talk of another war has me worried... But I know I'm not the only mother afraid for her son.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　いらっしゃい
ザックスとは会えたのかい？

English.Text: Oh, welcome back. You didn't happen to run into Zack, did you?

Japanese.Text: ごめんなさい　簡単じゃないわよね

English.Text:
Forgive me.
I suppose it was a bit of a long shot, but...

Japanese.Text: あの子　元気にやってるならいいんだけどね

English.Text:
I just hope that, wherever he is,
my boy's happy and healthy.

Japanese.Text:
戦争で活躍すれば　新聞に載るんでしょう？
村にも届くといいんだけど

English.Text: Everyone loves war heroes, don't they? If Zack makes a name for himself, I'm sure we'll get to read all about him in the papers.

Japanese.Text: 戦争の英雄なんて　不謹慎よね

English.Text: Not that I want him to risk his life chasing fame and glory...

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　ライフスポットから
新たなモンスター情報を入手しました

English.Text: Good news, Cloud. I've unearthed information about a particularly rare monster!

Japanese.Text:
森の奥に巨大なモルボルが――
……失礼しました

English.Text:
Deep in the forest lurks a fiend so fo─
Uh, pardon me.

Japanese.Text:
森の奥に　巨大な『モルボル』が
生息しているようです

English.Text: So foul the mere mention of it induces nausea.

Japanese.Text:
生態系に影響を及ぼしている可能性があります
早急に調査と討伐をお願いします

English.Text: This noxious pest may be negatively impacting the biome. I suggest you expedite its removal.

Japanese.Text: それに　キリエさんに頼まれていた

English.Text: And regarding your request from Kyrie...

Japanese.Text:
『伝説の撒き餌』を作るのに必要な素材も
手に入るかもしれません

English.Text: this expedition might yield some materials you require for the bait.

Japanese.Text:
コスタの海で暴れるモンスターを倒すためにも
よろしくお願いしますね

English.Text: One good deed could in turn help you carry out another. Isn't that great?

Japanese.Text: クラウド様　グレートな勝利でした！

English.Text: Your victory was inspiring, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
森の豊かさゆえに生み出された怪物を
見事　森へと帰しましたね！

English.Text: That malodorous monstrosity has been sent back to the jungle depths from whence it came.

Japanese.Text:
いま入手されたのは　とても貴重な素材です
いつか　クラフトで使えるかもしれません

English.Text: That's a considerably rare material, Cloud. I suspect it will prove useful in crafting new creations.

Japanese.Text: 大切にとっておいてくださいね

English.Text: I suggest you hold on to it.

Japanese.Text:
これで　キリエさんに頼まれていた
『伝説の撒き餌』が作れますね

English.Text: With this, you should be able to craft the legendary bait Kyrie spoke of.

Japanese.Text:
このエサで　コスタの海を荒らしているモンスターを
おびき寄せられるはずです

English.Text: Those fiends befouling the beaches of Costa del Sol won't be able to resist it.

Japanese.Text:
手が空いたら　コスタの遊泳禁止区域に
向かってみください

English.Text: Head to the off-limits beach and take care of those monsters when you can.

Japanese.Text:
キリエさんに頼まれていた
『伝説の撒き餌』に必要な素材が手に入りましたね

English.Text: I believe this is one of the materials required to craft Kyrie's legendary bait.

Japanese.Text:
コスタの海を荒らしているモンスターを倒すためにも
はやく残りの素材を探しましょう

English.Text: But to lure those monsters out of the water, you'll need to acquire the other one first.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ライフストリームを調べたところ

English.Text: Cloud! By analyzing the lifespring data...

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代のクラフトチップが
埋まっている場所がわかりました

English.Text: I was able to locate an old republic transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉方面の渓谷から反応を感知しています

English.Text: It appears to be in the pass leading to the reactor.

Japanese.Text:
周囲には　ゴンガガ魔晄炉を建設した際の
ガレキが残っているようなので

English.Text: The terrain you will need to traverse is littered with scrap metal and other such debris.

Japanese.Text: 気をつけてくださいね

English.Text: Please watch your step.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
ライフスポットから得た情報を分析した結果
新たなクラフトチップを発見しました

English.Text: Upon analyzing the data from the lifespring, I was able to locate a new transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text: 森の中にある遺跡を探してみてください

English.Text: It's hidden within overgrown ruins!

Japanese.Text:
どうやら　共和国時代よりも
さらに昔の建造物が残っているみたいですよ

English.Text: If my readings are correct, these mysterious structures predate even the republic!

Japanese.Text: どんどん冒険らしくなってきましたね！

English.Text: Goodness, what an adventure!

Japanese.Text: モンスターの討伐　お疲れ様です

English.Text: That was a very impressive showing!

Japanese.Text:
戦闘データから作成したコンバットコースを
バトルシミュレーターに搭載しました

English.Text: So impressive, in fact, that I was able to devise a new combat trial for you.

Japanese.Text:
戦闘のバランス調整は　わたくしが担当しました
ぜひ　挑戦してみてくださいね！

English.Text: And I was in charge of calibrating its difficulty level! We put a lot of thought into this, so give it a try!

Japanese.Text: お疲れ様です！

English.Text: Great job!

Japanese.Text:
ゴンガガに生息するモンスターのデータも
かなり集まりましたね

English.Text: We've amassed a considerable amount of data on the fiends within the Gongaga region.

Japanese.Text:
マスターに代わって感謝いたします
ありがとうございます

English.Text: On Chadley's behalf, allow me to express my gratitude.

Japanese.Text:
勝手に代弁しないでください　まったくもう
もちろん感謝はしてますよ

English.Text: MAI, I must insist that you not put words in my mouth! Oh─but I am grateful, of course.

Japanese.Text:
お礼と言ってはなんですが
今回もコンバットコースをご用意しましたので

English.Text: And to prove it, I have made a new combat trial so that you may test your might.

Japanese.Text: また遊びにきてくださいね

English.Text: A fitting gift, I should think!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ゴンガガの討伐依頼は　これで完了です

English.Text: You have completed all battle assignments within the Gongaga region.

Japanese.Text:
また新しいコンバットコースを追加しておいたので
そちらもよろしくお願いします

English.Text: I've added a new trial to the simulator, which you may undertake at your leisure.

Japanese.Text:
マスターは気楽ですよね
遠くから見てるだけなんだから

English.Text: "At your leisure"? Cheeky, considering you're not risking life and limb.

Japanese.Text: 見ているだけなのは　ＭＡＩも同じでしょ

English.Text: Neither are they; it's VR.

Japanese.Text:
わたくしは　現場でしっかりと
クラウド様をサポートしています

English.Text: Know that I am ever aware of the hazards you must face, Cloud.

Japanese.Text:
みなさまが戦いやすいようにガイドをしつつ
ときにはジョークをはさんで　場をなごませて――

English.Text: I will endeavor to not only assist you, but ease the weight─

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　ＭＡＩがうるさかったら
いつでも言ってくださいね

English.Text: If MAI begins to grate, I'll gladly tweak her AI.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンガガの祠では
召喚獣『クジャタ』の知識が手に入るはずです

English.Text: The divine sanctuaries of Gongaga hold knowledge of Kujata.

Japanese.Text:
クジャタは　森の守護者として
昔からゴンガガの地に語り継がれてきました

English.Text: According to folklore, this fantastical being is the tutelary of the forest.

Japanese.Text: それだけに　魔晄炉で事故があった時は

English.Text: Thus, when disaster struck the mako reactor...

Japanese.Text:
クジャタの怒りを買ったせいだと
大騒ぎになったそうです

English.Text: many believed it the result of Kujata's bestial wrath.

Japanese.Text:
言い伝えによると　クジャタは
人々の前に現れるたびに姿を変えていたそうです

English.Text: Legend holds that each time Kujata appears before humans, it takes on a different form.

Japanese.Text:
時には炎をまとい　時には氷をまとい
時には雷をまとっていたと言います

English.Text: It's been seen wreathed in raging flame, cloaked in chilling ice, and bathed in crackling lightning.

Japanese.Text:
そのため　クジャタは自然を体現する存在として
長らくゴンガガの人々に崇められていました

English.Text: For this reason, the people of Gongaga have worshipped it as an embodiment of nature itself for generations.

Japanese.Text: ゴンガガの伝説によると　クジャタは

English.Text: As many local residents would attest...

Japanese.Text:
炎　氷　雷といった
３つの属性を操ることができます

English.Text: Kujata can harness and wield the elements of fire, ice, and lightning.

Japanese.Text:
さらに『トライディザスター』という
３つの属性を掛け合わせた大技があるのですが

English.Text: Furthermore, it can strike down its foes with the combined might of all three.

Japanese.Text: やはり熱くて寒くてビリビリするのでしょうか！

English.Text: A shocking, chilling, and burning attack!

Japanese.Text:
これで　ゴンガガにあるクリスタルは
すべて解析できました　お疲れ様です

English.Text: That concludes our analysis of the Gongaga summon crystals. Thank you.

Japanese.Text:
クジャタも　きっと鼻息を荒くして
喜んでいると思います

English.Text: I suspect Kujata is quite pleased to have joined your cause!

Japanese.Text:
でも　クラウドさんは
まだ召喚マテリアをお持ちじゃなかったですね

English.Text: Though you have yet to obtain the requisite materia, as I recall.

Japanese.Text:
まずは　バトルシミュレーターで
召喚獣に挑戦してみてください！

English.Text: You'll first need to confront the divine via the combat simulator!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド様
モルボルグレートの生息地に到着しました

English.Text: This is it, Cloud: we've arrived at the great malboro's domain.

Japanese.Text:
ニオイますね……
念入りに準備しておいたほうが良さそうです

English.Text: As I'm sure you've surmised from the aroma... Olfactory risk level: high.

Japanese.Text: モルボルグレートの出現を確認しました

English.Text: Great malboro presence detected.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンガガにいるモルボルは
森に住む多様な生物を捕食できるため
大きく成長する傾向があったのですが

English.Text: Malboros native to the Gongaga region have been known to grow exceptionally large thanks to their ravenous appetite for woodland fauna.

Japanese.Text:
この個体は　魔晄の影響を受けたことで
独自の進化を遂げたようです

English.Text: This specimen, however, has undergone a unique evolution due to mako exposure.

Japanese.Text:
強烈な腐臭を放つことで
死肉を食らう動物をおびき寄せつつ
毒素で弱らせて捕食するモルボルは
森の生態系を崩す　厄介者です

English.Text: It lures in carrion-feeders with a noxious odor, then uses toxins to weaken its prey. If allowed to thrive, the great malboro could destroy the entire ecosystem.

Japanese.Text:
悪臭を吸い込まないよう
しっかりと鼻をつまんで
慎重に調査を進めていきましょう！

English.Text: Facial coverings aren't required for this mission, but they are strongly recommended to reduce fume inhalation.

Japanese.Text: タッチミーの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare amphidex variant detected.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
繁殖期のオスは体の色を変え
メスにアピールするようです

English.Text: During mating season, the males undergo a chromatic change to attract females.

Japanese.Text: いまはまさに恋の季節のまっただなか

English.Text: Visual analysis suggests love is in the air!

Japanese.Text:
意中の相手を振り向かせようと
『鳴き袋』と呼ばれる器官を震わせて
求愛の歌を奏でるので～す♪

English.Text: In order to draw its intended mate's attention, the amphidex will let air resonate through its vocal sac, resulting in a romantic serenade.

Japanese.Text:
『カエルの嫁とり』と呼ばれる
タッチミーの鳴き声は非常に魅力的で
ほかの動物たちですら　我を忘れて
求愛に応じてしまうと言います

English.Text: The melodic nature of its mating call is so intoxicating that other species have been known to fall under the amphidex's spell and pursue an unrequited love.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド様がタッチミーの
モテテクニックを身につければ
向かうところ敵ナシですよ！

English.Text: If you learned how to woo others like the amphidex, you could defeat any enemy without a fight!

Japanese.Text:
フラワープラングの希少種を
確認しました

English.Text: Rare frightflower variant detected.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
フラワープラングは　種から
発芽するまでに数十年かかると言います

English.Text: It's not uncommon for the frightflower's germination period to last several decades.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　芽を出してからの
成長速度は驚異的で
瞬く間に　完全体へと姿を変えます

English.Text: Once it sprouts, however, the plant grows at an astonishing rate, fully maturing in a fraction of the time.

Japanese.Text:
完全体となったフラワープラングは
通りかかった動物に鋭い牙で噛みつき
血を吸い　肉を食べるようになります

English.Text: Adult frightflowers sink their fangs into unsuspecting animals that draw too close, draining their blood before supping on their flesh.

Japanese.Text:
世にも恐ろしい食肉植物の
餌食となってしまった獲物は――

English.Text: A carnivorous plant is frightening in itself, but the worst part is─

Japanese.Text:
ああ　これ以上は恐ろしすぎて
わたくしの口からはとても……！

English.Text: ...I'm sorry, but the details are far too gruesome for me to share!

Japanese.Text:
被害が広がらないように
迅速に　駆除をお願いします！

English.Text: Please exterminate this pest before you learn the truth firsthand!

Japanese.Text: グランドホーンの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare grandhorn variant detected.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
グランドホーンは
爪で器用に土を掘り返して
木の根や地中の虫を食べる
比較的　温厚なモンスターです

English.Text: Generally speaking, grandhorns are peaceful creatures, which use their claws not for combat, but for unearthing insects to eat.

Japanese.Text:
繁殖の季節になると
つがいで巣を作り子育てにいそしみます

English.Text: During mating season, they pair off to build nests and raise their young.

Japanese.Text:
パートナーが見つからなかった個体は
巣を作らず　育児中のつがいのため
なわばりを守る役割を担うそうです

English.Text: Those unable to find partners eventually take up the role of protector, guarding the nests of others, and keeping the newborns from harm.

Japanese.Text:
あの真っ赤な体の色は　外敵に対する
警戒色になっているようですね

English.Text: Their crimson coloration is a warning to all would-be trespassers: "keep out."

Japanese.Text:
協力しあってこの地を生き抜く
グランドホーンを調査し
しっかり学んでいきましょう！

English.Text: The social structure of grandhorn communities is definitely worthy of further investigation!

Japanese.Text: サベッジグランドホーンを確認しました

English.Text: Mutant grandhorn detected nearby.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
サベッジグランドホーンは
ゴンガガ魔晄炉の事故により
魔晄汚染されたグランドホーンです

English.Text: The reactor disaster had a profound influence on the local ecosystem─including this particular breed.

Japanese.Text:
原種や希少種と比べて
格段に　凶暴性が増しています

English.Text: Prolonged exposure to mako has reduced their impulse control.

Japanese.Text:
本来の社会性は完全に失われており
仲間のなわばりであっても　容赦なく
荒らしまわることがあるようです

English.Text: Unlike most grandhorns, this variant lacks a sense of community, invading and upending territory belonging to others.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄汚染による動植物への影響は
いまだ未知の部分が多く
一刻も早い解明が望まれています

English.Text: The long-term effects of mako poisoning on both flora and fauna are still not fully understood─but the world needs to know.

Japanese.Text: 調査のご協力を　お願いします！

English.Text: I hope you'll assist me in the investigation!

Japanese.Text: ヘビータンクを確認しました

English.Text: Maloceros detected nearby.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
ヘビータンクは　古くより
農作業などの労働力として
大切にされてきました

English.Text: Farmers have long employed the maloceros as a source of agricultural labor.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　徐々に飼育数は減少していき
村で飼われていた最後の数頭も
魔晄炉の事故をきっかけに逃げ出し
すっかり野生化してしまったそうです

English.Text: Sadly, the beasts' numbers have dwindled over time, and in the chaos following the Gongaga reactor accident, the few remaining maloceros escaped and went completely feral.

Japanese.Text:
本来は草食でおとなしい性格なのですが
近年は集団で他のモンスターを襲う姿も
目撃されています

English.Text: Although these herbivores tend to have a rather calm disposition, some have been spotted traveling in herds and attacking other animals.

Japanese.Text:
おそらくは
魔晄の影響によるものでしょう

English.Text: This change is likely due to mako exposure...

Japanese.Text:
ほかにも　様々な変質が起きている
可能性があります

English.Text: and I suspect it's only one of many abnormal developments.

Japanese.Text:
くれぐれも気をつけて
調査を進めてください

English.Text: Please exercise caution during your investigation.

Japanese.Text: バジガンディの希少種を確認しました

English.Text: Rare gagighandi variant detected.

Japanese.Text: これより　ガイドを開始します

English.Text: Commencing guidance protocol.

Japanese.Text:
特徴的な牙が目を引くバジガンディは
元々　遠く離れた別の大陸に
生息していたと言われています

English.Text: Known best for its distinct fangs, the gagighandi is believed to have migrated to these lands from a faraway continent.

Japanese.Text:
かの土地では　神聖な生物として
王族の紋章に用いられていたそうです

English.Text: There it was revered as a sacred creature, and featured in the family crests of royalty.

Japanese.Text:
バジガンディが海を越え
ゴンガガに姿を現したのは
おそらく　この土地の豊富な魔晄に
引き寄せられてのことでしょう

English.Text: While it's unclear how and why the gagighandi became established in Gongaga, some suspect it was drawn to the region's mako deposits.

Japanese.Text:
最近になって　急速に生息エリアを
広げているようです

English.Text: Recent reports suggest the creatures have begun to expand their territory.

Japanese.Text:
ゴンガガの生態系が
外来種によってどう変化したのか

English.Text: Their presence has undoubtedly altered the Gongaga ecosystem...

Japanese.Text:
それを知るためにも
討伐調査をお願いします

English.Text: and I hope you will assist me in my quest to find out how!

Japanese.Text: ピヨ～　帰っておいで～

English.Text: Please come back, Mr. Birdie!

Japanese.Text: ピヨピヨー！

English.Text: Here, birdy bird!

Japanese.Text: 小鳥さーん　エサの時間だよ～

English.Text: Mr. Birdie! It's time for dinner!

Japanese.Text: ピヨちゃーん　どこいったの～？

English.Text: Mr. Birdieee, where aaare you?

Japanese.Text: なんか　困ってんのか？

English.Text: You kids need some help?

Japanese.Text: あん？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text: おじさんとは　口をきいちゃダメなの

English.Text: Mommy said I'm not s'posed to talk to you.

Japanese.Text:
ああ……そうか
じゃあよ　このおじさんに話してみろ

English.Text: Oh, is that so... Well then, why don't you talk to this old fella instead?

Japanese.Text:
こう見えて強いんだ
なんでも解決してくれるぜ　なあ？

English.Text: He's tough─tougher than he looks─and real good at solvin' people's problems. Right?

Japanese.Text: このおじさんが　なんでも解決してくれるぜ

English.Text: "Why don't you talk to this old fella instead?"

Japanese.Text: おじさんじゃない

English.Text: "Old fella"?

Japanese.Text: 子供には甘いな

English.Text: Someone's a softie.

Japanese.Text: 安くないぞ

English.Text: For the right price.

Japanese.Text:
こまけぇなあ
オレがおじさんなら　おまえもおじさんだ

English.Text: Don't get all bent outta shape. 'Sides, I'll always be older than you.

Japanese.Text: 雑にまとめるな

English.Text: Whatever.

Japanese.Text: 子供に優しくすんのが　大人の役目だ

English.Text: 'Course I'm soft on kids. Helpin' 'em's what we do.

Japanese.Text: 覚えておこう

English.Text: News to me.

Japanese.Text: 子供から取る気か

English.Text: You chargin' kids now?

Japanese.Text: あんたが立て替えるんだ

English.Text: You can pick up their tab.

Japanese.Text: それで　なにがあったんだ

English.Text: Well? What's the problem?

Japanese.Text: あのね　ピヨちゃんがどこか行っちゃったの

English.Text: Uh, y'see, Mr. Birdie ran away and hasn't come back...

Japanese.Text: ピヨちゃんは　なかよしの小鳥なんだよ

English.Text: Oh, Mr. Birdie is a bird friend of ours.

Japanese.Text: おじさんみたいに　髪がツンツンしてて

English.Text: His head is all pointy─kinda like yours, mister.

Japanese.Text: それって　クラピヨのことじゃねえか？

English.Text: "Pointy," huh? I bet they're talkin' about Cloud Jr.

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ？

English.Text: Who's that?

Japanese.Text:
その鳥の名前だ
モンスターに襲われていたのを助けたんだ

English.Text: Your bird friend. He had a run-in with a nasty fiend, and we saved his tiny behind.

Japanese.Text: そうだったんだ

English.Text: No way!

Japanese.Text:
みんな　ピヨが砂漠のほうに行ったって
じぃじが見たんだ

English.Text: You guys! Grandpa said he saw Mr. Birdie heading toward the desert!

Japanese.Text: ええ　砂漠？　どうしよう……

English.Text: What!? But we aren't allowed to go all the way out there.

Japanese.Text: おじさんたちにまかせろ　見つけてやる

English.Text: You just leave it to us. We'll find your friend.

Japanese.Text: ほんと？

English.Text: Really?

Japanese.Text: おうよ

English.Text: Promise.

Japanese.Text:
じぃじが言うには　共和国時代に使ってた鳥小屋が
砂漠にいくつか残ってるんだって

English.Text: Great! Grandpa said there's some old birdhouses out in the desert that people built back in the republic days.

Japanese.Text: そこにワナを仕掛けるといいって言ってた

English.Text: He said those are good places to set traps!

Japanese.Text:
ワナになるバードトラップは
アイテムクラフトで作れるよ

English.Text: Oh, and my mommy told me you can craft 'em yourself if you've got the right chip.

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　じゃあ
まずはワナを作らねえとな

English.Text: Huh... In that case, we'd better figure out how to transmute us some traps.

Japanese.Text:
安心しろ
鳥のワナなら作れるからよ　なあ？

English.Text: Don't you worry. We'll get those bird traps ready in no time, won't we?

Japanese.Text:
安心しろ
鳥のワナならもう持ってるからよ

English.Text: One step ahead of ya. Already got the tools we need to bag that bird.

Japanese.Text:
ホント？
じゃあ　あとは砂漠に仕掛けるだけだね

English.Text: Oh, cool! Then all you gotta do is go into the desert and find him!

Japanese.Text: 共和国時代は　よく鳥をとってたんだって

English.Text: Grandpa said in the old days, they used to trap birds all the time.

Japanese.Text: なんか　ちょっとかわいそう

English.Text: What? But why would they hunt their friends?

Japanese.Text:
傷つけないワナを使ってたんだって　でも
いまはもう売ってないって　じぃじが言ってた

English.Text: They didn't hunt 'em─just caught 'em for fun and stuff. But Grandpa said you can't find traps like that anywhere anymore.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　いちから作るしかないか

English.Text: So we just gotta make new ones instead!

Japanese.Text: おじさんが　ワナの設計図を手に入れたって！

English.Text: Old dude said he got sha-matics for a trap!

Japanese.Text: さすが　あとは作るだけだね！

English.Text:
Wow, that's great!
Now he's just gotta make some!

Japanese.Text: みんな　鳥のワナが完成したって！

English.Text: Hey guys! They said they got the bird traps!

Japanese.Text:
ホント？
じゃあ　あとは砂漠に仕掛けるだけだね

English.Text: Oh, cool! Then all you gotta do is go into the desert and find him!

Japanese.Text: クラピヨのこと　頼んだよ

English.Text: Make sure Cloud Jr.'s safe, okay?

Japanese.Text:
砂漠か～　クラピヨ
カラカラになってないよな

English.Text: If he's out here, he must be pretty thirsty. I hope he finds some water.

Japanese.Text: じぃじは腰が痛いから　手伝えないって

English.Text: I asked Grandpa to help us look, but he said his back hurt.

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ　おなか空かせてないかな

English.Text: Cloud Jr. must be starving! Poor thing...

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ　無事だといいけど

English.Text: I hope Cloud Jr.'s okay out there.

Japanese.Text: よっしゃ　クラピヨ探しといくか

English.Text: Alright then. Let's go find our bird buddy.

Japanese.Text: あんたに懐いていたからな

English.Text: He'll definitely be happy to see you.

Japanese.Text: まあ　それもあるが

English.Text: At least somebody will be.

Japanese.Text:
オレは　村にでっけえ借りがあるからよ
すこしでも返してえんだ

English.Text: I understand there's no makin' amends for how I did these people wrong, but...I wanna help. I need to help.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉の爆発は　あんたのせいじゃない

English.Text: What happened with the reactor wasn't your fault, you know.

Japanese.Text: んなことは　わかってる

English.Text: I coulda told ya that.

Japanese.Text:
そもそも　魔晄炉の建設だって
言い出したのは神羅　オレは乗っかっただけだ

English.Text: No, I ain't the one who proposed building the damn thing─that was Shinra. Just hitched my wagon to it.

Japanese.Text: そうだな

English.Text: Right.

Japanese.Text:
ってな　責任逃れの口実ばかり
考えた時期があった

English.Text: Took a while to accept that, though. Hell, I did everything in my power to avoid thinkin' about it at all.

Japanese.Text:
でもな　それじゃあオレの気が済まねえんだ
コレルに関しちゃあ　とことん背負う気でいる

English.Text: Eventually, I realized the excuses I was clingin' to weren't makin' me feel any better. What happened in Corel, that's my burden to bear.

Japanese.Text: ほどほどにしてくれ

English.Text: Just don't go breakin' your back.

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ探しも罪滅ぼし

English.Text: Yeah, well, it's stronger than you think.

Japanese.Text:
子供たちのためじゃねえ
結局　オレのためだ

English.Text: I won't pretend it's all for the kids. End of the day, I'm doin' this for me.

Japanese.Text:
おっ　これでクラピヨを
捕まえられるんじゃねえか？

English.Text: Hey. That oughta work for our Cloud Jr.-catchin' purposes, right?

Japanese.Text:
あとは　これを砂漠に仕掛けるだけだな
待ってろよ～　クラピヨ

English.Text: Just gotta place 'em in the wastelands now. Hang tight, Cloud Jr.! We'll have you back home in no time.

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ探し　忘れてねえだろうな

English.Text: Think we oughta do somethin' for Cloud Jr. Don't you?

Japanese.Text: トラップを仕掛けよう

English.Text: Kid's gotta eat.

Japanese.Text: バードトラップを仕掛けますか？

English.Text: Set the bait for Cloud Jr.?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Japanese.Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Japanese.Text: しばらく様子見だな

English.Text: And now, we wait.

Japanese.Text: 残りのふたつも仕掛けちまおうぜ

English.Text: Might as well rig the other traps, then.

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルにいた時は　もっとシンプルだった

English.Text: Life was a hell of a lot simpler back in ol' Midgar.

Japanese.Text:
神羅っていう大悪党をぶっつぶせれば
それでよかったからな

English.Text: We were good, Shinra was bad, and if we took 'em out, world would be alright.

Japanese.Text: いまは違うのか

English.Text: So, what's changed?

Japanese.Text: 神羅をぶっつぶすのは　もちろん変わんねえ

English.Text: Not a damn thing. Shinra's still goin' down.

Japanese.Text:
ただよ　やつら相手にがむしゃらになってたのも
いま思うと　目を逸らしていただけなのかもなって

English.Text: But comin' back here, I see how I got tunnel vision. And not 'cause Shinra was all I had to think about. It's 'cause I didn't want to think about anything else.

Japanese.Text:
星を救うっていう　でっけえ目的のほかに
オレには向き合わねえといけねえことがある

English.Text: Savin' the planet's important, but I put a lot of personal stuff on the back burner─and I shouldn't've.

Japanese.Text:
村の連中や　ダインと会って
それがわかったぜ

English.Text: Dyne and the others helped give me that clarity... Just wish I coulda got it sooner.

Japanese.Text:
おまえにゃどう見えてるか知らねえが
こう見えて　オレも変わったんだ

English.Text: I expect you'll find this hard to believe, but I've actually changed quite a bit since my younger days.

Japanese.Text:
まず　ティファの説教が効いたな
スラムで出会った頃の話だ　マリンのことでな

English.Text: Thanks to Tifa, mostly. She really set me straight─'specially as a parent. Wouldn't be half the father I am today without her.

Japanese.Text: ティファが？　意外だ

English.Text: That so? What'd she do?

Japanese.Text: な　よっぽどのことだったんだよな

English.Text: Oh, got fed up with my bullshit and tore me a new one.

Japanese.Text:
マリンには　安心して眠れる場所と
清潔な環境が必要だって怒ってよ

English.Text: Started yellin' about how a kid like Marlene needed a proper roof over her head─somewhere safe and clean.

Japanese.Text: それまでは　野宿だったんだ

English.Text: Said sleepin' outside was risky.

Japanese.Text: どうかしてる

English.Text: She was right.

Japanese.Text:
猛省したぜ
で　次はアバランチだな

English.Text: Sure was. And not just her: the whole team helped me get my act together.

Japanese.Text:
暴走機関車スタイルで
走りながら考えて　仲間を引っ張ってきたが

English.Text: I used to be a runaway train, chargin' full speed ahead and draggin' folks along for the ride.

Japanese.Text: 結局　走るだけで考えてなかった

English.Text: Never thought about hittin' the brakes─or anything else.

Japanese.Text:
衝突や脱線が多くてよお
いらねえトラブル抱え込んで

English.Text: Had my fair share of crashes and went off the rails a few times... Caused a lotta trouble for those guys.

Japanese.Text: ああ　いまはそこまでじゃない

English.Text: Well, I'd say you managed to get yourself back on track.

Japanese.Text: 縁がオレを変えた

English.Text: I couldn'ta done it without 'em.

Japanese.Text:
オレたちの出会い
クラピヨとの出会いも　きっと意味がある

English.Text: They came into my life for a reason─like you did, Cloud. Junior too.

Japanese.Text: 大事にしようぜ

English.Text: I know it in my heart.

Japanese.Text: これでワナは　ぜんぶ仕掛けたな

English.Text: Well, that's the last of the traps.

Japanese.Text:
そろそろ　ほかのトラップに
掛かってるかもしれない

English.Text: Our bird might've already been caught in one of the others.

Japanese.Text: よし　戻るか

English.Text: Only one way to find out.

Japanese.Text: なっ　この野郎～！

English.Text: Hey, take a hike! That food ain't for you!

Japanese.Text: チッ！　せっかく作ったワナを壊しやがって

English.Text: Went through the trouble of makin' that trap, and look how they treat it! What a waste.

Japanese.Text: 次がある

English.Text: We've got more.

Japanese.Text: おいおい　クラピヨのエサを食うんじゃねえ！

English.Text: Not again. Quit stealin' Junior's food!

Japanese.Text: やってくれるぜ

English.Text: Didn't even leave a crumb.

Japanese.Text: まだトラップはある

English.Text: Let's check the other.

Japanese.Text: まだ　なんにも掛かってねえな

English.Text: Looks the same as when we left it.

Japanese.Text: ほかのトラップを確認してみよう

English.Text: Then let's go and check another.

Japanese.Text: あれ　クラピヨじゃねえか

English.Text: Hey, I think we finally found our boy.

Japanese.Text: 見ろ！

English.Text: Look!

Japanese.Text: ピーーーッ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Japanese.Text: させるか！

English.Text: Let's move!

Japanese.Text: ピヨピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep cheep!

Japanese.Text: ったく　心配かけやがって

English.Text: You had us scared, Junior! Thought you were gonna wind up monster chow.

Japanese.Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Japanese.Text:
おっ　なんだ
ひとりで帰れんのか？

English.Text: Is that your way of sayin' you're good on your own?

Japanese.Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Japanese.Text: もう迷子になるんじゃねえぞ

English.Text: But go straight home, y'hear me?

Japanese.Text: ピピ！

English.Text: Cheep cheep!

Japanese.Text:
あっ　おじさん
クラピヨが帰ってきたよ！

English.Text: Oh! Hey, mister, he's back! Cloud Jr. came back!

Japanese.Text:
だろ？　ちゃんと帰るように
しっかり言い聞かせといたからな

English.Text: 'Course he did. When we found him, we said, "Your friends're lookin' for ya. You head straight home."

Japanese.Text: そうだったんだ　ありがとう！

English.Text: No wonder! Thank you so much!

Japanese.Text: どういたしまして

English.Text: Hey, just doin' our job!

Japanese.Text:
いつか　マリンといっしょにここに来てよ
ぜんぶ話してやりてえんだ

English.Text:
Hope I can bring Marlene back here one day.
Tell her about her home and everything else.

Japanese.Text: それは　いいことなのか

English.Text: Uh...you sure that's a good idea?

Japanese.Text: 贖罪だからな

English.Text: I owe it to her father.

Japanese.Text:
あんたは良くても
マリンにとって　いいことなのか？

English.Text: You'll feel better, maybe, but... how do you think she'll feel?

Japanese.Text: 俺にはわからない

English.Text: Don't know, man...

Japanese.Text: どうした？

English.Text: ...What's up?

Japanese.Text: おじさんから離れろって　父さんが言ってるって

English.Text: My dad says we're supposed to stay away from you... Sorry.

Japanese.Text: そうか　そりゃ仕方ねえな

English.Text: That so...? Well, don't wanna get you in trouble.

Japanese.Text: オレたちは行くから　クラピヨと遊んでやれ

English.Text: Us old fellas gotta go. Take care of Cloud Jr.

Japanese.Text: ぼく　おじさん好きだよ！

English.Text: Thanks again for all your help, mister!

Japanese.Text: ありがとうな

English.Text: Don't mention it!

Japanese.Text: たーんとおたべ

English.Text: Go on, eat up!

Japanese.Text: こいつ　どれぐらい大きくなるのかな？

English.Text: He's still growin' right? How big's he gonna get?

Japanese.Text: じぃじが言うには　そこそこ大きくなるって

English.Text: Grandpa said he'll prob'ly grow real big─bigger than me!

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ　もう遠くへいっちゃダメですよ

English.Text: No more running away, Cloud Jr. You hear me?

Japanese.Text: クラピヨ　ウチに連れて帰りた～い

English.Text: I wonder if Mommy would let Cloud Jr. stay with us.

Japanese.Text:
はやくでかくなって
モンスターを倒せるようになれよ

English.Text: Someday, you're gonna be big and strong and scare away all the monsters!

Japanese.Text:
クラピヨの毛って
なんでこんなにツンツンしてんだろ

English.Text: I thought feathers are supposed to be soft. How come yours are all pointy?

Japanese.Text:
じぃじは昔　凄腕のハンターだったって
ホントかな？

English.Text: Grandpa said he used to be the best hunter in the world. Musta been before he hurt his back.
